paras.en: PetSnowy OilClear AI Series Wireless Weight-Sensing Pet Fountain for $90: I was initially intrigued and confused by this fountain, but by the end of testing, I actually ended up throwing it away. (Mother Gaia weeps.) One big sell is the built-in gravity-sensing technology that tracks your pet’s daily water intake while accounting for natural evaporation. The other is a head-scratcher: There's real-time thermostatic heating to keep water warm year-round. Huh?? Do pets like warm water? Is this a thing I'm not aware of? It's rechargeable and can be operated cord-free with the battery, and it has a connected app to monitor usage. It has sensor-activated smart water dispensing, which dispenses water when cats approach. As time went on, the flow got weaker and weaker, and after about two weeks of testing, the water stopped flowing altogether. I was not able to fix it.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Petcube Ceramic Pet Water Fountain for $90: I really wanted to love this fountain; although its basin is plastic, it has a ceramic top, which is more hygienic than plastic (plus, I had never tested a ceramic model before), and the brand makes some of my favorite pet cameras. However, setup was a bit confusing; it took a long time to get the base charged to power the fountain's water flow, and the sensor to start the water flow can only be triggered from one side, making placement awkward. After a few days, it would only run while plugged in. Soon, its stream was barely strong enough to reach the top, and after just over a week, it stopped working altogether. Also, it's overly expensive for what it is.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Cat Mate 3-Level Pet Fountain for $28: This tall automatic Cat Mate fountain sets itself apart with three tiers for cats who like to drink at every level. Cleaning the motor requires disassembly using tools and extended soaking. Because of the long distance the water has to travel, it evaporates quickly and needs to be refilled about every other day. Plastic also harbors bacteria, and previous plastic models I’ve owned have had mold issues. The basin is quite large and sits flat. Because of this, some debris lingers in the front rather than flowing to the filter system behind. The plastic material and fact the basin doesn’t direct debris toward the filter caused this fountain to become dirtier faster than others.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Whisker City Free Fall Cat Fountain for $30: This huge fountain is better suited for dogs, with its 150-fluid-ounce bowl and waterfall design. Although the basin has a small splash pad to help offset the waterfall noise, this was one of the loudest fountains I tested. The evaporation from the waterfall-like system also caused me to refill it every other day. Because of the structure of the fountain, my cats had to bend their head at an awkward angle. They tended to avoid drinking from the basin because of that, and their heads got slightly wet from the splatter of the waterfall. The basin is also not angled, so crumbs and debris sit at the bottom of the bowl.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Petkit EverSweet Solo SE for $26: This very simple, straightforward fountain has a square-shaped body, is translucent to easily see water levels from the outside, and has a nearly silent 25-decibel wireless pump to circulate water from the basin to the top level, where 2 ounces of water are always available for drinking, even in case of power failure. The basin sits on a base and all parts easily detach, making it easier to clean. This fountain doesn’t have multiple modes or an associated app—you’ll have to check water levels manually. I noticed this fountain didn't keep water as cold as some of the others, and because of the design of the top, debris often pooled in the dipped areas, which required more frequent cleaning.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: I used each fountain for at least a week as my cats’ main water source. As mentioned, I noted the ease of setup, evaluated parts and filters, and generally compared the various types of water fountains—spigot, bubbling, or waterfall. Some flows were continuous, and some were intermittent (my cats didn’t prefer intermittent). Cats may also be intrigued and want to play with the machine rather than drink, so be sure to give them time and keep another water source around until they are fully adjusted to the new gadget.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Cats sometimes struggle to consume enough water, which can lead to potentially lethal UTIs and blockages, especially in male cats. This is one of the reasons vets are moving toward encouraging owners to give their cat at least a partially wet-food diet, as this helps them consume more moisture, especially since cats don’t naturally drink as much as dogs. Also, unlike dogs, cats are generally quite particular in their likes and dislikes, and cats can see stagnant water as potentially harmful. (If the cat were in the wild, stagnant water has more potential for harmful bacteria). Cats are more drawn to moving water in nature, and these fountains help encourage them to drink more by emulating what they’re naturally drawn to.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: While automatic water fountains are better for cats' overall water consumption, they do require a bit more work and money. Rather than refilling a bowl, these take a little elbow grease—but it’s worth it for your cat’s health. Along with routine refilling and cleaning, you’ll need to disassemble the fountain to clean all parts, including using a brush for the bowl and tubes. You may also have to disassemble the motor to deep-clean mineral buildup. There are different types of filtration cartridges in specific shapes for the brand’s fountains, which require you to buy and change out filters, usually monthly but sometimes more often.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Let’s be honest, a lot of these fountains are pretty much the same. I looked especially for the overall design—I am a fiend for stainless steel because of the potential of porous plastic harboring harmful bacteria. I also favor a wide reservoir without high sides to help reduce the chance of whisker fatigue. I prefer fountains that have a small basin reservoir of water available at all times, in case of low water levels or power failure. I took into account ease of setting up, refilling, and cleaning, as well as overall design. And of course, there were some that my cats took to straight away, and some they didn’t seem to favor as much.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: After prolonged testing, I now look for these three things and encourage you to as well: a cordless pump for easier (and safer) cleaning, hygienic stainless-steel construction, and a window to monitor water levels (especially if it's not connected to an app).
paras.zh: 经过长时间的测试，我现在寻找这三件事，并鼓励您也这样做：无绳泵，以便更轻松（更安全）地清洁，卫生的不锈钢结构，以及监控水位的窗口（特别是如果它没有连接到应用程序）。

articles.title: DOJ clears Fox's $22B Roku acquisition after antitrust investigation

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- The Justice Department closed its antitrust investigation into Fox Corp.'s $22 billion acquisition of streaming platform Roku after the media company agreed to measures aimed at protecting competing streaming services, officials said Friday.
paras.zh: 11月7日（ UPI ） -官员周五表示，在媒体公司同意旨在保护竞争性流媒体服务的措施后，司法部结束了对福克斯公司220亿美元收购流媒体平台Roku的反垄断调查。

paras.en: The decision allowed Fox to complete its acquisition of Roku, combining its television, news and sports operations with a streaming platform reaching more than 100 million households worldwide.
paras.zh: 这一决定使福克斯能够完成对Roku的收购，将其电视、新闻和体育运营与全球超过1亿户家庭的流媒体平台相结合。

paras.en: Federal regulators had investigated whether the merger would reduce competition or allow Fox to favor its own programming over rival content on Roku devices.
paras.zh: 联邦监管机构已经调查了这次合并是否会减少竞争，还是会让福克斯更青睐自己的节目，而不是Roku设备上的竞争对手内容。

paras.en: DOJ officials said its investigation found that competition from other streaming platforms would likely prevent the combined company from harming consumers.
paras.zh: 司法部官员表示，其调查发现，来自其他流媒体平台的竞争可能会阻止合并后的公司伤害消费者。

paras.en: Regulators also determined that Fox would risk losing customers and damaging Roku's business if it restricted access to competing services.
paras.zh: 监管机构还确定，如果福克斯限制获得竞争性服务，它将面临失去客户和损害Roku业务的风险。

paras.en: As part of the agreement, Fox committed to keeping Roku's platform open to competing content providers for at least three years.
paras.zh: 作为协议的一部分，福克斯承诺将Roku的平台向竞争对手的内容提供商开放至少三年。

paras.en: Fox CEO Lachlan Murdoch said the acquisition would strengthen the company's digital business while preserving Roku's role as a platform for competing services.
paras.zh: 福克斯首席执行官拉克兰·默多克（ Lachlan Murdoch ）表示，此次收购将加强该公司的数字业务，同时保留Roku作为竞争服务平台的角色。

paras.en: "Beginning today, our top priority for the combined company is to continue to relentlessly serve audiences and partners, while reinforcing the openness and choice that is the essence of the Roku platform," Murdoch said in a statement Friday.
paras.zh: 默多克周五在一份声明中表示： “从今天开始，我们合并后的公司的首要任务是继续为受众和合作伙伴提供不懈的服务，同时加强开放性和选择性，这是Roku平台的本质。”

articles.title: Laboratory used NFL, N.Y. Giants perks to get patient referrals

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- A New Jersey laboratory has paid more than $13 million to settle allegations that it provided doctors with free tickets to New York Giants games in exchange for patient referrals, officials said Friday.
paras.zh: 11月7日（ UPI ） -官员周五表示，新泽西州的一个实验室支付了超过1300万美元来解决指控，即它向医生提供免费的纽约巨人队比赛门票，以换取患者转诊。

paras.en: The company, Quest Diagnostics, was under allegations that it violated federal anti-kickback laws and submitted false claims to Medicare and Medicaid programs in New York and New Jersey.
paras.zh: Quest Diagnostics公司被指控违反了联邦反回扣法，并向纽约和新泽西州的Medicare和Medicaid计划提交了虚假索赔。

paras.en: Federal prosecutors said Quest used luxury suites at MetLife Stadium, VIP training camp access and exclusive events with former Giants players to encourage healthcare providers and executives to send laboratory testing business to them.
paras.zh: 联邦检察官表示， Quest使用了大都会人寿体育场的豪华套房， VIP训练营门票以及与前巨人队球员的独家活动，以鼓励医疗保健提供者和高管向他们发送实验室测试业务。

paras.en: The kickback scheme lasted from July 2013 to August 2022.
paras.zh: 回扣计划从2013年7月持续到2022年8月。

paras.en: Quest entered into a naming rights and sponsorship agreement with the Giants in 2013, gaining access to stadium suites that prosecutors said were used to entertain clients.
paras.zh: Quest于2013年与巨人队签订了命名权和赞助协议，获得了体育场套房的使用权，检察官称这些套房用于招待客户。

paras.en: The perks included food, alcohol, parking and occasional field access during pregame warmups.
paras.zh: 这些福利包括食物、酒精、停车和赛前热身期间偶尔进入现场。

paras.en: Selected customers were also invited to watch team practices from VIP areas, meet players, obtain autographs and participate in football-themed events with former Giants players.
paras.zh: 选定的客户还受邀观看VIP区域的球队练习，与球员见面，获得签名，并与前巨人队球员一起参加足球主题活动。

paras.en: "Kickbacks to referring providers, especially by lab companies, corrupt medical judgment, lead to unnecessary lab testing, cause providers to steer patients to labs that offer inducements, and squander taxpayer money," U.S. Attorney Robert Frazer said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国检察官罗伯特·弗雷泽（ Robert Frazer ）在一份声明中说： “对转诊提供者的回扣，特别是实验室公司的回扣，腐败的医疗判断，导致不必要的实验室测试，导致提供者将患者引导到提供诱因的实验室，并浪费纳税人的钱。”

articles.title: Nine dead after gunman opens fire in Poland's Krakow market square

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- Nine people were killed and at least 16 others wounded Saturday after a gunman opened fire in a crowded market square in Krakow, Poland.
paras.zh: 11月7日（ UPI ） -星期六，一名枪手在波兰克拉科夫一个拥挤的市场广场开火，造成9人死亡，至少16人受伤。

paras.en: Authorities later discovered three additional bodies at the suspect's home, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员说，当局后来在嫌疑人家中又发现了三具尸体。

paras.en: Six people were killed when a 25-year-old Polish man drove into Krakow's historic Main Market Square shortly before 3 p.m. and began shooting at pedestrians.
paras.zh: 一名25岁的波兰男子在下午3点前不久开车进入克拉科夫历史悠久的主市场广场，并开始向行人开枪，造成6人死亡。

paras.en: Four women and two men died in the attack, including three Polish women. Two other victims have not been identified, authorities said.
paras.zh: 四名妇女和两名男子在袭击中丧生，其中包括三名波兰妇女。当局表示，另外两名受害者尚未确定。

paras.en: The suspect was dressed in military-style clothing and armed with military-grade weapons. He exchanged gunfire with police before being wounded and taken to a hospital for surgery.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人身着军装，手持军用级武器。他与警方交火，然后受伤并被送往医院接受手术。

paras.en: Two police officers were injured during the confrontation. One was shot three times and remained in serious condition.
paras.zh: 两名警察在对抗中受伤。其中一人被枪击三次，情况仍然严重。

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said three additional bodies, belonging to two women and a man, were discovered during a search of the suspect's home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, approximately 125 miles north of Krakow.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克（ Donald Tusk ）说，在搜查嫌疑人位于克拉科夫以北约125英里的Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski的家时，又发现了三具尸体，分别属于两名妇女和一名男子。

paras.en: Tusk said there were "strong indications" the three were members of the suspect's immediate family.
paras.zh: 图斯克说，有“强烈迹象”表明这三人是嫌疑人的直系亲属。

paras.en: Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said investigators believed the gunman was influenced by far-right ideology and held extreme nationalist views.
paras.zh: 内政部长马尔钦·基尔文斯基（ Marcin Kierwiński ）表示，调查人员认为枪手受到极右翼意识形态的影响，并持有极端的民族主义观点。

paras.en: "Everything points to the fact that the shooter was influenced by far-right ideology, a matter that will also be subject to investigation," Kierwiński told reporters.
paras.zh: “一切都表明枪手受到极右翼意识形态的影响，这一问题也将受到调查，” Kierwiński告诉记者。

paras.en: Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz denied reports that the suspect had served in the Polish military.
paras.zh: 国防部长Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz否认有关嫌疑人曾在波兰军队服役的报道。

paras.en: "The man was not and is not a soldier in the Polish Armed Forces and has never had anything to do with the military," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “这名男子过去不是也不是波兰武装部队的士兵，也从未与军队有任何关系。”

paras.en: Authorities discovered additional weapons and ammunition in the suspect's vehicle, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，当局在嫌疑人的车辆中发现了其他武器和弹药。

paras.en: Among those wounded were five foreign nationals from Britain, Austria, Germany, Portugal and Russia.
paras.zh: 受伤者中有五名来自英国、奥地利、德国、葡萄牙和俄罗斯的外国人。

paras.en: Two horses pulling tourist carriages were shot but survived, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员说，两匹拉着旅游车厢的马被枪杀，但幸存下来。

paras.en: Tusk convened an emergency meeting with government ministers and security officials in Krakow as authorities investigated the attack.
paras.zh: 在当局调查袭击事件时，图斯克在克拉科夫与政府部长和安全官员召开了紧急会议。

paras.en: "Until now in Poland we haven't had such drastic cases of terrorism... that's what we have to call this cruel attack on people's lives here in Krakow," Tusk said.
paras.zh: 图斯克说： “到目前为止，波兰还没有发生过如此激烈的恐怖主义事件……我们不得不称之为对克拉科夫人民生活的残酷袭击。”

articles.title: Druski & The Strokes on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.zh: 所有推荐的产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。但是， Billboard可能会收到通过其零售链接下达的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: On Saturday (Nov. 7), Saturday Night Live returns with the third episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps comedian and influencer Druski to host, while rock band The Strokes serves as musical guest.

paras.en: This is Druski’s first time hosting, while this would be the fifth appearance for The Strokes as musical guest on SNL.
paras.zh: 这是Druski首次出租房源，而这是The Strokes作为音乐嘉宾在SNL的第五次亮相。

paras.zh: 2026年， SNL在NBC电视台播出。与此同时，综艺素描秀可在孔雀上直播。

paras.zh: 今晚谁会出现在“周六夜现场” ？

paras.en: Where to Watch ’Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free

With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

articles.title: Simple Plan Are Meeting a Whole New Generation of Fans, 25 Years In
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Simple Plan have been playing the same songs for 25 years. Lately, they’re playing them to a lot of people hearing them live for the first time.
paras.zh: Simple Plan 25 年来一直在播放同样的歌曲。最近，他们向很多第一次现场听到他们的人演奏这些作品。

paras.en: “Every night we ask people, ‘Hey, how many people are here for the first time?’” drummer Chuck Comeau tells Billboard. “Sometimes it’s like 85% have never seen the band.”
paras.zh: “每天晚上我们都会问人们，‘嘿，有多少人是第一次来这里？’”鼓手 Chuck Comeau 告诉 Billboard。 “有时好像 85% 的人从未见过乐队。”

paras.en: The Montreal pop-punk band is drawing fans who weren’t born when “I’m Just a Kid” arrived in 2002, alongside the original listeners who are now bringing their own kids to shows. Some of the younger crowd have even started calling Simple Plan “classic rock.”
paras.zh: 这支蒙特利尔流行朋克乐队吸引了 2002 年《I’m Just a Kid》问世时尚未出生的粉丝，以及现在带着自己的孩子观看演出的最初听众。一些年轻人群甚至开始将 Simple Plan 称为“经典摇滚”。

paras.en: “And you’re like, ‘What are you talking about?’” Comeau says.
paras.zh: “然后你就会说， ‘你在说什么？’” Comeau说。

paras.en: “There’s nothing cooler than what’s happening to our band right now,” he adds.
paras.zh: “没有什么比我们乐队现在发生的事情更酷了，”他补充道。

paras.en: Much of that can be traced to “I’m Just a Kid” going viral on TikTok, where it soundtracked a challenge encouraging users to recreate their childhood photos. Comeau calls the trend a “gigantic gift,” but says meeting fans online has always come naturally to the band, which was filming backstage antics and sharing them through its website and DVDs long before TikTok existed.
paras.zh: 这在很大程度上可以追溯到 TikTok 上病毒式传播的《我只是个孩子》，它为鼓励用户重新制作童年照片的挑战进行了配乐。科莫称这一趋势为“巨大的礼物”，但他表示，在网上与粉丝见面对乐队来说一直是一件很自然的事，早在 TikTok 出现之前，乐队就开始拍摄后台的滑稽动作，并通过其网站和 DVD 进行分享。

paras.en: “It’s the same thing,” he says. “It’s just a new platform.”
paras.zh: “这是同样的事情，”他说。“这只是一个新的平台。”

paras.en: The renewed attention builds on a strong early run. The band’s 2004 album Still Not Getting Any… debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, while “Perfect” and “Welcome to My Life” reached Nos. 24 and 40, respectively, on the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 重新的关注建立在强劲的早期运行之上。乐队2004年的专辑《Still Not Getting Any…》在Billboard 200上排名第3 ，而《Perfect》和《Welcome to My Life》在Billboard Hot 100上分别排名第24和40。

paras.en: Next up is a return to Australia for Good Things Festival, where Simple Plan join a bill led by Limp Bizkit and featuring Spiritbox, the All-American Rejects, Bad Religion and MxPx. The festival hits Melbourne’s Flemington Racecourse on Dec. 4, Sydney Showground on Dec. 5 and Brisbane Showgrounds on Dec. 6, marking the band’s third trip Down Under in three years.
paras.zh: 接下来是重返澳大利亚好东西节（ Australia for Good Things Festival ） ，在那里， Simple Plan加入了由Limp Bizkit领导的法案，其中包括Spiritbox、全美拒绝者（ All-American Rejects ）、Bad Religion和MxPx。该节日将于12月4日在墨尔本的弗莱明顿赛马场举行， 12月5日在悉尼展览中心举行， 12月6日在布里斯班展览中心举行，这是该乐队三年来的第三次下山之旅。

paras.en: “We love Australia. What can I say?” Comeau says. “Any excuse, we come back.”
paras.zh: “我们热爱澳大利亚。我能说什么呢？ Comeau说：“任何借口，我们都会回来。”

paras.en: The lineup mixes pop-punk with nu-metal, hardcore and heavier rock, the kind of bill Comeau admits might once have made him nervous. “Being on this lineup would have been a bit more intimidating 25 years ago,” he says.
paras.zh: 阵容将流行朋克与新金属，硬核和更重的摇滚混合在一起， Comeau承认这种比尔可能曾经让他感到紧张。他说： “25年前，加入这个阵容会更令人生畏。”

paras.en: He credits streaming with breaking down the scene boundaries that once divided fans, making it easier for younger listeners to move between genres. The band has seen it firsthand at European festivals, sharing stages with acts like Slipknot.
paras.zh: 他认为流媒体打破了曾经分裂粉丝的场景界限，使年轻听众更容易在流派之间移动。乐队在欧洲音乐节上亲眼目睹了它，与Slipknot等表演分享了舞台。

paras.en: “At first, you’re a little terrified,” he says. “You’re like, ‘How’s that gonna go?’ And then you actually realize that people are stoked.”
paras.zh: 他说：「起初，你有点害怕。“你说， ‘怎么样？“然后你实际上意识到人们被激怒了。”

paras.en: He has his own Good Things wish list. Bad Religion, whom he calls his favorite band, are near the top, along with Swedish punks Millencolin, who are playing Pennybridge Pioneers in full. He’s also keen to finally see Limp Bizkit live. “I’ve seen a lot of crazy videos right now that are popping up everywhere,” he says.
paras.zh: 他有自己的好东西心愿单。Bad Religion ，他称之为他最喜欢的乐队，与瑞典朋克Millencolin一起接近顶峰，他们正在全力以赴地扮演Pennybridge Pioneers。他也热衷于终于看到Limp Bizkit的现场直播。他说：「我现在看到很多疯狂的视频，到处都是。」

paras.en: Meanwhile, Simple Plan have started writing their seventh studio album, with work set to continue into 2027. There’s no release date, but Comeau says the band has a batch of songs it’s excited about, and no intention of rushing.
paras.zh: 与此同时， Simple Plan已经开始创作他们的第七张录音室专辑，工作将持续到2027年。没有发行日期，但Comeau说乐队有一批令人兴奋的歌曲，无意匆忙发行。

paras.en: “We’ve been around for 25 years and we only have six albums,” he says. “So we take our time.”
paras.zh: “我们已经存在了25年，我们只有六张专辑，”他说。“所以我们慢慢来。”

paras.en: The record will follow 2022’s Harder Than It Looks, and Comeau says the aim is to refine the band’s sound rather than overhaul it. “We know who we are,” he says. “We’re not going to turn around and make a black metal record.”
paras.zh: 这张唱片将跟随2022年的《Harder Than It Looks》， Comeau表示，目标是完善乐队的声音，而不是彻底改变它。“我们知道自己是谁，”他说。“我们不会转身制作黑色金属唱片。”

paras.en: The harder challenge is competing with the band’s own past. Songs that soundtracked fans’ teenage years carry a weight that new material has to earn.
paras.zh: 更艰巨的挑战是与乐队自己的过去竞争。原声歌迷青少年时期的歌曲具有新材料必须获得的重要性。

paras.en: “When you get to this stage of your career, you’re almost playing against yourself,” Comeau says. “You’re playing against your history.”
paras.zh: Comeau说： “当你进入职业生涯的这个阶段时，你几乎是在和自己对抗。” “你在和你的历史对抗。”

paras.en: “You’re not the new shiny young band anymore,” he adds. “So you’ve got to work harder to have people pay attention.”
paras.zh: “你不再是新的闪亮的年轻乐队了，”他补充道。“所以你必须更加努力地让人们关注。”

paras.en: That’s why he won’t put a deadline on it. “There’s never a good time for a bad record, and there’s never a bad time for a good record,” he says.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么他不会给它设定最后期限的原因。他说： “糟糕的记录从来没有好时机，好的记录从来没有坏时机。”

paras.en: Next year also marks 25 years since the band’s debut album, No Pads, No Helmets…Just Balls. Comeau says a special-edition vinyl and a few anniversary performances are on the table, but not a full album tour.
paras.zh: 明年也是乐队首张专辑《No Pads, No Helmets... Just Balls》发行25周年。Comeau说，特别版黑胶唱片和几场周年纪念表演已经摆在桌面上，但不是完整的专辑巡演。

paras.en: “I think we’re bigger than just one album,” he says. “But that album was really consequential for us. It’s the one that started it all.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们不仅仅是一张专辑，”他说。“但那张专辑对我们来说真的很重要。这一切都是从这里开始的。”

paras.en: Another milestone arrives March 9, 2027, when the band releases its first children’s picture book, I’m Just a Kid: The Story of Simple Plan, illustrated by Jomike Tejido. Comeau says it grew out of watching the band’s original fans grow up and start families of their own.
paras.zh: 另一个里程碑是2027年3月9日，乐队发布了第一本儿童图画书《我只是个孩子：简单计划的故事》，由Jomike Tejido绘制。Comeau说，它源于看着乐队的原始粉丝成长并建立自己的家庭。

paras.en: “We were with them throughout their difficult moments,” he says, recalling how songs about breakups, school and friendships became part of listeners’ teenage years. “Fast-forward 20 years, 25 years, now they’re starting families, they’re having kids. We want to be there with them in this new chapter of their lives.”
paras.zh: 他回忆起关于分手、学校和友谊的歌曲如何成为听众青少年时代的一部分。“快进20年， 25年，现在他们开始组建家庭，他们有了孩子。我们希望在他们人生的新篇章中与他们同在。”

paras.en: The book explores friendship and perseverance and includes nods for longtime fans. “It’s as much for the parents as it is for the kids,” Comeau says.
paras.zh: 这本书探讨了友谊和毅力，包括对长期粉丝的点头。Comeau说： “这对父母来说和孩子一样重要。”

paras.en: For all the anniversaries and nostalgia, Simple Plan have never broken up, gone on hiatus or staged a reunion, which is rare among their peers. Comeau believes the years since the pandemic have been some of the band’s best, with bigger crowds and a sharper focus on the live show.
paras.zh: 对于所有的纪念日和怀旧情绪， Simple Plan从未分手，中断或上演团聚，这在同龄人中是罕见的。Comeau认为，自疫情以来的几年是乐队最好的几年，有更多的人群和更多地关注现场表演。

paras.en: “When we were young, you were going out and you were partying,” he says. “Now it’s like, no, we don’t do that anymore. We’re all doing yoga and stretching.”
paras.zh: 他说：「我们年轻的时候，你出去参加派对。“现在就像是，不，我们不再这样做了。我们都在做瑜伽和伸展运动。」

paras.en: “We’ve always just kept going,” he says. “I feel like there’s a lot of work to be done.”
paras.zh: 他说：「我们一直都在努力。“我觉得还有很多工作要做。”

paras.en: “There’s no talk about a farewell tour,” Comeau says. “Not in the cards for now.”
paras.zh: Comeau说：「没有人谈论告别之旅。“暂时不在卡片里。”

articles.title: U2 Weigh In on Ed Sheeran and Macklemore Tour Controversy
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: U2 have weighed in on Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s U.S. tour, backing the rapper’s right to speak out while cautioning against blaming Sheeran.
paras.zh: U2 对 Macklemore 从 Ed Sheeran 的美国巡演中被除名一事发表了意见，支持这位说唱歌手发声的权利，同时警告不要指责 Sheeran。

paras.en: “We totally support Macklemore’s right as an artist to say what he wanted to say,” the Edge said in an interview with BBC News. “I don’t think Ed should be vilified,” he added, acknowledging the difficult position Sheeran had been in. The guitarist also praised the artists who left Sheeran’s tour in solidarity, framing the dispute as a matter of free expression.
paras.zh: “我们完全支持麦克莫尔作为一名艺术家表达他想说的话的权利，”The Edge 在接受 BBC 新闻采访时表示。 “我认为埃德不应该受到诽谤，”他补充道，承认希兰所处的困境。这位吉他手还赞扬了离开希兰巡演的艺术家们的团结，并将这场纠纷视为自由表达的问题。

paras.en: Drummer Larry Mullen Jr. went further. “Artists can choose whether they want to be politically active or not. It’s a human right,” he said. “But we as a band will fight for the right to speak your mind as long as it doesn’t incite violence. And even if we disagree with it or don’t like it, nobody has a right – no billionaire, no promoter, no owner has the right to censor anybody. They will definitely not be censoring us ever.”
paras.zh: 鼓手小拉里·马伦 (Larry Mullen Jr.) 走得更远。 “艺术家可以选择是否参与政治活动。这是一项人权，”他说。 “但作为一个乐队，我们将争取表达意见的权利，只要它不煽动暴力。即使我们不同意或不喜欢它，没有人有权利——没有亿万富翁、没有发起人、没有所有者有权审查任何人。他们绝对不会审查我们。”

paras.en: Macklemore was dropped from the North American leg of Sheeran’s Loop Tour in September after two opening sets at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, where he said “Free Palestine,” spoke about Gaza and the West Bank, and performed his protest song “Hind’s Hall.” Promoter Messina Touring Group said venues on the remaining dates would not allow the shows to go ahead with him on the bill.
paras.zh: 9月，麦克莫尔在新泽西州大都会人寿体育场举行了两场开场比赛后，在希兰环路巡回演唱会的北美站中被取消，他在那里唱了“自由巴勒斯坦”，谈到了加沙和约旦河西岸，并演唱了他的抗议歌曲“Hind’s Hall”。发起人墨西拿旅游集团表示，剩余日期的场馆不允许他在账单上继续演出。

paras.en: New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft confirmed he barred the rapper from Gillette Stadium, citing his comments and what Kraft called “a broader history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery.”
paras.zh: 新英格兰爱国者队老板罗伯特·克拉夫特证实，他​​禁止这位说唱歌手进入吉列体育场，并引用了他的言论以及克拉夫特所说的“更广泛的反犹太主义言论和图像的历史”。

paras.en: Sheeran said the decision belonged to the promoter. Several acts left the tour in response, including Finneas, Lukas Graham and Irish folk band Beoga, which had been performing with Sheeran each night. Sheeran later opened a show in Philadelphia by apologizing for “mistakes” in his handling of the situation.
paras.zh: 希兰表示，决定权属于发起人。作为回应，一些乐队退出了巡演，包括 Finneas、Lukas Graham 和每晚与 Sheeran 一起表演的爱尔兰民谣乐队 Beoga。希兰后来在费城举办了一场演出，他为自己处理此事的“错误”道歉。

paras.en: Macklemore has since played three sold-out Free Palestine benefit concerts in Dublin, Paris and London, with guests including Hozier, Kneecap and Beoga, raising money for organizations supporting Palestinians.
paras.zh: 此后，麦克莫尔在都柏林、巴黎和伦敦举办了三场座无虚席的自由巴勒斯坦慈善音乐会，嘉宾包括 Hozier、Kneecap 和 Beoga，为支持巴勒斯坦人的组织筹集资金。

paras.en: U2 release Carnaval De Luz, their 16th studio album and first full-length of new material in nine years, on Nov. 13. The album closes with “Torn,” a duet with the late Dolly Parton that the band says was her last recorded vocal performance.
paras.zh: U2于11月13日发行了Carnaval De Luz ，这是他们的第16张录音室专辑，也是九年来的第一张全新专辑。这张专辑以“Torn”结束，这是与已故的多莉·帕顿（ Dolly Parton ）的二重唱，乐队称这是她最后一次录制声乐表演。

articles.title: Emma Stone Joins Druski During His ‘SNL’ Hosting Debut
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Druski made his Saturday Night Live debut with an assist from his upcoming co-star Emma Stone.
paras.zh: 德鲁斯基在即将合作的艾玛·斯通的协助下首次亮相《周六夜现场》。

paras.en: He kicked off his first-ever monologue by acknowledging that his appearance marked the first time an online content creator hosted the show.
paras.zh: 他开始了他的第一次独白，承认他的出现标志着在线内容创作者第一次主持该节目。

paras.en: “It is a dream to be hosting Saturday Night Live. Apparently, people are saying I’m the first internet content creator, social media influencer, only make you laugh on your phone, TikTok and YouTube and Instagram star to host this show,” he said. “Woo. People say a lot of things about me, honestly.”
paras.zh: “主持《周六夜现场》是我的梦想。显然，人们说我是第一个互联网内容创作者、社交媒体影响者，只会让你在手机、TikTok、YouTube 和 Instagram 上开怀大笑来主持这个节目，”他说。 “哇。老实说，人们对我说了很多话。”

paras.en: “Some people say I look like a lesbian. I don’t know how true that is,” Druski joked. “Some people say I’m on Ozempic. Could be lies, could be truth to that.”
paras.zh: “有些人说我看起来像女同性恋。我不知道这有多真实，”德鲁斯基开玩笑说。 “有些人说我参加了 Ozempic。这可能是谎言，也可能是事实。”

paras.en: Druski, whose real name is Drew Desbordes, admitted that SNL would not be “holding me back from saying anything.” He said there were only a few rules to follow: No cussing and no “whiteface,” which he both joked he couldn’t promise to. (More on that later.)
paras.zh: 德鲁斯基（Druski）的真名是德鲁·德斯博德斯（Drew Desbordes），他承认《周六夜现场》不会“阻止我说什么”。他说只有几条规则需要遵守：不能咒骂，不能“白脸”，他都开玩笑说他无法承诺。 （稍后会详细介绍。）

paras.en: “But honestly, this is a huge moment for me growing up as a fat kid from the suburbs. Why y’all laughing? My teachers never believed in me, so I just wanna say… Yeah, I’m just lying. I just wanted to say that because rappers be saying that type of stuff,” he joked, before thanking his family, who was in the audience, for supporting his dreams.
paras.zh: “但说实话，这对我这个来自郊区的胖孩子来说是一个重要的时刻。你们为什么笑？我的老师从来不相信我，所以我只想说......是的，我只是在撒谎。我只是想说这些，因为说唱歌手们会说这种话，”他开玩笑说，然后感谢观众中支持他梦想的家人。

paras.en: “I’m so grateful. When I first started my career, I let them, let me turn my dreams into a full-blown movie convention. Every day I think about how could I possibly repay y’all,” he began, as one of his family members offered, “Some money!”
paras.zh: “我非常感激。当我刚开始我的职业生涯时，我让他们，让我把我的梦想变成一个成熟的电影大会。每天我都在想我怎样才能报答你们，”他开始说道，而他的一位家人则主动提出，“一些钱！”

paras.en: The comedian recounted the growth his career has seen in recent years, noting, “I am living proof you can bet on yourself and make your dreams come true.” He added, “I just finished filming my first ever movie with Emma Stone, and she is here right now!” The Oscar winner then entered the stage, and the two recounted their time working on The Catch together.
paras.zh: 这位喜剧演员讲述了他近年来职业生涯的发展，并指出：“我就是活生生的证据，你可以押注在自己身上，让你的梦想成真。”他补充道，“我刚刚与艾玛·斯通一起拍摄了我的第一部电影，她现在就在这里！”随后这位奥斯卡奖得主上台，两人讲述了他们一起拍摄《追捕》的时光。

paras.en: “Emma, what’s going on? I’m actually playing her love interest in the new movie that we just did,” he said. Stone responded, “Oh, I’m sorry. OK, yeah. I think you might have misread that in those scenes because we weren’t love interests in the film, but now it is actually starting to make more sense to me why you kept looking at me like that through all these scenes.”
paras.zh: “艾玛，发生了什么事？我实际上在我们刚刚拍的新电影中扮演她的爱人，”他说。斯通回答说：“哦，对不起。好吧，是的。我想你可能误读了那些场景，因为我们在电影中不是爱情，但现在我开始明白为什么你在所有这些场景中一直这样看着我。”

paras.en: “That’s probably why we ain’t kiss either,” Druski added, before also telling the actress he loved her work in Bugonia. “Oh my God, thank you, really?” Stone said. The comedian replied, “No, I just wanted to be the first Black guy to say it.”
paras.zh: “这可能就是我们也不接吻的原因，”德鲁斯基补充道，然后告诉这位女演员他喜欢她在布戈尼亚的工作。 “天啊，谢谢你，真的吗？”斯通说道。这位喜剧演员回答说：“不，我只是想成为第一个说这句话的黑人。”

paras.en: Druski and Stone are set to appear in Universal Pictures’ rom-com The Catch, which will be directed by Dave McCary, Stone’s husband who was also as a segment director on SNL in the 2010s. The film hits theaters on May 21, 2027.
paras.zh: 德鲁斯基和斯通将出演环球影业的浪漫喜剧《The Catch》，该片将由斯通的丈夫戴夫·麦卡里 (Dave McCary) 执导，戴夫·麦卡里曾在 2010 年代担任《周六夜现场》的片段导演。该片于 2027 年 5 月 21 日上映。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the episode, the show spoofed on the success of Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything with a fresh take on its origins. As the skit went, before Fielder and Oppenheim signed on to direct the project, Druski was originally attached to the doc. Jane Wickline appeared in the sketch as Elizabeth Holmes while Ben Marshall portrayed Holmes’ husband, Billy Evans.
paras.zh: 在这一集的其他地方，该剧恶搞了内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆的伊丽莎白·霍姆斯纪录片《你可以看到一切》的成功，并对其起源进行了全新的诠释。随着短剧的进行，在菲尔德和奥本海姆签约指导该项目之前，德鲁斯基最初是隶属于该纪录片的。简·威克兰在草图中饰演伊丽莎白·霍姆斯，而本·马歇尔则饰演霍姆斯的丈夫比利·埃文斯。

paras.en: SNL poked fun at the close-up shots featured in You Can See Everything, with Druski and Wickline recreating the infamous moment from the doc where Fielder and Holmes converse about whether the latter was trying to deceive the filmmaker. They also spoofed on Fielder’s decision to bring in an actress to portray Holmes later in the doc, with Druski himself stepping into the role of the disgraced Theranos CEO, prosthetics and all.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》取笑了《你可以看到一切》中的特写镜头，德鲁斯基和威克莱恩重现了医生中菲尔德和福尔摩斯谈论后者是否试图欺骗电影制片人的臭名昭著的时刻。他们还恶搞了菲尔德决定稍后在纪录片中聘请一位女演员来扮演福尔摩斯，而德鲁斯基本人则扮演了名誉扫地的希拉洛斯首席执行官的角色，包括假肢等等。

paras.en: Druski said, “I just need to find somebody who can truly embody her character,” before a a shot of Druski dressed up as Elizabeth Holmes was shown. “I’m always being real,” he said, as Wickline repeated, “I’m always being real.” They continued to repeat the phrase to one another, as Druski offered, “I could do this all day, bitch. You don’t scare me.”
paras.zh: 德鲁斯基说，“我只需要找到一个能够真正体现她的性格的人”，然后展示了德鲁斯基装扮成伊丽莎白·霍姆斯的镜头。 “我一直都是真实的，”他说道，威克莱恩重复道，“我一直都是真实的。”他们继续互相重复这句话，正如德鲁斯基所说，“我可以这样做一整天，婊子。你别吓到我。”

paras.en: Texas senator-elect James Talarico als ojoined the often-political cold open to call for a shift in SNL‘s cold opens. The sketch began by recounting the success Democrats found in the 2026 midterms, with Talarico joing by the end of the bit.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州当选参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科也加入了经常政治性的冷开场，呼吁改变《周六夜现场》的冷开场。该草图首先回顾了民主党在 2026 年中期选举中取得的成功，塔拉里科在中期选举结束时加入。

paras.en: “People want something new; they want something different,” Talarico said. “I’m talking about SNL’s cold opens,” he said turning to James Austin Johnson’s Trump to ask him how long he’d do the bit. “Infinity,” he said.
paras.zh: “人们想要一些新的东西；他们想要一些不同的东西，”塔拉里科说。 “我说的是《周六夜现场》的冷开场，”他转向詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊饰演的特朗普，问他会做多久。 “无限，”他说。

paras.en: As he said in his monologue, Druski is the first creator to ever host SNL. He was joined by The Strokes as the night’s musical guest.
paras.zh: 正如他在独白中所说，德鲁斯基是第一位主持《周六夜现场》的创作者。他与 The Strokes 一起作为当晚的音乐嘉宾。

paras.en: He got his beginning in the industry via his online presence, where he built a name for himself performing sketches online. Druski has since expanded his career into television (Grown-ish) and film (House Party), and hosted the BET Awards this June. On Monday, it was announced Druski signed a multi-year deal with Netflix, which will first see him star in the “semi-scripted” comedy series Collect & Praise.
paras.zh: 他通过在线表演开始了自己的行业生涯，并在网上表演素描而为自己赢得了声誉。此后，Druski 将他的职业生涯扩展到电视（成长型）和电影（家庭派对），并于今年 6 月主持了 BET 颁奖典礼。周一，德鲁斯基宣布与 Netflix 签署了一份多年期协议，他将首先主演“半剧本”喜剧剧集《收集与赞美》。

paras.en: Jalen Brunson, Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis and Inde Navarrette have already hosted season 52. Next up, John Mulaney will host the Nov. 14 episode alongside Phoebe Bridgers.
paras.zh: Jalen Brunson、Dakota Johnson、Shane Gillis 和 Inde Navarrette 已经主持过第 52 季。接下来，John Mulaney 将与 Phoebe Bridgers 一起主持 11 月 14 日的剧集。

articles.title: James Talarico Crashes ‘SNL’ Cold Open, Apologizes for Texting Us So Much
articles.author: Steven Zeitchik

paras.en: James Austin Johnson was born for this moment — Donald Trump spinning as he is roundly defeated by Democrats — and he rose to meet in Saturday Night Live’s cold open.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊就是为这一刻而生的——唐纳德·特朗普被民主党彻底击败，他在旋转——他在《周六夜现场》的冷开场中站了起来。

paras.en: But it was a Democratic politician who stole the show from Trump’s 2026 defeatism tour, as Texas senator-elect James Talarico made a surprise appearance as himself at the end of the sketch.
paras.zh: 但在特朗普 2026 年失败主义之旅中抢尽风头的是一位民主党政客，得克萨斯州当选参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 在小品最后以他自己的身份出人意料地出现。

paras.en: “I’m James Talarico, the guy who’s been texting you ever day as asking for five dollars,” the popular Texas politician said as he came out on stage to gasps and cheers in the audience, with Trump to mumbly meta-jibing behind him, “In this economy, who can blame you?”
paras.zh: “我是詹姆斯·塔拉里科，就是那个每天给你发短信索要五美元的人，”这位受欢迎的得克萨斯州政客在台下走上台时说道，观众们都喘着粗气，欢呼雀跃，特朗普在他身后含糊其辞地嘲笑道，“在这样的经济环境下，谁能责怪你呢？”

paras.en: Talarico a moment later invoked the iconic “Live from New York” with Johnson’s Trump.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，塔拉里科与约翰逊的特朗普一起引用了标志性的“纽约现场直播”。

paras.en: Talarico drubbed his Republican opponent Ken Paxton by 12 points in the most expensive race in the history of the United States Senate, in part on the back of the grassroots fundraising campaign he was self-mocking on SNL. The result turned a Texas Senate seat blue for the first time in over 30 years.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科在美国参议院历史上最昂贵的竞选中以 12 个百分点的优势击败了共和党对手肯·帕克斯顿，部分原因是他在《周六夜现场》上自嘲的草根筹款活动。结果使德克萨斯州参议院席位30多年来首次变成蓝色。

paras.en: Before the rising star’s appearance in Studio 8H, Johnson had been reveling in his presidential character’s anti-moment.
paras.zh: 在这位后起之秀出现在 Studio 8H 之前，约翰逊一直陶醉于他的总统角色的反时刻。

paras.en: “I didn’t even say it was rigged,” Trump said of the election tallies. “I accepted the results, which is even scarier in a way. It’s like, ‘What the hell is he planning?'” He then said he only cared about his newly redesigned White House ballroom, before allowing under his breath, “Oh my God, I hate my life.”
paras.zh: “我什至没有说它被操纵了，”特朗普在谈到选举统计时说道。 “我接受了结果，这在某种程度上更可怕。就像，‘他到底在计划什么？’”然后他说他只关心他新设计的白宫宴会厅，然后低声说道，“天哪，我讨厌我的生活。”

paras.en: Talarico’s cold-open appearance echoed moments like Kamala Harris’ 2024 turn-up, in which she played opposite her celebrity impersonator Maya Rudolph ahead of the election, while Hillary Clinton and Sarah Palin also made unexpected appearances as White House candidates more than a decade ago. A senator (or senator-elect) is rarer, and the moment both reflected and reinforced the newfound media celebrity of the new class of Congressional Democrats, many of them in their 30s or early 40s.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科冷漠开放的亮相与卡玛拉·哈里斯 2024 年露面的时刻相呼应，当时她在选举前与模仿她的名人玛雅·鲁道夫演对手戏，而希拉里·克林顿和莎拉·佩林也在十多年前出人意料地作为白宫候选人亮相。参议员（或当选参议员）更加罕见，这一时刻既反映又强化了国会民主党新阶层的新媒体名人，他们中的许多人都在 30 多岁或 40 岁出头。

paras.en: Johnson’s Trump, at least, is not a fan.
paras.zh: 至少约翰逊的特朗普不是他的粉丝。

paras.en: “The next few years are going to be horrible,” he said, pausing a comic beat. “It’s not that they’re Democrats; it’s that they’re Millennials.” He then lamented generational staples like “adorkable” and the show New Girl.
paras.zh: “接下来的几年将是可怕的，”他说，暂停了喜剧节拍。 “并不是说他们是民主党人；而是说他们是千禧一代。”然后，他对《可爱》和《新女孩》等几代人的主打节目表示遗憾。

paras.en: The president and the Republican party were handed several heaping platters of whoopings in the midterms, as Democrats gained at least 42 seats in the House and seven in the Senate. Voters rejected both Trump’s policies and personalities as they hoped for a whole range of change, especially on the economy.
paras.zh: 总统和共和党在中期选举中遭遇了数次欢呼，民主党在众议院赢得了至少 42 个席位，在参议院获得了 7 个席位。选民拒绝了特朗普的政策和个性，因为他们希望进行一系列的变革，特别是在经济方面。

paras.en: Johnson — who told The Hollywood Reporter last year that “I don’t want to call what I’m doing Shakespeare. But I am trying to find the deeper forms of Trump, who is a rich text” — went full Hamlet with a digression about when New Girl started finding good storylines (it involved Winston and the cat).
paras.zh: 约翰逊去年告诉《好莱坞报道》，“我不想把我正在做的事情称为莎士比亚。但我试图找到特朗普的更深层次，他是一个丰富的文本。”他完全是哈姆雷特，并题外话讲述了新女孩何时开始寻找好的故事情节（涉及温斯顿和猫）。

paras.en: Johnson has been been appearing (or crashing) the cold open as the president seemingly every week since Trump’s return to office, and writers gave Talarico one of the best lines of the sketch in letting him…question that choice.
paras.zh: 自从特朗普重返办公室以来，约翰逊似乎每周都以总统的身份出现（或崩溃），编剧们给了塔拉里科素描中最好的台词之一，让他……质疑这个选择。

paras.en: “People want something new; they want something different,” Talarico said, appearing to talk about electoral politics, before the pivot. “I’m talking about SNL’s cold opens,” he said turning to Trump to ask him how long he will continue doing this shtick. “Infinity,” Johnson’s Trump said. They don’t want to talk about it, but we have to talk about it.
paras.zh: “人们想要一些新的东西；他们想要一些不同的东西，”塔拉里科说道，他似乎在谈论转向之前的选举政治。 “我说的是《周六夜现场》的冷开场，”他转向特朗普，问他这样的表演还要持续多久。 “无限，”约翰逊的特朗普说。他们不想谈论它，但我们必须谈论它。

paras.en: Johnson’s Trump also engaged in what might be a bon voyage to Colin Jost’s Pete Hegseth; with the defense secretary rumored as leaving the administration, it could end Jost’s well-regarded impression run.
paras.zh: 约翰逊的特朗普也对科林·乔斯特的皮特·赫格斯进行了一次可能的顺风顺水。据传国防部长将离开政府，这可能会结束约斯特备受推崇的印象。

paras.en: “Do I look like a person who gets less crazy when backed into a corner,” Jost said in the appearance, adding, “I live a YOLO life: you only lose often.” He then sashayed off, backside first, playing to the new Trumpian rumpian obsession.
paras.zh: “我看起来像一个在被逼到墙角时不会那么疯狂的人吗？”乔斯特在出庭时说道，并补充道，“我过着 YOLO 的生活：你只会经常失败。”然后他大摇大摆地离开了，屁股在前，迎合了新的特朗普式的对牛仔的痴迷。

paras.en: The sketch began with Sarah Sherman’s Chuck Schumer and Kenan Thompson’s Hakeem Jeffries taking credit for victories that were only partly their doing.
paras.zh: 草图一开始，莎拉·谢尔曼饰演的查克·舒默和基南·汤普森饰演的哈基姆·杰弗里斯将胜利归功于他们，而这些胜利只是他们的部分功劳。

paras.en: “As our first order of business we are going to march right up to Donald Trump, look him right in the eye and say, ‘Knock it off buster,'” Thompson’s Jeffries said, mocking a perceived ineffectuality of current Congressional Democratic leadership.
paras.zh: 汤普森的杰弗里斯说：“作为我们的首要任务，我们将直接走到唐纳德·特朗普面前，直视他的眼睛并说，‘别再搞了’”，他嘲笑了目前国会民主党领导层的无能。

paras.en: As they asked how they did pulled off the wins, Johnson’s Trump appeared taking upside-down credit: “Me,” he boasted.
paras.zh: 当他们问他们是如何取得胜利时，约翰逊的特朗普似乎把功劳颠倒了：“我，”他吹嘘道。

paras.en: Talarico’s appearance on SNL provides a bookend — and a bit of sweet revenge — for the Texas politician after broader threats by FCC chair Brendan Carr led ABC and Jimmy Kimmel to move an appearance of Talarico’s on Jimmy Kimmel Live! off broadcast television to YouTube in September, a decision both Kimmel and the candidate condemned. The ostensible reason Carr would take issue was because Talarico was a candidate, triggering an equal-time provision, even though both Republican and Democratic candidates have long appeared on late-night shows. With Talarico officially a senator-elect, all of that is moot.
paras.zh: 在 FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔发出更广泛的威胁后，美国广播公司 (ABC) 和吉米·金梅尔 (Jimmy Kimmel) 要求塔拉里科 (Talarico) 在吉米·金梅尔直播 (Jimmy Kimmel Live) 上露面！ 9 月份，电视转播不再转至 YouTube，金梅尔和候选人都谴责了这一决定。卡尔提出异议的表面原因是因为塔拉里科是候选人，从而触发了平等时间条款，尽管共和党和民主党候选人长期以来都出现在深夜节目中。随着塔拉里科正式当选参议员，所有这些都变得毫无意义。

articles.title: Druski Embodies Elizabeth Holmes in ‘You Can See Everything’ Spoof on ‘SNL’
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: You really can see just about everything on Saturday Night Live — even Druski dressed up as Elizabeth Holmes.
paras.zh: 你真的可以在《周六夜现场》中看到几乎所有的东西——甚至德鲁斯基也打扮成伊丽莎白·霍姆斯。

paras.en: During the comedian’s SNL debut, the show spoofed on the success of Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything with a fresh take on its origins.
paras.zh: 在这位喜剧演员的《周六夜现场》首秀中，该剧恶搞了内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆的伊丽莎白·霍姆斯纪录片《你可以看到一切》的成功，并对其起源进行了全新的诠释。

paras.en: As the skit went, before Fielder and Oppenheim signed on to direct the project, Druski was originally attached to the doc. Jane Wickline appeared in the sketch as Elizabeth Holmes while Ben Marshall portrayed Holmes’ husband, Billy Evans.
paras.zh: 随着短剧的进行，在菲尔德和奥本海姆签约指导该项目之前，德鲁斯基最初是隶属于该纪录片的。简·威克兰在草图中饰演伊丽莎白·霍姆斯，而本·马歇尔则饰演霍姆斯的丈夫比利·埃文斯。

paras.en: “We’re so glad you’re here,” Wickline’s Holmes said, as Marshall’s Evans added, “It’s really important to us that people find out who Liz really is, you know.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴你在这里，”威克林的霍姆斯说，马歇尔的埃文斯补充道，“对我们来说，让人们了解莉兹的真实身份非常重要，你知道。”

paras.en: “I just want people to see me as an ordinary person. Can you do that, Druski?” the faux Holmes asked. Druski replied, “Based on what I’ve seen so far, I’m gonna go ahead and say no. Y’all got some of the weirdest, freakiest vibes I have ever seen.”
paras.zh: “我只是想让人们把我视为一个普通人。你能做到吗，德鲁斯基？”假福尔摩斯问道。德鲁斯基回答道：“根据我迄今为止所看到的情况，我会直接说不。你们都感受到了我所见过的最奇怪、最怪异的感觉。”

paras.en: SNL poked fun at the close-up shots featured in You Can See Everything, with Druski and Wickline recreating the infamous moment from the doc where Fielder and Holmes converse about whether the latter was trying to deceive the filmmaker.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》取笑了《你可以看到一切》中的特写镜头，德鲁斯基和威克莱恩重现了医生中菲尔德和福尔摩斯谈论后者是否试图欺骗电影制片人的臭名昭著的时刻。

paras.en: And while Fielder and Oppenheim’s doc “was a three-hour cinematic epic,” the show joked that “Druski’s tape was released on Instagram Reels in a 1,000 part series titled ‘Crazy White Lady Skit.'”
paras.zh: 虽然菲尔德和奥本海姆的纪录片“是一部长达三个小时的电影史诗”，但该剧开玩笑说，“德鲁斯基的录像带在 Instagram Reels 上以 1,000 部分的系列形式发布，名为‘疯狂白女士短剧’”。

paras.en: Referencing the comedian’s own popular mock audition show Coulda Been Love, he even had Marshall’s Evans perform a song of his own. “My name is Billy and I make eight figures, can’t believe I’m here with all my –” he said before being cut off.
paras.zh: 参考这位喜剧演员自己的热门模拟试镜节目《Coulda Been Love》，他甚至让马歇尔的埃文斯表演了一首他自己的歌曲。 “我叫比利，我的收入有八位数，简直不敢相信我带着我的全部——”他说道，然后就被打断了。

paras.en: In one of the most jaw-dropping parts of the sketch, Druski himself transformed into Elizabeth Holmes, prosthetics and all. The moment was prefaced with an SNL voiceover that said, “And just like Fielder, Druski used reenactments to better understand his subjects.” Druski himself added, “I just need to find somebody who can truly embody her character.”
paras.zh: 在草图中最令人瞠目结舌的部分之一，德鲁斯基本人变成了伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯，包括假肢等等。这一刻以《周六夜现场》的画外音开头：“就像菲尔德一样，德鲁斯基也利用重演来更好地理解他的拍摄对象。”德鲁斯基本人补充道：“我只需要找到一个能够真正体现她性格的人。”

paras.en: Cut to a shot of Druski dressed up as Elizabeth Holmes. “I’m always being real,” he said, as Wickline repeated, “I’m always being real.” They continued to repeat the phrase to one another, as Druski offered, “I could do this all day, bitch. You don’t scare me.”
paras.zh: 切换到德鲁斯基装扮成伊丽莎白·霍姆斯的镜头。 “我一直都是真实的，”他说道，威克莱恩重复道，“我一直都是真实的。”他们继续互相重复这句话，正如德鲁斯基所说，“我可以这样做一整天，婊子。你别吓到我。”

paras.en: During his monologue as host, Druski warned the SNL audience he couldn’t promise that he wouldn’t do whiteface. “Listen, I know y’all think SNL gonna water me down tonight, but no, they are not holding me back from saying anything,” he said earlier in the episode. “They said, number one, no cussing. I cannot promise that. Number two, no whiteface. I also can’t promise that. That’s about half the show right there.”
paras.zh: 在主持人的独白中，德鲁斯基警告《周六夜现场》的观众，他不能保证自己不会演白脸。 “听着，我知道你们都认为《周六夜现场》今晚会让我失望，但不，他们不会阻止我说什么，”他在本集早些时候说道。 “他们说，第一，不要咒骂。我不能保证这一点。第二，没有白人。我也不能保证这一点。这大约是演出的一半。”

paras.en: In another moment in full Elizabeth Holmes drag, Druski told Wickline, “I’m going to show you one of the most famous comedy videos in all of history,” which cut to a viral video of Druski dancing.
paras.zh: 在伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes) 变装的另一个时刻，德鲁斯基 (Druski) 告诉 Wickline，“我将向你们展示历史上最著名的喜剧视频之一”，该视频切入了德鲁斯基 (Druski) 跳舞的病毒视频。

paras.en: Earlier in the episode, Emma Stone crashed the comedian’s monologue, as the two are set to co-star in the Universal Pictures rom-com The Catch, which hits theaters on May 21, 2027.
paras.zh: 在本集早些时候，艾玛·斯通打断了这位喜剧演员的独白，因为两人将共同主演环球影业的浪漫喜剧《The Catch》，该片将于 2027 年 5 月 21 日上映。

paras.en: “Emma, what’s going on? I’m actually playing her love interest in the new movie that we just did,” he said. Stone responded, “Oh, I’m sorry. OK, yeah. I think you might have misread that in those scenes because we weren’t love interests in the film, but now it is actually starting to make more sense to me why you kept looking at me like that through all these scenes.”
paras.zh: “艾玛，发生了什么事？我实际上在我们刚刚拍的新电影中扮演她的爱人，”他说。斯通回答说：“哦，对不起。好吧，是的。我想你可能误读了那些场景，因为我们在电影中不是爱情，但现在我开始明白为什么你在所有这些场景中一直这样看着我。”

paras.en: In another surprise appearance, Texas senator-elect James Talarico joined the often-political cold open to call for a shift in SNL‘s cold opens.
paras.zh: 另一次出人意料的露​​面是，得克萨斯州当选参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科(James Talarico)加入了经常政治性的冷开场，呼吁改变《周六夜现场》的冷开场方式。

paras.en: “People want something new; they want something different,” Talarico said. “I’m talking about SNL’s cold opens,” he said turning to Trump to ask him how long he will continue doing this shtick. “Infinity,” James Austin Johnson’s Trump said.
paras.zh: “人们想要一些新的东西；他们想要一些不同的东西，”塔拉里科说。 “我说的是《周六夜现场》的冷开场，”他转向特朗普，问他这样的表演还要持续多久。 “无限，”詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊的特朗普说。

articles.title: Polish gunman who killed 6 people in Krakow has 'ultranationalistic' views, minister says

paras.en: A Polish man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow on Saturday and opened fire, killing six people and injuring 15 others before police shot and wounded him, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周六，一名持极右观点的波兰男子驾车驶入克拉科夫一个繁忙的中心广场并开枪，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤，随后警方开枪打伤了他。

paras.en: The attack, which Poland's defense minister described as an "act of terror," happened in Main Square, which is in the heart of Krakow's Old Town and is a major tourist hub in the country's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 波兰国防部长称这起袭击事件发生在主广场，该广场位于克拉科夫老城区的中心，是该国第二大城市的主要旅游中心。

paras.en: The 25-year-old attacker drove to multiple spots in the square and opened fire at each stop with an automatic weapon, authorities said. Although they didn't release his name, Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said the man holds "very radical" and "ultranationalistic" views.
paras.zh: 当局称，这名 25 岁的袭击者开车前往广场的多个地点，并在每个站点都用自动武器开枪。尽管他们没有公布他的名字，但内政部长马尔辛·基尔温斯基表示，该男子持有“非常激进”和“极端民族主义”的观点。

paras.en: "Everything indicates that he was fascinated by far-right ideologies," Kierwiński said at a news conference.
paras.zh: “一切都表明他对极右意识形态着迷，”基尔文斯基在新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: Hours after the attack, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said authorities found the bodies of three of the suspect's close family members — two women and a man — inside his home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, a city about 150 kilometers (93 miles) northeast of Krakow.
paras.zh: 袭击发生几小时后，总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，当局在嫌疑人位于克拉科夫东北约 150 公里（93 英里）的奥斯特罗维茨维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski) 的家中发现了三名嫌疑人的近亲（两名女性和一名男性）的尸体。

paras.en: "We have the next acts of this tragedy," Tusk told reporters.
paras.zh: 图斯克对记者说：“我们正在准备这场悲剧的下一幕。”

paras.en: Four women and two men were killed in the Krakow attack. At least three of the women were Polish, and one of the dead was a U.K. citizen, authorities said at a news conference. Police were still trying to identify the other two people who were killed.
paras.zh: 四名妇女和两名男子在克拉科夫袭击中丧生。当局在新闻发布会上表示，其中至少三名妇女是波兰人，其中一名死者是英国公民。警方仍在试图确认另外两名遇难者的身份。

paras.en: Authorities said a total of 13 people were hospitalized in serious condition, though that figure may include the gunman, who underwent surgery after the attack.
paras.zh: 当局表示，共有 13 人伤势严重入院治疗，不过这一数字可能包括枪手，他在袭击后接受了手术。

paras.en: It's unclear how many of the injured were shot. Two of them were treated and released within hours of the mass shooting. Two police officers were among the injured, including one whose injuries were serious, Kierwiński said. Also injured in the attack were five non-Poles, police commander Marek Boroń said.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚有多少伤者被枪杀。其中两人在大规模枪击事件发生后数小时内接受治疗并出院。基尔温斯基说，伤者中有两名警察，其中一名伤势严重。警察指挥官马雷克·博伦说，袭击中还有五名非波兰人受伤。

paras.en: The attacker wore military-style fatigues and a bulletproof vest, and used a military-type long gun, Krakow police spokesperson Katarzyna Cisło said. Police found many other weapons and ammunition in his car. He kept firing at the police even after being shot himself, she said.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方发言人卡塔齐娜·西斯洛表示，袭击者身穿军用迷彩服和防弹背心，并使用军用长枪。警方在他的车里发现了许多其他武器和弹药。她说，即使他自己被枪杀，他仍继续向警察开枪。

paras.en: The attacker engaged in a "wild ride" around Main Square, which is why people were wounded at several locations, Cisło said.
paras.zh: 西斯沃说，袭击者在主广场周围进行了“疯狂骑行”，这就是为什么多处地方有人受伤的原因。

paras.en: Cisło added that the gunman acted alone and that the public is safe.
paras.zh: 西斯沃补充说，枪手是单独行动的，公众是安全的。

paras.en: Krakow mayor Łukasz Gibała said the city will be in official mourning until Wednesday. He vowed that Krakow will remain open to visitors despite the tragedy.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市长乌卡斯·吉巴拉表示，该市将在周三之前进行正式哀悼。他发誓，尽管发生了悲剧，克拉科夫仍将向游客开放。

paras.en: "The square will belong to us again," Gibała said in a video posted to X.
paras.zh: “这个广场将再次属于我们，”吉巴拉在发布到 X 的视频中说道。

paras.en: Videos posted on social media by witnesses show people running away from the square to take cover on small streets nearby, as well as first responders trying to resuscitate victims. In one video, a police officer is seen repeatedly shooting the attacker, who is lying on the street, only to later slowly collapse to the ground.
paras.zh: 目击者在社交媒体上发布的视频显示，人们逃离广场，躲到附近的小街道上，急救人员也试图对受害者进行复苏。在一段视频中，可以看到一名警察多次向躺在街上的袭击者开枪，随后袭击者慢慢倒在地上。

paras.en: Photos showed a Polish Medical Air Rescue helicopter after it landed in the square.
paras.zh: 照片显示一架波兰医疗空中救援直升机降落在广场上。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether the firearm used in Saturday's attack, or the guns found in the perpetrator's car, were legal. Around 411,000 people hold gun permits in Poland, which has a population of 37 million, and interest in gun ownership has been rising.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚周六袭击中使用的枪支或在肇事者汽车中发现的枪支是否合法。在拥有 3700 万人口的波兰，约有 411,000 人持有枪支许可证，人们对拥有枪支的兴趣一直在上升。

paras.en: Mass shootings are uncommon in Poland. However, in mid-October, three attacks at schools in the central province of Mazovia took place within four days, leaving one person dead and many wounded, including children.
paras.zh: 大规模枪击事件在波兰并不常见。然而，10月中旬，中部马佐维亚省四天内发生三起学校袭击事件，造成一人死亡、多人受伤，其中包括儿童。

paras.en: In a post on X, Tusk praised the police officers who responded to Saturday's tragedy. President Karol Nawrocki said his thoughts were with the victims, the wounded and their families.
paras.zh: 图斯克在 X 上的一篇帖子中赞扬了对周六悲剧做出反应的警察。总统卡罗尔·纳罗基表示，他的心与受害者、伤者及其家人同在。

paras.en: A tram driver reported around 3 p.m. that his vehicle was shot at by a man in a moving car while passing nearby the main square, the Krakow municipal transport company said. The tram driver's cabin window was shattered.
paras.zh: 下午 3 点左右，一名电车司机报告称。克拉科夫市交通公司表示，他的车辆在经过主广场附近时被一辆行驶中的汽车中的一名男子开枪射击。电车司机室的窗户被震碎。

paras.en: Animal rights group OTOZ Animals said the attacker also shot two horses. Both animals are alive, but one was grazed by a bullet and the other hit in the leg. White carriages drawn by horses are a main tourist attraction in the square.
paras.zh: 动物权利组织 OTOZ Animals 表示，袭击者还射杀了两匹马。两只动物都还活着，但其中一只被子弹擦伤，另一只则击中腿部。白色马车是广场上的主要旅游景点。

paras.en: Warsaw mayor Rafał Trzaskowski announced increased security measures, including road barriers, along main streets in the old town in the Polish capital after the Krakow attack.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫袭击事件发生后，华沙市长拉法尔·特尔扎斯科夫斯基宣布加强波兰首都老城区主要街道的安全措施，包括路障。

articles.title: Trump offers UFC chief Dana White press secretary job

paras.en: President Donald Trump offered UFC president and CEO Dana White the job of press secretary on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，唐纳德·特朗普总统向 UFC 主席兼首席执行官达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 提供了新闻秘书的职位。

paras.en: In a post on Truth Social, Trump said: "I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States."
paras.zh: 特朗普在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中表示：“我很高兴地宣布，伟大的达纳·怀特（Great Dana White），一位暴力斗士和战士，已被任命为美国新闻秘书。”

paras.en: "We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left," Trump wrote. "Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job!"
paras.zh: 特朗普写道：“我们需要这些人来保护我们免受疯狂左派的侵害。” “达纳将成为一名与众不同的新闻秘书。达纳，请接受这份工作！”

paras.en: CNN, citing a source, reported White had declined the president's offer.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 援引消息人士的话报道称，怀特拒绝了总统的提议。

paras.en: Earlier Saturday, White posted a picture of himself on Instagram stories standing behind the press secretary's lectern in the White House, with the caption, "On to the next chapter."
paras.zh: 周六早些时候，怀特在 Instagram Stories 上发布了一张自己站在白宫新闻秘书讲台后面的照片，标题是“进入下一章”。

paras.en: It was unclear whether White had accepted the position or was simply acknowledging the president's request as a joke.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚怀特是否接受了这一职位，或者只是承认总统的要求只是开玩笑。

paras.en: Trump said that he was offering White the job of "Press Secretary of the United States," but the president's spokesperson is called the "White House press secretary." Trump also recently speculated about considering Trump loyalist and rapper Nicki Minaj as press secretary, in an interview with podcaster Benny Johnson.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他向怀特提供“美国新闻秘书”的职位，但总统的发言人被称为“白宫新闻秘书”。特朗普最近在接受播客本尼·约翰逊采访时还猜测考虑考虑考虑特朗普的忠实拥护者、说唱歌手尼基·米娜担任新闻秘书。

paras.en: Trump said the job offer to White extended to his assistants, "even though some are not from our Country." The so-called assistants Trump named included current and former UFC mixed martial arts fighters from countries such as Brazil and Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，向怀特提供的工作机会也涵盖了他的助手，“尽管有些人不是来自我们国家。”特朗普点名的所谓助手包括来自巴西和俄罗斯等国的现任和前UFC综合格斗选手。

paras.en: In October, White House press secretary Katie Zacharia left the position just five days after her stint as Karoline Leavitt's replacement began.
paras.zh: 10月，白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚(Katie Zacharia)在接替卡罗琳·莱维特(Karoline Leavitt)上任五天后就离职了。

paras.en: The president told reporters he suggested Zacharia quit after her first and only press briefing, where, in her six minutes answering questions behind the lectern, she only took questions from three conservative outlets.
paras.zh: 总统告诉记者，他建议扎卡里亚在第一次也是唯一一次新闻发布会后辞职，在讲台后面回答问题的六分钟内，她只回答了三个保守派媒体的问题。

paras.en: "I just spoke to her about it. I said, 'Katie, is this for you?'" Trump said outside the White House on Oct. 16.
paras.zh: “我刚刚和她谈过这件事。我说，‘凯蒂，这是给你的吗？’”特朗普 10 月 16 日在白宫外说道。

paras.en: The president's appeal to White follows Friday's announcement that Trump's deputy chief of staff, Stephen Miller, would be promoted to chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles.
paras.zh: 总统向怀特提出上诉之前，周五宣布特朗普的副幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒将晋升为幕僚长，接替苏西·威尔斯。

paras.en: Trump's stunning shake-up came just three days after Democrats won a landslide victory in the midterm elections, gaining majority control in the House and Senate.
paras.zh: 就在特朗普进行令人震惊的改组三天前，民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，获得了参众两院的多数控制权。

paras.en: The president and White have a longstanding friendship. During Trump's first campaign in 2016, White praised the then-Republican nominee and called him a "fighter."
paras.zh: 总统和怀特有着长期的友谊。在特朗普 2016 年第一次竞选期间，怀特赞扬了这位当时的共和党候选人，称他为“斗士”。

paras.en: "Nobody took us seriously. Nobody. Except Donald Trump. Donald was the first guy to recognize the potential we saw in the UFC and encouraged us to build our business," White said.
paras.zh: “没有人认真对待我们。没有人。除了唐纳德·特朗普。唐纳德是第一个认识到我们在 UFC 中看到潜力并鼓励我们建立业务的人，”怀特说。

paras.en: And for his 80th birthday in June, President Trump hosted a UFC match — dubbed UFC Freedom 250 — on the White House's South Lawn.
paras.zh: 6 月，为庆祝特朗普总统 80 岁生日，特朗普总统在白宫南草坪举办了一场 UFC 比赛，名为 UFC Freedom 250。

paras.en: The White House and the UFC didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫和 UFC 没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: — CNBC's Kevin Breuninger contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Kevin Breuninger 对本报告做出了贡献。

paras.en: CORRECTION: This article has been updated to correct the spelling of Karoline Leavitt's name.
paras.zh: 更正：本文已更新，以更正卡罗琳·莱维特 (Karoline Leavitt) 名字的拼写。

articles.title: Cathie Wood 'always feels better when the market is worried' — here's why

paras.en: Ark Invest CEO Cathie Wood is shrugging off this week's market jitters, telling CNBC on Friday that concerns among investors actually reinforce her optimism that further gains lie ahead.
paras.zh: Ark Invest 首席执行官凯西·伍德 (Cathie Wood) 没有理会本周的市场不安情绪，她周五向 CNBC 表示，投资者的担忧实际上增强了她对未来进一步上涨的乐观态度。

paras.en: U.S. equities sold off sharply on Thursday, reversing the initial rally seen in the wake of the midterm elections. AI-related stocks led the rout, sending the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite into correction territory. On Friday, tech stocks staged a tentative recovery.
paras.zh: 美国股市周四大幅抛售，扭转了中期选举后最初的涨势。人工智能相关股票领跌，导致以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数进入调整区间。周五，科技股出现试探性复苏。

paras.en: Much of the sell-off on Thursday was driven by concerns that a Democrat-led Congress would lead to a slowdown in data center construction. But concerns about artificial intelligence – particularly when it comes to capital expenditure, cash flow, debt and circular financing – have sparked multiple bouts of volatility over the course of this year.
paras.zh: 周四的抛售很大程度上是由于担心民主党领导的国会将导致数据中心建设放缓。但对人工智能的担忧——特别是在资本支出、现金流、债务和循环融资方面——在今年引发了多轮波动。

paras.en: Wood, whose firm manages various funds focused on tech and innovation, told CNBC there was a "wall of worry" pervading financial markets right now. But her decades of experience as an investor give her a somewhat unconventional view of the state of play.
paras.zh: 伍德的公司管理着各种专注于科技和创新的基金，他告诉 CNBC，目前金融市场上弥漫着“担忧之墙”。但她数十年的投资者经验让她对行业现状有了一些非传统的看法。

paras.en: "I experienced the tech and telecom bubble, and you know there really wasn't much worry about it," she said. "It was the 80s and the 90s, and it was a bull market, and people were just assuming this would go to the moon, that is not how this [the AI trade] has evolved."
paras.zh: “我经历了科技和电信泡沫，你知道实际上没有太多担心，”她说。 “那是 80 年代和 90 年代，那是一个牛市，人们只是假设这会登上月球，这并不是 [AI 行业] 的发展方式。”

paras.en: She explained that "from the beginning," many investors have been concerned about how much firms are spending on AI development, how rapidly the spending is taking place, and how the hyperscalers have moved from extreme levels of positive free cash flow to negative free cash flow.
paras.zh: 她解释说，“从一开始”，许多投资者就一直担心公司在人工智能开发上投入了多少资金、支出发生的速度有多快，以及超大规模企业如何从正自由现金流的极端水平转变为负自由现金流。

paras.en: "So it's been unsettling the markets for quite some time," she said. "I always feel better when the market is worried, because that tends to suggest a more durable bull market, and I don't think we've derailed this bull market."
paras.zh: “因此，这已经让市场不安了相当长一段时间，”她说。 “当市场感到担忧时，我总是感觉更好，因为这往往表明牛市会更持久，而且我不认为我们已经破坏了牛市。”

paras.en: In 2025, her flagship Ark Innovation ETF gained more than 35%, far outperforming the S&P 500's 16.4% rise and the Nasdaq Composite's 20.5% rally.
paras.zh: 2025年，她的旗舰Ark Innovation ETF涨幅超过35%，远远超过标准普尔500指数16.4%的涨幅和纳斯达克综合指数20.5%的涨幅。

paras.en: Asked on Friday whether markets were anywhere near the end of the current bull run, Wood replied: "I don't think so."
paras.zh: 周五，当被问及市场是否已接近当前牛市结束时，伍德回答说：“我不这么认为。”

paras.en: "I think we're in the middle of a technology revolution," she said, pointing to the development of technologies like robotaxis and AI agents.
paras.zh: “我认为我们正处于一场技术革命之中，”她指着机器人出租车和人工智能代理等技术的发展说道。

paras.en: One thing that did risk becoming a "showstopper," Wood noted, was the rising cost of capital.
paras.zh: 伍德指出，确实有可能成为“搅局者”的一件事是资本成本不断上升。

paras.en: Interest rates and bond yields have risen sharply this year as the U.S.-Iran war pushes inflation higher across the globe. Yields on corporate bonds have been rising too, with creditors demanding greater compensation for lending to companies.
paras.zh: 由于美伊战争推高全球通胀，今年利率和债券收益率大幅上升。公司债券的收益率也在上升，债权人要求为公司提供更高的贷款补偿。

paras.en: "This correction is partly caused by what's going on in the bond markets," Wood said on Friday.
paras.zh: “这次调整部分是由债券市场的情况造成的，”伍德周五表示。

paras.en: "I had been saying for quite some time that the wall of worry has been built by senior leaders in the financial world who were young during the bubble," she said.
paras.zh: “我很长一段时间以来一直在说，担忧之墙是由泡沫时期年轻的金融界高级领导人建造的，”她说。

paras.en: "It's the elder statesmen and women of the industry who are keeping this wall of worry in place, and that's not bad. Now you can add the bond investor to that. Bond investors in the old days weren't necessary for technology. It was software. It was low fixed cost. It was viral apps, very high margins. [AI] is high fixed cost, so bond investors are experiencing or taking a journey into the technology world, really that they haven't very much before."
paras.zh: “正是这个行业的资深政治家和女性将这堵担忧之墙保持在适当的位置，这还不错。现在你可以将债券投资者加入其中。过去的债券投资者对于技术来说并不是必需的。它是软件。它的固定成本很低。它是病毒式应用程序，利润非常高。[AI]是高固定成本，所以债券投资者正在体验或进入技术世界，实际上他们以前没有太多。”

paras.en: But she noted that AI hyperscalers were somewhat insulated by opportunities for growth.
paras.zh: 但她指出，人工智能超大规模企业在某种程度上与增长机会隔绝。

paras.en: "If a company thinks that taking on debt is going to accelerate its momentum, meaning its growth rate, it hardly matters what happens to interest rates for those companies," Wood explained.
paras.zh: 伍德解释说：“如果一家公司认为承担债务将加速其发展势头，即其增长率，那么这些公司的利率发生什么变化就无关紧要了。”

paras.en: Wood said her advice to investors in the current volatile environment was to identify their high-conviction positions and double down on them as the market shifts.
paras.zh: 伍德表示，在当前动荡的环境中，她对投资者的建议是确定他们高度确信的头寸，并随着市场的变化加倍押注。

paras.en: "When you see a rally in a volatile environment, take some profits. When you see a sell-off, you'll have the psychological wherewithal if you have taken profits to move back in," she said.
paras.zh: “当你在动荡的环境中看到上涨时，就获利了结。当你看到抛售时，如果你已经获利了结，那么你就有了心理上的必要手段，”她说。

paras.en: "That's what we do. So what we do during periods like this is concentrate towards our highest conviction names. So that's what we've been doing in the last week or so. Our SpaceX position has gone up. If anything, the controversy around data centers on Earth is giving data centers in space a bigger opportunity."
paras.zh: “这就是我们所做的。因此，在这样的时期，我们所做的就是专注于我们最有信心的名字。这就是我们在过去一周左右一直在做的事情。我们 SpaceX 的地位有所上升。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是围绕地球数据中心的争议给太空数据中心带来了更大的机会。”

paras.en: In 2027, Wood said she expects the equity rally to continue.
paras.zh: 伍德表示，她预计 2027 年股市将继续上涨。

paras.en: "This is two steps forward, one step back," she said of the post-election turbulence. "The revolution will become clearer and clearer next year, and I think the market will do well."
paras.zh: “这是前进两步，又是后退一步，”她在谈到选举后的动荡时说道。 “明年的革命将会变得越来越清晰，我认为市场会表现良好。”

articles.title: These are the doctors and scientists elected in the 2026 midterms

paras.en: Tuesday’s midterm elections saw dozens of historic wins across the country. Some of these newly elected officials to the Senate, House of Representatives and state governorships are health care professionals, scientists or engineers.
paras.zh: 周二的中期选举在全国各地取得了数十场历史性胜利。这些新当选的参议院、众议院和州长官员中有一些是医疗保健专业人员、科学家或工程师。

paras.en: The current Congress includes 20 physicians, a record that the upcoming Congress could surpass.
paras.zh: 本届国会有 20 名医生，下一届国会可能会超越这一记录。

paras.en: Here’s what you need to know about some of the politicians who will be bringing a scientific background into public office.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的一些将把科学背景带入公职的政治家的信息。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, an epidemiologist by training, was elected to the Senate for the state of Michigan. El-Sayed, who previously led Detroit’s public health department, told Scientific American in October that he sees many parallels between the practice of science and public policy.
paras.zh: 民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德是一位受过训练的流行病学家，他当选为密歇根州参议员。底特律公共卫生部门前负责人埃尔-赛义德十月份告诉《科学美国人》，他看到科学实践和公共政策之间有许多相似之处。

paras.en: “Once you train in the sciences, you don’t leave that scientific approach to thinking and that rigor of thinking,” he said. “And I try to bring that to policy problems.”
paras.zh: “一旦你接受了科学训练，你就不会放弃科学的思维方法和严谨的思维，”他说。 “我试图将其带入政策问题。”

paras.en: Democrat Annie Andrews flipped a Senate seat in South Carolina, defeating the incumbent Republican Darline Graham, who succeeded her brother, Lindsey Graham, after his death. Andrews worked as a pediatrician in South Carolina and Washington, D.C., until earlier this year.
paras.zh: 民主党人安妮·安德鲁斯(Annie Andrews)击败了现任共和党人达林·格雷厄姆(Darline Graham)，在南卡罗来纳州赢得了参议院席位，达林·格雷厄姆在她的兄弟林赛·格雷厄姆(Lindsey Graham)去世后继任。安德鲁斯一直在南卡罗来纳州和华盛顿特区担任儿科医生，直到今年早些时候。

paras.en: The Ohio public first came to know Amy Acton when she served as the state’s chief public health officer during the COVID pandemic. Now Acton, a Democrat, will serve as Ohio’s governor.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州公众第一次认识艾米·阿克顿是在她在新冠病毒大流行期间担任该州首席公共卫生官员时。现在，民主党人阿克顿将担任俄亥俄州州长。

paras.en: She beat biotech billionaire Vivek Ramaswamy to become Ohio’s second Democratic governor in 35 years and the state’s first elected female governor.
paras.zh: 她击败生物技术亿万富翁维韦克·拉马斯瓦米 (Vivek Ramaswamy)，成为俄亥俄州 35 年来第二位民主党州长，也是该州第一位民选女州长。

paras.en: Democrat Josh Green, a physician, won a second term as governor of Hawaii on Tuesday, beating Republican challenger Gary Cordery by 45 percentage points. He and Acton are the only two physician-governors in the country.
paras.zh: 周二，医生、民主党人乔什·格林 (Josh Green) 以 45 个百分点的优势击败共和党挑战者加里·科德里 (Gary Cordery)，赢得了夏威夷州州长的第二个任期。他和阿克顿是该国仅有的两位医生兼州长。

paras.en: Jasmine Clark, a microbiologist at Emory University, won a House of Representatives seat in Georgia’s 13th district. Clark, a Democrat, will represent parts of the city of Atlanta and will be the first Black woman with a science Ph.D. in Congress.
paras.zh: 埃默里大学微生物学家 Jasmine Clark 赢得了佐治亚州第 13 选区的众议院席位。克拉克是一名民主党人，将代表亚特兰大市的部分地区，并将成为第一位拥有科学博士学位的黑人女性。在国会。

paras.en: Democrat Rebecca Bennett, a former Navy pilot, who worked in the health care industry and has a degree in chemical engineering, flipped New Jersey’s seventh congressional district, which stretches across the northern and central parts of the state. She beat the two-term, incumbent Republican Tom Kean, Jr.
paras.zh: 民主党人丽贝卡·贝内特(Rebecca Bennett)是一名前海军飞行员，曾在医疗保健行业工作，拥有化学工程学位，她推翻了新泽西州的第七个国会选区，该选区横跨该州北部和中部。她击败了连任两届的现任共和党人小汤姆·基恩(Tom Kean, Jr.)。

paras.en: Christina Bohannan flipped Iowa’s first district, which stretches from the Des Moines suburbs to the southeastern corner of the state. Also a Democrat, Bohannan has worked as an environmental engineer and a lawyer. She beat Republican incumbent Mariannette Miller-Meeks, a physician, by nearly 10 points.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·博汉南（Christina Bohannan）翻转了爱荷华州的第一个选区，该选区从得梅因郊区一直延伸到该州的东南角。博汉南也是一名民主党人，曾担任环境工程师和律师。她以近 10 个百分点的优势击败了共和党现任医生玛丽安内特·米勒-米克斯 (Mariannette Miller-Meeks)。

paras.en: Democrat Mitchell Berman, an emergency room nurse, flipped Wisconsin’s first district, narrowly beating incumbent Bryan Steil and turning the district, which covers southeastern Wisconsin, blue for the first time in more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 急诊室护士、民主党人米切尔·伯曼(Mitchell Berman)以微弱优势击败了现任总统布莱恩·斯泰尔(Bryan Steil)，推翻了威斯康星州的第一选区，并将覆盖威斯康星州东南部的选区30多年来首次变成蓝色。

paras.en: A newcomer to politics, Berman spent more than a decade as a nurse at the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
paras.zh: 作为政坛新人，伯曼在美国退伍军人事务部担任了十多年的护士。

paras.en: Elaine Luria worked as a nuclear engineer for the U.S. Navy for two decades. She won the House seat for Virginia’s second district, which covers Virginia Beach and parts of the state’s coast. A Democrat, she previously served as the district’s representative from 2019 to 2023.
paras.zh: 伊莱恩·卢里亚 (Elaine Luria) 在美国海军担任核工程师长达二十年。她赢得了弗吉尼亚州第二选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖弗吉尼亚海滩和该州部分海岸。她是民主党人，曾于 2019 年至 2023 年担任该区代表。

paras.en: Democrat Adam Hamawy, a plastic surgeon and former U.S. Army physician, won New Jersey’s 12th district. He served as a trauma surgeon in Iraq and has since served as a volunteer doctor in war and disaster zones, including Haiti, Sudan and Gaza.
paras.zh: 整形外科医生、前美国陆军医生、民主党人亚当·哈马威 (Adam Hamawy) 赢得了新泽西州第 12 选区的胜利。他曾在伊拉克担任创伤外科医生，此后一直在海地、苏丹和加沙等战争和灾区担任志愿医生。

paras.en: Daniel Biss, a mathematician and former assistant professor at the University of Chicago, won the House seat in Illinois’s ninth district in a landslide after serving as the mayor of Evanston, Ill., for five years.
paras.zh: 数学家、芝加哥大学前助理教授丹尼尔·比斯 (Daniel Biss) 在担任伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿市市长五年后，以压倒性优势赢得了伊利诺伊州第九选区的众议院席位。

paras.en: Richard Pan, a Democrat and a pediatrician, won the House seat for California’s sixth district, which covers northern and west Sacramento. Pan was a member of the California State Senate from 2014 to 2022, when he championed vaccine mandates and protections, and unsuccessfully ran for mayor of Sacramento in 2024.
paras.zh: 民主党人和儿科医生理查德·潘赢得了加州第六选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖萨克拉门托北部和西部。潘在 2014 年至 2022 年期间担任加州参议院议员，当时他支持疫苗授权和保护，并于 2024 年竞选萨克拉门托市长，但未能成功。

paras.en: Jacqui Irwin, who worked as a systems engineer before entering politics, won a House seat in California’s 26th district, which covers most of Ventura County.
paras.zh: 杰奎·欧文 (Jacqui Irwin) 在进入政界之前曾担任系统工程师，赢得了加州第 26 选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖了文图拉县的大部分地区。

paras.en: Republican John Cowan, a neuroscientist, won a House of Representatives seat in Georgia’s 11th district. It will be his first position in public office after he unsuccessfully ran against then representative Marjorie Taylor Greene in the state’s 14th district.
paras.zh: 神经科学家、共和党人约翰·考恩赢得了佐治亚州第 11 选区的众议院席位。这将是他在该州第 14 选区与时任众议员马乔里·泰勒·格林 (Marjorie Taylor Greene) 竞选失败后首次担任公职。

paras.en: Republican and former anesthesiologist Andy Harris won reelection as representative of Maryland’s first district, which covers the state’s eastern shore.
paras.zh: 共和党人、前麻醉师安迪·哈里斯（Andy Harris）赢得连任，成为马里兰州第一选区的代表，该选区覆盖该州东海岸。

paras.en: Ronny Jackson, a Republican who served as physician to the president during Barack Obama’s second term and Donald Trump’s first term, won reelection in Texas’s 13th district, which includes the Texas panhandle.
paras.zh: 共和党人罗尼·杰克逊(Ronny Jackson)在巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)第二任期和唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)第一任期期间担任总统医生，在德克萨斯州第13选区（包括德克萨斯州狭长地带）赢得连任。

paras.en: Republican John Joyce won reelection in Pennsylvania’s 13th district, where he’s served since 2019. Joyce is a dermatologist by training.
paras.zh: 共和党人约翰·乔伊斯 (John Joyce) 在宾夕法尼亚州第 13 选区赢得连任，自 2019 年以来一直在该选区任职。乔伊斯是一名皮肤科医生。

paras.en: Rich McCormick, an emergency physician and a former military doctor, won reelection in Georgia’s seventh district, which includes the northern parts of the Atlanta metropolitan area.
paras.zh: 里奇·麦考密克（Rich McCormick）是一名急诊医生，也是一名前军医，他在佐治亚州第七选区赢得连任，该选区包括亚特兰大都会区的北部地区。

paras.en: Republican physician Bob Onder won a second term in Missouri’s third district, beating Democratic challenger and environmental chemist Bethany Mann by eight percentage points.
paras.zh: 共和党医生鲍勃·翁德 (Bob Onder) 在密苏里州第三选区赢得了第二个任期，击败民主党挑战者、环境化学家贝瑟尼·曼 (Bethany Mann) 八个百分点。

paras.en: Democratic physician Ami Bera won an eighth term in the House of Representatives and will represent California’s third district, which was recently redrawn. Bera previously served as the chief medical officer for the County of Sacramento.
paras.zh: 民主党医生阿米·贝拉 (Ami Bera) 赢得了众议院第八个任期，并将代表最近重新划分的加州第三选区。贝拉此前曾担任萨克拉门托县的首席医疗官。

paras.en: Democrat Herb Conaway won a second term as the representative for New Jersey’s third district. A physician specializing in internal medicine, Conaway is currently the only member of the newly elected Congress to hold a medical and law degree.
paras.zh: 民主党人赫伯·科纳威赢得了新泽西州第三选区代表的第二个任期。科纳威是一名专攻内科的医生，目前是新当选的国会中唯一一位拥有医学和法律学位的议员。

paras.en: Democrat Maxine Dexter was elected to represent Oregon’s third district, which includes most of Portland, for a second term. Dexter is a pulmonologist.
paras.zh: 民主党人玛克辛·德克斯特（Maxine Dexter）当选代表俄勒冈州第三选区（包括波特兰大部分地区）连任。德克斯特是一位肺科医生。

paras.en: Obstetrician-gynecologist Kelly Morrison won a second term in Minnesota’s third district. With the loss of incumbent Republican Roger Marshall in Kansas’s Senate race, Morrison will be the only ob-gyn in Congress.
paras.zh: 妇产科医生凯利·莫里森在明尼苏达州第三选区赢得了第二个任期。随着现任共和党人罗杰·马歇尔在堪萨斯州参议员竞选中落败，莫里森将成为国会中唯一的妇产科医生。

paras.en: Democrat Raul Ruiz, an emergency physician, won an eighth term as representative of California’s 25th district, beating Republican challenger Joe Males by nearly 30 percentage points.
paras.zh: 急诊科医生、民主党人劳尔·鲁伊斯(Raul Ruiz)以近30个百分点的优势击败共和党挑战者乔·马尔斯(Joe Males)，赢得加州第25选区代表第八个任期。

paras.en: Democrat Kim Schrier was the first pediatrician elected to Congress in 2018. She won reelection in Washington’s eighth district for a fifth term.
paras.zh: 民主党人 Kim Schrier 是 2018 年第一位当选国会议员的儿科医生。她在华盛顿第八选区赢得连任，第五次连任。

paras.en: A number of races with scientists or health care professionals in the running have not been called yet. These candidates include Democratic nurse Kristina Knickerbocker in Ohio; Democratic nuclear engineer Chris Jones in Arkansas; Democratic physician Amish Shah in Arizona; Republican physician Scott DesJarlais in Tennessee; Republican physician Mike Kennedy in Utah; Republican urologist Greg Murphy in North Carolina; Democrat and former NASA chief of staff Bale Dalton in Florida; and Democratic Army engineer Dwayne Romero in Colorado.
paras.zh: 许多由科学家或医疗保健专业人员参加的比赛尚未确定。这些候选人包括俄亥俄州的民主党护士克里斯蒂娜·尼克博克(Kristina Knickerbocker)；阿肯色州的民主党核工程师克里斯·琼斯；亚利桑那州的民主党医生阿米什·沙阿；田纳西州的共和党医生斯科特·德贾莱斯（Scott DesJarlais）；犹他州的共和党医生迈克·肯尼迪；北卡罗来纳州共和党泌尿科医生格雷格·墨菲；民主党人、美国宇航局前参谋长贝尔·道尔顿 (Bale Dalton)，佛罗里达州；和科罗拉多州的民主党工程师德韦恩·罗梅罗。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/5/26): This is a developing story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/5/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，将会更新。

articles.title: Ancient humans used cannabis in burial rituals 2,800 years ago

paras.en: Whether you’re eating, smoking or drinking it, cannabis is commonplace; in the U.S., more people use it on a daily or near-daily basis than any other intoxicating substance, including alcohol or cigarettes. But how far back does humanity’s relationship with cannabis stretch?
paras.zh: 无论你是吃、吸还是喝，大麻都很常见。在美国，每天或几乎每天使用它的人比任何其他致醉物质（包括酒精或香烟）都要多。但人类与大麻的关系可以追溯到多久之前呢？

paras.en: In new research, archaeologists have dated the earliest known human use of cannabis to 2,800 years ago. The drug was likely used in a burial ritual at a tomb discovered in what is now Siberia. The archaeologists found direct evidence of its use, gathered from a combination of seeds and human hair—together these provide new insights into ancient societies and their cultural legacies’ potential influence on our world today, experts say.
paras.zh: 在新的研究中，考古学家将已知人类最早使用大麻的日期追溯到 2800 年前。这种药物很可能用于在现在西伯利亚发现的一座坟墓的埋葬仪式中。专家表示，考古学家从种子和人类头发的组合中发现了其使用的直接证据，这些证据共同为了解古代社会及其文化遗产对当今世界的潜在影响提供了新的见解。

paras.en: “There is a lot of speculation about the use of psychoactive substances in the past,” says Gino Caspari, the paper’s lead author and an archaeologist at the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Jena, Germany. “It is extremely rare to find real evidence for it. We bring a bit of realism into these debates, and we show that cannabis has a deep cultural history which might factor into ongoing societal discourse on legalization and medical use.”
paras.zh: “关于过去使用精神活性物质的情况有很多猜测，”该论文的主要作者、德国耶拿马克斯·普朗克地球人类学研究所的考古学家吉诺·卡斯帕里（Gino Caspari）说。 “找到真正的证据是极其罕见的。我们在这些辩论中引入了一些现实主义，我们表明大麻具有深厚的文化历史，这可能会影响正在进行的关于合法化和医疗用途的社会讨论。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Caspari’s team excavated Tunnug 1, a burial mound used by the Scythian people in southern Siberia that dates to between the eighth and ninth centuries B.C.E. While studying the tombs, the archaeologists found more than 1,000 cannabis seeds. Radiocarbon analysis dated them back to the early eighth century B.C.E.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里 (Caspari) 的团队挖掘了图努格 1 号 (Tunnug 1)，这是西伯利亚南部斯基泰人使用的墓葬，其历史可以追溯到公元前八世纪到公元前九世纪之间。在研究坟墓时，考古学家发现了 1000 多颗大麻种子。放射性碳分析将它们追溯到公元前八世纪初。

paras.en: The real breakthrough, though, was in the human hair recovered from the burial sites, Caspari says. It contained cannabinol, a chemical produced from tetrahydrocannabinol, or THC—the compound that makes cannabis psychoactive.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里说，真正的突破在于从墓地中发现的人类头发。它含有大麻酚，这是一种由四氢大麻酚或 THC（使大麻具有精神活性的化合物）产生的化学物质。
