paras.zh: 霍姆斯-罗斯女士同时也是阿德莱德内南部米查姆市的市长，她表示，全州有几个议会正在试验这项技术，以期在人工监督下提高效率。

paras.en: "If you drive past 10 or 20 cars, then that video can be viewed, and those fines can be mailed out," she said.
paras.zh: “如果你开车经过 10 或 20 辆车，那么可以观看该视频，并且可以邮寄这些罚款，”她说。

paras.en: "If you're stopping and you're giving out those 20 individually, it just takes more time.
paras.zh: “如果你停下来，单独分发这 20 个，只会花费更多时间。

paras.en: "So if there's a way of doing it accurately and more efficiently, it's better for everyone."
paras.zh: “因此，如果有一种方法可以更准确、更有效地做到这一点，那对每个人都更好。”

articles.title: Paraguay's impeached ex-president charged with crimes linked to collapse of major bank

paras.en: Paraguay's impeached ex-president charged with crimes linked to collapse of major bank
paras.zh: 巴拉圭被弹劾的前总统被指控犯有与大型银行倒闭有关的罪行

paras.en: Santiago Peña charged with breach of trust, administration for personal gain
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥·佩纳被控违反信任、谋取私利的管理罪

paras.en: A Paraguayan judge on Saturday ordered former President Santiago Peña held in pretrial detention at a military facility while prosecutors investigate his ties to digital lender Ueno, whose collapse has left millions of customers struggling to access their accounts.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭一名法官周六下令将前总统圣地亚哥·佩纳审前拘留在军事设施中，同时检察官调查他与数字贷款公司 Ueno 的关系，该公司的倒闭导致数百万客户难以访问自己的账户。

paras.en: Judge Humberto Otazú ordered Peña, who has been charged with breach of trust and administration for personal gain, held at the facility, saying detention was necessary to ensure he remained in the country while the case proceeded.
paras.zh: 温贝托·奥塔苏法官下令将被指控违反信任和谋取个人利益的管理罪的佩纳关押在该设施中，并称拘留是必要的，以确保他在案件审理期间留在该国。

paras.en: The detention, a day after Peña's removal from office, deepens a political and financial crisis that has prompted protests in Asunción, swept up senior officials and led regulators to try to contain risks to the wider financial system.
paras.zh: 佩尼亚被免职一天后的这次拘留加深了政治和金融危机，引发了亚松森的抗议活动，席卷了高级官员，并导致监管机构试图遏制更广泛的金融体系面临的风险。

paras.en: Peña's attorney, Ricardo Preda, told journalists that Peña was pleading not guilty to the charges.
paras.zh: 佩纳的律师里卡多·普雷达告诉记者，佩纳对这些指控表示不认罪。

paras.en: "We will submit to the investigation and I am sure that when this investigation is over the result will be the dismissal," Preda said.
paras.zh: 普雷达说：“我们将接受调查，我相信调查结束后，结果将是解雇。”

paras.en: Otazú also ordered former central bank chief Carlos Carvallo to pretrial detention in a holding centre after prosecutors charged him with breach of trust, producing false public documents and administration for personal gain.
paras.zh: 奥塔祖还下令将前央行行长卡洛斯·卡瓦洛 (Carlos Carvallo) 审前拘留在拘留中心，此前检察官指控他违反信任、提供虚假公共文件和谋取个人利益的行政行为。

paras.en: Carvallo did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 卡瓦洛没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: Peña has been accused of using his political influence to steer hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds into Ueno while regulators overlooked risky insider lending.
paras.zh: 佩纳被指控利用其政治影响力将数亿美元的公共资金引导到上野，而监管机构却忽视了高风险的内部贷款。

paras.en: Prosecutors say that relationship created a conflict of interest as Peña encouraged, facilitated or influenced decisions benefiting the bank.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，由于佩尼亚鼓励、促进或影响有利于银行的决策，这种关系造成了利益冲突。

paras.en: Rumblings of the crisis started in June, when inspectors at the central bank found a pattern of risky lending to insiders, reported ABC Color, a leading Paraguayan newspaper.
paras.zh: 据巴拉圭主要报纸 ABC Color 报道，危机的传言始于 6 月份，当时央行检查人员发现了向内部人士提供高风险贷款的模式。

paras.en: Ueno Bank executives arrive in custody at the anti-corruption prosecutor's office in Asunción on Wednesday. (Jorge Saenz/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 上野银行高管周三抵达亚松森反腐败检察官办公室被拘留。 （豪尔赫·萨恩斯/美联社）

paras.en: Ueno had extended large sums to companies tied to its owners, beyond what the law allows and without enough collateral to cover the debts if they went bad.
paras.zh: 上野向与其所有者相关的公司提供了大量资金，超出了法律允许的范围，而且如果这些公司出现坏账，也没有足够的抵押品来偿还债务。

paras.en: By November, regulators investigating Ueno's loans to companies linked to its owners found poorly documented lending, the central bank said, as well as expenses the bank had wrongly counted as assets.
paras.zh: 央行表示，到 11 月，监管机构在调查上野向与其所有者有关联的公司提供的贷款时发现，贷款记录不实，而且该行还错误地计入了资产。

paras.en: Once the books were corrected, Ueno's capital — the cushion banks must keep to absorb losses — fell to less than half the legal minimum.
paras.zh: 一旦账目得到更正，上野的资本——银行必须保留以吸收损失的缓冲资金——就降至法定最低限额的一半以下。

paras.en: A person stands outside a closed branch of Ueno Bank in Asunción on Thursday. (Cesar Olmedo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周四，一个人站在亚松森上野银行一家已关闭的分行外。 （塞萨尔·奥尔梅多/路透社）

paras.en: The central bank announced the lender's seizure Tuesday — freezing the accounts of nearly three million customers — and began a process of transferring deposits and recoverable assets to other banks before liquidating what remained.
paras.zh: 央行周二宣布扣押该银行，冻结近 300 万客户的账户，并开始将存款和可收回资产转移到其他银行，然后再清算剩余资产。

paras.en: Ueno's app, cards and transfers went dark and its branches locked their doors, leaving desperate depositors lined up outside.
paras.zh: 上野的应用程序、卡和转账都被关闭，其分行也锁上了门，留下绝望的储户在外面排队。

paras.en: On Wednesday, a rush to open new accounts elsewhere crashed other banks' mobile apps, fuelling public panic.
paras.zh: 周三，在其他地方开设新账户的热潮导致其他银行的移动应用程序崩溃，加剧了公众的恐慌。

paras.en: People line up outside a branch of the Banco Familiar bank in Asunción on Wednesday. (Daniel Duarte/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周三，人们在亚松森 Banco Familiar 银行的一家分行外排队。 （丹尼尔·杜阿尔特/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The central bank on Saturday said the equivalent of $160 million US had been paid out to nearly 1.2 million savers, under the state deposit guarantee scheme.
paras.zh: 央行周六表示，根据国家存款担保计划，已向近 120 万储户支付了相当于 1.6 亿美元的资金。

paras.en: Peña, who was a shareholder in Ueno’s holding company until March 2025, has denied wrongdoing and said the bank's problems were a regulatory matter.
paras.zh: 佩尼亚在 2025 年 3 月之前一直是上野控股公司的股东，他否认有不当行为，并表示该银行的问题是监管问题。

paras.en: The two charges against Peña could carry a sentence of up to 10 years in prison each, prosecutors say.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，针对佩纳的两项指控可能每项最高可判处 10 年监禁。

paras.en: Carvallo resigned as central bank chief earlier this week as the crisis surrounding Ueno escalated. He had previously headed the digital lender until 2023.
paras.zh: 随着围绕上野的危机升级，卡瓦洛本周早些时候辞去央行行长职务。此前，他一直领导这家数字贷款公司直至 2023 年。

paras.en: Prosecutors have charged 27 bank officials and associates with breach of trust and attempted fraud.
paras.zh: 检察官指控 27 名银行官员和同事违反信托和企图欺诈。

paras.en: Peña submitted his resignation Thursday, but Congress did not accept it and pressed ahead with an impeachment trial. Opposition lawmakers insisted on his removal to prevent him from leaving office with immunity.
paras.zh: 佩纳周四提交了辞呈，但国会没有接受，并继续进行弹劾审判。反对派议员坚持将他免职，以防止他在获得豁免权的情况下离任。

paras.en: "He must go, but not home. He must go to a maximum-security prison," opposition Sen. Yolanda Paredes told reporters. "The public is fed up with impunity."
paras.zh: “他必须走，但不能回家。他必须去最高安全级别的监狱，”反对党参议员约兰达·帕雷德斯告诉记者。 “公众已经厌倦了有罪不罚的现象。”

paras.en: His ouster brought Vice-President Pedro Alliana to power, with the longtime ruling Colorado Party politician sworn in on Friday to complete Peña’s term through August 2028.
paras.zh: 他的下台使副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳上台，这位长期执政的科罗拉多党政治家于周五宣誓就职，完成佩纳的任期至 2028 年 8 月。

paras.en: Pedro Alliana addresses lawmakers after taking the oath of office as Paraguay's new president on Friday after Peña's impeachment. (Jorge Saenz/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 佩纳被弹劾后，佩德罗·阿利亚纳于周五宣誓就任巴拉圭新总统后向立法者发表讲话。 （豪尔赫·萨恩斯/美联社）

paras.en: The collapse has left millions of customers struggling to access their accounts and prompted protests in Asunción.
paras.zh: 崩溃导致数百万客户难以访问自己的账户，并引发了亚松森的抗议活动。

paras.en: Thousands of protesters demanding access to their frozen savings and accountability for Ueno's failure have clashed with police firing rubber bullets and pepper spray this week.
paras.zh: 本周，数千名抗议者要求获得冻结的积蓄，并要求对上野的失败负责，并与发射橡皮子弹和胡椒喷雾的警察发生冲突。

paras.en: Paraguay's largest teachers' union, which has more than 40,000 members, plans to begin an indefinite national strike Monday to press for protection of public pension funds.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭最大的教师工会拥有超过 40,000 名成员，计划周一开始无限期全国罢工，敦促保护公共养老基金。

paras.en: Protesters gather outside Peña's residence in Asunción on Friday. (Cesar Olmedo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五，抗议者聚集在亚松森佩尼亚的住所外。 （塞萨尔·奥尔梅多/路透社）

paras.en: On Saturday, a few dozen protesters gathered outside the attorney general's compound hoping to express their frustration with Peña, who was driven quickly out of the building.
paras.zh: 周六，数十名抗议者聚集在总检察长大院外，希望表达对佩纳的不满，佩纳很快就被赶出了大楼。

paras.en: Some of the protesters said they also want Paraguay's new president, who was a close ally of Peña, to be investigated.
paras.zh: 一些抗议者表示，他们还希望对佩纳的亲密盟友巴拉圭新总统进行调查。

paras.en: "They are all accomplices," said Liliana Jara, a demonstrator who showed up at the site. "They are part of the same clique."
paras.zh: “他们都是同谋，”出现在现场的示威者莉莉安娜·贾拉 (Liliana Jara) 说。 “他们是同一个集团的一部分。”

articles.title: Israel's president asks Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu's rival, to form new government

paras.en: Israel's president asks Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu's rival, to form new government
paras.zh: 以色列总统要求内塔尼亚胡的竞争对手加迪·艾森科特组建新政府

paras.en: Recent election left neither Eisenkot nor Netanyahu with clear path to power
paras.zh: 最近的选举给艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡都没有明确的权力之路

paras.en: Israel's president on Saturday chose Gadi Eisenkot, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's strongest rival, to try to form a new government following a deadlocked election that left neither man with a clear path to power.
paras.zh: 以色列总统周六选择了总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡最强劲的竞争对手加迪·艾森科特来试图组建新政府，此前选举陷入僵局，两人都没有明确的权力之路。

paras.en: Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader, is fighting to hold onto office after his religious-nationalist coalition lost its majority in an Oct. 27 election but still emerged as the largest bloc in parliament.
paras.zh: 以色列任职时间最长的领导人内塔尼亚胡在其宗教民族主义联盟在10月27日的选举中失去多数席位后，正在努力保住职位，但仍成为议会中最大的集团。

paras.en: An anti-Netanyahu bloc led by Eisenkot, an ex-military chief, has refused to join forces with Arab parties who could hand it a majority of seats in Israel's parliament, the Knesset.
paras.zh: 由前军事首长艾森科特领导的反内塔尼亚胡集团拒绝与可能让其在以色列议会中获得多数席位的阿拉伯政党联手。

paras.en: But Arab leaders, incensed by what they view as the racist policies of Netanyahu and his far-right allies, still nominated Eisenkot to try to form a government first — giving him the most endorsements.
paras.zh: 但阿拉伯领导人对内塔尼亚胡及其极右翼盟友的种族主义政策感到愤怒，仍然提名艾森科特试图首先组建政府，并给予他最多的支持。

paras.en: "President Herzog has invited Gadi Eisenkot to the President’s Residence, where he will be tasked with forming the government tomorrow," said the spokesperson of Israel President Isaac Herzog, whose largely ceremonial role involves nominating a candidate to form a coalition after elections.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格的发言人表示：“赫尔佐格总统已邀请加迪·艾森科特前往总统官邸，他明天将在那里负责组建政府。”他的主要职责是在选举后提名一名候选人组建联合政府。

paras.en: Israel's President Isaac Herzog, right, receives the results of Israel's elections from Supreme Court Justice Noam Sohlberg at the president's residence in Jerusalem on Wednesday. (Ohad Zwigenberg/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周三，以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格（右）在耶路撒冷总统官邸从最高法院法官诺姆·索尔伯格手中接过以色列选举结果。 （奥哈德·茨维根伯格/美联社）

paras.en: Weeks of protracted negotiations are expected to follow Eisenkot's nomination. He has 28 days to try to forge a government, with a possible 14-day extension.
paras.zh: 艾森科特获得提名后预计将进行数周的旷日持久的谈判。他有 28 天的时间尝试组建政府，并可能延长 14 天。

paras.en: His potential pathways to power include trying to form a minority government with Arab support from the outside; forming a coalition with ultra-Orthodox parties that he and his allies have shunned in the past; or forging a unity government with Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 他的潜在权力途径包括尝试在阿拉伯外部支持下组建少数派政府；与他和他的盟友过去回避的极端正统政党组成联盟；或与内塔尼亚胡组建联合政府。

paras.en: Analysts say that all three options are unlikely to take shape. If Eisenkot fails, another candidate can try to form a government and if that candidate fails, parliament can nominate another.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，这三种选择都不太可能实现。如果艾森科特失败，另一位候选人可以尝试组建政府，如果该候选人失败，议会可以提名另一位候选人。

paras.en: There is a deadline for the process of about 100 days. If no one succeeds, another election is held.
paras.zh: 该过程的最后期限约为 100 天。如果没有人成功，则举行另一次选举。

paras.en: An Orthodox Jewish voter casts a ballot at a polling station in Haifa, Israel, on Oct. 27. (Baz Ratner/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 10 月 27 日，一名东正教犹太选民在以色列海法的一个投票站投票。（巴兹·拉特纳/美联社）

paras.en: "This is the time to establish a national emergency government. I will do anything possible to prove us worthy," Eisenkot posted on his X account just after the president's announcement.
paras.zh: “现在是建立国家紧急政府的时候了。我将尽一切可能证明我们的价值，”总统宣布这一消息后，艾森科特在他的 X 账户上发帖称。

paras.en: Likud won the most seats of any single party with 27 in the 120-seat Knesset, but Netanyahu's wider religious-nationalist coalition garnered only 53 in total, short of a 61-seat majority.
paras.zh: 利库德集团在议会 120 个席位中赢得了 27 个席位，是所有政党中最多的，但内塔尼亚胡更广泛的宗教民族主义联盟总共只获得了 53 个席位，未达到 61 个席位的多数席位。

paras.en: Eisenkot's Yashar party emerged as the second-largest party with 21 seats, while his coalition, spanning four centre-left to right-wing Jewish-led parties, won just 48 seats. Two parties representing Israel's Arab minority won an unprecedented 19 seats.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党以 21 个席位成为第二大党，而他的联盟由四个中左翼和右翼犹太人领导的政党组成，只赢得了 48 个席位。代表以色列阿拉伯少数民族的两个政党史无前例地赢得了 19 个席位。

paras.en: A son of Moroccan immigrants, Eisenkot, 66, would be the country's first prime minister from Israel's Mizrahi community, Jews who trace their roots to the Middle East and North Africa.
paras.zh: 66 岁的艾森科特是摩洛哥移民的儿子，他将成为该国第一位来自以色列米兹拉希社区的总理，该社区是犹太人，其根源可追溯到中东和北非。

paras.en: Reserved and media-shy, Eisenkot only entered politics in 2022. He briefly served in Netanyahu's wartime cabinet following Hamas's Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel before returning to the opposition.
paras.zh: 艾森科特性格内向，不愿接受媒体采访，直到 2022 年才进入政坛。哈马斯 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击以色列后，他曾短暂在内塔尼亚胡的战时内阁中任职，然后又回到反对派。

paras.en: From opposition, he publicly rebuked Netanyahu over his leadership, including his management of the military campaign in Gaza, and has sworn that he would not serve in government with him.
paras.zh: 他在反对派中公开谴责内塔尼亚胡的领导能力，包括他对加沙军事行动的管理，并发誓不会与内塔尼亚胡一起在政府任职。

paras.en: Eisenkot's public standing is also bound up with the personal price his family has paid since 2023: a son and two nephews were killed fighting in Gaza.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的公众地位也与他的家人自 2023 年以来所付出的个人代价密切相关：一个儿子和两个侄子在加沙的战斗中丧生。

paras.en: Eisenkot highlighted his security credentials on the campaign trail, citing his "Dahiyeh doctrine" of responding to attacks with disproportionate force, which he deployed as a commander during Israel's 2006 war with Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.
paras.zh: 艾森科特强调了他在竞选过程中的安全资历，并引用了他以不成比例的武力应对袭击的“达希耶主义”，他在 2006 年以色列与伊朗支持的黎巴嫩真主党的战争期间作为指挥官部署了这一主义。

paras.en: Eisenkot has criticized settler violence against Palestinians, which has surged since 2023, raising tensions in Israel’s ties with Western states, and he opposes Netanyahu's far-right coalition partners Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, who have both faced sanctions by some Western countries for inciting violence against Palestinians.
paras.zh: 艾森科特批评定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为，这种暴力行为自2023年以来激增，加剧了以色列与西方国家关系的紧张局势，他还反对内塔尼亚胡的极右翼联盟伙伴伊塔马尔·本-格维尔和贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇，他们​​都因煽动针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为而面临一些西方国家的制裁。

articles.title: UFC boss Dana White says he's meeting with Trump after press secretary job offer

paras.en: UFC boss Dana White says he's meeting with Trump after press secretary job offer
paras.zh: UFC老板达纳怀特表示，在获得新闻秘书职位后，他将与特朗普会面

paras.en: U.S. president has attended several UFC events with close friend White
paras.zh: 美国总统与密友怀特一起参加了几场UFC赛事

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has offered the job of White House press secretary to his friend and UFC boss Dana White, an announcement unconventional even for the norm-busting president. White said Saturday that he plans to meet with Trump on Monday at the White House.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六表示，他已向他的朋友兼 UFC 老板达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 提供了白宫新闻秘书的职位，即使对于这位打破常规的总统来说，这一宣布也是不合常规的。怀特周六表示，他计划周一在白宫与特朗普会面。

paras.en: Trump, while he was at his golf club in Florida, posted on social media that he made the offer to "the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior" to become the Republican president's chief spokesperson.
paras.zh: 特朗普在佛罗里达州的高尔夫俱乐部时在社交媒体上发帖称，他向“伟大的达纳怀特，一位暴力斗士和战士”提出了成为共和党总统首席发言人的邀请。

paras.en: White, who was in London on Saturday for a boxing event, was asked at a news conference about Trump's post and responded by saying that he planned to fly to Washington right after and meet with Trump on Monday.
paras.zh: 怀特周六在伦敦参加拳击比赛，在新闻发布会上被问及特朗普的帖子时，他回应说，他计划立即飞往华盛顿，并于周一与特朗普会面。

paras.en: When asked how he would balance the job with the current positions he has in the fighting world, White seemed confused by the question and then said, "Yeah, I got a lot of jobs already."
paras.zh: 当被问及他将如何平衡这份工作与他目前在格斗界的职位时，怀特似乎对这个问题感到困惑，然后说：“是的，我已经找到了很多工作。”

paras.en: He declined to say what conversations he'd had with Trump but said, "I'm sure I'll have more to talk about after that."
paras.zh: 他拒绝透露与特朗普进行了哪些对话，但表示：“我确信在那之后我会有更多话要谈。”

paras.en: White and Trump are seen at the White House on June 14. (Julia Demaree Nikhinson/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 6 月 14 日，怀特和特朗普出现在白宫。（Julia Demaree Nikhinson/美联社）

paras.en: Before the news conference, the UFC head shared an image of Trump's post on Instagram, along with an image of himself standing behind the podium in the White House press briefing room with the words "On to the next chapter."
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会之前，这位 UFC 负责人在 Instagram 上分享了一张特朗普帖子的图片，以及一张他自己站在白宫新闻发布室讲台后面的照片，上面写着“进入下一个篇章”。

paras.en: The White House and a spokesperson for the UFC did not respond Saturday to messages inquiring about the Truth Social post.
paras.zh: 周六，白宫和 UFC 发言人没有回复有关“真相社会”帖子的询问信息。

paras.en: Trump said in his post that he requested that White bring along several UFC fighters as "assistants," adding, "We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job!"
paras.zh: 特朗普在帖子中表示，他要求怀特带几名UFC选手作为“助手”，并补充道，“我们需要这些人来保卫我们免受疯狂左派的侵害。达纳将成为一名与众不同的新闻秘书。达纳，请接受这份工作！”

paras.en: While White didn't make it clear if he was seriously considering the position of becoming the primary spokesperson for the president of the United States, he did elsewhere in his news conference describe his ambitions to expand the Zuffa Boxing organization he also runs with Saudi Arabian backers and hold more of its events around the world.
paras.zh: 虽然怀特没有明确表示他是否正在认真考虑成为美国总统的主要发言人，但他在新闻发布会的其他地方描述了他扩大祖法拳击组织的雄心，他还与沙特阿拉伯的支持者一起运营，并在世界各地举办更多的活动。

paras.en: Trump's post came as his White House is in a period of major transition and struggling with his party's deep losses in Tuesday's midterm elections. The historic wins by Democratic candidates, including in areas that Republicans had held for decades, led to the GOP losing control of both chambers of Congress.
paras.zh: 特朗普上任之际，他的白宫正处于重大过渡时期，并正在为他的政党在周二中期选举中惨败而苦苦挣扎。民主党候选人的历史性胜利，包括在共和党几十年来占据的领域的胜利，导致共和党失去了对国会两院的控制权。

paras.en: Trump on Friday announced he was replacing his longtime adviser Susie Wiles, who was seen as something of a tempering force on the president's impulses, with aide Stephen Miller to serve as the next chief of staff. Miller is known as the architect of the administration's hard-line immigration policies and is among the most determined of Trump's inner circle.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五宣布，他将用助手斯蒂芬·米勒(Stephen Miller)取代长期顾问苏西·怀尔斯(Susie Wiles)，担任下一任幕僚长，苏西·怀尔斯被认为是抑制总统冲动的力量。米勒被认为是政府强硬移民政策的设计师，也是特朗普核心圈子中最坚定的人之一。

paras.en: The shake-up at the heart of his administration follows the brief but tumultuous week when Trump tried out a new press secretary in Katie Zacharia, who seemed uncomfortable in her sole appearance with reporters before leaving the job after five days.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府在短暂但动荡的一周内进行了核心的改组，当时特朗普试用了凯蒂·扎卡里亚（Katie Zacharia）的新新闻秘书，凯蒂·扎卡里亚（Katie Zacharia）在五天后离职前唯一一次与记者见面似乎感到不舒服。

paras.en: The post had been vacant since Karoline Leavitt left at the end of August. Trump remains without a chief spokesperson.
paras.zh: 自卡罗琳·莱维特八月底离职后，该职位一直空缺。特朗普仍然没有首席发言人。

paras.en: Trump is close friends with White and has attended several UFC events with him since returning to the White House in January 2025.
paras.zh: 特朗普与怀特是亲密朋友，自 2025 年 1 月回到白宫以来，曾与他一起参加过多次 UFC 赛事。

paras.en: He brought White and the sport to the White House's South Lawn in June for the celebration of America's 250th year of its independence and the president's own 80th birthday. A wire-mesh Octagon was constructed near the executive mansion under "the Claw," a spaceship-like metal arch fitted with lights, sound equipment and large screens.
paras.zh: 6 月，他将怀特和这项运动带到了白宫南草坪，庆祝美国独立 250 周年和总统本人的 80 岁生日。在“爪”下的行政官邸附近建造了一个金属丝网八边形，“爪”是一个宇宙飞船般的金属拱门，配有灯光、音响设备和大屏幕。

paras.en: "It was an amazing experience, this was a one-of-one," said White afterward.
paras.zh: “这是一次奇妙的经历，这是独一无二的，”怀特事后说道。

paras.en: White also spoke at the Republican National Conventions in 2016, 2020 and 2024.
paras.zh: 怀特还在 2016 年、2020 年和 2024 年的共和党全国代表大会上发表了讲话。

articles.title: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections

paras.en: South Africa's African National Congress (ANC) is heading for an historically poor election performance, with the near-final tally from Wednesday's municipal polls showing it coming in with just over 30% of the vote.
paras.zh: 南非非洲人国民大会 (ANC) 的选举表现将创下历史新低，周三市政民意调查的接近最终结果显示，该党的得票率略高于 30%。

paras.en: The ANC also lost its majority in six of the eight metropolitan regions, South Africa's Electoral Commission said Saturday in sharing the results after 98% of votes were counted.
paras.zh: 南非选举委员会周六在统计 98% 的选票后分享结果时表示，非国大在 8 个大都市区中的 6 个地区也失去了多数席位。

paras.en: South African voters in 2026 are angry about water and electricity shortages, with the ANC taking the blame for the poor state of municipalities. High unemployment, crime, and widespread corruption are other pressing issues.
paras.zh: 2026 年南非选民对水电短缺感到愤怒，非国大将城市糟糕的状况归咎于该党。高失业率、犯罪和普遍腐败是其他紧迫问题。

paras.en: ANC leader, and South African president, Cyril Ramaphosa, has not yet addressed the poor performance as of Saturday evening. However, during the week, he admitted in his weekly presidential letter that "municipal failures have contributed to declining public trust and confidence in democratic governance."
paras.zh: 截至周六晚上，非国大领导人兼南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨尚未解决糟糕的表现。然而，本周他在每周的总统信中承认，“市政失误导致公众对民主治理的信任和信心下降。”

paras.en: On Saturday, ANC Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula told reporters that the ANC needs to work on winning back public confidence.
paras.zh: 周六，非国大秘书长菲基尔·姆巴卢拉告诉记者，非国大需要努力赢回公众信心。

paras.en: "We cannot ask the people to trust us merely because of our history," Mbalula said.
paras.zh: 姆巴卢拉说：“我们不能仅仅因为我们的历史就要求人们信任我们。”

paras.en: "This has been a very catastrophic outcome for the ANC ... as much as we are the largest party, it has been catastrophic for the movement," he added.
paras.zh: “这对非国大来说是一个非常灾难性的结果……尽管我们是最大的政党，但这对这场运动来说也是灾难性的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Although the ANC will still be the single largest party by overall vote percentage, it had governed with an absolute majority for most of its history up until the general election in 2024 saw it lose an outright parliamentary majority for the first time in South Africa's democratic era.
paras.zh: 尽管非国大仍将是总得票率最大的政党，但它在其历史的大部分时间里一直以绝对多数执政，直到 2024 年大选，它在南非民主时代首次失去了议会绝对多数席位。

paras.en: "This is the most severe result that the ANC would have feared," political analyst Daniel Silke told the AFP news agency.
paras.zh: 政治分析家丹尼尔·西尔克告诉法新社：“这是非国大担心的最严重的结果。”

paras.en: "It's the ANC's worst result in history," Silke said, adding that the result will undermine the ANC's ability to exert authority on the local and national level. The results could also provide a bellwether of voter sentiment ahead of the 2029 general elections.
paras.zh: 西尔克说：“这是非国大历史上最糟糕的结果。”他补充说，这一结果将削弱非国大在地方和国家层面行使权力的能力。结果还可能成为 2029 年大选前选民情绪的风向标。

paras.en: Once led by Nelson Mandela, the ANC was instrumental in ending apartheid, and took and power in 1994 after South Africa became a democracy.
paras.zh: 非国大曾由纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 领导，在结束种族隔离方面发挥了重要作用，并于 1994 年南非成为民主国家后掌权。

paras.en: But over the past decade, it has steadily performed worse in one election after another. In 2024, the ANC secured just over 40% in the 2024 national polls and 46% at the previous municipal elections in 2021.
paras.zh: 但在过去的十年里，它在一次又一次的选举中表现越来越差。 2024 年，非国大在 2024 年全国民意调查中获得略高于 40% 的支持率，在 2021 年上次市政选举中获得 46% 的支持率。

paras.en: After losing the absolute majority in 2024, the ANC formed a cross-party national unity government with all the parties represented in parliament, which is still in power.
paras.zh: 2024年，非国大失去绝对多数席位后，组建了跨党派民族团结政府，各党派均在议会中拥有代表权，目前议会仍在执政。

paras.en: The ANC's decline comes amid disillusionment over corruption, mismanagement and high unemployment. Smaller parties have also emerged across South Africa's political landscape, cutting into the ANC's voter base.
paras.zh: 非国大衰落之际，人们对腐败、管理不善和高失业率感到失望。南非政治格局中也出现了较小的政党，削弱了非国大的选民基础。

paras.en: South Africa is now looking at complex coalition negotiations for municipal level governing alliances.
paras.zh: 南非目前正在考虑建立市级治理联盟的复杂联盟谈判。

paras.en: Runner up in the polls looks to be the pro-business, center-right Democratic Alliance (DA), coming in at 24% of the votes.
paras.zh: 在民调中排名第二的似乎是亲商的中右翼民主联盟 (DA)，获得 24% 的选票。

paras.en: The DA is set to keep control of Cape Town after winning an absolute majority. It also performed well in the capital, Pretoria, and economic hub of Johannesburg, and is expected to form coalitions that exclude the ANC.
paras.zh: DA 在赢得绝对多数后将继续控制开普敦。它在首都比勒陀利亚和经济中心约翰内斯堡也表现良好，预计将形成排除非国大的联盟。

paras.en: "All of the cut and thrust that comes with the election is now over, and it is time now... to put together governments that can actually fix these towns and cities," DA leader Geordin Hill-Lewis told reporters.
paras.zh: 民主联盟领导人乔丁·希尔-刘易斯对记者表示：“选举带来的所有激烈竞争现在都已经结束，现在是时候……组建能够真正修复这些城镇的政府了。”

paras.en: "We have already reached out to many parties over the last 24 hours and will continue to do so today," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“过去 24 小时内，我们已经与多方进行了接触，今天还将继续这样做。”

articles.title: Armenia's selective prosecution: A threat to EU relations?

paras.en: In early October, Artur Danielyan, leader of Armenia's opposition party Adekvad, was arrested following a Facebook post criticizing Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan.
paras.zh: 10 月初，亚美尼亚反对党 Adekvad 领导人阿图尔·丹尼尔扬 (Artur Danielyan) 在 Facebook 发帖批评总理尼科尔·帕辛扬 (Nikol Pashinyan) 后被捕。

paras.en: The incident is part of a growing trend: Over the past two years, Armenian authorities have brought charges against multiple opposition figures, largely based on their social media activity.
paras.zh: 该事件是日益增长的趋势的一部分：在过去两年中，亚美尼亚当局对多名反对派人士提出指控，主要是因为他们的社交媒体活动。

paras.en: Civil society representatives warn that such selective justice signals a worrying turn toward democratic backsliding.
paras.zh: 民间社会代表警告说，这种选择性司法标志着令人担忧的民主倒退。

paras.en: The grounds for Danielyan's detention were Facebook posts in which he criticized both Pashinyan and the country's security services.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔扬被拘留的理由是他在 Facebook 上发表的帖子，其中批评了帕辛扬和该国的安全部门。

paras.en: One point of contention was Pashinyan's stance on a possible prisoner exchange involving an Azerbaijani soldier accused of breaking into the home of a 39-year-old woman in the Armenian village of Shaki and injuring her and her children.
paras.zh: 争论的一个焦点是帕希尼扬对可能涉及一名阿塞拜疆士兵交换战俘的立场，该士兵被指控闯入亚美尼亚沙基村一名 39 岁妇女的家中并伤害她和她的孩子。

paras.en: In an interview with Armenian news outlet Infocom, Pashinyan ruled out swapping the soldier imprisoned in Armenia for detained Armenians in Azerbaijan. Danielyan responded with a scathing attack, calling the prime minister a "scumbag" and accusing him of being unwilling to bring his fellow citizens home.
paras.zh: 在接受亚美尼亚新闻媒体 Infocom 采访时，帕希尼扬排除了将亚美尼亚被监禁的士兵换成阿塞拜疆被拘留的亚美尼亚人的可能性。丹尼尔扬以严厉的攻击回应，称总理是“渣男”，并指责他不愿意将同胞带回家。

paras.en: Armenia and Azerbaijan were in conflict for three decades over Nagorno-Karabakh, a breakaway Azerbaijani region populated by Armenians that declared independence in the 1990s. After Azerbaijan's military offensive in 2023, Baku regained control over the territory, forcing over 100,000 Armenians to flee. Currently, 19 Armenian individuals are being detained in Baku, including former high-ranking officials from Nagorno-Karabakh's de facto administration.
paras.zh: 亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆因纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫问题发生了长达三十年的冲突，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫是一个脱离阿塞拜疆的地区，居住着亚美尼亚人，该地区于 20 世纪 90 年代宣布独立。 2023年阿塞拜疆发动军事进攻后，巴库重新控制了该领土，迫使超过10万亚美尼亚人逃离。目前，19名亚美尼亚人被拘留在巴库，其中包括纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫事实上的政府的前高级官员。

paras.en: Growing trend of selective prosecutions?
paras.zh: 选择性起诉的趋势有增无减？

paras.en: Over a dozen Armenian civil society organizations have condemned the prosecution of the Adekvad party leader, calling it "patently illegal, disproportionate, and politically motivated."
paras.zh: 十多个亚美尼亚民间社会组织谴责对阿德克瓦德党领导人的起诉，称其“明显非法、不成比例且具有政治动机”。

paras.en: "It is punitive in nature and sends a direct signal to the broader public aimed at silencing dissent, critical views, and undesirable speech", said the joint statement.
paras.zh: 联合声明称：“它本质上是惩罚性的，向更广泛的公众发出直接信号，旨在压制异议、批评观点和不良言论。”

paras.en: Several other criminal proceedings have been launched against activists who criticized the ruling establishment or Pashinyan.
paras.zh: 针对批评执政机构或帕希尼扬的活动人士还启动了其他几项刑事诉讼。

paras.en: Another prominent case emerged ahead of the parliamentary elections in June. Artur Osipyan, a displaced activist from Nagorno-Karabakh, was arrested after a verbal clash with Pashinyan over his Nagorno-Karabakh policy.
paras.zh: 六月议会选举前夕出现了另一个突出案例。来自纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的流离失所活动人士阿图尔·奥西皮扬 (Artur Osipyan) 在与帕希尼扬因纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫政策而发生言语冲突后被捕。

paras.en: Following the incident, Armenian prosecutors indicted Osipyan for disrupting public order and obstructing the ruling party's campaign. He was also charged with inciting violence against Pashinyan in a social media post from March.
paras.zh: 事件发生后，亚美尼亚检察官以扰乱公共秩序和阻碍执政党竞选的罪名起诉奥西皮扬。他还被指控在三月份的社交媒体帖子中煽动针对帕希尼扬的暴力行为。

paras.en: Is freedom of expression in danger in Armenia?
paras.zh: 亚美尼亚的言论自由是否面临危险？

paras.en: On April 15, 2020, Article 226.2 was added to the Criminal Code of Armenia, penalizing public calls to violence, as well as the public justification or promotion of violence.
paras.zh: 2020 年 4 月 15 日，亚美尼亚《刑法》添加了第 226.2 条，对公开呼吁暴力以及公开为暴力辩护或宣扬暴力的行为进行处罚。

paras.en: After strong outrage by civil society, these offences were subsequently decriminalized. According to a 2025 report by Freedom House, "nearly 95% of court cases concerning incitement to violence under a 2020 criminal code amendment had involved alleged threats against Prime Minister Pashinyan and his supporters, whereas potentially prohibited statements by ruling party members were apparently not subject to the same scrutiny."
paras.zh: 在民间社会强烈愤慨之后，这些罪行随后被非刑事化。根据自由之家 2025 年的一份报告，“根据 2020 年刑法修正案，有关煽动暴力的法庭案件中，近 95% 涉及对总理帕希尼扬及其支持者的威胁，而执政党成员可能被禁止的言论显然没有受到同样的审查。”

paras.en: Throughout the 2026 pre-election period, the Regional Center for Democracy and Security (RCDS), an independent think tank based in Yerevan, monitored online hate speech targeting Nagorno-Karabakh refugees.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年选举前期间，总部位于埃里温的独立智囊团民主与安全区域中心 (RCDS) 一直在监控针对纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫难民的网上仇恨言论。

paras.en: Their reports documented how pro-government bloggers and influential social media users used their platforms to direct hostile rhetoric toward displaced Karabakh Armenians, labeling them with derogatory terms. Despite these findings, law enforcement agencies in Armenia largely refrained from pursuing criminal prosecutions against these activists.
paras.zh: 他们的报告记录了亲政府的博主和有影响力的社交媒体用户如何利用他们的平台向流离失所的卡拉巴赫亚美尼亚人发表敌对言论，并给他们贴上了贬义词。尽管有这些调查结果，亚美尼亚的执法机构基本上没有对这些活动分子提起刑事诉讼。

paras.en: Despite Armenia's efforts to strengthen its ties with the EU, Brussels has given no clear response to the silencing of opposition voices, observers in Yerevan told DW.
paras.zh: 埃里温观察家告诉德国之声，尽管亚美尼亚努力加强与欧盟的关系，但布鲁塞尔并未对压制反对声音做出明确回应。

paras.en: "The EU, by and large, has adopted a very pragmatic and geopolitically driven approach," said political analyst Tigran Grigoryan.
paras.zh: “总的来说，欧盟采取了非常务实且受地缘政治驱动的做法，”政治分析师蒂格兰·格里戈里安(Tigran Grigoryan)表示。

paras.en: "Given various regional developments, including what is happening in Georgia, Armenia has now become the EU's primary partner in the region," he added. "Coupled with the fact that the alternative to Pashinyan is a pro-Russian opposition, there is ultimately no serious response to these criminal cases."
paras.zh: 他补充说：“鉴于各种地区事态发展，包括格鲁吉亚正在发生的事情，亚美尼亚现已成为欧盟在该地区的主要合作伙伴。” “再加上帕希尼扬的替代者是亲俄反对派，最终这些刑事案件没有得到认真的回应。”

paras.en: Stefan Meister, Eastern Europe expert at the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP), echoed this view. European support for Armenia appears to be "mainly driven by the European Russia policy," Meister said. "So it's not so much about Armenia itself, but it is more about strengthening those forces that are undermining Russia's influence in the country and in the region."
paras.zh: 德国外交关系委员会（DGAP）东欧问题专家斯特凡·梅斯特（Stefan Meister）也赞同这一观点。梅斯特说，欧洲对亚美尼亚的支持似乎“主要受到欧洲俄罗斯政策的推动”。 “因此，这与亚美尼亚本身无关，而更多的是加强那些削弱俄罗斯在该国和该地区影响力的力量。”

paras.en: He believes that Pashinyan leverages this geopolitical dynamic to label internal political opponents as Russian proxies. However, not everyone who criticizes Pashinyan is pro-Russian, Meister added. He pointed out that "the EU is somehow falling into this trap by accepting that this is the right narrative."
paras.zh: 他认为，帕希尼扬利用这种地缘政治动态，将内部政治对手贴上俄罗斯代理人的标签。然而，梅斯特补充说，并非所有批评帕希尼扬的人都是亲俄罗斯的。他指出，“欧盟在某种程度上承认这是正确的叙述，从而陷入了这个陷阱。”

paras.en: EU: Armenia should deliver on its commitment
paras.zh: 欧盟：亚美尼亚应履行承诺

paras.en: Democracy, the rule of law, and fundamental rights are at the core of the EU-Armenia Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and the Strategic Agenda for the EU-Armenia Partnership, an EU spokesperson said in a written response to DW's request for comment.
paras.zh: 欧盟发言人在回应德国之声置评请求的书面回应中表示，民主、法治和基本权利是《欧盟-亚美尼亚全面强化伙伴关系协定》（CEPA）和《欧盟-亚美尼亚伙伴关系战略议程》的核心。

paras.en: It also pointed out that "the EU is closely following developments in the country, including as regards criminal investigations. In line with Armenia's international commitments and legal framework, such investigations should be carried out in an independent and impartial manner, free from political considerations."
paras.zh: 它还指出，“欧盟正在密切关注该国的事态发展，包括刑事调查方面的事态发展。根据亚美尼亚的国际承诺和法律框架，此类调查应以独立和公正的方式进行，不受政治考虑。”

articles.title: Ebola: Why is there still no vaccine?

paras.en: 1976: A hitherto unknown disease breaks out near the Ebola river in the country then known as Zaire, now the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). This was the first scientifically documented Ebola epidemic.
paras.zh: 1976 年：当时称为扎伊尔（现为刚果民主共和国）的国家埃博拉河附近爆发了一种迄今未知的疾病。这是第一次有科学记录的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: Now, 50 years on, the DRC once again finds itself at the center of a major Ebola outbreak. This time the pathogen is the less common Bundibugyo type of the genus Orthoebolavirus. The virus was identified in 2007 during an outbreak in Bundibugyo, Uganda. Another outbreak occurred in the DRC in 2012.
paras.zh: 50 年后的今天，刚果民主共和国再次处于埃博拉病毒大爆发的中心。这次的病原体是不太常见的本迪布焦型正埃博拉病毒属。该病毒于 2007 年乌干达本迪布焦爆发期间被发现。 2012 年，刚果民主共和国爆发了另一次疫情。

paras.en: Bundibugyo: Preparations could have been made
paras.zh: 本迪布焦：本来可以做好准备

paras.en: How can a virus that has been known for decades continue to infect thousands of people, yet there is still no licensed vaccine or official treatment?
paras.zh: 一种已知数十年的病毒如何能够继续感染数千人，却仍然没有获得许可的疫苗或官方治疗方法？

paras.en: Torsten Feldt, a doctor of tropical medicine at Düsseldorf's University Hospital, sees this as a missed opportunity. "We had come across the Bundibugyo virus in two previous outbreaks: 2007 in Uganda and 2012 in DR Congo. So we had enough time to develop vaccines and therapeutic options. But we didn't make use of this opportunity, meaning crucial time was lost during the current outbreak."
paras.zh: 杜塞尔多夫大学医院的热带医学医生托斯顿·费尔特 (Torsten Feldt) 认为这是一个错失的机会。 “我们在之前的两次疫情中都遇到过本迪布焦病毒：2007年在乌干达和2012年在刚果民主共和国。因此我们有足够的时间来开发疫苗和治疗方案。但我们没有利用这个机会，这意味着在当前的疫情爆发期间浪费了关键的时间。”

paras.en: Leonie Mayer from the German Center for Infection Research (DZIF) and the Institute for Infection Research and Vaccine Development at the University Medical Center in Hamburg-Eppendorf agrees. "They could of course have developed a vaccine and run pre-clinical trials before," Mayer told DW. She stressed, however, that their effectiveness can only be assessed and confirmed during an actual outbreak.
paras.zh: 德国感染研究中心 (DZIF) 和汉堡-埃彭多夫大学医学中心感染研究和疫苗开发研究所的 Leonie Mayer 对此表示同意。梅耶尔告诉德国之声：“他们当然可以开发出疫苗并进行临床前试验。”但她强调，它们的有效性只能在实际爆发期间才能评估和确认。

paras.en: Mayer is the lead author of a recently published study that examined whether Ervebo, an Ebola vaccine that has already been licensed, can be used against other types of Ebola as well.
paras.zh: 梅耶尔是最近发表的一项研究的主要作者，该研究检查了 Ervebo（一种已获得许可的埃博拉疫苗）是否也可以用于对抗其他类型的埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: Why Ebola is a good candidate for vaccine development
paras.zh: 为什么埃博拉病毒是疫苗开发的良好候选者

paras.en: From an immunological point of view, and compared to — for example — influenza or HIV, Ebola is a very worthwhile candidate for a vaccine. Influenza viruses are constantly mutating, and the human immunodeficiency virus is particularly good at evading our immune defenses. Ebola is far more predictable.
paras.zh: 从免疫学的角度来看，与流感或艾滋病毒等相比，埃博拉病毒是一种非常有价值的候选疫苗。流感病毒不断变异，人类免疫缺陷病毒尤其擅长逃避我们的免疫防御。埃博拉病毒的可预测性要高得多。

paras.en: "I think — and perhaps it's kind of a blessing in disguise — that it will be relatively straightforward to develop a vaccine against Bundibugyo," says Mayer.
paras.zh: 梅耶尔说：“我认为，开发针对本迪布焦的疫苗将相对简单，这也许是因祸得福。”

paras.en: Herein lies the paradox. From a scientific point of view, Ebola is a good vaccine candidate, yet there is still no licensed form of prevention against the Bundibugyo variant that is currently circulating.
paras.zh: 悖论就在这里。从科学的角度来看，埃博拉病毒是一种很好的候选疫苗，但目前还没有针对目前流行的本迪布焦变种的预防许可形式。

paras.en: Mayer explains that vaccines cannot be developed as a precautionary measure against every potential pathogen. Lack of funding or the prioritization of other pathogens often have a role to play. Many researchers had assumed that a fresh outbreak of the Sudan Ebola virus was more likely, and vaccine development for this strain is more advanced.
paras.zh: 梅耶尔解释说，疫苗的开发不能作为针对每种潜在病原体的预防措施。缺乏资金或优先考虑其他病原体通常会产生影响。许多研究人员认为，苏丹埃博拉病毒再次爆发的可能性更大，而且针对该毒株的疫苗开发也更为先进。

paras.en: Another part of the problem is that Ebola is not one single virus. The known, highly dangerous orthoebolaviruses include Ebola virus (EBOV), previously called the Zaire Ebola virus (ZEBOV), the Sudan virus (SUDV), and the Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). The existing vaccine, Ervebo, was developed and licensed for use against the Zaire variant. But there is still no approved protection against the others.
paras.zh: 问题的另一部分是埃博拉病毒不是一种单一病毒。已知的高度危险的正埃博拉病毒包括埃博拉病毒（EBOV）（以前称为扎伊尔埃博拉病毒（ZEBOV））、苏丹病毒（SUDV）和本迪布焦病毒（BDBV）。现有疫苗 Ervebo 已开发并获得许可用于对抗扎伊尔变种。但目前还没有获得批准的针对其他病毒的保护措施。

paras.en: This is why the existing Ebola vaccine has been of only limited use to people in the areas of the current outbreak.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么现有的埃博拉疫苗对当前疫情爆发地区的人们作用有限。

paras.en: Another factor may also be relevant: The Bundibugyo virus appears to be less aggressive than the Zaire variant. At first, that sounds like good news, but it may make it harder to contain, as people remain mobile for longer after being infected, and can pass on the virus without realizing.
paras.zh: 另一个因素也可能相关：本迪布焦病毒似乎不如扎伊尔变种的攻击性。乍一看，这听起来像是个好消息，但它可能会让控制变得更加困难，因为人们在被感染后保持活动的时间更长，并且可能在不知不觉中传播病毒。

paras.en: Ervebo vaccine: Immune response to Bundibugyo
paras.zh: Ervebo 疫苗：对 Bundibugyo 的免疫反应

paras.en: In the recently published study, Mayer's research team from the DZIF investigated whether the already licensed Ebola vaccine could trigger an immune response not only against EBOV, but against other types of Ebola as well. They found cross-reactive T-cell responses against Bundibugyo, and also, to a lesser extent, against the Sudan virus.
paras.zh: 在最近发表的研究中，DZIF 的梅耶尔研究小组调查了已经获得许可的埃博拉疫苗是否不仅可以引发针对埃博拉病毒的免疫反应，还可以引发针对其他类型埃博拉病毒的免疫反应。他们发现 T 细胞针对 Bundibugyo 产生交叉反应，并且在较小程度上也针对苏丹病毒产生交叉反应。

paras.en: For Mayer, this is already an important finding: "We now know that the immune cells can most likely also recognize the Bundibugyo virus." But she also observes: "Our data does not enable us to answer the question of whether this immune response actually provides protection, or if it results in a milder progression of the disease." This is currently an important gap in our knowledge.
paras.zh: 对于梅耶尔来说，这已经是一个重要的发现：“我们现在知道免疫细胞很可能也能识别本迪布焦病毒。”但她也观察到：“我们的数据无法让我们回答这样的问题：这种免疫反应是否真正提供了保护，或者是否会导致疾病较温和的进展。”这是目前我们知识中的一个重要空白。

paras.en: Why the existing vaccine cannot currently be deployed
paras.zh: 为什么现有疫苗目前无法部署

paras.en: If there's a vaccine that has already been licensed, and indications that it could protect people, why isn't it simply being deployed?
paras.zh: 如果有一种疫苗已经获得许可，并且有迹象表明它可以保护人们，为什么不简单地部署它呢？

paras.en: Mayer explains the dilemma. For one thing, she says, it's not ethical to deploy a vaccine if you're not sure whether or how well it works. Also, if it were used on a large scale, it would no longer be possible to establish whether it actually works: A reduction in cases could also be a result of other measures, or the epidemic might already have passed its peak.
paras.zh: 梅耶尔解释了这个困境。她说，一方面，如果你不确定疫苗是否有效或效果如何，那么部署疫苗是不道德的。而且，如果大规模使用，就无法确定它是否真的有效：病例减少也可能是其他措施的结果，或者疫情可能已经过了高峰期。

paras.en: Jürgen May, a specialist in tropical diseases at the Bernhard Nocht Institute, also warns against mass vaccination: "Mass vaccination without proof of efficacy could create a false sense of security, forfeit trust, and, if it does not provide sufficient protection, make study impossible."
paras.zh: Bernhard Nocht 研究所的热带病专家于尔根·梅 (Jürgen May) 也对大规模疫苗接种提出警告：“没有有效性证明的大规模疫苗接种可能会产生错误的安全感，丧失信任，如果不能提供足够的保护，研究就会变得不可能。”

paras.en: It's very important for there to be acceptance on the ground. "If we inoculate people with a vaccine on a large scale, and afterwards it turns out that it was nothing like as effective as we expected, it's very difficult to communicate that to people on the ground," Mayer says. In a worst-case scenario, people could subsequently refuse inoculation with more effective vaccines.
paras.zh: 获得实地认可非常重要。梅耶尔说：“如果我们大规模给人们接种疫苗，但事后发现它并不像我们预期的那么有效，那么就很难向当地的人们传达这一信息。”在最坏的情况下，人们随后可能会拒绝接种更有效的疫苗。

paras.en: Why Ebola is still so difficult to contain
paras.zh: 为什么埃博拉病毒仍然如此难以遏制

paras.en: But the current outbreak also shows that medical innovation alone is not enough. Conflicts, difficult transport routes, attacks on healthcare facilities, and gaps in contact tracing all make it harder to contain.
paras.zh: 但当前的疫情也表明，仅靠医疗创新是不够的。冲突、困难的交通路线、对医疗设施的袭击以及接触者追踪方面的差距都使疫情的控制变得更加困难。

paras.en: Torsten Feldt says identifying Bundibugyo is no longer a problem in itself. What is often limiting is the practical availability of diagnostic tools. "In remote or conflict-affected regions, samples often have to be transported over long distances," he explains.
paras.zh: 托斯顿·费尔特表示，识别本迪布焦本身不再是一个问题。诊断工具的实际可用性常常受到限制。 “在偏远或受冲突影响的地区，样本通常必须长距离运输，”他解释道。

paras.en: Here we see another Ebola paradox. The world is getting ever better at diagnosing infections, but it still struggles to contain outbreaks fast enough. The authors of an article in the current issue of Nature come to the same conclusion: The problem is often not identifying cases, but the speed with which people react. Finding Ebola is often easier now than stopping Ebola, they write.
paras.zh: 在这里我们看到了另一个埃博拉悖论。世界在诊断感染方面正在变得越来越好，但仍然难以足够快地遏制疫情爆发。最新一期《自然》杂志上一篇文章的作者得出了同样的结论：问题往往不在于识别病例，而在于人们反应的速度。他们写道，现在发现埃博拉病毒通常比阻止埃博拉病毒更容易。

paras.en: From a Bundibugyo vaccine to a pan-Ebola one?
paras.zh: 从本迪布焦疫苗到泛埃博拉疫苗？

paras.en: Many researchers believe the current crisis could potentially also provide a great opportunity. The so-called Tumaini study, which is testing different vaccine candidates, has now been launched in the DRC.
paras.zh: 许多研究人员认为，当前的危机也可能提供一个巨大的机遇。所谓的图迈尼研究正在测试不同的候选疫苗，现已在刚果民主共和国启动。

paras.en: These include Ervebo, developed by Oxford University, and a Moderna mRNA vaccine. The study aims to provide the first reliable data about their efficacy against the Bundibugyo virus.
paras.zh: 其中包括牛津大学开发的 Ervebo 和 Moderna mRNA 疫苗。该研究旨在提供有关其对抗本迪布焦病毒功效的第一个可靠数据。

paras.en: Whether these vaccines could still help control the current outbreak is uncertain. There is hope, but experts estimate that, realistically, it will be several months before any such vaccine is available for widespread use; perhaps not until mid-2027.
paras.zh: 这些疫苗是否仍能帮助控制当前的疫情尚不确定。希望是有的，但专家估计，实际上，这种疫苗要广泛使用还需要几个月的时间；也许要到 2027 年中期。

paras.en: "Ideally, we will develop cross-reactive pan-Ebola vaccines," Christof Geldmacher, a co-author of the DZIF study, says of their long-term plans. This is also something that is being worked on. For now, though, the focus is on developing an effective vaccine against the Bundibugyo variant of the virus.
paras.zh: “理想情况下，我们将开发交叉反应的泛埃博拉疫苗，”DZIF 研究的合著者 Christof Geldmacher 在谈到他们的长期计划时说道。这也是正在研究的事情。不过，目前的重点是开发针对该病毒本迪布焦变种的有效疫苗。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be White House press secretary

paras.en: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief executive Dana White has said he will meet with Donald Trump after the US president offered him the job of White House press secretary.
paras.zh: 终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）首席执行官达纳怀特表示，在美国总统向他提供白宫新闻秘书一职后，他将与唐纳德特朗普会面。

paras.en: Speaking at a new conference after a boxing event in London on Saturday, White said he would meet with Trump at the White House on Monday to discuss the president’s offer.
paras.zh: 周六在伦敦举行的拳击比赛结束后举行的新会议上，怀特表示，他将于周一在白宫与特朗普会面，讨论总统的提议。

paras.en: “Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other,” Trump wrote on Truth Social earlier on Saturday. “Dana, please take the job!”
paras.zh: “达纳将成为一位与众不同的新闻秘书，”特朗普周六早些时候在“真相社会”上写道。 “达娜，请接受这份工作！”

paras.en: Trump also requested that White “bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country”.
paras.zh: 特朗普还要求怀特“带上助手，尽管其中一些不是来自我们国家”。

paras.en: Trump listed and posted pictures of six current and former UFC title holders to join White: Islam Makhachev and Khabib Nurmagomedov from Russia’s Dagestan region; Americans Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier and “Kayla Harris”, likely a reference to Kayla Harrison; and Amanda Nunes, a Brazilian who became a US citizen last year.
paras.zh: 特朗普列出并发布了六名现任和前任 UFC 冠军头衔持有者加入怀特的照片：来自俄罗斯达吉斯坦地区的伊斯兰·马哈乔夫 (Islam Makhachev) 和哈比卜·努尔马戈梅多夫 (Khabib Nurmagomedov)；美国人 Justin Gaethje、Daniel Cormier 和“Kayla Harris”，可能指的是 Kayla Harrison；以及去年成为美国公民的巴西人阿曼达·努内斯(Amanda Nunes)。

paras.en: “We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left,” Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普写道：“我们需要这些人来保护我们免受疯狂左派的侵害。”

paras.en: The White House press secretary role has been vacant since Katie Zacharia’s tenure ended last month after just five days.
paras.zh: 自从凯蒂·扎卡里亚 (Katie Zacharia) 的任期仅五天后于上个月结束以来，白宫新闻秘书的职位一直空缺。

paras.en: Zacharia succeeded Karoline Leavitt, who stepped down from the role at the end of August.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚 (Zacharia) 接替了卡罗琳·莱维特 (Karoline Leavitt)，卡罗琳·莱维特于 8 月底辞去这一职务。

paras.en: White and Trump first worked together in the early 2000s, but they grew closer since the UFC chief publicly backed Trump’s presidential campaign in 2016.
paras.zh: 怀特和特朗普在 2000 年代初首次合作，但自从 UFC 主席 2016 年公开支持特朗普的总统竞选以来，他们的关系变得更加密切。

paras.en: In recent years, Trump has attended several UFC events, and in June, the White House hosted a night of UFC fights as part of celebrations marking the 250th anniversary of US independence.
paras.zh: 近年来，特朗普参加了多次 UFC 赛事，今年 6 月，白宫举办了一场 UFC 比赛之夜，作为庆祝美国独立 250 周年的一部分。

paras.en: The White House press office already has a former UFC spokesperson among its ranks: Director of Communications Steven Cheung, who worked for White’s organisation from 2013 to 2016.
paras.zh: 白宫新闻办公室的队伍中已经有一位前 UFC 发言人：通讯总监史蒂文·张 (Steven Cheung)，他曾于 2013 年至 2016 年为怀特的组织工作。

paras.en: Cheung shared the president’s message on X and said, “Hell yeah! Do it, @DanaWhite! It’ll just be like old times!”
paras.zh: 张在 X 上分享了总统的信息，并说道：“天哪！就这么做吧，@DanaWhite！一切都会像以前一样！”

articles.title: Earthquake hits central Japan, injuring more than 20 people

paras.en: More than 20 people have been injured after a strong earthquake shook central Japan, shattering store windows and sending people fleeing buildings, according to local media and authorities.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体和当局报道，日本中部发生强烈地震，商店橱窗震碎，人们纷纷逃离建筑物，造成 20 多人受伤。

paras.en: The magnitude 5.7 quake struck at 1:04am local time on Sunday (16:00 GMT Saturday) at a depth of about 40km (25 miles) in western Shizuoka Prefecture, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency.
paras.zh: 据日本气象厅称，当地时间周日凌晨 1:04（格林威治标准时间周六 16:00），静冈县西部发生了 5.7 级地震，震源深度约 40 公里（25 英里）。

paras.en: More than 20 people were injured in the Aichi and Shizuoka prefectures, the Kyodo news agency cited authorities as saying.
paras.zh: 共同社援引当局消息称，爱知县和静冈县有 20 多人受伤。

paras.en: A wide area near Aichi Prefecture was affected, including the city of Hamamatsu, the ancient capitals of Kyoto and Nara, and the prefectures of Yamanashi, where Mount Fuji is located, and Gifu.
paras.zh: 爱知县附近的大片地区受到影响，包括滨松市、古都京都和奈良，以及富士山所在的山梨县和岐阜县。

paras.en: No tsunami warning was issued, Kyodo reported.
paras.zh: 据共同社报道，没有发布海啸警报。

paras.en: The quake was not felt in Tokyo, which is far from the epicentre.
paras.zh: 距离震中较远的东京没有震感。

paras.en: Japanese television showed shattered shop windows and shards of glass scattered across streets. A bookstore was left with mounds of books that had fallen from the shelves.
paras.zh: 日本电视画面显示商店橱窗破碎，街道上散落着玻璃碎片。一家书店里堆满了从书架上掉落的书籍。

paras.en: Some of the injured had fallen on the stairs as they tried to flee, the Associated Press news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，一些伤者在试图逃跑时跌倒在楼梯上。

paras.en: The meteorological agency warned people to be ready for possible strong quakes in the coming week, especially the next two to three days.
paras.zh: 气象部门警告人们，要做好应对未来一周，特别是未来两到三天可能发生的强震的准备。

paras.en: “Please be on the lookout for mudslides, falling rocks and the possible effects from rainfall,” agency official Ayataka Ebita told reporters.
paras.zh: “请留意泥石流、落石以及降雨可能造成的影响，”该机构官员埃比塔绫隆告诉记者。

paras.en: He said no apparent change had been detected so far in the Nankai Trough, an underwater ocean trench where two major tectonic plates meet under parts of Japan, where scientists say a megaquake could occur.
paras.zh: 他说，到目前为止，南海海槽尚未发现明显变化。南海海槽是一个水下海沟，两个主要构造板块在日本部分地区交汇，科学家称那里可能会发生特大地震。

paras.en: Some local train services were suspended, while the Shinkansen bullet trains were running at slower speeds in affected areas as a precautionary measure.
paras.zh: 一些当地火车服务被暂停，而作为预防措施，新干线子弹头列车在受影响地区减慢了运行速度。

paras.en: Trains on the Tokaido Shinkansen line, which connects Tokyo and Osaka, were delayed between Shizuoka and Gifu-Hashima stations after safety checks, rail operator JR Central said.
paras.zh: 铁路运营商 JR Central 表示，连接东京和大阪的东海道新干线列车在经过安全检查后，在静冈站和岐阜羽岛站之间发生延误。

articles.title: Drone attack on Colombian army base kills three soldiers and wounds 16

paras.en: A drone attack on a military base in northern Colombia has killed three soldiers and wounded at least 16, the country’s armed forces said.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚武装部队表示，哥伦比亚北部军事基地遭遇无人机袭击，造成 3 名士兵死亡、至少 16 人受伤。

paras.en: The Colombian military said in a statement on Saturday that the attack hit a base in Santa Rosa del Sur, a small town in the foothills of the San Lucas mountain range. Authorities have not said who carried out the strike, the latest in a series of attacks on security forces as violence rises across rural parts of the country.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚军方周六在一份声明中表示，袭击袭击了圣卢卡斯山脉山麓小镇南圣罗莎的一个基地。当局尚未透露是谁发动了这次袭击，这是随着该国农村地区暴力事件加剧而发生的一系列针对安全部队的袭击中的最新一起。

paras.en: The area is rich in gold mines and has long been disputed by rebel armed groups including the Gulf Clan, the National Liberation Army (ELN) and smaller groups led by former members of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC).
paras.zh: 该地区蕴藏着丰富的金矿，长期以来一直受到包括海湾部族、民族解放军（ELN）和前哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）成员领导的较小团体在内的反叛武装团体的争议。

paras.en: Footage shared on social media showed clouds of smoke rising from the base after three explosions, and soldiers taking cover in shelters made of sandbags.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上分享的视频显示，三起爆炸后，基地升起浓烟，士兵们躲在沙袋搭建的避难所里。

paras.en: “Those who were behind this attack… will have nowhere to hide,” President Abelardo de la Espriella wrote on X. “Every attack against our soldiers strengthens our resolve to defend Colombia.”
paras.zh: 总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉在 X 上写道：“这次袭击的幕后黑手……将无处可藏。每一次针对我们士兵的袭击都增强了我们保卫哥伦比亚的决心。”

paras.en: Violence has intensified in several rural areas since de la Espriella, a conservative, took office in August.
paras.zh: 自保守派人士德拉埃斯普里埃拉八月上任以来，一些农村地区的暴力事件加剧。

paras.en: The president cancelled peace talks with rebel groups and has taken a confrontational approach, including more air strikes, deploying more troops in some cities and creating joint task forces to defend strategic assets such as a pipeline that runs from the Caribbean coast to central Colombia.
paras.zh: 总统取消了与反叛组织的和平谈判，并采取了对抗性做法，包括更多空袭、在一些城市部署更多部队以及组建联合特遣部队来保卫战略资产，例如从加勒比海岸到哥伦比亚中部的管道。

paras.en: De la Espriella’s government argues that armed groups used ceasefires granted by the previous government to consolidate their grip on rural areas, where they tax local businesses and profit from the drug trade.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉政府辩称，武装团体利用上届政府批准的停火协议来巩固对农村地区的控制，他们向当地企业征税并从毒品贸易中获利。

paras.en: Some groups have responded by stepping up attacks on the country’s armed forces.
paras.zh: 一些组织的回应是加大对该国武装部队的攻击力度。

paras.en: Last week, a military base in Tolima province was targeted with missiles made from gas canisters. The attack killed four civilians, including a two-month-old baby.
paras.zh: 上周，托利马省的一个军事基地遭到由瓦斯罐制成的导弹袭击。这次袭击造成四名平民死亡，其中包括一名两个月大的婴儿。

paras.en: Police in the border city of Cucuta have been attacked several times with remotely activated bombs.
paras.zh: 边境城市库库塔的警察多次遭到远程炸弹袭击。

paras.en: State forces and illegal armed groups carried out 34 attacks with bombs or explosives in Colombia in the four weeks to October 16, a 9 percent increase on last year’s four-week average, according to ACLED, a group that monitors armed conflicts.
paras.zh: 据监测武装冲突的组织 ACLED 称，截至 10 月 16 日的四个星期内，国家军队和非法武装团体在哥伦比亚发动了 34 起炸弹或爆炸物袭击，比去年四个星期的平均水平增加了 9%。

paras.en: A 2016 peace deal with FARC led to the demobilisation of more than 14,000 fighters, but smaller groups have since fought over the rebels’ former territory.
paras.zh: 2016 年与哥伦比亚革命武装力量达成的和平协议导致 14,000 多名武装分子复员，但此后较小的团体一直在争夺叛军的前领土。

articles.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
articles.author: Tara Neill

paras.en: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
paras.zh: 以色列总统选择反对派候选人而非内塔尼亚胡组建政府

paras.en: Israel's president has tapped Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, to try to form the next government. It's a setback for Netanyahu, whose party won the most seats but failed to secure a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 以色列总统任命总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的主要政治对手加迪·艾森科特来尝试组建下一届政府。这对内塔尼亚胡来说是一个挫折，他的政党赢得了最多席位，但未能获得议会多数席位。

paras.en: Netanyahu's Likud party won 27 seats in last month's election, six more than Eisenkot's Yashar party. But neither secured enough support to command a majority in Israel's 120-seat parliament.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团在上个月的选举中赢得了 27 个席位，比艾森科特的亚沙尔党多了 6 个席位。但两人都没有获得足够的支持，无法在以色列 120 个席位的议会中获得多数席位。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog will formally give Eisenkot the mandate at 5 p.m. local time on Sunday.
paras.zh: 艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统将于下午 5 点正式授权艾森科特。当地时间周日。

paras.en: Eisenkot is a former chief of staff of the Israel Defense Forces, serving as the country's top military commander from 2015 to 2019. A veteran of several military campaigns, he later joined Netanyahu's emergency war cabinet following the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas attacks on Israel, but left the following year, accusing Netanyahu of failing to make progress toward ending the Gaza war and securing the release of hostages. Eisenkot lost his son, Gal, a reservist killed in Gaza, as well as two nephews during the war.
paras.zh: 艾森科特是以色列国防军前参谋长，2015年至2019年担任该国最高军事指挥官。他是多次军事战役的老兵，后来在2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列后加入内塔尼亚胡的紧急战争内阁，但于次年离开，指责内塔尼亚胡未能在结束加沙战争和确保释放人质方面取得进展。艾森科特在战争期间失去了他的儿子加尔（一名预备役军人在加沙阵亡）以及两个侄子。

paras.en: Eisenkot leads the centrist Yashar party, which he founded on an anti-corruption and government reform platform. He will now have 28 days to put together a coalition government, with a possible 14-day extension.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导中间派亚沙尔党，他以反腐败和政府改革为纲领创立了该党。他现在有 28 天的时间组建联合政府，并可能延长 14 天。

paras.en: That gives him up to six weeks to negotiate with rival parties and secure the 61 seats needed for a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 这让他有六周的时间与对手政党进行谈判，并获得议会多数所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: If Eisenkot fails, Herzog can give another lawmaker a chance to form a government. If those efforts also fail, Israel could face another election. Netanyahu would remain caretaker prime minister in the meantime.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特失败，赫尔佐格可以给另一位立法者一个组建政府的机会。如果这些努力也失败，以色列可能面临另一次选举。内塔尼亚胡在此期间仍将担任看守总理。

articles.title: A correspondent finds Cuba's people struggling
articles.author: Gabriel J. Sánchez

paras.en: A correspondent finds Cuba's people struggling
paras.zh: 记者发现古巴人民正在苦苦挣扎

paras.en: Reporting from Cuba comes with distinct challenges especially amid widespread power outages and fuel shortages.
paras.zh: 来自古巴的报道面临着明显的挑战，特别是在大范围停电和燃料短缺的情况下。

paras.en: Life in Cuba these days is increasingly defined by darkness.
paras.zh: 如今古巴的生活越来越被黑暗所定义。

paras.en: EYDER PERALTA, BYLINE: Right now, the streets are completely empty. Yesterday, even the iconic capitol building was totally dark. You have to walk around with a flashlight.
paras.zh: 艾德·佩拉尔塔连线：现在，街道上空无一人。昨天，就连标志性的国会大厦也一片漆黑。你必须带着手电筒走来走去。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That's Eyder Peralta, who has rare access to Cuba this week. In January, the U.S. moved to choke off Cuba's fuel. There are frequent blackouts that last longer than a day and critical shortages of food, fuel and medicine.
paras.zh: 施密茨：这是艾德·佩拉尔塔（Eyder Peralta），他本周很少能进入古巴。一月份，美国采取行动切断古巴的燃料供应。经常发生持续超过一天的停电，食品、燃料和药品严重短缺。

paras.en: PERALTA: This is by far the worst I've ever seen Havana.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：这是迄今为止我见过的最糟糕的哈瓦那。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Add to that threats from the Trump administration that the days of Cuba's communist government are numbered. For this week's Reporter's Notebook, we wanted to talk about what it was like to report there now. I began by asking Eyder what had changed since the last time he had reported there.
paras.zh: 施密茨：除特朗普政府的威胁外，古巴共产主义政府的日子已经屈指可数了。对于本周的记者笔记本，我们想谈谈现在在那里进行报道的感受。我首先询问艾德，自从他上次在那里报道以来发生了什么变化。

paras.en: PERALTA: The last time I was here was nearly a year ago, and it's just dark. I have to say that was really shocking. I went for a long walk around Old Havana yesterday, and you just walk blocks and blocks, and it feels like the day after a hurricane where it's pitch dark in the streets. People are walking around with flashlights. I mean, it's sort of stunning how much life light gives to a city, and this - it feels like a zombie movie.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：我上次来这里已经是一年前的事了，当时天还很黑。不得不说，这实在是太令人震惊了。昨天我在哈瓦那旧城走了很长一段路，你只是走过一个又一个街区，感觉就像飓风过后的第二天，街道上一片漆黑。人们拿着手电筒四处走动。我的意思是，这座城市的生命之光令人惊叹，这感觉就像一部僵尸电影。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So you were talking about how many regular Cubans there in Havana don't have power. They're walking around with flashlights. How do you do your job? I mean, you're a radio reporter. You need batteries. You need light. You're...
paras.zh: 施密茨：所以你说的是哈瓦那有多少普通古巴人没有权力。他们拿着手电筒走来走去。你的工作怎么样？我是说，你是一名电台记者。你需要电池。你需要光。你是...

paras.en: PERALTA: Yes. I have a lot of batteries.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：是的。我有很多电池。

paras.en: PERALTA: But then also, you know, the one thing that complicates things even more is American sanctions. I'm on a U.S. passport, which means Americans cannot stay at the big hotels here. Most of them are closed anyway, but the big hotels here have generators, and they have lights, and you can have a nice coffee, and you can have hot water, and you can have air conditioning. Right now, I'm talking to you with a fan because I - there's no power, but I have - the Airbnb I'm staying at has a battery pack that...
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：但是，你知道，让事情变得更加复杂的一件事是美国的制裁。我持有美国护照，这意味着美国人不能入住这里的大酒店。反正大部分都关门了，不过这里的大酒店有发电机，有灯，可以喝好咖啡，可以喝热水，可以有空调。现在，我正在和一位粉丝聊天，因为我 - 没有电，但我有 - 我住的 Airbnb 有一个电池组......

paras.en: PERALTA: ...Powers the fans. So, you know, you get - I get to charge my laptop, and I get to charge, you know, like, all the other stuff I need.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：……为粉丝提供动力。所以，你知道，我可以给我的笔记本电脑充电，我可以为我需要的所有其他东西充电。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Is - what's your sense from talking to folks there? Are they angry with the United States? Are they angry with their own government? Where is the frustration directed at?
paras.zh: 施密茨：从与那里的人们交谈中你有何感想？他们对美国感到愤怒吗？他们对自己的政府感到愤怒吗？挫败感指向哪里？

paras.en: PERALTA: It's both. They feel that the oil blockade is inhumane. But they don't feel that the United States is solely the cause of this crisis. They feel that their government has let them down. They feel that their government is not negotiating, right?
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：两者都是。他们认为石油封锁是不人道的。但他们并不认为美国是这场危机的唯一根源。他们觉得政府让他们失望了。他们觉得他们的政府没有谈判，对吧？

paras.en: I actually asked a guy, like, in the 60s. I was talking to him in a park, and I asked him, you know, if you had a government official right here in front of you, what would you say? And he said, you have to join the world. You can't continue thinking that you can do things your way and survive in this world. And by that, he means, he said, do what everyone else in the world does - free political prisoners, have elections.
paras.zh: 我实际上问过一个 60 年代的人。我在公园里和他说话，我问他，如果你面前有一位政府官员，你会说什么？他说，你必须加入这个世界。你不能继续认为你可以按照自己的方式做事并在这个世界上生存。他说，他的意思是，做世界上其他人所做的事情——释放政治犯，举行选举。

paras.en: And then, you know, the world - the U.S. has to stop this blockade, and, you know, the IMF can give you money, right? And so they - a lot of what I've heard on the streets is, please Cuban government. Just do what the U.S. tells you so this ends.
paras.zh: 然后，你知道，世界 - 美国必须停止这种封锁，而且，你知道，国际货币基金组织可以给你钱，对吗？所以他们——我在街上听到的很多话都是，请古巴政府。只要按照美国告诉你的去做，事情就结束了。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: I mean, I would imagine the Trump administration would hear that and say, that's exactly why we're doing this.
paras.zh: 施密茨：我的意思是，我想特朗普政府会听到这个消息并说，这正是我们这样做的原因。

paras.en: PERALTA: It is. But you know, I asked the deputy foreign minister. I played that tape for her. And she said, the problem is - and, you know, one of the things the guy on the street said was, like, look, they don't have to change their political system. They can do all of these things and not change their political system. And she said, the problem is, they want us to change the political system, right? And...
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：是的。但你知道，我问过外交部副部长。我给她放了那盘磁带。她说，问题是 - 你知道，街上那个人说的其中一件事是，看，他们不必改变他们的政治制度。他们可以做所有这些事情而不改变他们的政治制度。她说，问题是，他们希望我们改变政治制度，对吧？和...

paras.en: PERALTA: We're not going to do that. That's a red line for us, and it's never going to happen.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：我们不会那样做。这对我们来说是一条红线，而且永远不会发生。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Wow. That is fascinating. I mean, you know, when you're talking to folks like this, I'm just curious, are they - do they give you their names? I mean, given the government of Cuba, I would imagine there's a lot of fear about, A, talking to an American journalist but also just giving any kind of information about who they are for fear of retribution.
paras.zh: 施密茨：哇。这很有趣。我的意思是，你知道，当你和这样的人交谈时，我只是很好奇，他们会告诉你他们的名字吗？我的意思是，考虑到古巴政府，我想人们会非常担心，A，与一名美国记者交谈，但也只是提供有关他们是谁的任何信息，以免遭到报复。

paras.en: PERALTA: You constantly have people saying things that everybody else knows they shouldn't be saying, and they're giving them looks, right? And they're like, I'm going to go to jail for this, right? But...
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：经常有人说一些其他人都知道他们不应该说的话，而他们却对他们投以异样的目光，对吧？他们说，我会因此入狱，对吗？但...

paras.en: PERALTA: But they always talk. And that has kind of always been the case in Cuba, right? They've always - I feel like Cubans always know where the red line is, and they don't cross it.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：但他们总是说话。古巴的情况一直如此，对吧？他们一直——我觉得古巴人总是知道红线在哪里，而且他们不会跨越它。

paras.en: PERALTA: Or they talk in metaphors, or they give you the roundabout, right? We - you know, we tend not to use names because people fear retribution here.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：或者他们用隐喻说话，或者他们给你迂回，对吧？我们——你知道，我们倾向于不使用名字，因为人们害怕在这里遭到报复。

paras.en: PERALTA: But people talk, and I think the frustration at this moment means that people are much more willing to cross a red line that they didn't used to be.
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：但是人们会说话，我认为此时此刻的挫败感意味着人们更愿意跨越以前没有的红线。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: You know, you're going to be doing a bunch of stories that we will hear in the coming weeks. I'm curious, is there a moment from this trip that sort of stays with you, even though it may not make it into one of these stories?
paras.zh: 施密茨：你知道，你将制作一系列我们将在未来几周内听到的故事。我很好奇，这次旅行中是否有某个时刻让你印象深刻，尽管它可能不会出现在这些故事中？

paras.en: PERALTA: We were reporting in this big - one of the old buildings in Old Havana, and they're like - and they're beautiful, right? It's got this, like, huge staircase in the middle. And, you know, it used to be beautiful. But, like, you know, you have just this, like, spiderweb of, like - of cables and hoses that take water up and down this building. But, like, I kept talking to people, and, like, I was like, so, you know, what are you up to? And they were like, (non-English language spoken), they say. And...
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：我们在哈瓦那旧城的一栋老建筑里进行报道，它们就像——而且很漂亮，对吧？中间有一个巨大的楼梯。而且，你知道，它曾经很美丽。但是，就像，你知道，你有这样的，像蜘蛛网一样的电缆和软管，将水带到这座建筑物的上下。但是，就像，我一直在和人们说话，就像，我就像，所以，你知道，你在做什么？他们说，他们就像（非英语口语）。和...

paras.en: PERALTA: We'll see what falls. But they would...
paras.zh: PERALTA：我们会看看会发生什么。但他们会...

paras.en: PERALTA: And they would, like, step outside - right? - and, like, look up and be like, (non-English language spoken). We'll see what's going to happen. Like, and I was like, what? Are you expecting this to come - something to fall from the sky, right?
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：他们会喜欢走出去——对吧？ - 并且，就像，抬起头来，就像，（非英语口语）。我们会看看会发生什么。就像，我当时想，什么？你期待这一切的到来吗——有什么东西从天上掉下来，对吗？

paras.en: PERALTA: And they're kind of like, yeah. And so I left. I went to go do some more reporting, right? And then I came back. And, like, one of the ladies I was talking to was just thrilled because something had fallen from the sky. And I'll tell you what it is (laughter).
paras.zh: PERALTA：他们有点像，是的。于是我就离开了。我去再做一些报道吧？然后我回来了。而且，就像，与我交谈的一位女士很兴奋，因为有东西从天上掉了下来。我会告诉你它是什么（笑声）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Wait, something fell from the sky?
paras.zh: 施密茨：等等，有什么东西从天上掉下来了？

paras.en: PERALTA: Something fell to her - right? - which was...
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：有什么东西掉到了她身上——对吧？ - 这是...

paras.en: PERALTA: Some lady told her, hey, I have these seven blouses that you can go try and sell on the street, right? Just some random lady. And she sold, you know, five of those blouses, and she was able to buy a carton of eggs with it, right?
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：有位女士告诉她，嘿，我有这七件衬衫，你可以去尝试并在街上卖，对吧？只是一个随机的女士。你知道，她卖掉了其中五件衬衫，她可以用它买一盒鸡蛋，对吗？

paras.en: PERALTA: Cubans - they keep telling you I live day to day, right? And that's what fell that day, right?
paras.zh: 佩拉尔塔：古巴人——他们一直告诉你我每天都在生活，对吧？这就是那天发生的事，对吗？

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is NPR's Eyder Peralta, seeing what falls in Havana, Cuba. Eyder, thank you so much.
paras.zh: 施密茨：这是 NPR 的艾德·佩拉尔塔 (Eyder Peralta)，他正在观察古巴哈瓦那发生的事情。艾德，非常感谢你。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Israeli president invites Netanyahu's opposition leader to broker new government
articles.author: Lauren Frayer

paras.en: Israeli president invites Netanyahu's opposition leader to broker new government
paras.zh: 以色列总统邀请内塔尼亚胡反对派领导人斡旋新政府

paras.en: Israel's political landscape shifts as President Herzog hands opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the mandate to form a government, dealing a blow to Benjamin Netanyahu's grip on power.
paras.zh: 随着赫尔佐格总统授权反对派领导人加迪·艾森科特组建政府，以色列的政治格局发生了变化，这对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的权力控制造成了打击。

paras.en: Israel's president says he's tapped Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, to form the next Israeli government. Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot won a clear majority in last month's election. But parties representing most of the members of Israel's parliament have recommended Eisenkot to try to form a governing coalition. For more on what that means, let's go to NPR's Lauren Frayer, who joins us live from Tel Aviv. Hey, Lauren.
paras.zh: 以色列总统表示，他已任命总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的政治对手加迪·艾森科特组建下一届以色列政府。内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特在上个月的选举中都没有赢得明显多数。但代表以色列议会大多数成员的政党建议艾森科特尝试组建执政联盟。想了解更多关于这意味着什么的信息，请听 NPR 的劳伦·弗雷耶 (Lauren Frayer) 的报道，她从特拉维夫现场直播。嘿，劳伦。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So remind us, who is Gadi Eisenkot?
paras.zh: 施密茨：请提醒我们，加迪·艾森科特是谁？

paras.en: FRAYER: So he's a former military chief whose son was an Israeli soldier killed in combat in Gaza. He is a center-right politician, while Netanyahu is on the far right. Eisenkot briefly served in Netanyahu's cabinet after the October 7 Hamas attacks on Israel, but the two had a falling out. Eisenkot founded a new political party, ran against Netanyahu and now wants to replace him. Netanyahu's been Israel's longest serving prime minister, and he is still the caretaker prime minister for now.
paras.zh: 弗雷尔：所以他是一位前军事首长，他的儿子是一名在加沙战斗中丧生的以色列士兵。他是一名中右翼政治家，而内塔尼亚胡则属于极右翼。 10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列后，艾森科特曾短暂在内塔尼亚胡内阁任职，但两人发生了争吵。艾森科特成立了一个新政党，与内塔尼亚胡竞选，现在希望取代他。内塔尼亚胡是以色列任期最长的总理，目前仍担任看守总理。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Got it. So what is the timeline for a possible change of power here?
paras.zh: 施密茨：明白了。那么这里可能发生权力更迭的时间表是什么？

paras.en: FRAYER: Israel's president is holding a ceremony with Eisenkot Sunday evening local time, and that's when the clock starts. Eisenkot has about six weeks to form a coalition with other parties. If he fails, the president could ask someone else to try, perhaps Netanyahu. If that person fails, Israel could be looking at do-over elections in a few months. And the coalition building could be really tough.
paras.zh: 弗雷尔：当地时间周日晚上，以色列总统将与艾森科特举行仪式，此时时钟开始计时。艾森科特有大约六周的时间与其他政党组成联盟。如果他失败了，总统可以请其他人尝试，也许是内塔尼亚胡。如果这个人失败了，以色列可能会在几个月内考虑重新选举。建立联盟可能非常困难。

paras.en: FRAYER: So a coalition would include all these strange bedfellows, you know, from ultra-Orthodox Jewish parties to Arab-led parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel. They make up about 20% of Israel and had a record turnout in these elections - could be the kingmakers. But both Eisenkot and Netanyahu ruled out working with them. And now there's some public pressure on Eisenkot to change his mind. Tonight, Netanyahu issued a video warning against that, against partnering what - with what he called Hamas supporters and, quote, "those who oppose Judaism." You know, Netanyahu has used a lot of racist and Islamophobic language throughout this election towards the - Israel's minority-Arab population. Eisenkot tonight called Netanyahu's video hysterical. So things are very, very tense here.
paras.zh: 弗雷尔：因此，一个联盟将包括所有这些奇怪的伙伴，你知道，从极端正统的犹太政党到代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的阿拉伯领导的政党。他们约占以色列人口的 20%，在这些选举中的投票率创历史新高——可能成为国王的缔造者。但艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡都排除了与他们合作的可能性。现在，公众对艾森科特施加了一些压力，要求他改变主意。今晚，内塔尼亚胡发布了一段视频警告反对这种做法，反对与他所谓的哈马斯支持者以及“那些反对犹太教的人”合作。你知道，内塔尼亚胡在这次选举中对以色列的阿拉伯少数民族人口使用了大量种族主义和仇视伊斯兰教的语言。艾森科特今晚称内塔尼亚胡的视频歇斯底里。所以这里的局势非常非常紧张。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Yeah, it sounds like it. I mean, so the next Israeli prime minister will also have to contend with a more strained relationship with the United States. And I'm curious here, how did the U.S. midterm election results go over in Israel?
paras.zh: 施密茨：是的，听起来是这样。我的意思是，下一任以色列总理也将不得不应对与美国更加紧张的关系。我很好奇，美国中期选举结果在以色列的影响如何？

paras.en: FRAYER: Pretty badly. I mean, many Israelis I've talked to are really dismayed that criticism of Israel was a talking point for some of the winning candidates in the U.S. You know, newspapers here are splashed with photos of the Democratic senator-elect from Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed. Meanwhile, President Trump on Election Day says he's cutting U.S. aid to Israel.
paras.zh: 弗雷尔：非常糟糕。我的意思是，与我交谈过的许多以色列人都对批评以色列成为美国一些获胜候选人的话题感到非常沮丧。你知道，这里的报纸上充斥着密歇根州当选民主党参议员阿卜杜勒·赛义德的照片。与此同时，特朗普总统在选举日表示，他将削减美国对以色列的援助。

paras.en: I spoke with Mairav Zonszein. She's an Israeli American analyst at the International Crisis Group here in Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 我与迈拉夫·宗泽因进行了交谈。她是特拉维夫国际危机组织的一名以色列裔美国分析师。

paras.en: MAIRAV ZONSZEIN: The U.S.-Israel relationship has been the cornerstone of Israeli national security and foreign relations for decades. And we're seeing that completely unravel at a very accelerated pace because of Gaza, because of Iran.
paras.zh: 迈拉夫·宗泽因：几十年来，美以关系一直是以色列国家安全和外交关系的基石。由于加沙和伊朗，我们看到这种情况正在以非常快的速度完全瓦解。

paras.en: FRAYER: And she says the next prime - Israeli prime minister, whoever it is - Eisenkot gets a first shot at that post - his government is gonna have to really try to rebuild relations with the U.S., especially with Democrats, at a time when U.S. public opinion of Israel has really plummeted.
paras.zh: 弗雷尔：她说下一任总理——以色列总理，无论是谁——艾森科特在这个职位上获得了第一次机会——他的政府将不得不真正努力重建与美国的关系，特别是与民主党的关系，而此时美国公众对以色列的看法确实直线下降。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is NPR's Lauren Frayer in Tel Aviv. Lauren, thank you.
paras.zh: 施密茨：我是特拉维夫 NPR 的劳伦·弗雷耶 (Lauren Frayer)。劳伦，谢谢你。
