articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: Two-thirds of used car buyers concerned about undisclosed damage
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Over two-thirds of used car buyers are concerned about hidden faults or undisclosed damage, according to a new United Kingdom survey completed by Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel.
paras.zh: Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel 在英国完成的一项新调查显示，超过三分之二的二手车购买者担心隐藏的故障或未公开的损坏。

paras.en: Hidden faults or undisclosed damage was the largest concern identified in the survey of 2,025 buyers, according to Cazoo.
paras.zh: Cazoo 表示，在对 2,025 名买家进行的调查中，发现的最大问题是隐藏故障或未公开的损坏。

paras.en: Overall, only around a third (35.5%) of used car buyers trust dealers and more than half expect friction as part of their buying experience, the survey found. Another 16.5% said they do not trust dealers and the remaining 48% are sitting on the fence.
paras.zh: 调查发现，总体而言，只有约三分之一（35.5%）的二手车买家信任经销商，超过一半的人认为摩擦是他们购买体验的一部分。另有 16.5% 的人表示不信任经销商，其余 48% 的人持观望态度。

paras.en: Other concerns buyers have include an unclear vehicle history (45%), being overcharged (41%), and pushy sales tactics (36%).
paras.zh: 买家担心的其他问题包括车辆历史不明确（45%）、收费过高（41%）和咄咄逼人的销售策略（36%）。

paras.en: Buyers said dealers could build trust by making a full vehicle history report available (61%), including independent vehicle inspections or warranties (42%), clear no-haggle pricing (42%), and verified customer reviews (40%).
paras.zh: 买家表示，经销商可以通过提供完整的车辆历史报告（61%）来建立信任，包括独立的车辆检查或保修（42%）、明确的无讨价还价的定价（42%）和经过验证的客户评论（40%）。

paras.en: Thirty-two percent of buyers said they value dealer accreditation from a trade body and 18% value photographs or videos of dealerships.
paras.zh: 32% 的买家表示他们看重贸易机构对经销商的认证，18% 的买家看重经销商的照片或视频。

paras.en: “Our latest Consumer Insight Panel identifies the role dealers can play in recognizing how trust can address the pain points experienced by many used car buyers,” Lucy Tugby, Cazoo chief marketing officer, says in the release. “Time and again we see how the best performing used car dealers are the ones with processes in place to ensure vehicles are described accurately and sold with independent inspections and warranties.”
paras.zh: Cazoo 首席营销官露西·塔格比 (Lucy Tugby) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们最新的消费者洞察小组确定了经销商在认识到信任如何解决许多二手车购买者所经历的痛点方面可以发挥的作用。” “我们一次又一次地看到，表现最好的二手车经销商是那些拥有适当流程以确保车辆得到准确描述并在销售时经过独立检查和保修的经销商。”

paras.en: Independent inspections of used vehicles is one suggestion the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) gives to consumers who are concerned their vehicles could have a counterfeit airbag.
paras.zh: 对二手车进行独立检查是美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 向担心其车辆可能装有假冒安全气囊的消费者提出的一项建议。

paras.en: NHTSA identified an 11th death caused by a specific banned counterfeit airbag part in September.
paras.zh: NHTSA 于 9 月份确认了第 11 起死亡事件，原因是特定的违禁假冒安全气囊部件造成的。

paras.en: It is the first death involving one of the replacement airbag inflators installed in a Chevrolet Equinox, according to a NHTSA release. The previous 10 deaths and three serious injuries happened in Chevrolet Malibu and Hyundai Sonata vehicles.
paras.zh: 据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 发布的消息，这是第一起涉及雪佛兰 Equinox 车上安装的替换安全气囊充气机的死亡事件。此前发生的 10 人死亡和 3 人重伤事故均发生在雪佛兰 Malibu 和现代 Sonata 车辆上。

paras.en: Each deadly crash involved vehicles that had the original frontal driver airbag inflators replaced with a defective and likely illegally imported inflator marked with the identifier DTN60DB, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，每起致命事故都涉及车辆将原来的正面驾驶员安全气囊充气机更换为有缺陷且可能非法进口的充气机，其标识符为 DTN60DB。

paras.en: Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) board member, said during a Collision Industry Conference (CIC) in July that NHTSA’s investigation has uncovered how dangerous counterfeit parts find their way into vehicles.
paras.zh: 汽车反假冒委员会 (A2C2) 董事会成员 Teena Bohi 在 7 月份的碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 上表示，NHTSA 的调查发现了危险的假冒零部件是如何进入车辆的。

paras.en: “Up until the point that a counterfeit product gets installed in the vehicle, everything about it is legal,” she added.
paras.zh: “直到假冒产品安装在车上之前，一切都是合法的，”她补充道。

paras.en: The vehicles are typically fleet vehicles or self-insured vehicles that were at some point totaled, Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说，这些车辆通常是车队车辆或在某个时候被总计的自保车辆。

paras.en: “The totaling of a vehicle isn’t a cut-and-dried process,” Bohi says. “The value is driven depending on whether it is self-insured, the state the vehicle was in, the insurer’s own practices, processes, and thresholds. There is a lot that goes into just determining if the vehicle is totaled.”
paras.zh: “车辆的总计并不是一个现成的过程，”Bohi 说。 “该价值取决于车辆是否自我保险、车辆所处的状态、保险公司自己的做法、流程和阈值。确定车辆是否报废需要考虑很多因素。”

paras.en: Next, the vehicle often goes to an auction. If it is a public auction, an airbag deployment will possibly be reported to the National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS). The system is a database meant to prevent the resale of stolen vehicles and track unsafe salvage cars. If the vehicle goes to a wholesale or private auction, the previous crash information is not always captured, she said.
paras.zh: 接下来，车辆经常去拍卖。如果是公开拍卖，安全气囊的部署情况可能会报告给国家机动车辆所有权信息系统（NMVTIS）。该系统是一个数据库，旨在防止被盗车辆的转售并跟踪不安全的报废车辆。她说，如果车辆进行批发或私人拍卖，以前的碰撞信息并不总是能够被捕获。

paras.en: After the repair, vehicles are retitled, and the process can vary state to state, including the inspection process, Bohi says. Many don’t require airbag inspections.
paras.zh: 博希说，维修后，车辆将被重新命名，而且各州的流程可能有所不同，包括检查流程。许多不需要安全气囊检查。

paras.en: “There are a lot of gaps where attention could be focused that could help address these types of issues,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说：“有很多差距值得关注，这有助于解决此类问题。”

paras.en: NHTSA “urges” owners of used vehicles that have previously been in a crash since 2020 to have their vehicles inspected. It also “urges” used vehicle owners and buyers to learn their vehicle’s history and ensure it has genuine airbag inflators.
paras.zh: NHTSA“敦促”自 2020 年以来曾发生过碰撞事故的二手车车主对车辆进行检查。它还“敦促”二手车车主和买家了解其车辆的历史，并确保其配备正品安全气囊充气机。

paras.en: “If a vehicle has been in a previous crash where the air bag deployed, it should be inspected by a reputable mechanic immediately to ensure the air bag is a legitimate replacement equivalent to the original,” NHTSA says in the release. “Owners should not attempt to inspect their air bag themselves. If a vehicle is found to have a DTN60DB inflator, it should not be driven until the inflator is replaced with genuine parts.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 在新闻稿中表示：“如果车辆在之前发生过事故且安全气囊展开，则应立即由信誉良好的机械师对其进行检查，以确保安全气囊是与原始安全气囊相同的合法替代品。” “车主不应尝试自行检查安全气囊。如果发现车辆有 DTN60DB 充气机，则不应驾驶该车，除非用正品零件更换充气机。”

paras.en: Technicians looking for guidance on identifying a DTN airbag can also refer to an NHTSA document. The document outlines the materials and design characteristics that can be used to indicate whether an airbag is a counterfeit. DTN airbags are also often marked with DTN60DB. Yet, it can be hard to identify DTN airbags when they’re still installed in a vehicle.
paras.zh: 寻求识别 DTN 安全气囊指导的技术人员也可以参考 NHTSA 文件。该文件概述了可用于表明安全气囊是否为假冒产品的材料和设计特征。 DTN 安全气囊也常标有 DTN60DB。然而，当 DTN 安全气囊仍然安装在车辆上时，很难识别它们。

paras.en: Bohi said the council has reached out to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) and the Department of Transportation (DOT) to get clarification on those processes.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，该委员会已联系酒精、烟草、枪械和爆炸物局 (ATF) 和交通部 (DOT)，以澄清这些流程。

paras.en: “How do you safely handle these things, and what do you do if you get one? Because there are special permits to transport or get rid of these things if there is a counterfeit because we don’t know what’s in them. It’s an unknown explosive, potentially,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: “如何安全地处理这些东西？如果收到了，该怎么办？因为如果有假货，我们需要特殊许可证才能运输或销毁这些东西，因为我们不知道里面有什么。这可能是一种未知的爆炸物，”博希说。

paras.en: NHTSA’s technician guidance does offer warnings that strongly advise technicians not to electronically probe or electrify airbag connecting terminals because they can detonate and cause serious injury or death.
paras.zh: NHTSA 的技术人员指南确实提供了警告，强烈建议技术人员不要对安全气囊连接端子进行电子探测或通电，因为它们可能会爆炸并导致严重伤害或死亡。

paras.en: Bud Center, I-CAR director of technical products and curriculum, previously told Repairer Driven News that electronic probes can be used to deploy a removed airbag. However, if a repairer believes an airbag is counterfeit, they should contact the vehicle’s OEM and ask for instructions.
paras.zh: I-CAR 技术产品和课程总监 Bud Center 此前告诉 Repairer Driven News，电子探针可用于部署拆下的安全气囊。然而，如果维修人员认为安全气囊是假冒的，他们应该联系车辆的原始设备制造商并寻求指示。

paras.en: “You want to make sure you are not going to deploy something that is unsafe,” Center said.
paras.zh: “你要确保不会部署不安全的东西，”中心说。

paras.en: Center dives into the issue of counterfeit parts from the collision shop level in an I-CAR Repairers Realm series.
paras.zh: 中心在 I-CAR 维修领域系列中从碰撞车间层面深入研究假冒零件问题。

paras.en: Nearly all OEMs and many major aftermarket parts companies have people within their organizations who can answer questions concerning products, Bohi said.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，几乎所有原始设备制造商和许多主要售后零部件公司的组织内都有可以回答有关产品问题的人员。

paras.en: If an owner has a vehicle with one of these suspect inflators, they should contact their local Homeland Security Investigations office or FBI field office to report it or submit an online complaint to the National Intellectual Property Rights Coordination Center.
paras.zh: 如果车主的车辆装有这些可疑充气机之一，他们应该联系当地的国土安全调查办公室或联邦调查局外地办事处进行报告或向国家知识产权协调中心提交在线投诉。

paras.en: Owners should also contact NHTSA online or by calling the agency’s Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time.
paras.zh: 车主还应在线联系 NHTSA 或致电该机构的车辆安全热线 888-327-4236，周一至周五上午 8 点至晚上 8 点。东部时间。

articles.title: How the Alignment Process is Changing
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: For technicians working in an alignment pit before the 1980s, obtaining the initial angles was a relatively easy process because most vehicles had steel wheels. Mounting the alignment “sensor” with rim clamps provided a very accurate representation of the front wheels’ planes of rotation for measuring camber, caster and toe. However, because the tools used to measure these angles were contained inside the sensor head, they were very fragile and frequently fell out of calibration.
paras.zh: 对于 20 世纪 80 年代之前在对准坑中工作的技术人员来说，获得初始角度是一个相对容易的过程，因为大多数车辆都有钢轮。用轮辋夹具安装对准“传感器”可以非常准确地表示前轮的旋转平面，以测量外倾角、主销后倾角和前束角。然而，由于用于测量这些角度的工具包含在传感器头内，因此它们非常脆弱并且经常无法校准。

paras.en: By the 1980s, more vehicles were being equipped with cast-alloy wheels that did not have a suitable lip for mounting the sensor head. Getting a secure grip on the rim became more difficult. It was not uncommon for a rim clamp to come off during an alignment and damage the expensive head.
paras.zh: 到 20 世纪 80 年代，越来越多的车辆配备了铸造合金车轮，但这些车轮没有合适的唇缘来安装传感器头。牢固地抓住轮缘变得更加困难。轮辋夹在对准过程中脱落并损坏昂贵的云台的情况并不罕见。

paras.en: In the 1990s, alignment technology began to change with improvements in digital cameras. Engineers started mounting cameras to fixtures positioned in front of the vehicle. The expensive sensors at the wheels were replaced with simple targets that the cameras could scan to determine the alignment angles.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代，随着数码相机的改进，对准技术开始发生变化。工程师开始将摄像头安装到车辆前方的固定装置上。车轮上昂贵的传感器被简单的目标取代，摄像机可以扫描这些目标以确定对准角度。

paras.en: However, cameras added a new wrinkle to the alignment process: the rolling-compensation procedure. This procedure also helped resolve problems caused by attaching alignment targets to alloy wheels.
paras.zh: 然而，相机给对准过程增加了一个新的问题：滚动补偿程序。此过程还有助于解决因将对准目标连接到合金轮毂而引起的问题。

paras.en: Nearly every modern chassis alignment system uses this step to obtain accurate alignment measurements. First, the vehicle is positioned 12 to 20 inches behind the front turntables. Most systems require the targets to be attached so that a specified part of each target is level with the center of the wheel. The vehicle is then rolled forward onto the turntables. This process is called rolling compensation.
paras.zh: 几乎每个现代底盘对准系统都使用此步骤来获得准确的对准测量结果。首先，车辆位于前转盘后方 12 至 20 英寸处。大多数系统要求连接目标，以便每个目标的指定部分与车轮中心齐平。然后车辆向前滚动到转盘上。这个过程称为滚动补偿。

paras.en: Modern camera-based aligners attach a target to each wheel, and the vehicle is rolled backward or forward a short distance while the cameras track each target through part of a wheel revolution.
paras.zh: 现代基于摄像头的定位器将一个目标固定在每个车轮上，车辆向后或向前滚动一小段距离，同时摄像头通过车轮旋转的一部分跟踪每个目标。

paras.en: As the wheel rotates, the aligner observes the path traveled by the target. The system detects changes in the target’s orientation or the center of the wheel’s rotation caused by clamp runout, wheel damage or an off-center target. From these observations, the software calculates the relationship between the target and the wheel’s actual plane of rotation. This prevents a slightly crooked clamp or target from being interpreted as camber or toe.
paras.zh: 当车轮旋转时，对准器会观察目标的行进路径。该系统可检测由于夹具跳动、车轮损坏或目标偏心导致的目标方向或车轮旋转中心的变化。根据这些观察结果，软件计算目标与车轮实际旋转平面之间的关系。这可以防止稍微弯曲的夹具或目标被解释为外倾或趾部。

paras.en: The primary purpose of rolling compensation is to establish the true rotational plane and centerline of each wheel while compensating for target or clamp mounting errors. Camber and toe can then be calculated directly. Caster and steering-axis inclination require a separate steering sweep.
paras.zh: 滚动补偿的主要目的是建立每个车轮的真实旋转平面和中心线，同时补偿目标或夹具安装误差。然后可以直接计算外倾角和前束角。主销后倾角和转向轴倾斜度需要单独的转向扫描。

paras.en: Some systems do not require rolling compensation. These systems typically use lasers, mirrors or other devices mounted near the center of the lift to calculate the alignment angles. On some heavy-duty alignment systems, the target or sensor is mounted directly to the spindle.
paras.zh: 有些系统不需要滚动补偿。这些系统通常使用安装在电梯中心附近的激光器、镜子或其他设备来计算对准角度。在一些重型对准系统上，目标或传感器直接安装到主轴上。

paras.en: With today’s electronic parking brakes and advanced driver-assistance systems, including collision-mitigation systems, the alignment process is becoming more challenging.
paras.zh: 凭借当今的电子驻车制动器和先进的驾驶员辅助系统（包括碰撞缓解系统），对准过程变得更具挑战性。

paras.en: Even pulling a vehicle onto an alignment rack can be a struggle. We recently had a 2024 Audi Q4 come into our training center. As the technician began driving the vehicle onto the ramps of the drive-on lift, the car applied the brakes, stopped and displayed a collision warning on the instrument panel. The technician applied the accelerator, and the vehicle eventually began moving again.
paras.zh: 即使将车辆拉到对准架上也可能很困难。最近，我们的培训中心迎来了一辆 2024 款奥迪 Q4。当技术人员开始将车辆开上行车电梯的坡道时，汽车踩下刹车，停下来，并在仪表板上显示碰撞警告。技术人员踩下油门，车辆最终再次开始移动。

paras.en: Even after reviewing the service information, it was unclear what caused this behavior. Was the alignment equipment interfering with the vehicle’s sensors, or was the system reacting to the proximity of the wall and toolbox in front of the vehicle? Were the lasers on the cameras causing the issue?
paras.zh: 即使在查看了服务信息后，也不清楚是什么原因导致了这种行为。对准设备是否干扰了车辆的传感器，或者系统是否对车辆前方的墙壁和工具箱附近做出了反应？相机上的激光是否导致了该问题？

paras.en: We had a similar incident with a 2023 Ford F-150 that bucked like a bronco (not a Ford Bronco) while we were positioning it on a drive-on lift. Once again, neither the service information nor the owner’s manual clearly explained the behavior.
paras.zh: 我们的 2023 款福特 F-150 也发生过类似事件，当我们将其放在驾驶式升降机上时，它像野马（不是福特野马）一样颠簸。再次，服务信息和用户手册都没有明确解释该行为。

paras.en: Most other late-model vehicles with collision-mitigation systems that we have driven onto the same lift issue audible and visual warnings when they detect what they interpret as a possible threat in the bay. However, they rarely intervene and stop the vehicle.
paras.zh: 我们驾驶到同一电梯上的大多数其他带有碰撞缓解系统的新型车辆，当它们检测到海湾中可能存在的威胁时，都会发出声音和视觉警告。然而，他们很少干预并停车。

paras.en: Even more challenging are the procedures for preparing a vehicle for an alignment when it must be moved during rolling compensation. The primary difficulties involve keeping the parking brake released and the transmission in neutral.
paras.zh: 更具挑战性的是在滚动补偿过程中必须移动车辆时准备车辆对准的程序。主要的困难在于保持驻车制动器释放以及变速器处于空档。

paras.en: Many modern vehicles use electronic parking brakes that engage automatically when the vehicle is parked. Some systems do this for safety, while others use the parking brake to prevent slight vehicle movement before the transmission’s parking pawl fully engages.
paras.zh: 许多现代车辆都使用电子驻车制动器，在车辆停车时自动接合。有些系统这样做是为了安全，而另一些系统则使用驻车制动器来防止车辆在变速箱驻车棘爪完全接合之前发生轻微移动。

paras.en: Even if the transmission is placed in neutral and the ignition is switched off using a push button or physical key, the parking brake may engage automatically without any action from the driver.
paras.zh: 即使变速箱处于空档并且使用按钮或物理钥匙关闭点火装置，驻车制动器也可能会自动接合，而无需驾驶员进行任何操作。

paras.en: On many vehicles, the driver’s gear selection does not have final authority. Even after neutral is selected, a control module may shift the transmission into park when it detects certain conditions, such as an open driver’s door or an unbuckled seat belt.
paras.zh: 在许多车辆上，驾驶员的档位选择没有最终决定权。即使选择空档后，控制模块在检测到某些条件（例如驾驶员车门打开或安全带未扣）时也可能会将变速箱切换至驻车档。

paras.en: Modern transmissions use electronic driver interfaces and communicate with numerous other vehicle systems. This integration has made selecting neutral—and keeping the transmission in neutral—more challenging.
paras.zh: 现代变速箱使用电子驾驶员接口并与许多其他车辆系统进行通信。这种集成使得选择空档并保持变速箱处于空档变得更具挑战性。

paras.en: Working around systems designed to protect the driver requires awareness, accurate information and, in some cases, a scan tool. Many vehicles have built-in procedures or operating modes that allow them to remain in neutral and roll freely. The challenge is finding the correct procedure.
paras.zh: 围绕旨在保护驾驶员的系统工作需要意识、准确的信息，在某些情况下还需要扫描工具。许多车辆都有内置程序或操作模式，使它们能够保持空档并自由行驶。挑战在于找到正确的程序。

paras.en: Many late-model Ford vehicles have a Stay in Neutral or Temporary Neutral mode that remains active for a limited period. Depending on the vehicle, the mode may be engaged by holding the brake pedal, selecting neutral and pressing the manual-mode or low-range button when prompted.
paras.zh: 许多新款福特汽车都具有“保持空档”或“临时空档”模式，该模式在有限的时间内保持活动状态。根据车辆的不同，可以通过按住制动踏板、选择空档并在出现提示时按下手动模式或低档按钮来启用该模式。

paras.en: Some Tesla alignment procedures require the technician to buckle the front seat belts and manually close the front door latches before placing the vehicle in neutral. This prevents the vehicle from determining that the occupants have exited and automatically applying park or the electronic parking brake.
paras.zh: 一些特斯拉对准程序要求技术人员扣好前排安全带并手动关闭前门锁，然后再将车辆置于空档。这可以防止车辆确定乘员已离开并自动应用驻车或电子驻车制动器。

paras.en: Other vehicles allow technicians to activate these modes through the infotainment system. Some require a particular sequence of button presses to keep the transmission in neutral and the electronic parking brake released. Instructions for these procedures may be found in the service information or owner’s manual.
paras.zh: 其他车辆允许技术人员通过信息娱乐系统激活这些模式。有些需要按特定顺序的按钮来保持变速箱处于空档并释放电子驻车制动器。这些程序的说明可以在服务信息或用户手册中找到。

paras.en: In other cases, a scan tool with bidirectional controls or dedicated service functions may be needed to select neutral, place the braking system in a service mode or release the electronic parking brake. Regardless of the method, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions and use wheel chocks whenever the vehicle is not being moved for the rolling-compensation procedure.
paras.zh: 在其他情况下，可能需要具有双向控制或专用服务功能的扫描工具来选择空档、将制动系统置于服务模式或释放电子驻车制动器。无论采用哪种方法，技术人员都必须遵循制造商的说明，并在不移动车辆进行滚动补偿程序时使用车轮楔块。

paras.en: It is easy to see that alignment and ADAS calibration are beginning to merge into a single service as chassis alignment and ADAS sensor positioning become increasingly dependent on each other. One area that is currently growing is the integration of vehicle communication capabilities into the alignment and calibration bay. As more late-model vehicles come out of warranty, alignment service will require an even more increased use of scan tools to initiate adjustments and calibrations.
paras.zh: 很容易看出，随着底盘对准和 ADAS 传感器定位变得越来越相互依赖，对准和 ADAS 校准开始合并为一项服务。目前正在发展的一个领域是将车辆通信功能集成到对准和校准台中。随着越来越多的新型车辆超出保修期，对准服务将需要更多地使用扫描工具来启动调整和校准。

articles.title: XL Parts, The Parts House Expands VIP Event Series
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: XL Parts and The Parts House recently concluded its 2026 VIP Event Series with expanded programming across Houston, Dallas and Orlando.
paras.zh: XL Parts 和 The Parts House 最近结束了 2026 年 VIP 活动系列，并在休斯顿、达拉斯和奥兰多扩大了活动范围。

paras.en: “This year’s VIP Event Series represents a significant step forward in how we engage with our team, our vendor partners, and our customers,” said President and CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “We have had the opportunity to create meaningful opportunities to align on strategic growth, strengthen industry relationships, and express our deep appreciation for the partners who drive our business forward.”
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 表示：“今年的 VIP 活动系列代表着我们在与团队、供应商合作伙伴和客户互动方面向前迈出了重要一步。” “我们有机会创造有意义的机会，以协调战略增长，加强行业关系，并向推动我们业务发展的合作伙伴表示深深的谢意。”

paras.en: This year’s events introduced an upgraded two-day experience in both Houston and Orlando. The new structure provided dedicated time for internal strategy sessions, vendor showcases, formal awards ceremonies for employee-of-the-year honorees and supplier partners and customer-focused trade shows and appreciation dinners.
paras.zh: 今年的活动在休斯顿和奥兰多推出了升级的两天体验。新的结构为内部战略会议、供应商展示、年度最佳员工获奖者和供应商合作伙伴的正式颁奖典礼以及以客户为中心的贸易展览和答谢晚宴提供了专门的时间。

paras.en: The series debuted Sept. 17-18 at The Woodlands Resort in Houston, TX, where XL Parts team members, vendor partners, and customers gathered for comprehensive product training, business development and vendor recognition.
paras.zh: 该系列于 9 月 17 日至 18 日在德克萨斯州休斯顿的 Woodlands Resort 首次亮相，XL Parts 团队成员、供应商合作伙伴和客户齐聚一堂，进行全面的产品培训、业务开发和供应商认可。

paras.en: It continued at The Shop Club in Dallas, TX, on September 24, where XL Parts says local shop owners and industry partners connected with suppliers over interactive exhibition booths, live entertainment, and multiple prizes.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日，活动在德克萨斯州达拉斯市的 The Shop Club 继续进行，XL Parts 表示，当地店主和行业合作伙伴通过互动展位、现场娱乐表演和多种奖品与供应商建立了联系。

paras.en: The VIP event line-up concluded Oct. 1–2 at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, FL, where The Parts House (TPH) honored VIP customers and supplier partners through targeted product training, networking, and evening celebrations.
paras.zh: VIP 活动系列于 10 月 1 日至 2 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多盖洛德棕榈度假村结束，The Parts House (TPH) 通过有针对性的产品培训、社交和晚间庆祝活动向 VIP 客户和供应商合作伙伴致敬。

articles.title: Milwaukee Introduces M12 Fuel Straight Die Grinders
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Milwaukee Tool has introduced the next generation M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder and new M12 Fuel 1/4″ Extended Die Grinder.
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 推出了下一代 M12 Fuel 1/4" 直模磨床和新型 M12 Fuel 1/4" 加长模磨床。

paras.en: According to the company, these cordless die grinders provide sustained power while not requiring hoses and compressors, allowing professionals to work more efficiently in tight spaces. Applications include rust removal, deburring, grinding, cutting and finishing.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，这些无绳模磨机可提供持续的动力，同时不需要软管和压缩机，使专业人员能够在狭小的空间中更高效地工作。应用包括除锈、去毛刺、研磨、切割和精加工。

paras.en: - 2″ cutting wheels and 3″ sanding accessories
paras.zh: - 2英寸切割轮和3英寸打磨配件

paras.en: According to the company, the M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder is built for more control in precision applications, featuring an improved ergonomic handle; while the M12 Fuel Gen 2 1/4″ Extended Straight Die Grinder delivers greater mobility with extended access, incorporating a 4″ shaft designed to reach deeper into confined or hard‑to‑access areas.
paras.zh: 据该公司介绍，M12 Fuel 1/4" 直模磨床专为精密应用中的更多控制而设计，具有改进的符合人体工程学的手柄；而 M12 Fuel Gen 2 1/4" 加长直模磨床可提供更大的移动性和扩展的操作范围，其 4" 轴设计用于更深入地进入受限或难以进入的区域。

paras.en: M12 Fuel 1/4″ Straight Die Grinder Kit (3486-22)
paras.zh: M12 燃油 1/4" 直模研磨机套件 (3486-22)

paras.en: Kit Includes: (1) M12 Fuel 1/4 Straight Die Grinder (3486-20); (1) M12 RedLithium HO XC5.0 Battery (48-11-2450)(1) M12 RedLithium HO CP2.5 Battery (48-11-2425)(1) Carrying Case (1) Wrench
paras.zh: 套件包括：(1) M12 燃油 1/4 直模磨床 (3486-20)； (1) M12 RedLithium HO XC5.0 电池 (48-11-2450)(1) M12 RedLithium HO CP2.5 电池 (48-11-2425)(1) 便携包 (1) 扳手

paras.en: M12 Fuel 1/4″ Extended Die Grinder (3487-20)
paras.zh: M12 燃油 1/4" 加长模具研磨机 (3487-20)

articles.title: Coach K on ‘Building Trust and Sharing Ownership’
articles.author: aftermarketNews Staff

paras.en: Automotive aftermarket leaders can build stronger teams by adapting how they communicate, holding their best people accountable and giving employees ownership of the work, Mike Krzyzewski told AAPEX attendees at the Keynote Breakfast on November 3, 2026.
paras.zh: Mike Krzyzewski 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日的主题早餐会上对 AAPEX 与会者表示，汽车售后市场领导者可以通过调整沟通方式、让最优秀的人员承担责任并赋予员工工作所有权来建立更强大的团队。

paras.en: The former Duke basketball coach, known as Coach K, drew on his experiences at West Point and with U.S. Olympic teams to explain how preparation and trust help talented people succeed together. His message for an industry built on relationships centered on what leaders do every day to make those relationships stronger.
paras.zh: 这位前杜克大学篮球教练，被称为 K 教练，利用他在西点军校和美国奥运代表队的经历来解释准备和信任如何帮助有才华的人共同取得成功。他向建立在关系基础上的行业传达的信息是，领导者每天所做的事情可以使这些关系更加牢固。

paras.en: “It’s on you as the leader to get your message across,” Krzyzewski said.
paras.zh: “作为领导者，你有责任传达你的信息，”沙舍夫斯基说。

paras.en: That responsibility requires leaders to keep learning. Throughout his career, he said, he viewed himself as becoming something better, with improvement always ahead of him. He encouraged attendees to approach their time at the show the same way: renew relationships, learn something new and return to their businesses better prepared.
paras.zh: 这种责任要求领导者不断学习。他说，在他的整个职业生涯中，他认为自己正在变得更好，进步总是在他前面。他鼓励与会者以同样的方式对待他们在展会上的时间：更新关系，学习新东西，并为重返业务做好更好的准备。

paras.en: Krzyzewski traced several leadership principles to West Point, including responding to setbacks by looking for solutions and building relationships in which people tell one another the truth immediately. He described that foundation as the speed to trust. When people can believe what their teammates say, they can move forward together with confidence.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基将几条领导原则追溯到西点军校，包括通过寻找解决方案来应对挫折，以及建立人们立即告诉彼此真相的关系。他将这个基础描述为信任的速度。当人们能够相信队友所说的话时，他们就能满怀信心地共同前进。

paras.en: Preparation was another lesson, reinforced by his college coach, Bob Knight. Everyone wants to win, Krzyzewski said. The difference is how much work people will do to prepare themselves for it. His goal was to make his teams worthy of winning.
paras.zh: 准备工作是另一堂课，他的大学教练鲍勃·奈特（Bob Knight）强化了这一点。沙舍夫斯基说，每个人都想赢。区别在于人们会为此做多少准备工作。他的目标是让他的球队值得获胜。

paras.en: That preparation still left room for adjustments. He wrote practice plans the night before, then changed them when he or his assistants saw something that needed attention. Agility, adaptability and accountability formed his leadership framework. Agility meant reading the situation and responding. A plan gave the team direction, while observations during the work helped determine what should happen next.
paras.zh: 这项准备工作仍然留有调整的空间。他在前一天晚上写下了练习计划，然后当他或他的助手看到需要注意的事情时就改变了计划。敏捷性、适应性和责任感构成了他的领导框架。敏捷意味着了解情况并做出反应。计划为团队提供了方向，而工作期间的观察有助于确定下一步应该发生什么。

paras.en: Accountability, Krzyzewski said, means telling the truth. That includes recognizing good work and useful ideas alongside addressing problems. Doing both takes time and attention.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基说，责任意味着说实话。这包括在解决问题的同时认可良好的工作和有用的想法。两者都需要时间和注意力。

paras.en: One of his toughest examples involved Kobe Bryant before the 2008 Beijing Olympics. During an exhibition game against Australia, Bryant began taking shots that fell outside the team’s expectations. Other players noticed, leaving Krzyzewski responsible for addressing it.
paras.zh: 他最艰难的例子之一是 2008 年北京奥运会前的科比·布莱恩特。在对阵澳大利亚的一场表演赛中，科比的投篮开始超出了球队的预期。其他球员注意到了，让沙舍夫斯基负责解决这个问题。

paras.en: He and his staff assembled video of the shots. The next morning, he showed Bryant the footage and explained how those decisions could undermine the team. Bryant accepted the correction.
paras.zh: 他和他的工作人员收集了这些镜头的视频。第二天早上，他向科比展示了这段录像，并解释了这些决定将如何损害球队。科比接受了更正。

paras.en: Weeks later, during the gold medal game against Spain, Bryant helped rally his teammates during a timeout. Players spoke up, took ownership of the moment and made the plays needed to win.
paras.zh: 几周后，在对阵西班牙的金牌比赛中，科比在暂停期间帮助队友团结起来。球员们大声疾呼，掌握了比赛的主动权，并做出了取胜所需的比赛。

paras.en: For Krzyzewski, that was evidence of a winning attitude developed through the team’s daily work. Leaders cannot anticipate every decision their people will need to make. They can establish the expectations and trust that help people make those decisions together.
paras.zh: 对于沙舍夫斯基来说，这是团队通过日常工作培养出的胜利态度的证据。领导者无法预测员工需要做出的每一个决定。他们可以建立期望和信任，帮助人们共同做出这些决定。

paras.en: Krzyzewski said he became more committed to empowerment as his career progressed. He asked players for input on practice plans and defensive decisions, giving them ownership of how the team would execute.
paras.zh: 沙舍夫斯基表示，随着职业生涯的发展，他变得更加致力于赋权。他要求球员们就训练计划和防守决策提出意见，让他们对球队的执行方式有自主权。

paras.en: He also wanted assistants to think like head coaches, developing their judgment while improving his own.
paras.zh: 他还希望助理教练能够像主教练一样思考，在提高自己判断力的同时培养他们的判断力。

paras.en: “You can’t teach them everything, but you can create an environment where they feel comfortable in using their talents,” he said.
paras.zh: “你无法教他们一切，但你可以创造一个环境，让他们能够轻松地发挥自己的才能，”他说。

paras.en: The same principle applied to values. Teams needed shared standards that members upheld together, including honesty, respect and responsibility for one another.
paras.zh: 同样的原则也适用于价值观。团队需要成员共同维护的共同标准，包括彼此的诚实、尊重和责任。

paras.en: “My values stayed the same. How I communicated them changed,” Krzyzewski said.
paras.zh: “我的价值观保持不变。我传达这些价值观的方式发生了变化，”沙舍夫斯基说。

paras.en: For leaders working through change, that distinction provides a practical starting point: keep the standards clear, listen to the team and give people the confidence to act on them.
paras.zh: 对于致力于变革的领导者来说，这种区别提供了一个实际的起点：保持标准清晰，倾听团队的意见，并让人们有信心按照这些标准采取行动。

paras.en: Pictured (from left): Bill Babcox, Chairman and CEO of Babcox Media, with Mike Krzyzewski, aka Coach K.
paras.zh: 图（左起）：Babcox Media 董事长兼首席执行官比尔·巴布克斯 (Bill Babcox) 与迈克·沙舍夫斯基 (Mike Krzyzewski)，又名教练 K.

articles.title: MotoRad Highlights Expanded Product Coverage, Partner Support
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: MotoRad is showcasing its expanding product portfolio, application coverage and aftermarket support capabilities at AAPEX 2026 in Las Vegas. The company is exhibiting at Booth V2818.
paras.zh: MotoRad 在拉斯维加斯 AAPEX 2026 上展示其不断扩大的产品组合、应用覆盖范围和售后支持能力。该公司的展位为V2818。

paras.en: MotoRad’s exhibit highlights a range of product categories, including thermal management solutions, powertrain controls and engine management, EVAP and emissions components, and fuel, coolant, oil and specialty caps.
paras.zh: MotoRad 的展览重点展示了一系列产品类别，包括热管理解决方案、动力总成控制和发动机管理、EVAP 和排放部件以及燃油、冷却剂、机油和特种盖。

paras.en: The company also is emphasizing expanded application coverage for today’s vehicle population, along with product content and data designed to support cataloging, inventory management and sales.
paras.zh: 该公司还强调扩大当今车辆的应用覆盖范围，以及旨在支持编目、库存管理和销售的产品内容和数据。

paras.en: Beyond its product offerings, MotoRad continues to invest in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain capabilities and product data to help its distribution partners improve parts availability and meet evolving market demand.
paras.zh: 除了产品供应之外，MotoRad 还继续投资于工程、制造、供应链能力和产品数据，以帮助其分销合作伙伴提高零件可用性并满足不断变化的市场需求。

paras.en: Building on its “Together We Say YES” message introduced at last year’s AAPEX, MotoRad is using this year’s show to engage with customers and industry partners on opportunities to address coverage gaps, identify emerging demand and support future category expansion.
paras.zh: 基于去年 AAPEX 上推出的“我们一起说 YES”信息，MotoRad 正在利用今年的展会与客户和行业合作伙伴互动，寻找解决覆盖范围差距、识别新兴需求和支持未来品类扩展的机会。

paras.en: The company said feedback from these discussions helps guide its product development and aftermarket support initiatives, with an emphasis on helping partners deliver the right parts for the right vehicles at the right time.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，这些讨论的反馈有助于指导其产品开发和售后支持计划，重点是帮助合作伙伴在正确的时间为正确的车辆提供正确的零件。

articles.title: The Case for Fewer SKUs
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Every automotive parts store faces the same inventory challenge: having the right parts available without tying up too much capital. With thousands of SKUs competing for limited shelf space, finding the right balance isn’t easy.
paras.zh: 每个汽车零部件商店都面临着同样的库存挑战：在不占用太多资金的情况下拥有合适的零部件。由于数以千计的 SKU 争夺有限的货架空间，找到适当的平衡并不容易。

paras.en: Bill Nunnery, senior director, sales and marketing, Global Aftermarket at Dana Incorporated, believes SKU consolidation can help stores address that challenge while improving customer service.
paras.zh: 达纳公司全球售后市场销售和营销高级总监 Bill Nunnery 认为，SKU 整合可以帮助商店应对这一挑战，同时改善客户服务。

paras.en: “The one challenge that every distributor is faced with is having the right part at the right place at the right time,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “每个分销商面临的一个挑战是在正确的时间、正确的地点提供正确的零件，”Nunnery 说。

paras.en: Inventory management involves more than keeping shelves stocked. Stores must also consider how much working capital they invest in inventory and whether those products generate sufficient sales.
paras.zh: 库存管理不仅仅涉及保持货架库存。商店还必须考虑他们在库存上投资了多少营运资金以及这些产品是否产生了足够的销售额。

paras.en: Nunnery said the industry has little tolerance for slow-moving inventory, particularly as shelf space becomes increasingly valuable. Carrying similar products from multiple suppliers can further complicate inventory management. Reducing redundant SKUs can help stores control costs while simplifying the purchasing process.
paras.zh: Nunnery 表示，该行业对库存缓慢流动的容忍度很低，尤其是在货架空间变得越来越有价值的情况下。从多个供应商那里购买类似的产品可能会使库存管理进一步复杂化。减少冗余 SKU 可以帮助商店控制成本，同时简化采购流程。

paras.en: “And so minimizing the complexity and choices is always a good thing for the customer,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “因此，最大限度地减少复杂性和选择对客户来说始终是一件好事，”Nunnery 说。

paras.en: That means fewer overlapping options to navigate while helping customers identify the appropriate products for their applications.
paras.zh: 这意味着导航的重叠选项更少，同时帮助客户确定适合其应用的产品。

paras.en: Counter pros see firsthand which products customers request most often and which alternatives can serve multiple applications. That experience can provide valuable insight into inventory decisions, particularly when stores evaluate overlapping products or identify opportunities to simplify their assortments.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员可以直接了解客户最常需要哪些产品以及哪些替代品可以服务于多种应用。这种经验可以为库存决策提供有价值的见解，特别是当商店评估重叠产品或确定简化其分类的机会时。

paras.en: Nunnery pointed to Dana’s Reinzosil universal sealing compound as an example of how SKU consolidation can benefit parts stores and repair shops.
paras.zh: Nunnery 指出，Dana 的 Reinzosil 通用密封剂是 SKU 整合如何使零件店和维修店受益的示例。

paras.en: According to Nunnery, one tube of Reinzosil can replace 10 to 12 conventional RTV sealant varieties. That allows distributors to reduce inventory requirements while offering a product that serves multiple applications.
paras.zh: 据 Nunnery 介绍，一管 Reinzosil 可以替代 10 至 12 种传统 RTV 密封胶品种。这使得分销商能够减少库存需求，同时提供服务于多种应用的产品。

paras.en: The benefits extend into the repair bay. A technician might otherwise keep 10 or 12 different tubes of RTV sealant in a toolbox. Those tubes take up space, and their contents have a limited shelf life.
paras.zh: 这些好处还延伸到了维修区。否则，技术人员可能会在工具箱中保存 10 或 12 管不同的 RTV 密封剂。这些管子占用空间，而且其内容物的保质期有限。

paras.en: “You’ve got to remember this is a perishable item,” Nunnery said.
paras.zh: “你必须记住，这是一种容易腐烂的物品，”纳纳里说。

paras.en: Consolidating those products into one sensor-safe solution can simplify inventory management for technicians while reducing the number of individual products they must purchase and maintain. The same principle applies at the parts store.
paras.zh: 将这些产品整合到一个传感器安全的解决方案中可以简化技术人员的库存管理，同时减少他们必须购买和维护的单个产品的数量。同样的原则也适用于零件店。

paras.en: Nunnery noted that an automotive retailer or independent parts store might dedicate 10 to 12 linear feet of shelf space to RTV products. He estimated that consolidating the category around a universal solution could reduce merchandising requirements by 70% to 80%. That would free valuable space for other products without requiring additional shelving or warehouse capacity.
paras.zh: Nunnery 指出，汽车零售商或独立零部件商店可能会专门为 RTV 产品预留 10 到 12 英尺的货架空间。他估计，围绕通用解决方案整合品类可以将销售需求减少 70% 至 80%。这将为其他产品释放宝贵的空间，而无需额外的货架或仓库容量。

paras.en: Of course, reducing SKUs shouldn’t come at the expense of product availability or application coverage. Nunnery emphasized that distributors must evaluate consolidation opportunities with their customers’ needs in mind.
paras.zh: 当然，减少 SKU 不应以牺牲产品可用性或应用程序覆盖范围为代价。 Nunnery 强调，分销商必须考虑客户的需求来评估整合机会。

paras.en: “I think when they’re deciding on consolidation, I think it always, again, it starts with the customer first,” he said.
paras.zh: “我认为，当他们决定整合时，我认为总是以客户为先，”他说。

paras.en: That philosophy should guide inventory decisions throughout the distribution chain. Manufacturers and distributors can use category management analytics to identify opportunities to reduce inventory while maintaining appropriate application coverage.
paras.zh: 这一理念应该指导整个分销链的库存决策。制造商和分销商可以使用类别管理分析来确定减少库存的机会，同时保持适当的应用覆盖范围。

paras.en: Ultimately, successful SKU consolidation requires collaboration between manufacturers and distributors. The objective isn’t simply to stock fewer products. It’s to reduce unnecessary complexity, make better use of available resources and ensure customers can get the products they need.
paras.zh: 最终，成功的 SKU 整合需要制造商和分销商之间的合作。目标不仅仅是减少产品库存。这是为了减少不必要的复杂性，更好地利用可用资源并确保客户可以获得他们需要的产品。

paras.en: For parts stores, that’s a strategy that can benefit both sides of the counter.
paras.zh: 对于零件店来说，这是一种对柜台双方都有利的策略。

articles.title: AWDA Names Richard and Lisa Beirne 2026 Outstanding Leader
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, celebrated the recipients of its 2026 AWDA Industry Awards during the AWDA General Session on Nov. 1 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The annual awards take place during the AWDA Annual Business Conference and recognize individuals who exemplify leadership, innovation, education and service to the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 于 11 月 1 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 全体会议上庆祝了 2026 年 AWDA 行业奖的获得者。该年度奖项在 AWDA 年度商务会议期间颁发，旨在表彰在汽车售后市场发挥领导力、创新、教育和服务作用的个人。

paras.en: AWDA presented its 2026 Outstanding Leadership Award in honor of Jack Creamer to Richard and Lisa Beirne of Auto Parts Headquarters.
paras.zh: AWDA 向汽车零部件总部的 Richard Beirne 和 Lisa Beirne 颁发了 2026 年杰出领导奖，以表彰 Jack Creamer。

paras.en: Formerly known as the “Leader of the Year,” the award honors an aftermarket professional who has contributed to the industry in a unique and significant way. It is named for former AWDA President Jack Creamer. The award was presented by 2025 recipient Don Bickle, former AWDA Treasurer.
paras.zh: 该奖项以前被称为“年度领袖”，旨在表彰以独特而重大的方式为该行业做出贡献的售后市场专业人士。它以 AWDA 前主席 Jack Creamer 的名字命名。该奖项由 2025 年获奖者、前 AWDA 财务主管 Don Bickle 颁发。

paras.en: Richard’s aftermarket career spans nearly six decades, beginning in 1968 as a delivery driver. With Lisa’s steadfast partnership, he led United Auto Supply as president and CEO, guided its successful partnership with Automotive Parts Headquarters (APH), and built a reputation for valuing employees, customers and supplier partners. Today, he serves as a senior advisor for APH, while he and Lisa continue supporting APH and Auto Value expansion efforts throughout the Midwest.
paras.zh: Richard 的售后职业生涯长达近 60 年，从 1968 年担任送货司机开始。在 Lisa 坚定的合作伙伴关系下，他作为总裁兼首席执行官领导了 United Auto Supply，指导其与汽车零部件总部 (APH) 的成功合作，并建立了重视员工、客户和供应商合作伙伴的声誉。如今，他担任 APH 的高级顾问，同时他和丽莎继续支持 APH 和汽车价值在中西部地区的扩张工作。

paras.en: Richard’s decades of AWDA service include roles as board member, treasurer, chairman, treasurer emeritus and lifetime board member. He also helped lead AWDA’s merger with the Automotive Aftermarket Industry Association. Richard and Lisa have participated in Auto Care Association Leadership Meetings, Capitol Hill advocacy and Right to Repair initiatives, while consistently supporting the Auto Care Political Action Committee.
paras.zh: Richard 在 AWDA 服务了数十年，担任过董事会成员、财务主管、董事长、名誉财务主管和终身董事会成员。他还帮助领导了 AWDA 与汽车售后市场行业协会的合并。理查德和丽莎参加了汽车护理协会领导会议、国会山倡导和维修权倡议，同时一贯支持汽车护理政治行动委员会。

paras.en: The Beirnes’ investment in the next generation is equally significant. Richard serves on the University of the Aftermarket Foundation Board of Trustees and has supported its scholarship and contributions work. Richard and Lisa became Lifetime Trustees in 2019 and, in 2025, were the first individuals named Gold Lifetime Trustees, recognizing cumulative contributions exceeding $250,000.
paras.zh: 贝尔恩斯家族对下一代的投资同样重要。理查德在售后市场大学基金会董事会任职，并支持其奖学金和捐款工作。 Richard 和 Lisa 于 2019 年成为终身受托人，并于 2025 年成为第一批被命名为“黄金终身受托人”的个人，表彰累计捐款超过 25 万美元。

articles.title: Eric Johnson Receives 2026 AWDA Pursuit of Excellence Award
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented its 2026 Pursuit of Excellence Award to Eric Johnson, President and CEO of Arnold Motor Supply and The Merrill Company in Spencer, Iowa. The award was presented by AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis at the association’s 2026 Annual Conference on November in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于爱荷华州斯宾塞的 Arnold Motor Supply 和 Merrill Company 总裁兼首席执行官 Eric Johnson 颁发了 2026 年追求卓越奖。该奖项由 AWDA 秘书长 Cliff Hovis 在 11 月于拉斯维加斯举行的协会 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: Established in 1983, the award recognizes an AWDA member for special achievement and for setting high standards in business, volunteer service or advocacy. AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis presented the award.
paras.zh: 该奖项设立于 1983 年，旨在表彰 AWDA 成员在商业、志愿服务或宣传方面取得的特殊成就和制定的高标准。 AWDA 秘书长克利夫·霍维斯颁发了该奖项。

paras.en: As president and managing partner of Arnold Motor Supply, Eric Johnson has combined technological advancement with a customer- and employee-first culture. He championed investments in e-commerce, digital tools, data-driven operations and cybersecurity education to strengthen customer engagement, operational efficiency and employee readiness.
paras.zh: 作为 Arnold Motor Supply 的总裁兼管理合伙人，Eric Johnson 将技术进步与客户和员工至上的文化结合起来。他倡导对电子商务、数字工具、数据驱动的运营和网络安全教育进行投资，以加强客户参与度、运营效率和员工准备程度。

paras.en: Johnson has also built a culture of continuous learning through training for employees, managers and sales teams. The company’s annual Roadshow brings together more than 130 vendors and over 1,500 attendees for hands-on training, product education and collaboration.
paras.zh: 约翰逊还通过对员工、经理和销售团队的培训建立了持续学习的文化。该公司的年度路演汇聚了 130 多家供应商和 1,500 多名与会者，进行实践培训、产品教育和协作。

paras.en: Beyond Arnold Motor Supply, Eric serves on the Board of Directors of the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc., and supports Alliance University, Northwood University’s University of the Aftermarket and other professional development programs. His contributions were recognized with the 2025 Mort Schwartz Excellence in Education Award. He has also supported charitable initiatives, including the company’s annual golf outing benefiting Tori’s Angels, and provided steady, employee-focused leadership during historic flooding affecting the company and its communities.
paras.zh: 除了 Arnold Motor Supply 之外，Eric 还担任售后汽车零部件联盟 (Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc.) 的董事会成员，并支持联盟大学 (Alliance University)、诺斯伍德大学 (Northwood University) 的售后市场大学和其他专业发展项目。他的贡献获得了 2025 年 Mort Schwartz 卓越教育奖的认可。他还支持慈善活动，包括公司每年一度为托里天使 (Tori’s Angels) 举办的高尔夫郊游活动，并在影响公司及其社区的历史性洪水期间提供稳定、以员工为中心的领导。

articles.title: Bennie Skelton Named 2026 WIX Filters Counter Pro of the Year
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: WIX Filters and Counterman have named Bennie Skelton of Crow-Burlingame’s Bumper to Bumper store in Neosho, Missouri, the 2026 Counter Professional of the Year. Skelton brings more than four decades of parts experience to the counter, building customer relationships that now extend across generations. His career reflects a commitment to helping customers and a determination to overcome challenges.
paras.zh: WIX Filters 和 Counterman 任命密苏里州 Neosho 的 Crow-Burlingame Bumper to Bumper 商店的 Bennie Skelton 为 2026 年度柜台专业人士。 Skelton 将四十多年的零件经验带到了柜台，建立了跨越几代人的客户关系。他的职业生涯体现了帮助客户的承诺和克服挑战的决心。

paras.en: Skelton entered the parts field in 1980 when he enlisted in the U.S. Air Force. During 12 years of service, he learned to identify parts using microfiche and paper catalogs, measure engine components and supervise military and civilian personnel. While stationed in California, he worked weekends at an auto parts story after leaving the Air Force in 1992. Skelton joined Crow-Burlingame in 2009.
paras.zh: Skelton 于 1980 年加入美国空军，进入零部件领域。在 12 年的服役生涯中，他学会了使用缩微胶片和纸质目录来识别零件、测量发动机部件以及监督军事和文职人员。 1992 年离开空军后，他在加利福尼亚州驻扎期间，周末在一家汽车零部件公司工作。Skelton 于 2009 年加入 Crow-Burlingame。

paras.en: “Bennie has great customer service and has a lifetime of knowledge,” said Darren Brewer, manager of the Neosho store. “I don’t have to tell him to do something when he sees it needs to be done, he does it. He’s the best man I’ve ever worked with. ”
paras.zh: Neosho 商店经理达伦·布鲁尔 (Darren Brewer) 表示：“Bennie 拥有出色的客户服务和终生的知识。” “当他认为需要做某事时，我不必告诉他做某事，他就会去做。他是我共事过的最好的人。”

paras.en: Brewer credits Skelton with helping strengthen the store’s financial performance and praised his initiative, sales ability and perseverance.
paras.zh: 布鲁尔称赞斯克尔顿帮助加强了商店的财务业绩，并赞扬了他的主动性、销售能力和毅力。

paras.en: In 2012, Skelton suffered a major stroke that affected his speech and the use of his right side. He spent months relearning how to walk and talk, adapting to perform tasks left-handed. Today, he continues building hydraulic hoses, pulling parts and completing paperwork while serving the customers he knows so well.
paras.zh: 2012年，斯克尔顿遭遇严重中风，影响了他的言语和右侧肢体的使用。他花了几个月的时间重新学习如何走路和说话，以适应用左手执行任务。如今，他继续制造液压软管、拉动零件并完成文书工作，同时为他熟悉的客户提供服务。

paras.en: Established in 1986, Counter Professional of the Year recognizes excellence among automotive aftermarket parts professionals. WIX Filters has sponsored the program since 2006.
paras.zh: Counter Professional of the Year 成立于 1986 年，旨在表彰汽车售后市场零部件专业人士的卓越表现。 WIX Filters 自 2006 年以来一直赞助该计划。

articles.title: Women often get cold more easily than men — a mouse study offers hints why
articles.author: Zunnash Khan

paras.en: It's a common observation that women often prefer warmer temperatures and feel cold more easily than men do, and the same trend appears among females of other species. Now, a study offers new clues as to what drives this preference — and testosterone may play a part.
paras.zh: 人们普遍观察到，女性通常比男性更喜欢温暖的温度，更容易感到寒冷，其他物种的雌性也存在同样的趋势。现在，一项研究提供了关于是什么驱动了这种偏好的新线索——睾丸激素可能发挥了一定作用。

paras.en: Skin carries sensors to detect heat and cold that influence each organism's decision to stay in or move out of an environment. The new study, published Oct. 28 in the Journal of Physiology, found that these sensors activate at higher temperatures in female mice, which appears to shift their preferred temperature roughly 7 degrees Fahrenheit (4 degrees Celsius) higher than that of male mice. Testosterone seems to influence this difference in activation.
paras.zh: 皮肤携带传感器来检测冷热，这些传感器会影响每个生物体留在或离开环境的决定。 10 月 28 日发表在《生理学杂志》上的这项新研究发现，雌性小鼠的这些传感器在较高温度下会激活，这似乎使雌性小鼠的首选温度比雄性小鼠高出大约 7 华氏度（4 摄氏度）。睾酮似乎会影响这种激活差异。

paras.en: "You could say it's just a cute observation of no particular importance," said study co-author Peter McNaughton, a pharmacologist at King's College London who studies pain, thermal sensation and thermoregulation. "[But] it's got practical ramifications," in that it might be important in designing buildings and spaces that accommodate people, he told Live Science.
paras.zh: “你可以说这只是一个可爱的观察结果，并没有特别重要的意义，”该研究的合著者彼得·麦克诺顿（Peter McNaughton）说，他是伦敦国王学院研究疼痛、热感觉和体温调节的药理学家。他告诉《生活科学》杂志，“[但是]它具有实际影响”，因为它对于设计适合人们居住的建筑和空间可能很重要。

paras.en: Proteins in the skin's nerve endings activate in response to warmth or cold. "You can look at them like little electrical generators in the nerve endings," said Dr. Michael Caterina, a neuroscientist at Johns Hopkins University who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: 皮肤神经末梢中的蛋白质会响应温暖或寒冷而激活。 “你可以将它们视为神经末梢中的小型发电机，”未参与这项研究的约翰·霍普金斯大学神经科学家迈克尔·卡特里纳博士说。

paras.en: When activated, these proteins allow charged ions to enter sensory nerve cells, which, in turn, transmit electrical signals to the brain. The circuits a given nerve cell connects to determines our perception of heat or cold, Caterina told Live Science.
paras.zh: 当被激活时，这些蛋白质允许带电离子进入感觉神经细胞，进而将电信号传输到大脑。卡特琳娜告诉《生活科学》杂志，特定神经细胞连接的回路决定了我们对热或冷的感知。

paras.en: Beyond humans, it is known that many female animals, including mice and birds, prefer slightly warmer temperatures than their male counterparts do. So the researchers set up an experiment to investigate these differences.
paras.zh: 除了人类之外，众所周知，许多雌性动物，包括老鼠和鸟类，都比雄性动物更喜欢稍微温暖的温度。因此研究人员进行了一项实验来研究这些差异。

paras.en: They put 30 male and 27 female mice on two adjacent plates of different temperatures — one at 91.4 degrees Fahrenheit (33 degrees Celsius) and another that varied between lower and higher temperatures. A camera tracked the mice's movements and calculated how much time they spent on each plate.
paras.zh: 他们将 30 只雄性小鼠和 27 只雌性小鼠放在两个不同温度的相邻盘子上，其中一个温度为 91.4 华氏度（33 摄氏度），另一个温度在较低和较高温度之间变化。摄像头跟踪小鼠的动作并计算它们在每个盘子上花费的时间。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Both male and female mice spent more time at the 91.4 F plate when the second plate was cooler. However, when put next to a plate measuring 100.4 F (38 C), female mice spent significantly more time on the warmer plate than male mice did. The average preferred surface temperature was approximately 89.6 F (32 C) for male mice and 96.8 F (36 C) for female mice.
paras.zh: 当第二块板温度较低时，雄性和雌性小鼠在 91.4 F 板处停留的时间更长。然而，当放在温度为 100.4 F (38 C) 的盘子旁边时，雌性小鼠在温暖的盘子上停留的时间明显多于雄性小鼠。雄性小鼠的平均优选表面温度约为 89.6 F (32 C)，雌性小鼠的平均优选表面温度约为 96.8 F (36 C)。

paras.en: "Since the top of the cage was completely open, there was no question of the air temperature affecting the mice," McNaughton said, so the preference was driven solely by the sensors in their skin. The researchers also measured the internal and skin temperatures of the mice and confirmed that there were no significant differences between the sexes on those fronts.
paras.zh: 麦克诺顿说：“由于笼子的顶部完全开放，所以毫无疑问气温会影响老鼠，”因此这种偏好完全是由老鼠皮肤上的传感器驱动的。研究人员还测量了小鼠的内部温度和皮肤温度，并证实性别之间在这些方面没有显着差异。

paras.en: The scientists explored what would happen if they genetically deleted the warmth-detector protein. In male mice, this reduced their avoidance of the warmer plate, suggesting this protein normally sends a signal that discourages them from staying on warmer surfaces. The mice's preferred temperature also rose to about 95 F (35 C), closer to that of females.
paras.zh: 科学家们探索了如果从基因上删除温度探测器蛋白会发生什么。在雄性小鼠中，这减少了它们对较温暖的盘子的回避，表明这种蛋白质通常会发出一种信号，阻止它们留在较温暖的表面上。小鼠的首选温度也升至约 95 F (35 C)，更接近雌性。

paras.en: In female mice, deleting or blocking the protein did not have any significant effect.
paras.zh: 在雌性小鼠中，删除或阻断该蛋白质没有任何显着效果。

paras.en: The team then tried eliminating or blocking the coolness-detecting protein, finding that males and females didn't avoid the cool plates as strongly as they did before. Female mice also spent less time on the warmer plates, but males' preference for the warmer plates didn't change.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组尝试消除或阻断凉爽度检测蛋白质，发现雄性和雌性不再像以前那样强烈地避开凉爽的盘子。雌性小鼠在较温暖的盘子上花费的时间也较少，但雄性小鼠对较温暖的盘子的偏好没有改变。

paras.en: "Females are a little bit more responsive to activation of the cold receptor," Caterina said, "and a little bit less responsive to activation of the warmer receptor." That's despite the temperature-sensing neurons in both sets of mice working identically, the team found.
paras.zh: 卡特琳娜说：“雌性对寒冷受体的激活反应稍强，而对温暖受体的激活反应稍弱。”研究小组发现，尽管两组小鼠的温度感应神经元的工作方式相同。

paras.en: The researchers suspected that sex hormones might help to explain this difference.
paras.zh: 研究人员怀疑性激素可能有助于解释这种差异。

paras.en: They gave a group of male mice a drug that blocks the production of testosterone. Weeks after the treatment, these mice spent more time on the 38 C plate than males with normal testosterone. Meanwhile, female mice given testosterone lost their preference for warmer temperatures.
paras.zh: 他们给一组雄性小鼠服用一种药物来阻止睾酮的产生。治疗几周后，这些小鼠比睾酮正常的雄性小鼠在 38 C 板上停留的时间更长。与此同时，给予睾丸激素的雌性小鼠失去了对温暖温度的偏好。

paras.en: Interestingly, giving male mice female hormones, including forms of estrogen and progesterone, did not affect their temperature preferences. And blocking the hormones in female mice also had no effect. These hormones are known to influence other aspects of temperature regulation in the body, though, such as heat dissipation through the skin; but in this case, they didn't seem to affect animals' perception of temperature.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，给予雄性小鼠雌性激素，包括雌激素和黄体酮，并没有影响它们的温度偏好。阻断雌性小鼠的激素也没有效果。不过，众所周知，这些激素会影响体内温度调节的其他方面，例如通过皮肤散热；但在这种情况下，它们似乎并没有影响动物对温度的感知。

paras.en: "So it really seems as though testosterone is the most important determinant," McNaughton said. But these changes were only partial; testosterone did not completely reverse the differences between the sexes. "So there is something else going on that we weren't able to identify," he added.
paras.zh: “所以看起来睾酮确实是最重要的决定因素，”麦克诺顿说。但这些改变只是部分的。睾酮并没有完全扭转性别之间的差异。 “所以还有其他一些我们无法识别的事情正在发生，”他补充道。

paras.en: The exact mechanism for how testosterone impacts the sensor proteins is not clear. Because the effect happened over weeks, researchers suggested that it did not directly affect the temperature-sensing proteins. It might instead act indirectly by influencing the activity of genes, but further studies would be needed to confirm this idea.
paras.zh: 睾酮如何影响传感器蛋白的确切机制尚不清楚。由于这种效应持续了数周，研究人员认为它不会直接影响温度传感蛋白。相反，它可能通过影响基因的活性来间接发挥作用，但需要进一步的研究来证实这一想法。

paras.en: Although the researchers did not conduct any tests in humans, McNaughton noted that the same sensor proteins are present in people and that studies with humans suggest that they behave in a similar way.
paras.zh: 尽管研究人员没有在人类身上进行任何测试，但麦克诺顿指出，相同的传感器蛋白也存在于人类体内，并且对人类的研究表明它们的行为方式相似。

paras.en: This research provides "valuable information" for understanding how the proteins responsible for sensing temperature work, Caterina said. Understanding these mechanisms could be useful for studying conditions like neuropathic pain, in which people's sensitivity to heat and cold is enhanced.
paras.zh: 卡特琳娜说，这项研究为了解负责感知温度的蛋白质如何工作提供了“有价值的信息”。了解这些机制可能有助于研究神经性疼痛等疾病，在神经性疼痛中，人们对热和冷的敏感性增强。

paras.en: "What kinds of signals create our daily experiences around temperature is by itself very important," he told Live Science. "It's a big part of understanding ourselves as living beings."
paras.zh: “什么样的信号创造了我们对温度的日常体验，这本身就非常重要，”他告诉《生活科学》。 “这是理解我们自己作为生物的一个重要部分。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Vilar, B., & McNaughton, P. A. (2026). TRPM8 and TRPM2 ion channels determine sex differences in thermal preference in mice. The Journal of Physiology. https://doi.org/10.1113/jp288076
paras.zh: Vilar, B. 和 McNaughton, P. A. (2026)。 TRPM8 和 TRPM2 离子通道决定小鼠热偏好的性别差异。生理学杂志。 https://doi.org/10.1113/jp288076

paras.en: Zunnash Khan is a mechatronics engineer and a science journalist from Pakistan. She has written for Science, The Scientist and Brainfacts.org, among other outlets.
paras.zh: Zunnash Khan 是一名来自巴基斯坦的机电工程师和科学记者。她曾为《科学》、《科学家》和 Brainfacts.org 等媒体撰稿。

articles.title: Tectonic forces near Japan helped fuel the formation of the Grand Canyon
articles.author: Stephanie Pappas

paras.en: A geological reorganization near Japan may have led to the formation of one of North America's most recognizable features.
paras.zh: 日本附近的一次地质重组可能导致了北美最知名的地貌之一的形成。

paras.en: The birth of the Gulf of California, which rifted from Mexico and created the Baja Peninsula 6 million to 8 million years ago, was accelerated by the formation of a double subduction zone more than 6,000 miles (9,600 kilometers) away, near Japan. This reorganization led to a transfer of tectonic force across the Pacific tectonic plate, which, in turn, opened the Gulf of California and ultimately led to the Grand Canyon's formation, according to new research published Oct. 29 in the journal Science.
paras.zh: 600万至800万年前，从墨西哥裂开并形成巴哈半岛的加利福尼亚湾的诞生，因日本附近6,000多英里（9,600公里）外的双俯冲带的形成而加速。根据 10 月 29 日发表在《科学》杂志上的新研究，这种重组导致了太平洋构造板块上构造力的转移，进而打开了加利福尼亚湾并最终导致了大峡谷的形成。

paras.en: The findings will help researchers understand more about plate boundaries, which is where most of the strongest earthquakes on the planet originate.
paras.zh: 这些发现将帮助研究人员更多地了解板块边界，这是地球上大多数最强地震的发源地。

paras.en: "It's more than a regional curiosity," study co-author Thorsten Becker, a geophysicist at the University of Texas at Austin (UT Austin), told Live Science. "It's a reminder of the global connectedness of mantle convection and plate tectonics."
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是一种区域性的好奇心，”该研究的合著者、德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（UT Austin）的地球物理学家托尔斯滕·贝克尔（Thorsten Becker）告诉《生活科学》。 “这提醒我们地幔对流和板块构造的全球联系。”

paras.en: The Gulf of California is an example of a rift zone, a place where continental crust pulls apart and creates a spot so low that it can be filled by ocean water. There are many rift zones around the world; a currently active one is the Red Sea. But rifting can slow down, speed up or peter out entirely. In the Gulf of California, rifting not only persisted, but sped up. Rifting took about 6 million to 13 million years — much quicker than the typical speed of 30 million to 80 million years.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚湾是裂谷带的一个例子，这里大陆地壳分裂，形成一个低矮的地方，可以被海水充满。世界各地有许多裂谷带；目前活跃的一个区域是红海。但裂谷可能会减慢、加速或完全消失。在加利福尼亚湾，裂谷不仅持续存在，而且还在加速。裂谷大约持续了 600 万到 1300 万年，比通常的 3000 万到 8000 万年要快得多。

paras.en: Study co-author Guido Gianni, a geophysicist at the Czech Academy of Sciences, wondered why that was. No previous research fully explained the rapid rifting, which changed the face of North America in many ways. Not only did the rifting transfer Baja California to the Pacific Plate, but it provided an outlet for the developing Colorado River, which subsequently carved the Grand Canyon on its way to sea level.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、捷克科学院地球物理学家吉多·贾尼（Guido Gianni）想知道这是为什么。之前没有任何研究能够完全解释快速裂谷，它在很多方面改变了北美的面貌。裂谷不仅将下加利福尼亚州转移到了太平洋板块，而且为不断发展的科罗拉多河提供了出海口，随后科罗拉多河在通往海平面的途中雕刻了大峡谷。

paras.en: Gianni and Becker's doctoral student at UT Austin, Xiang He, used a global model of plate tectonics, run on supercomputers at the Texas Advanced Computing Center on campus, to find out if far-flung forces might provide an explanation. Around the same time the Gulf of California was pulling apart, Japan was undergoing its own geological changes. Off the coast of Japan, the Pacific Plate subducts, or pushes under, the Eurasian Plate. About 10 million to 12 million years ago, a single subduction zone near Japan transitioned into two separate subduction zones.
paras.zh: 吉安尼和贝克尔在德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的博士生何翔使用了一个全球板块构造模型，该模型在校园德克萨斯高级计算中心的超级计算机上运行，​​以找出遥远的力量是否可以提供解释。大约在加利福尼亚湾分裂的同时，日本也正在经历自己的地质变化。在日本海岸附近，太平洋板块俯冲或推入欧亚板块下方。大约1000万至1200万年前，日本附近的一个俯冲带转变为两个独立的俯冲带。

paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: This transition at the western end of the Pacific Plate influenced the tectonic forces on the other side of the plate, He, Gianni, Becker and their colleagues found.
paras.zh: He、Gianni、Becker 及其同事发现，太平洋板块西端的这一转变影响了板块另一侧的构造力。

paras.en: "It turned out — ta-da! — [with] the change in this pulling stress, Baja California was one of the few places outside the Japan region that were affected," Becker said. It was "unexpected and sort of a little bit too good to be true."
paras.zh: 贝克尔说：“事实证明，随着拉力的变化，下加利福尼亚州成为日本地区以外少数受到影响的地方之一。”这是“出乎意料的，有点好得令人难以置信。”

paras.en: The researchers tweaked their model to see if the result held with different assumptions about stresses and mantle properties, and it did.
paras.zh: 研究人员调整了他们的模型，看看结果是否适用于关于应力和地幔特性的不同假设，结果确实如此。

paras.en: influenced the tectonic forces on the other side of the plate, He, Gianni, Becker and their colleagues found.
paras.zh: He、Gianni、Becker 及其同事发现，影响了板块另一侧的构造力。

paras.en: "It turned out — ta-da! — [with] the change in this pulling stress, Baja California was one of the few places outside the Japan region that were affected," Becker said. It was "unexpected and sort of a little bit too good to be true."
paras.zh: 贝克尔说：“事实证明，随着拉力的变化，下加利福尼亚州成为日本地区以外少数受到影响的地方之一。”这是“出乎意料的，有点好得令人难以置信。”

paras.en: The researchers tweaked their model to see if the result held with different assumptions about stresses and mantle properties, and it did.
paras.zh: 研究人员调整了他们的模型，看看结果是否适用于关于应力和地幔特性的不同假设，结果确实如此。

paras.en: The Gulf of California was already rifting regardless of the situation across the Pacific. The initial rift was caused by the subduction of a tectonic plate called the Farallon Plate, located under the West Coast of North America. The Farallon slab stretched and thinned the continental crust of the North American plate as it moved. But such rifting might have ended with nothing more than the formation of a little valley or low spot if Japan's influence had not kicked in to give the rifting some extra oomph.
paras.zh: 不管太平洋那边的情况如何，加利福尼亚湾已经在裂痕。最初的裂谷是由位于北美西海岸下方的法拉隆板块的俯冲引起的。法拉隆板块在移动时拉伸并减薄了北美板块的大陆地壳。但如果日本的影响力没有介入，给裂痕带来额外的影响力，那么这种裂痕可能只会形成一个小山谷或低点。

paras.en: The findings have a direct effect on scientists' understanding of how plate boundaries form, Becker said. And this isn't just academic. The findings could have implications for understanding earthquake-generating faults such as the San Andreas in California and the Cascadia subduction zone in the Pacific Northwest, Becker said. Cascadia is what's known as a "megathrust" boundary, capable of triggering quakes of more than magnitude 9.
paras.zh: 贝克尔说，这些发现对科学家对板块边界如何形成的理解有直接影响。这不仅仅是学术上的。贝克尔说，这些发现可能对理解加利福尼亚州的圣安德烈亚斯断层和太平洋西北部的卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带等地震断层具有重要意义。卡斯卡迪亚是所谓的“巨型逆冲断层”边界，能够引发 9 级以上的地震。

paras.en: "If I'm asking what is the mantle doing underneath Cascadia so I get our megathrust correct," Becker said, "I need to include these effects."
paras.zh: 贝克尔说：“如果我问卡斯卡迪亚下面的地幔在做什么，以便我得到正确的巨型逆冲断层，我需要考虑这些影响。”

paras.en: Gianni, G. M., He, X., Becker, T. W., & Faccenna, C. (2026). Western Pacific double subduction drives Gulf of California rifting. Science, 394(6823), 515–519. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aef5187
paras.zh: Gianni, G. M.、He, X.、Becker, T. W. 和 Faccenna, C. (2026)。西太平洋双重俯冲驱动了加利福尼亚湾裂谷。科学，394（6823），515–519。 https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aef5187

paras.en: Stephanie Pappas is a contributing writer for Live Science, covering topics ranging from geoscience to archaeology to the human brain and behavior. She was previously a senior writer for Live Science but is now a freelancer based in Denver, Colorado, and regularly contributes to Scientific American and The Monitor, the monthly magazine of the American Psychological Association. Stephanie received a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of South Carolina and a graduate certificate in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯 (Stephanie Pappas) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，涵盖的主题从地球科学到考古学，再到人脑和行为。她曾是《Live Science》的高级撰稿人，但现在是科罗拉多州丹佛市的自由职业者，并定期为《科学美国人》和美国心理学协会的月刊《监视器》撰稿。斯蒂芬妮获得了南卡罗来纳大学的心理学学士学位和加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书。

articles.title: The Maya used so much red paint that they poisoned their water with mercury, mud sediments reveal
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: The Maya used so much red paint that they accidentally poisoned their lakes and waterways with mercury, a new study finds.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，玛雅人使用了太多的红色油漆，以至于他们不小心用汞污染了他们的湖泊和水道。

paras.en: The problem was cinnabar, a vivid-red mercury-sulfide mineral that can be used as the pigment vermilion in red paint. The run-off from the paint can enter waterways, where anaerobic bacteria then transform cinnabar into highly toxic methylmercury in the sediments of lakes. Over time, the methylmercury accumulates to higher levels in the food chain.
paras.zh: 问题在于朱砂，一种鲜红色的硫化汞矿物，可用作红色油漆中的朱红色颜料。油漆的径流可以进入水道，然后厌氧细菌将朱砂转化为湖泊沉积物中的剧毒甲基汞。随着时间的推移，甲基汞在食物链中积累到更高的水平。

paras.en: The ancient Maya, a people who lived in what is now southern Mexico and Central America and whose descendants are still around today, painted almost everything red. Archaeologists have found countless artifacts that the Maya reddened, including sculptures, monuments, walls, plazas, pottery and the dead for ceremonial funerals. Cinnabar was a common pigment in the paint they made, along with red ocher, which gets its color from a nontoxic iron mineral called hematite.
paras.zh: 古代玛雅人生活在现在的墨西哥南部和中美洲，他们的后裔至今仍然存在，他们几乎把所有东西都漆成红色。考古学家发现了无数被玛雅人染红的文物，包括雕塑、纪念碑、墙壁、广场、陶器和葬礼上的死者。朱砂和红赭石是他们制造的油漆中的常见颜料，赭石的颜色来自一种称为赤铁矿的无毒铁矿物。

paras.en: But the Maya passion for the color red — which to them represented the sun, blood and life — caused an environmental disaster when the nearby waters were poisoned by the cinnabar runoff, said study first author Matthew Waters, a paleolimnologist (a scientist who studies ancient waterways) at Auburn University in Alabama.
paras.zh: 但玛雅人对红色的热情——对他们来说代表着太阳、血液和生命——造成了环境灾难，附近的水域被朱砂径流污染，该研究的第一作者、阿拉巴马州奥本大学的古湖泊学家（研究古代水道的科学家）马修·沃特斯说。

paras.en: "They would have seen a strange color change in the water … and a drop in its productivity, such as fish for protein," he told Live Science. The Maya depended heavily on freshwater fisheries, including for freshwater shellfish.
paras.zh: 他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“他们会看到水发生了奇怪的颜色变化……并且生产力下降，例如鱼的蛋白质含量下降。”玛雅人严重依赖淡水渔业，包括淡水贝类。

paras.en: Previous studies had already found evidence for high levels of mercury in the Maya's southern highlands and south-central lowlands, but no one had fully examined levels of the toxic mineral in Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.
paras.zh: 此前的研究已经发现玛雅南部高地和中南部低地汞含量较高的证据，但没有人全面检查墨西哥尤卡坦半岛有毒矿物的含量。

paras.en: To investigate, Waters and his colleagues studied mercury levels in Maya-era mud in the Yucatán, and found overwhelming signs of mercury poisoning, probably from cinnabar paint, they reported in their study, published Nov. 4 in the journal Science Advances.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，沃特斯和他的同事研究了尤卡坦州玛雅时代泥浆中的汞含量，并在 11 月 4 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上的研究报告中发现了压倒性的汞中毒迹象，很可能是来自朱砂涂料。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "We did not suspect [the Maya] used it in the quantities that we were seeing," he said.
paras.zh: “我们并不怀疑（玛雅人）使用它的数量达到了我们所看到的程度，”他说。

paras.en: The study found extreme levels of mercury in sediment cores from two Maya-era sites: Cobá Lake, a shallow lake beside the Maya city of that name, and Cenote Xcach (also spelled X-Canché), a flooded sinkhole beside a ruined city in the jungle that few have excavated.
paras.zh: 研究发现，两个玛雅时代遗址的沉积物核心中汞含量极高：科巴湖（Cobá Lake），玛雅城市旁边的一个浅湖，以及 Cenote Xcach（也拼写为 X-Canché），这是丛林中一座废墟城市旁边的一个被淹没的天坑，很少有人挖掘过。

paras.en: The sediment cores chronicle the composition of earth and water over more than 2,000 years, and the times of mercury poisoning coincide with several periods during the Preclassic and Classic periods of the Maya civilization from about A.D. 40 to 820.
paras.zh: 沉积物岩芯记录了 2000 多年来地球和水的组成，汞中毒的时间与玛雅文明前古典时期和古典时期（大约公元 40 年至 820 年）的几个时期相吻合。

paras.en: Waters explained that the Environmental Protection Agency in the U.S. has determined it is unsafe to drink water with mercury levels above 2 parts per billion, while the official limit for the level of mercury in fish, where it builds up over time, is 1 part per million — any number above that means the fish can be seized by authorities.
paras.zh: 沃特斯解释说，美国环境保护局已确定饮用汞含量超过十亿分之二的水是不安全的，而随着时间的推移，鱼体内汞含量的官方限值是百万分之一——任何高于该数字的鱼都可能被当局扣押。

paras.en: Severe poisoning occurs when the mercury levels in human blood exceed about 100 parts per billion, from drinking contaminated water or eating contaminated marine animals, such as fish. In humans, mercury poisoning can cause severe symptoms, including permanent lung damage, brain damage and death.
paras.zh: 当人体血液中的汞含量超过十亿分之一百分之十时，就会发生严重中毒，原因是饮用受污染的水或食用受污染的海洋动物（例如鱼）。对于人类来说，汞中毒会导致严重的症状，包括永久性肺损伤、脑损伤和死亡。

paras.en: The most polluted parts of the Yucatan cores had a mercury level of 2.3 parts per million, the team discovered. "They experienced this for decades and, in one case, for centuries," Waters said.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，尤卡坦核心污染最严重的部分的汞含量为百万分之 2.3。沃特斯说：“他们经历了这种情况数十年，甚至几个世纪。”

paras.en: The researchers then examined the sediment cores for signs of environmental damage caused by the mercury poisoning. They found that the cores lacked tiny fossils of freshwater shellfish, indicating that the high mercury levels were killing marine life. The team also noticed that the sediment cores had hardly any traces of algal blooms, which should have happened frequently, Waters said. That's likely because algae could not survive in the poisoned water nutrients.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了沉积物核心，寻找汞中毒造成的环境破坏的迹象。他们发现岩心中缺少淡水贝类的微小化石，这表明高汞含量正在杀死海洋生物。沃特斯说，研究小组还注意到沉积物核心几乎没有任何藻华的痕迹，而藻华应该经常发生。这可能是因为藻类无法在有毒的水中营养物质中生存。

paras.en: Scholars debate why the Maya civilization collapsed in the eighth and ninth centuries, but a leading suspect is the disruption of food supplies caused by drought.
paras.zh: 学者们争论玛雅文明为何在八世纪和九世纪崩溃，但最主要的怀疑是干旱造成的粮食供应中断。

paras.en: But although mercury levels were high during the Preclassic and Classic periods, the environmental damage caused by mercury levels had been falling in many places for hundreds of years by the time of the Maya collapse, Waters said, although it may have been a contributing factor.
paras.zh: 沃特斯说，虽然前古典时期和古典时期的汞含量很高，但到玛雅崩溃时的数百年里，许多地方汞含量造成的环境破坏一直在下降，尽管这可能是一个促成因素。

paras.en: Cinnabar does not occur naturally in the Yucatán, so it must have been imported there, probably from what's now Honduras, the researchers said. It seems these cinnabar imports eventually stopped at Cobá Lake, and the poisoning there fell to a background level of about 20 parts per billion by A.D. 520. However, the sediment cores showed that the mercury poisoning continued at Cenote Xcach until the collapse, they said.
paras.zh: 研究人员说，朱砂在尤卡坦半岛并不是天然存在的，因此它肯定是从那里进口的，很可能是从现在的洪都拉斯进口的。这些朱砂进口似乎最终在科巴湖停止了，到公元 520 年，那里的中毒量已降至约十亿分之 20 的背景水平。不过，他们说，沉积岩芯显示，Cenote Xcach 的汞中毒一直持续到塌方。

paras.en: Waters, M. N., Wooten, S. L., Abrook, A. M., Brenner, M., Curtis, J. H., Langdon, P. G., Medina-Gonzalez, R. M., Paradeisis-Stathis, S., & Vachula, R. S. (2026). Toxic mercury, aquatic ecosystem collapse, and the ancient Lowland Maya. Science Advances, 12(45), eaeh3280. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aeh3280
paras.zh: Waters, M. N.、Wooten, S. L.、Abrook, A. M.、Brenner, M.、Curtis, J. H.、Langdon, P. G.、Medina-Gonzalez, R. M.、Paradeisis-Stathis, S. 和 Vachula, R. S. (2026)。有毒汞、水生生态系统崩溃以及古代低地玛雅人。科学进展，12(45)，eaeh3280。 https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aeh3280

paras.en: What do you know about the civilization that built pyramids across Mesoamerica? Find out with our ancient Maya quiz.
paras.zh: 您对在中美洲建造金字塔的文明了解多少？通过我们古老的玛雅测验来找出答案。

paras.en: Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.
paras.zh: 汤姆·梅特卡夫 (Tom Metcalfe) 是一名自由撰稿人，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，常驻英国伦敦。汤姆主要撰写有关科学、太空、考古学、地球和海洋的文章。他还为 BBC、NBC 新闻、国家地理、科学美国人、航空航天等多家媒体撰稿。
