paras.en: Nevertheless, this is a mighty political achievement, which raises an important question: has the curtain come down on the age of Donald Trump?
paras.zh: 然而，这是一项巨大的政治成就，这引发了一个重要问题：唐纳德·特朗普的时代是否已经落幕？

paras.en: As always, it is dangerous to write off or underestimate Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 一如既往，否定或低估唐纳德·特朗普是危险的。

paras.en: Just seven weeks after the storming of the US Capitol on January 6, 2021 as Congress met to certify the 2020 presidential election results, I watched as Trump was greeted like a conquering hero at a conservative conference in Orlando, Florida. The event had the feel of a cargo cult.
paras.zh: 2021 年 1 月 6 日，国会开会确认 2020 年总统选举结果，美国国会大厦遭到袭击，就在七周后，我看到特朗普在佛罗里达州奥兰多举行的保守派会议上受到了征服英雄般的欢迎。这次活动有一种货物崇拜的感觉。

paras.en: Likewise, after Trump-backed Republican candidates failed to make expected breakthroughs in the 2022 congressional midterms, pundits composed obituaries for the MAGA movement which proved wildly premature.
paras.zh: 同样，在特朗普支持的共和党候选人未能在 2022 年国会中期选举中取得预期突破后，专家们为 MAGA 运动撰写了讣告，事实证明这还为时过早。

paras.en: Yet this week's results are certainly a game-changer.
paras.zh: 然而，本周的结果无疑会改变游戏规则。

paras.en: Any ambitions Trump might harbour of illegally defying the 22nd Amendment, which limits presidents to two terms in office, have surely been snuffed out. The notion of Trump 3.0 is even more outlandish now. A Trump dynasty also seems more unlikely. The thought of President Donald Trump Jr taking the oath of office in 2029 or 2033 requires a giant leap of imagination.
paras.zh: 特朗普可能怀有的任何非法违反第 22 条修正案（该修正案限制总统连任两届）的野心肯定已被扼杀。特朗普3.0的概念现在更加古怪。特朗普王朝似乎也不太可能出现。小唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2029 年或 2033 年宣誓就职的想法需要极大的想象力飞跃。

paras.en: Instead, Trump has been badly weakened. His fear factor, within a Republican Party that over the past decade has come to resemble a Trump Party, has been diminished. Signs of his waning power have come already from his Vice President JD Vance who, in a 600-word screed on social media, broke spectacularly with the president.
paras.zh: 相反，特朗普已被严重削弱。在过去十年里，共和党内部已经变得与特朗普党相似，他的恐惧因素已经减少。他的权力减弱的迹象已经从他的副总统 JD 万斯身上显现出来，他在社交媒体上发表了 600 字的长篇大论，与总统发生了惊人的决裂。

paras.en: "The reason we lost is the war," he wrote. "The president himself said so last night."
paras.zh: “我们失败的原因是战争，”他写道。 “昨晚总统本人也是这么说的。”

paras.en: But the president had not said so last night, and the ambitious vice president, who is eyeing a bid for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, is already trying to distance himself from a damaged brand.
paras.zh: 但总统昨晚并没有这么说，而这位雄心勃勃、着眼于竞选 2028 年共和党总统提名的副总统已经在努力与受损的品牌保持距离。

paras.en: In anointing his political heir, Trump might not be the all-powerful kingmaker after all. Maybe Republican presidential aspirants will not even crave his endorsement. When Texas Republican Senator Ted Cruz published his own 1700-word election post-mortem on X — he described the midterms as "an ass kicking" — it did not include a single word of praise for a president who is used to sycophantic encomiums from his party.
paras.zh: 在指定政治继承人时，特朗普可能并不是全能的造王者。也许共和党总统候选人甚至不会渴望他的支持。当得克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹在 X 网站上发表了自己的 1700 字选举事后分析时——他将中期选举描述为“踢屁股”——其中没有包含对一位习惯于党内阿谀奉承的总统的赞扬。

paras.en: Trump, however, still commands fierce loyalty from millions in his MAGA base. His approval rating among self-described "MAGA Republicans" is 96 per cent. Again, it is worth remembering what happened in the aftermath of January 6. Republicans could have banished Trump into the political wilderness. Instead, his grip on the party tightened. He successfully managed to purge the party of Trump critics, such as former Congresswoman Liz Cheney, and easily saw off the challenge from rivals such as Florida Governor Ron DeSantis in the 2024 Republican primaries.
paras.zh: 然而，特朗普仍然赢得了数百万人对他的 MAGA 基地的强烈忠诚。他在自称“MAGA共和党人”中的支持率为96%。再次值得记住 1 月 6 日之后发生的事情。共和党人本可以将特朗普驱逐到政治荒野。相反，他对党的控制加强了。他成功地清除了党内对特朗普的批评者，例如前国会女议员利兹·切尼，并在 2024 年共和党初选中轻松击败了佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯等竞争对手。

paras.en: This election was not only a rejection of Trump but a repudiation of his hyper-aggressive style of politics.
paras.zh: 这次选举不仅是对特朗普的拒绝，也是对他过度激进的政治风格的否定。

paras.en: In Michigan, he slandered Democrat Abdul El-Sayed as a "jihadist" and "terrorist", repeatedly called him "Mohammed". But in this bellwether of bellwethers, El-Sayed won comfortably.
paras.zh: 在密歇根州，他诽谤民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德为“圣战分子”和“恐怖分子”，多次称他为“穆罕默德”。但在这场领头羊中的领头羊中，埃尔-赛义德轻松获胜。

paras.en: The defeat of Trump acolyte, Vivek Ramaswamy, was also emblematic. Ramaswamy aired one of the most vile political attacks in US campaign history, which featured the mother of his Democratic rival, Amy Aston, castigating her daughter as a liar for accusing her ex-husband, who had been criminally charged of rape and then fled from police, of sexually molesting her as a child. Senior Republicans, including the state's outgoing Governor Mike DeWine, called for Ramaswamy to take down the ad. Trump described it as "very powerful".
paras.zh: 特朗普助手维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的失败也具有象征意义。拉马斯瓦米发表了美国竞选历史上最恶毒的政治攻击之一，他的民主党竞争对手艾米·阿斯顿的母亲严厉斥责她的女儿是个骗子，因为她指控她的前夫在她小时候对她进行性骚扰。她的前夫曾被刑事指控强奸，后来逃离了警方。包括该州即将卸任的州长迈克·德温在内的共和党资深人士呼吁拉马斯瓦米撤下这则广告。特朗普形容其“非常强大”。

paras.en: Voters overwhelmingly rejected that kind of hateful politics.
paras.zh: 选民压倒性地拒绝了这种充满仇恨的政治。

paras.en: James Talarico, who Trump labelled "Talafreako", made this yearning for a gentler kind of politics the centrepiece of his victory speech in Texas.
paras.zh: 被特朗普称为“塔拉弗雷科”的詹姆斯·塔拉里科(James Talarico)将这种对温和政治的渴望作为他在德克萨斯州胜利演讲的核心内容。

paras.en: "We are tired of being told to hate each other," said Talarico. "It has been 10 years of this kind of politics, politics as blood sport, politics as trolling and owning, politics as professional wrestling."
paras.zh: “我们厌倦了被告知要互相仇恨，”塔拉里科说。 “这种政治已经有十年了，政治就是血腥运动，政治就是恶搞和占有，政治就是职业摔跤。”

paras.en: Much of the MAGA agenda, however, will survive. Strong borders. Economic nationalism. A rejection of globalisation and frictionless free trade. The insistence that US allies must cough up more money for their own defence.
paras.zh: 然而，MAGA 议程的大部分内容将继续存在。坚固的边界。经济民族主义。拒绝全球化和无摩擦的自由贸易。坚持美国盟友必须为自己的防务拿出更多资金。

paras.en: Democrats will be more wary of pushing what might be called "woke" issues. Even New York congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez remarked in August that "Woke 1.0 was crazy".
paras.zh: 民主党人将更加谨慎地推动所谓的“觉醒”问题。就连纽约女议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯 (Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez) 在 8 月份也表示“Woke 1.0 太疯狂了”。

paras.en: Democrats have already made concessions to Trumpism.
paras.zh: 民主党人已经对特朗普主义做出了让步。

paras.en: This election they focused on economic issues rather than identity politics. Crucially, however, in the 11 years since Trump came down that golden escalator he has not managed to create a pre-eminent new political order.
paras.zh: 这次选举他们关注的是经济问题而不是身份政治。然而，至关重要的是，自特朗普走下金色自动扶梯以来的 11 年里，他未能创造出卓越的新政治秩序。

paras.en: For much of the past century, as the historian Gary Gerstle noted in his 2022 landmark study, The Rise and Fall of the Neoliberal Order, US politics was dominated by two political orders.
paras.zh: 正如历史学家加里·格斯特尔 (Gary Gerstle) 在其 2022 年里程碑式研究《新自由主义秩序的兴衰》中指出的那样，在过去一个世纪的大部分时间里，美国政治由两种政治秩序主导。

paras.en: First, the New Deal created in the 1930s by Franklin Delano Roosevelt, marked by broad consensus between Democrats and Republicans on the role of the state in regulating capitalism and providing a basic welfare safety net for the economically disadvantaged.
paras.zh: 首先是富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福在 20 世纪 30 年代制定的新政，其标志是民主党和共和党就国家在规范资本主义和为经济弱势群体提供基本福利安全网方面的作用达成了广泛共识。

paras.en: Next, from the 1970s to the 2010s, came the neoliberal order, based on a reduced role of government and greater emphasis on the market, which was championed by Reagan and acquiesced in by Clinton, who presented himself as a market-friendly "New Democrat".
paras.zh: 接下来，从 20 世纪 70 年代到 2010 年代，出现了新自由主义秩序，其基础是减少政府作用并更加重视市场，这一秩序得到了里根的倡导，并得到了克林顿的默许，后者自称是市场友好的“新民主党”。

paras.en: Since the Great Recession of 2008, however, no party has managed to impose its ideas on the other, or accrued enough power for long enough in Washington to do so. Instead, we have entered what Gerstle describes as an "interregnum characterised by disorder and instability".
paras.zh: 然而，自 2008 年经济大衰退以来，没有任何一方能够将自己的想法强加给对方，也没有在华盛顿积累足够的权力足够长的时间来这样做。相反，我们已经进入了格斯特尔所描述的“以混乱和不稳定为特征的过渡期”。

paras.en: This election offers further proof that we remain in this liminal phase, with neither side establishing lasting dominance.
paras.zh: 这次选举进一步证明我们仍处于这个临界阶段，双方都没有建立持久的主导地位。

paras.en: Trump believed there had been a conservative vibe shift in 2024 after he regained the presidency by winning all seven battleground states. Republicans also controlled both houses of Congress. Two years later, Trump and his party have been hammered.
paras.zh: 特朗普认为，在赢得全部七个摇摆州重新当选总统后，2024 年保守派氛围发生了转变。共和党还控制了国会两院。两年后，特朗普及其政党遭受重创。

paras.en: In a chronically polarised nation, we are witnessing a period of unusual political volatility.
paras.zh: 在一个长期两极分化的国家，我们正在目睹一段不寻常的政治动荡时期。

paras.en: At the presidential level, three consecutive two-term presidencies (Democrat Bill Clinton, Republican George W Bush and Democrat Barack Obama) have been followed three consecutive one-term presidencies (Republican Trump, Democrat Joe Biden, Republican Trump).
paras.zh: 在总统层面，连续三届两届总统（民主党人比尔·克林顿、共和党人乔治·W·布什和民主党人巴拉克·奥巴马）紧随其后的是连续三届一届总统（共和党人特朗普、民主党人乔拜登、共和党人特朗普）。

paras.en: Not since the late 19th century, when Grover Cleveland lost the presidency only to win it back four years later, have we seen the presidency switch quadrennially between the parties. Likewise, no party has managed to command Capitol Hill for an extended period. Already this century the House has changed hands five times.
paras.zh: 自 19 世纪末格罗弗·克利夫兰失去总统职位，四年后又重新夺回总统宝座以来，我们还没有看到总统职位每四年在两党之间更换一次。同样，没有一个政党能够长期掌控国会山。本世纪以来，这座房子已易手五次。

paras.en: In the entire second half the 21st century, during which Democrats dominated the House of Representatives, that scenario has only occurred three times. In the final 25 years of the 20th century, the Senate changed majority control just three times. In the first 25 years of the 21st century, it has flipped eight times.
paras.zh: 整个21世纪下半叶，民主党在众议院占主导地位的时期，这种情况只出现过3次。在 20 世纪的最后 25 年里，参议院仅改变了 3 次多数控制权。 21世纪的前25年里，已经翻转了8次。

paras.en: Now we will see divisions not only between the parties but within them. Progressive Democrats will point to the success of El-Sayed in Michigan, and the energising effect of Zohran Mamdani's 2025 mayoral victory in New York, as proof that a left-wing version of economic populism can succeed at the national level.
paras.zh: 现在我们不仅会看到政党之间的分歧，而且会看到政党内部的分歧。进步民主党将指出埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州的成功，以及佐兰·马姆达尼 2025 年纽约市长胜利的激励效应，作为左翼经济民粹主义能够在国家层面取得成功的证据。

paras.en: Among the Democratic victors on Tuesday were a record number of candidates backed by, or affiliated with, the Democratic Socialists of America. Centrists will cite the breakthrough in Texas of Talarico, a moderate Christian Democrat, and the mega-church pastor Adam Hamilton in Kansas as evidence that the party should occupy the middle ground.
paras.zh: 周二的民主党胜利者中，受美国民主社会主义者支持或隶属于美国民主社会主义者的候选人数量创下了纪录。中间派会引用德克萨斯州温和派基督教民主党人塔拉里科和堪萨斯州大型教会牧师亚当·汉密尔顿在德克萨斯州取得的突破作为该党应该占据中间立场的证据。

paras.en: All the party's winning presidential candidates since World War II — Harry Truman, John F Kennedy, Lyndon Johnson, Jimmy Carter, Bill Clinton and Barack Obama — have been pragmatic centrists.
paras.zh: 二战以来该党获胜的所有总统候选人——哈里·杜鲁门、约翰·F·肯尼迪、林登·约翰逊、吉米·卡特、比尔·克林顿和巴拉克·奥巴马——都是务实的中间派。

paras.en: The orthodoxy that only a moderate can win the White House will now be challenged, and contested, ahead of the 2028 presidential election.
paras.zh: 在 2028 年总统选举之前，只有温和派才能入主白宫的正统观念现在将受到挑战和争议。

paras.en: On the right of politics, what remains of the more traditionalist wing of the Republican Party might argue the party has to move away from its Trump branding and become more recognisably Reaganesque. Reagan was a free-trade internationalist who backed traditional conservative governance, compared with Trump's populist nationalism that embraces economic protectionism and rejects global alliances and institutional norms.
paras.zh: 在政治右翼方面，共和党中剩下的较为传统的一派可能会认为，该党必须摆脱特朗普的品牌，变得更加明显的里根风格。里根是一位支持传统保守治理的自由贸易国际主义者，而特朗普则奉行经济保护主义、拒绝全球联盟和制度规范的民粹主义民族主义。

paras.en: MAGA diehards will remain faithful to Trump, though some will argue he has not been MAGA enough, especially by launching an unpopular war with Iran. Think-tanks, such as the Heritage Foundation which produced the controversial policy blueprint Project 2025, have lurched a long way to the right. So, too, have media channels such as Fox News and NewsMax, whose "angertainment" business models are based on stoking culture war outrage.
paras.zh: “MAGA”顽固分子将继续忠于特朗普，尽管有些人会认为他还不够“MAGA”，特别是在与伊朗发动不受欢迎的战争方面。传统基金会（Heritage Foundation）等制定了颇具争议的政策蓝图“2025计划”的智囊团已经严重右倾。福克斯新闻和 NewsMax 等媒体频道也是如此，它们的“愤怒娱乐”商业模式是基于煽动文化战争的愤怒。

paras.en: So, it is by no means inevitable that the party will move back towards what is sometimes called the sensible centre.
paras.zh: 因此，该党退回到有时被称为明智中心的位置绝不是不可避免的。

paras.en: How could the Republicans remain viable if MAGA voters withdrew their support? Some are now likening the Trump Republican Party to the Trump casino empire. That did not end well.
paras.zh: 如果 MAGA 选民撤回支持，共和党如何能够继续生存？现在有些人将特朗普共和党比作特朗普赌场帝国。结局并不好。

paras.en: If, moreover, Texas becomes the new California — the Golden State voted Republican in every presidential election between 1968 and 1988 but Democrat ever since — then it could face a prolonged shut-out from the White House. Try gaining an Electoral College majority without at least one of the country's two most populous states.
paras.zh: 此外，如果得克萨斯州成为新的加利福尼亚州——金州在 1968 年至 1988 年间的每次总统选举中都投票给共和党，但此后一直投票给民主党——那么它可能会面临白宫的长期拒之门外。尝试在至少没有该国人口最多的两个州之一的情况下获得选举团多数席位。

paras.en: Looking to the future, the youth vote does not augur well for the Republicans. Nationally, in House elections, exit polling suggest 66 per cent of voters aged 18-29 voted for a Democrat candidate.
paras.zh: 展望未来，年轻人投票对共和党来说并不是一个好兆头。在全国范围内，在众议院选举中，出口民意调查显示，18-29 岁的选民中有 66% 投票给了民主党候选人。

paras.en: Always, though, we must be wary of over-extrapolating in the aftermath of what look like transformative elections. I have seen too many victorious parties over-reach and then face push-back from voters. Remember the heady talk after Barack Obama's election in 2008 that suggested he would usher in a phase of post-partisanship, and even post-racialism.
paras.zh: 不过，我们必须始终警惕在看似变革性的选举之后过度推断。我见过太多获胜政党过度扩张，然后面临选民的抵制。还记得 2008 年巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 当选后的一次令人兴奋的言论，当时他表示他将迎来一个后党派之争，甚至是后种族主义的阶段。

paras.en: As a correspondent in the US at the time, I witnessed how the country's first African-American president was followed into the White House by the untitled leader of the Birther Movement, who placed himself at the head of the anti-Obama white backlash. As Obama himself described the shift after Trump's victory in 2016: "History doesn't move in a straight line. It zigs and zags."
paras.zh: 作为当时在美国的一名记者，我亲眼目睹了该国第一位非裔美国总统如何被出生运动的无名领导人带入白宫，后者将自己置于反奥巴马白人反弹的带头位置。正如奥巴马本人对 2016 年特朗普获胜后的转变所描述的那样：“历史不会沿着直线前进。它是曲折的。”

paras.en: For the past decade, anti-incumbency has so often been the driver of American politics. That, and the negative partisanship that comes with it. Voters often cast their ballots against a party rather than for a party. In these midterms we saw it again. In a 50/50 nation, where for much of this century the results of elections have been far narrower than on Tuesday night, politics has been marked by deadlock not dominance.
paras.zh: 在过去的十年里，反现任往往是美国政治的驱动力。那，以及随之而来的消极党派之争。选民经常投票反对某个政党，而不是支持某个政党。在这些中期选举中，我们再次看到了这一点。在一个 50/50 的国家，本世纪的大部分时间里，选举结果都比周二晚上的结果要窄得多，政治的特点是僵局，而不是主导地位。

paras.en: What we do know for sure is that the Democrats have just won the authority to scrutinise and investigate. When the new Congress meets on January 3, expect Democratic lawmakers to use those subpoena powers to the full.
paras.zh: 我们可以肯定的是，民主党刚刚赢得了审查和调查的权力。当新一届国会于 1 月 3 日召开会议时，预计民主党立法者将充分利用这些传票权力。

paras.en: Robert Garcia, the top ranking Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, which tends to spearhead congressional investigations, has said already that allegations of Trump family corruption will be his main priority, with the president's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, and his son-in-law, Jared Kushner, coming under closer scrutiny. On election night, he posted two words on social media: "LAWYER UP!"
paras.zh: 负责主导国会调查的众议院监督委员会民主党高层罗伯特·加西亚(Robert Garcia)已经表示，对特朗普家族腐败的指控将是他的首要任务，总统的长子小唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump Jr)和女婿贾里德·库什纳(Jared Kushner)将受到更密切的审查。选举之夜，他在社交媒体上发布了两个词：“律师起来！”

paras.en: Garcia also released a statement pledging to take on "the Trump Crime Family, corporate corruption, DHS [Department of Homeland Security] and ICE abuses, and the cover-up of the Epstein files". Hakeem Jeffries has accused the "Trump Cartel" of "massive corruption" and warned: "We are going to hold the crooks accountable."
paras.zh: 加西亚还发表了一份声明，承诺打击“特朗普犯罪家族、企业腐败、国土安全部和 ICE 的滥用职权，以及掩盖爱泼斯坦档案”。哈基姆·杰弗里斯指责“特朗普卡特尔”“大规模腐败”，并警告说：“我们将追究骗子的责任。”

paras.en: With a majority in the House, the Democrats could for a third time impeach Donald Trump (previously, only two presidents — Andrew Johnson and Bill Clinton — have faced the charge of committing high crimes and misdemeanours). But winning a conviction in the Senate trial that would ensue requires 67 votes, the kind of super-majority the Democrats are not close to achieving. Besides, attempts to punish Trump have often worked in his favour, by allowing him to claim a political form of martyrdom.
paras.zh: 民主党在众议院占多数，可以第三次弹劾唐纳德·特朗普（此前，只有两位总统——安德鲁·约翰逊和比尔·克林顿——面临重罪和轻罪指控）。但在随后的参议院审判中赢得定罪需要 67 票，而民主党距离达到这种绝对多数票还差得远。此外，惩罚特朗普的尝试往往对他有利，让他可以宣称政治形式的殉道。

paras.en: The Democrats could also try to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth for waging military hostilities without congressional authorisation, which is a violation of the 1973 War Powers Resolution. Moves are already afoot in what is now a lame duck Congress, spearheaded by the anti-Trump Republican Thomas Massie, to trigger an impeachment vote against Hegseth as soon as this week.
paras.zh: 民主党还可能试图弹劾战争部长皮特·赫格斯(Pete Hegseth)，因为他在未经国会授权的情况下发动军事敌对行动，这违反了 1973 年的战争权力决议。由反特朗普共和党人托马斯·马西带头的现在的跛脚鸭国会已经采取行动，最早将于本周引发针对赫格塞斯的弹劾投票。

paras.en: The newly-elected 120th Congress, whose members will take their seats in the new year, could become known as the Accountability Congress. But House Democrats will also want to make it an Action Congress, by passing bills, on healthcare especially, that meet the concerns of struggling American voters — even though they could be blocked by Republican filibusters in the Senate, which require 60 votes to break, or vetoed by the president.
paras.zh: 新当选的第 120 届国会可能被称为“问责大会”，其成员将在新的一年就职。但众议院民主党人也希望通过通过法案，特别是在医疗保健方面的法案，以满足苦苦挣扎的美国选民的担忧，从而使其成为一场行动国会——尽管这些法案可能会受到共和党在参议院的阻挠，因为这项法案需要 60 票才能打破，或者被总统否决。

paras.en: Ethics reform is an area the Democrats could highlight, such as beefing up financial conflict-of-interest rules in the executive branch and placing limits on presidential pardons. The post-Watergate Congress placed a heavy emphasis on ethics reform, with the creation of the Office of Government Ethics and independent Inspectors General within federal departments.
paras.zh: 道德改革是民主党可以强调的一个领域，例如加强行政部门的财务利益冲突规则以及对总统赦免进行限制。水门事件后的国会高度重视道德改革，在联邦各部门内设立了政府道德办公室和独立监察长。

paras.en: Among the challenges for the Democrats will be to restore the power of Capitol Hill, which has been the home for the past two years of an incredible shrinking Congress.
paras.zh: 民主党面临的挑战之一将是恢复国会山的权力，过去两年来，国会山一直是令人难以置信的萎缩的所在地。

paras.en: Since returning to the White House, Trump has sought to expand the power of the presidency and to govern almost by decree through signing so many executive orders with the flourish of his Sharpie felt tip pen. Already, he has signed 292 executive orders during his second term, well over 100 more than Joe Biden issued during his entire four-year term.
paras.zh: 自从回到白宫后，特朗普一直试图扩大总统权力，并通过用他的记号笔签署如此多的行政命令来几乎通过法令进行执政。他在第二个任期内已经签署了 292 项行政命令，比乔·拜登在整个四年任期内签署的行政命令多出 100 多项。

paras.en: The conservative-dominated Supreme Court, while sometimes checking his power, has helped him create a more maximal presidency. In Trump v Slaughter, the court ruled in June that the president can fire the heads of independent regulatory agencies at his behest, without being required to show "cause".
paras.zh: 保守派主导的最高法院虽然有时会限制他的权力，但帮助他创造了一个更大的总统职位。在特朗普诉斯劳特一案中，法院于 6 月裁定，总统可以根据自己的要求解雇独立监管机构的负责人，而无需出示“原因”。

paras.en: In its landmark Trump v United States ruling in 2024, brought in connection with the criminal charges he faced over his attempt to overturn the presidential election, it decided presidents possess substantial immunity from criminal prosecution for official acts taken while in office. Among the three branches of government, Congress has felt like the third wheel.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年具有里程碑意义的特朗普诉美国案裁决中，该裁决与他因试图推翻总统选举而面临的刑事指控有关，裁定总统对在任期间采取的官方行为享有实质上的刑事起诉豁免权。在政府的三个部门中，国会感觉就像是第三个轮子。

paras.en: The founding fathers, however, had a very different power ranking in mind. The legislature was supposed to be the most powerful branch of government, which is why Congress was vested with the power of the purse. The presidency was meant to be second. The Supreme Court a distant third.
paras.zh: 然而，开国元勋们心目中的权力排名却截然不同。立法机关被认为是最有权势的政府部门，这就是为什么国会被赋予财政权。总统职位原本应该是第二位。最高法院排名第三。

paras.en: Democrats on Capitol Hill will attempt to restore parity with the executive branch, especially over trade policy, and to overtake the Supreme Court. Supreme Court Justice John Roberts has been a more influential figure than the departing Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson. Incoming House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries will attempt to restore the sway of a role traditionally regarded as the second most powerful government position in the country.
paras.zh: 国会山的民主党人将试图恢复与行政部门的平等，特别是在贸易政策方面，并超越最高法院。最高法院法官约翰·罗伯茨比即将离任的共和党众议院议长迈克·约翰逊更有影响力。即将上任的众议院议长哈基姆·杰弗里斯将试图恢复传统上被视为美国第二大政府职位的影响力。

paras.en: After the Republicans' shellacking at the polls, it will be tempting to describe Trump as a "lame duck" president, the usual descriptor for an incumbent whose party loses control of Congress and cannot seek re-election. With Trump, that would be an act of folly. Normal nomenclature does not apply to such an abnormal president.
paras.zh: 共和党在民意调查中遭遇惨败后，人们很容易将特朗普描述为“跛脚鸭”总统，这是对共和党失去国会控制权且无法寻求连任的现任总统的通常描述。对于特朗普来说，这将是一种愚蠢的行为。正常的命名不适用于这样一位不正常的总统。

paras.en: Trump will not be a lame duck until the final second of the final minute of his presidency. In his last supposed lame-duck phase, from his defeat at the 2020 election to inauguration day in 2021, he propagated the "Big Lie" about Joe Biden stealing the election, amassed his supporters in Washington and did little to restrain them when they first started storming the US Capitol.
paras.zh: 不到总统任期最后一刻的最后一秒，特朗普不会成为一只跛脚鸭。在他最后一个所谓的“跛脚鸭”阶段，从2020年大选失败到2021年就职日，他散布了乔·拜登窃取选举的“大谎言”，在华盛顿聚集了他的支持者，并且在他们第一次开始冲击美国国会大厦时几乎没有采取任何措施来阻止他们。

paras.en: Trump still has enormous executive powers at his disposal. He remains the commander-in-chief of the world's most powerful military. He still has control of the FBI and Justice Department, and could use both in an attempt to take vengeance on political opponents. Overcoming a presidential veto requires a two-thirds super-majority in both houses of Congress, which alone the Democrats cannot muster. Trump has issued 12 vetoes over the course of his two terms; congress has only overridden one of them.
paras.zh: 特朗普仍然拥有巨大的行政权力。他仍然是世界上最强大军队的总司令。他仍然控制着联邦调查局和司法部，并可以利用两者来报复政治对手。克服总统否决权需要国会参众两院获得三分之二的绝对多数，而仅靠民主党是无法聚集到这一点的。特朗普在两届任期内发出了 12 次否决权；国会仅推翻了其中一项。

paras.en: By appointing as his new White House chief of staff arch loyalist Stephen Miller, the hardline architect of the ICE immigration crackdown, Trump is signally there will be no retreat from MAGA. Heading the West Wing is a figure who Trump will regard as a wartime consigliere, an aggressively combative figure in upcoming battles with Congress.
paras.zh: 特朗普任命他的新任白宫办公厅主任、ICE移民镇压强硬派的斯蒂芬·米勒(Stephen Miller)为他的新任白宫幕僚长，这表明他不会从MAGA中退缩。特朗普将西翼的领导者视为战时参谋，在即将与国会展开的战斗中积极好斗的人物。

paras.en: Often, if presidents are thwarted on the home front by an obstructionist Congress, they look to make their mark in the foreign realm. Trump could press for a peace deal in the Ukraine war, on terms that would likely be highly favourable towards Vladimir Putin. He could renew the kind of summitry with North Korean dictator Kim Jong Un, which became such a feature of his first term diplomacy.
paras.zh: 通常，如果总统在国内受到阻挠国会的阻挠，他们就会寻求在国外领域留下自己的印记。特朗普可能会敦促在乌克兰战争中达成和平协议，其条款可能对弗拉基米尔·普京非常有利。他可以与朝鲜独裁者金正恩恢复那种峰会，这成为他第一任期外交的一个特色。

paras.en: He might agree to carve up the world into spheres of influence as part of a grand bargain with Putin and President Xi Jinping of China, which would require concerns in Taiwan. Trump has made no secret of his desire for regime change in Cuba.
paras.zh: 作为与普京和中国国家主席习近平达成的大交易的一部分，他可能会同意将世界划分为势力范围，这将引起台湾的担忧。特朗普毫不掩饰他对古巴政权更迭的渴望。

paras.en: As the dust settles after such an extraordinary electoral event, it is worth noting what did not happen in the 2026 congressional midterms.
paras.zh: 随着如此非凡的选举事件尘埃落定，值得注意的是 2026 年国会中期选举中没有发生的事情。

paras.en: For sure, Donald Trump tried to disrupt the polls beforehand, by attempting to limit postal voting and demanding, unsuccessfully, that states surrender their voter registration lists to the Justice Department in Washington.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，唐纳德·特朗普事先试图扰乱民意调查，试图限制邮寄投票，并要求各州将选民登记名单交给华盛顿司法部，但没有成功。

paras.en: Yet worries that Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents, or even federal troops, would be deployed at, or in the close vicinity of, polling stations on Election Day did not eventuate. Nor has Trump tried to interfere with the count. The Republican defeat, of course, was too big to rig. In a closer election, disputed contests could easily have become flashpoints. But it is worth pointing out that, although he has distanced himself from the results, he had not disputed them.
paras.zh: 然而，有关移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 特工甚至联邦军队将在选举日部署在投票站或其附近的担忧并未成为现实。特朗普也没有试图干扰计票。当然，共和党的失败规模太大，无法操纵。在一场势均力敌的选举中，有争议的竞选很容易成为热点。但值得指出的是，尽管他与结果保持距离，但他并没有对此提出异议。

paras.en: In the year America marked its 250th birthday, the country faced a democratic test, and passed.
paras.zh: 在美国庆祝其 250 岁生日的那一年，该国面临着民主考验，但最终通过了考验。

paras.en: Nobody was assassinated during the campaign. Election Day passed without violence. On January 3, when the new Congress is seated we will not see a repeat of the American insurrection that unfolded on January 6, 2021.
paras.zh: 竞选期间没有人被暗杀。选举日没有发生暴力事件。 1 月 3 日，当新一届国会就职时，我们将不会看到 2021 年 1 月 6 日发生的美国叛乱重演。

paras.en: That alone, in a country as divided and fractious as America, is cause for celebration.
paras.zh: 在美国这样一个分裂和暴躁的国家，仅此一点就值得庆祝。

articles.title: Canada's military is using Palantir software. What are the risks?
articles.author: Ashley Fraser, Exan Auyoung

paras.en: Canada's military is using Palantir software. What are the risks?
paras.zh: 加拿大军方正在使用 Palantir 软件。有哪些风险？

paras.en: Palantir is often referred to as a data analytics company, but some experts say Canada should cut its ties.
paras.zh: Palantir 通常被称为数据分析公司，但一些专家表示加拿大应该切断与它的联系。

paras.en: Canada has multimillion-dollar contracts with Palantir, a controversial U.S. software company. Experts warn the deals could expose Canadian military data to U.S. authorities and leave Canada reliant on critical technology supplied by a foreign company.
paras.zh: 加拿大与备受争议的美国软件公司 Palantir 签订了价值数百万美元的合同。专家警告说，这些交易可能会将加拿大军事数据暴露给美国当局，并使加拿大依赖外国公司提供的关键技术。

paras.en: Documents obtained by the Investigative Journalism Foundation revealed that the Department of National Defence (DND) has had a contract for Palantir's Gotham software since 2020 that was internally flagged as "not for public disclosure." Initially valued at $14 million, it could be worth up to $63 million.
paras.zh: 调查新闻基金会获得的文件显示，国防部 (DND) 自 2020 年以来就签订了一份 Palantir 的 Gotham 软件合同，该合同在内部被标记为“不得公开披露”。最初估值为 1,400 万美元，目前价值可能高达 6,300 万美元。

paras.en: DND told CBC News that Gotham brings together information from military databases and operates on closed, classified networks inside secure facilities in Canada. The department declined to say exactly what information Gotham processes, citing national-security concerns.
paras.zh: DND 告诉 CBC 新闻，Gotham 汇集了来自军事数据库的信息，并在加拿大安全设施内的封闭机密网络上运行。该部门以国家安全为由，拒绝透露 Gotham 处理的具体信息。

paras.en: DND says its security assessment determined that no government data, prompts, outputs or metadata handled under the contracts could be stored, accessed or processed outside Canada.
paras.zh: DND 表示，其安全评估确定，根据合同处理的任何政府数据、提示、输出或元数据都不能在加拿大境外存储、访问或处理。

paras.en: But experts argue U.S. law could still provide American authorities with a means to acquire information within an American company's possession, custody or control. Others warn Canada could become dependent on military technology that would be difficult to replace.
paras.zh: 但专家认为，美国法律仍然可以为美国当局提供获取美国公司拥有、保管或控制的信息的手段。其他人警告加拿大可能会变得依赖难以替代的军事技术。

paras.en: A view of the Palantir building is seen during the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2026 in Davos, Switzerland, in January. (Hans Lucas/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 1 月份在瑞士达沃斯举行的世界经济论坛 2026 年年会上，Palantir 大楼的景色。 （汉斯·卢卡斯/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Palantir Technologies was co-founded in 2003 by five people, including CEO Alex Karp and board chair Peter Thiel. It has since become a major technology contractor for governments and militaries.
paras.zh: Palantir Technologies 于 2003 年由五人共同创立，其中包括首席执行官 Alex Karp 和董事会主席 Peter Thiel。此后，它已成为政府和军队的主要技术承包商。

paras.en: Its software integrates information from multiple datasets so users can identify connections and patterns across large amounts of information.
paras.zh: 其软件集成了来自多个数据集的信息，因此用户可以识别大量信息中的联系和模式。

paras.en: Michael Steinberger, a journalist and author of The Philosopher in the Valley: Alex Karp, Palantir, and the Rise of the Surveillance State, said the company has drawn criticism over its involvement in military operations and immigration enforcement in the United States.
paras.zh: 记者兼《山谷里的哲学家：亚历克斯·卡普、Palantir 和监视国家的崛起》一书的作者迈克尔·斯坦伯格 (Michael Steinberger) 表示，该公司因其参与美国的军事行动和移民执法而受到批评。

paras.en: Some of its most important work, he said, involves Project Maven, the U.S. military's artificial-intelligence program used to analyze military data and support targeting operations.
paras.zh: 他说，其中一些最重要的工作涉及“Maven 项目”，这是美国军方的人工智能项目，用于分析军事数据和支持瞄准行动。

paras.en: "This is being used extensively now in U.S. military actions," Steinberger said.
paras.zh: “这现在在美国的军事行动中被广泛使用，”斯坦伯格说。

paras.en: When asked about Project Maven, a Palantir spokesperson told CBC News: "We do not conduct surveillance. The Maven platform provides the U.S. warfighter a live, synchronized view of the battlespace to help them make better-informed decisions and reduce errors … all of this is conducted with strong safeguards and accountability logs."
paras.zh: 当被问及 Maven 项目时，Palantir 发言人告诉 CBC 新闻：“我们不进行监视。Maven 平台为美国作战人员提供实时、同步的战场视图，帮助他们做出更明智的决策并减少错误……所有这一切都是在强有力的保障措施和问责日志下进行的。”

paras.en: Palantir's work with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement has also drawn criticism.
paras.zh: Palantir 与美国移民和海关执法局的合作也招致了批评。

paras.en: "Its technology seems to be a critical node in the immigration crackdown that's happening here in the United States right now," Steinberger said.
paras.zh: 斯坦伯格说：“它的技术似乎是美国目前正在发生的移民打击行动的一个关键节点。”

paras.en: Palantir CEO Alex Karp is shown at the 48th Annual Meeting of the World Economic Forum in Davos in 2018. (Peter Klaunzer/EPA-EFE/Shutterstock)
paras.zh: Palantir 首席执行官 Alex Karp 出席 2018 年达沃斯世界经济论坛第 48 届年会。 (Peter Klaunzer/EPA-EFE/Shutterstock)

paras.en: The company has also increasingly identified itself with U.S. national interests.
paras.zh: 该公司也越来越认同美国的国家利益。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump praised Palantir earlier this year for having "great war-fighting capabilities and equipment."
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普今年早些时候称赞 Palantir 拥有“强大的作战能力和设备”。

paras.en: In June, Palantir posted on X a list of 22 principles drawn from The Technological Republic, a book co-written by Karp. They include the assertion that Silicon Valley has an "obligation to participate in the defense of the nation" and describe some cultures as "dysfunctional and regressive."
paras.zh: 6 月，Palantir 在 X 上发布了一份 22 条原则清单，该清单摘自卡普 (Karp) 与人合着的《技术共和国》(The Technological Republic) 一书。其中包括声称硅谷有“参与保卫国家的义务”的主张，并将某些文化描述为“功能失调和倒退”。

paras.en: Karp has also appeared in company advertising saying "the West is superior, and we have to fight for these values."
paras.zh: 卡普还出现在公司广告中，称“西方更优越，我们必须为这些价值观而奋斗”。

paras.en: Vass Bednar, managing director of the Canadian Shield Institute, an independent public policy think tank, said the concern extends beyond Palantir's politics to Canada's reliance on an outside supplier for critical digital infrastructure.
paras.zh: 独立公共政策智库加拿大盾牌研究所 (Canadian Shield Institute) 董事总经理瓦斯·贝德纳尔 (Vass Bednar) 表示，人们的担忧不仅限于 Palantir 的政治，还包括加拿大对关键数字基础设施外部供应商的依赖。

paras.en: "We're potentially growing a digital dependency, enriching what is fundamentally a U.S. company at the expense of our sovereignty," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们可能会越来越依赖数字技术，从而以牺牲我们的主权为代价来丰富美国公司的利益。”

paras.en: A protester opposed to data analytics firm Palantir Technologies' role in the National Health Service (NHS) holds a sign in a demonstration outside St Thomas' Hospital during a global day of action against the company's healthcare contracts, in London, in October. (Toby Shepheard/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月，在伦敦举行的针对该公司医疗保健合同的全球行动日期间，一名反对数据分析公司 Palantir Technologies 在英国国民医疗服务体系 (NHS) 中发挥作用的抗议者在圣托马斯医院外举着牌子进行示威。 （托比谢泼德/路透社）

paras.en: The debate over Palantir comes amid a broader push in Europe for "digital sovereignty" — greater domestic control over technology and data.
paras.zh: 关于 Palantir 的争论正值欧洲更广泛地推动“数字主权”——即国内对技术和数据的更大控制权。

paras.en: In July, France and Germany pledged to reduce reliance on foreign providers by examining domestic alternatives after ending Palantir's contracts with their intelligence services.
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，法国和德国承诺在终止 Palantir 与其情报部门的合同后，通过研究国内替代方案来减少对外国提供商的依赖。

paras.en: In the U.K., MPs have called on the government to end Palantir's 330-million-pound ($619 million Cdn) National Health Service contract, citing "serious mistrust" of the company after a Financial Times report that a small number of company employees had access to identifiable patient data in the Palantir-built platform. The National Data Guardian, an independent adviser on the use of health and social-care data in England, said the incident breached data-governance principles.
paras.zh: 在英国，议员们呼吁政府终止 Palantir 价值 3.3 亿英镑（6.19 亿加元）的国家医疗服务合同，理由是英国《金融时报》报道称少数公司员工可以访问 Palantir 构建的平台中的可识别患者数据后，对该公司“严重不信任”。英国健康和社会护理数据使用独立顾问国家数据卫报表示，这一事件违反了数据治理原则。

paras.en: A Palantir spokesperson at the time told the Financial Times that "Palantir software can only be used to process data precisely in line with the instruction of the customer. Using the data for anything else would not only be illegal but technically impossible due to granular access controls overseen by the NHS."
paras.zh: Palantir 的一位发言人当时告诉英国《金融时报》，“Palantir 软件只能用于按照客户的指示精确处理数据。将数据用于其他任何用途不仅是非法的，而且由于 NHS 监督的精细访问控制，在技术上也是不可能的。”

paras.en: Barry Appleton, an international lawyer who practises both Canadian and American law, says the U.S. CLOUD Act could compel U.S. companies to produce data stored outside the United States. (CBC)
paras.zh: 从事加拿大和美国法律的国际律师巴里·阿普尔顿 (Barry Appleton) 表示，美国《云法案》可能会迫使美国公司生成存储在美国境外的数据。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: One potential concern is whether U.S. authorities could compel access to Canadian information.
paras.zh: 一个潜在的担忧是美国当局是否可以强制获取加拿大信息。

paras.en: Barry Appleton, an international lawyer who practises both Canadian and American law, pointed to the U.S. CLOUD Act, which allows authorities, with appropriate legal process, to compel covered U.S. companies to produce data within their possession, custody or control, regardless of whether it is stored inside or outside the United States.
paras.zh: 从事加拿大和美国法律的国际律师巴里·阿普尔顿(Barry Appleton)指出，美国的《云法案》允许当局通过适当的法律程序，迫使受管辖的美国公司提供其拥有、保管或控制的数据，无论这些数据是存储在美国境内还是境外。

paras.en: "I'm talking to you today while we're having massive trade wars," Appleton said. "Do I want Canada's trade strategy to be able to be surveilled and read by the United States today? No, I don't."
paras.zh: “我今天在我们正在进行大规模贸易战的时候与你们交谈，”阿普尔顿说。 “我是否希望加拿大的贸易战略今天能够被美国监视和解读？不，我不希望。”

paras.en: DND says its Palantir systems have been assessed for this kind of exposure. It says government data, prompts, outputs or metadata could not be stored, accessed or processed outside Canada and that Gotham information is protected on closed, classified networks in secure Canadian facilities.
paras.zh: DND 表示其 Palantir 系统已针对此类暴露进行了评估。它表示，政府数据、提示、输出或元数据无法在加拿大境外存储、访问或处理，并且 Gotham 的信息在加拿大安全设施的封闭机密网络上受到保护。

paras.en: "The United States CLOUD Act does not have any authority over servers located in Canada," DND said.
paras.zh: “美国云法案对位于加拿大的服务器没有任何权力，”DND 表示。

paras.en: "The CLOUD Act is not about where the server is located," he said.
paras.zh: “云法案与服务器所在位置无关，”他说。

paras.en: "Any data at any time that Palantir has, if it was subject to an order under the CLOUD Act would have to be produced," Appleton said because "it's decided by American courts under American law, not under Canadian law."
paras.zh: 阿普尔顿表示：“Palantir 在任何时候拥有的任何数据，如果受到《云法案》下的命令的约束，都必须提供，因为“这是由美国法院根据美国法律而不是加拿大法律做出的决定。”

paras.en: Palantir Technologies CEO Alex Karp listens as U.S. President Donald Trump speaks during a reception with business leaders, at the 56th annual World Economic Forum (WEF), in Davos, in January 2026. (Jonathan Ernst/Reuters)
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，在达沃斯举行的第 56 届年度世界经济论坛 (WEF) 上，Palantir Technologies 首席执行官 Alex Karp 聆听美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在与商界领袖的招待会上发表讲话。（Jonathan Ernst/路透社）

paras.en: Jennifer Evans, a policy researcher and founder of PatternPulse AI, said DND's statement that data is stored on closed, classified networks in Canada doesn't make clear what level of security is being used.
paras.zh: PatternPulse AI 的政策研究员兼创始人 Jennifer Evans 表示，DND 关于数据存储在加拿大封闭的机密网络上的声明并没有明确说明所使用的安全级别。

paras.en: She agreed with Appleton that the CLOUD Act "means that there is potential data visibility to some of the highest levels in the U.S. government."
paras.zh: 她同意阿普尔顿的观点，即《云法案》“意味着美国政府的一些最高层有潜在的数据可见性”。

paras.en: Evans said DND should disclose more about its contract with Palantir, including whether it uses air-gapping, which isolates computers or networks from unsecured networks and the internet.
paras.zh: 埃文斯表示，DND 应该披露更多有关其与 Palantir 的合同的信息，包括是否使用气隙，将计算机或网络与不安全的网络和互联网隔离。

paras.en: A Palantir spokesperson told CBC News in an email that it is "a software company" and rejected suggestions that the company takes ownership of or uses its customers' information.
paras.zh: Palantir 发言人在一封电子邮件中告诉 CBC News，它是“一家软件公司”，并拒绝了该公司拥有或使用客户信息的说法。

paras.en: "Our customers own and control their own data. Palantir never uses or retains customer data for its own purposes or shares data with other customers," the spokesperson told CBC News.
paras.zh: “我们的客户拥有并控制自己的数据。Palantir 绝不会出于自身目的使用或保留客户数据，也不会与其他客户共享数据，”该发言人告诉 CBC News。

paras.en: A second potential risk is Canada's dependence on a foreign supplier for military technology.
paras.zh: 第二个潜在风险是加拿大对外国军事技术供应商的依赖。

paras.en: A Ukrainian artilleryman sets up a Starlink satellite internet system near the front line in the Donetsk region in October 2026. Ukrainian officials said Starlink speeds had been throttled earlier that month, disrupting military operations. (Stringer/File Photo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月，一名乌克兰炮兵在顿涅茨克地区前线附近建立了星链卫星互联网系统。乌克兰官员表示，当月早些时候，星链速度受到限制，扰乱了军事行动。 （斯金格/档案照片/路透社）

paras.en: Bednar points to Space X's Starlink internet technology, owned by Elon Musk. Beginning Oct. 14, Ukrainian officials accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink's speeds, disrupting military activity. The accusations came after Trump announced a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to supply the world with millions of tonnes of Russian diesel.
paras.zh: Bednar 提到了埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 拥有的 SpaceX 的 Starlink 互联网技术。从 10 月 14 日开始，乌克兰官员指责 SpaceX 限制 Starlink 的速度，扰乱军事活动。这些指控是在特朗普宣布与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成一项向世界供应数百万吨俄罗斯柴油的协议后提出的。

paras.en: While it's unclear who was responsible for the slowdown, Bednar says the episode shows how reliance on a company with ties to the U.S. government can leave militaries vulnerable.
paras.zh: 虽然尚不清楚谁应对经济放缓负责，但贝德纳表示，这一事件表明，对一家与美国政府有联系的公司的依赖可能会让军队变得脆弱。

paras.en: "These are not neutral technologies. So let's stop treating them as if they're neutral," Bednar said.
paras.zh: “这些不是中立的技术。所以我们不要再把它们当作中立的了，”贝德纳说。

paras.en: Evans said few companies compete with the breadth of Palantir's software but pointed to Canadian alternatives, including Vancouver-based Caseway and Ottawa-based Anvil.
paras.zh: 埃文斯表示，很少有公司能够与 Palantir 软件的广度相竞争，但他指出了加拿大的替代方案，包括总部位于温哥华的 Caseway 和总部位于渥太华的 Anvil。

paras.en: "They don't come anywhere close to the breadth and depth that Palantir offers," she said. She added that it will take time for them to develop comparable technology.
paras.zh: “它们在广度和深度上远远无法与 Palantir 相比，”她说。她补充说，他们需要时间来开发类似的技术。

paras.en: Bednar said Canada should nevertheless invest in developing that technology domestically.
paras.zh: 贝德纳尔表示，加拿大仍然应该投资在国内开发该技术。

paras.en: "Building and owning this kind of necessary digital infrastructure for defence should be a primary goal for Canada," she said.
paras.zh: “建设和拥有这种必要的国防数字基础设施应该是加拿大的首要目标，”她说。

articles.title: The age of AI warfare has dawned. Is Canada ready?
articles.author: Jennifer Yoon

paras.en: The age of AI warfare has dawned. Is Canada ready?
paras.zh: 人工智能战争时代已经到来。加拿大准备好了吗？

paras.en: Russia has reportedly already used autonomous drones to deadly effect in Ukraine
paras.zh: 据报道，俄罗斯已经在乌克兰使用自主无人机造成致命影响

paras.en: The drone looks like a small fighter jet. Artificial Intelligence is flying it, and it's firing a missile. A human approved the shot, but AI carried it out.
paras.zh: 无人机看起来像一架小型战斗机。人工智能正在驾驶它，它正在发射导弹。人类批准了这一镜头，但人工智能执行了它。

paras.en: That's not science fiction. It may be the future of modern warfare.
paras.zh: 这不是科幻小说。这可能是现代战争的未来。

paras.en: In July, American defence company Anduril's YFQ-44A drone, known as Fury, fired an air-to-air tactical missile at a simulated target in California's Mojave Desert. In October, a pilot in an F-22 fighter jet was able to get the drone to carry out simulated combat tasks.
paras.zh: 7月，美国国防公司Anduril的YFQ-44A无人机“Fury”向加州莫哈韦沙漠的模拟目标发射了一枚空对空战术导弹。 10月，一名F-22战斗机飞行员能够让无人机执行模拟作战任务。

paras.en: It's the latest step in the global race for autonomous weapons as armies try to gain a tactical edge.
paras.zh: 这是全球自主武器竞赛的最新一步，军队试图获得战术优势。

paras.en: With governments increasingly integrating AI into military software and hardware, Canada faces a question: should it join the autonomous arms race and start investing more in AI-enhanced weapons despite legal and ethical concerns?
paras.zh: 随着各国政府越来越多地将人工智能融入军事软件和硬件中，加拿大面临着一个问题：尽管存在法律和道德方面的担忧，加拿大是否应该加入自主军备竞赛并开始加大对人工智能增强武器的投资？

paras.en: YFQ-44A is a collaborative combat aircraft (CCA), designed to fly alongside manned fighter jets. It's meant to extend the jet's reach, while reducing risk to the pilot. The drone would use AI to carry out many fighter jet tasks, including firing weapons on command and eventually engaging in close aerial combat.
paras.zh: YFQ-44A 是一款协作战斗机 (CCA)，设计用于与有人驾驶战斗机一起飞行。其目的是扩大飞机的航程，同时降低飞行员的风险。该无人机将使用人工智能来执行许多战斗机任务，包括根据命令发射武器并最终进行近距离空战。

paras.en: "You're getting artificial intelligence in a platform that is deadly," said Yvan Blondin, who commanded the Royal Canadian Air Force from 2012 to 2015.
paras.zh: 2012 年至 2015 年指挥加拿大皇家空军的伊万·布朗丁 (Yvan Blondin) 表示：“人工智能平台是致命的。”

paras.en: - Ottawa drone makers tool up for increased defence budget
paras.zh: - 渥太华无人机制造商准备增加国防预算

paras.en: - As Canadian defence spending ramps up, London firms excited about opportunities
paras.zh: - 随着加拿大国防开支的增加，伦敦公司对机会感到兴奋

paras.en: Blondin believes these drones will become integral to modern militaries by the 2030s.
paras.zh: Blondin 相信，到 2030 年代，这些无人机将成为现代军队不可或缺的一部分。

paras.en: The U.S. has two prototypes, including Fury. Australia has a Boeing-built CCA — and they're working on an underwater version built by Anduril. The U.K. is spending five billion pounds to boost drones and autonomous systems in their military.
paras.zh: 美国有两种原型机，其中包括Fury。澳大利亚拥有波音制造的 CCA，而且他们正在开发由 Anduril 制造的水下版本。英国正花费 50 亿英镑来增强军队中的无人机和自主系统。

paras.en: Western armies say humans will stay in control and responsible for weapons using lethal force: it's part of NATO's policy on responsible use of AI.
paras.zh: 西方军队表示，人类将继续控制使用致命武力的武器并对其负责：这是北约负责任地使用人工智能政策的一部分。

paras.en: Canadian officials told CBC that warfare must stay a fundamentally human endeavour, and said that no machine, weapons systems or algorithmic code can be held responsible for complying with International Humanitarian Law. But Blondin says other adversaries may not wait.
paras.zh: 加拿大官员告诉加拿大广播公司，战争本质上必须是人类的努力，并表示任何机器、武器系统或算法代码都不能承担遵守国际人道主义法的责任。但布朗丁表示，其他对手可能不会等待。

paras.en: If one country uses autonomous AI in a conflict, Blondin wonders how other countries would respond — would they raise their ethical standards, or drop them entirely?
paras.zh: 如果一个国家在冲突中使用自主人工智能，布隆丁想知道其他国家会如何反应——他们会提高道德标准，还是完全放弃？

paras.en: "In times of war, would China bother with the step of having a human in the loop?" he asked.
paras.zh: “在战争时期，中国会费心让人员介入吗？”他问道。

paras.en: In a statement sent to CBC News, the Department of National Defence said the Royal Canadian Air Force is examining how these systems could be useful for Canada, but that no decision has been made about plans to procure CCAs.
paras.zh: 在发给 CBC 新闻的一份声明中，国防部表示，加拿大皇家空军正在研究这些系统如何为加拿大发挥作用，但尚未就采购 CCA 的计划做出决定。

paras.en: The Canadian Armed Forces supports the development of autonomous functionality, the statement said, on the condition that it would be "operated within a responsible chain of human command and control and commits to uphold the reliable and lawful use of such weapon systems."
paras.zh: 声明称，加拿大武装部队支持自主功能的发展，条件是该功能将“在负责任的人类指挥和控制链内运行，并致力于维护此类武器系统的可靠和合法使用”。

paras.en: - Military commander vows fast action on AI and robots, sees 'untapped potential' for Canada
paras.zh: - 军事指挥官誓言对人工智能和机器人迅速采取行动，看到加拿大“未开发的潜力”

paras.en: - In Canada's drone-killing 'Sandbox,' companies compete for a $1M prize
paras.zh: - 在加拿大的无人机杀戮“沙盒”中，各公司争夺 100 万美元的奖金

paras.en: Canada has no collaborative combat aircraft, but Dominion Dynamics CEO Eliot Pence wants to change that.
paras.zh: 加拿大没有协作战斗机，但 Dominion Dynamics 首席执行官艾略特·彭斯希望改变这一现状。

paras.en: His defence technology company is building Scout, a CCA that would fly ahead of a crewed fighter, three or four drones per jet, beyond the radar's edge — and be able to strike by firing a weapon, like a missile.
paras.zh: 他的国防技术公司正在建造Scout，这是一种CCA，可以在载人战斗机之前飞行，每架飞机有三到四架无人机，超出雷达边缘，并且能够通过发射导弹等武器进行攻击。

paras.en: Dominion Dynamics CEO Eliot Pence stands in front of a subscale model of Scout, a collaborative combat aircraft that the Canadian defence technology company is building. Scout would fly ahead of a crewed fighter beyond the edge of its radar and be able to strike by firing a weapon, like a missile. (Nicolas Legault/CBC)
paras.zh: Dominion Dynamics 首席执行官艾略特·彭斯 (Eliot Pence) 站在 Scout 的缩小模型前，Scout 是这家加拿大国防技术公司正在制造的协作战斗机。侦察兵将在载人战斗机的雷达边缘之外飞行，并能够通过发射导弹等武器进行攻击。 （尼古拉斯·莱戈/CBC）

paras.en: Pence, who previously worked at Anduril, says the need for CCA is about sovereignty, especially over the Arctic, which makes up about 40 per cent of Canada. The country doesn't have the fighter jets to cover all that territory, Pence argues, noting that leaves a gap in Canada's ability to carry out intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance — a gap Dominion is trying to fill.
paras.zh: 曾在 Anduril 工作过的彭斯表示，CCA 的必要性在于主权，特别是对占加拿大国土面积约 40% 的北极地区。彭斯认为，加拿大没有战斗机来覆盖所有领土，并指出加拿大执行情报、监视和侦察的能力存在差距，而自治领正试图填补这一空白。

paras.en: "The best, most efficient and technologically advanced way of doing that is by pairing those jets with autonomous systems."
paras.zh: “实现这一目标的最佳、最有效和技术先进的方法是将这些喷气式飞机与自主系统配对。”

paras.en: Dominion stands to benefit if Ottawa buys in.
paras.zh: 如果渥太华加入，Dominion 将会受益。

paras.en: Pence says he's raised about a third of the $500 million needed to build the prototype, and though Ottawa has bought into Dominion's simulation platform, there's no government contract for a prototype.
paras.zh: 彭斯表示，他已经筹集了建造原型机所需的 5 亿美元中的约三分之一，尽管渥太华已经购买了 Dominion 的模拟平台，但政府并没有签订原型机合同。

paras.en: "We don't care. We're going to build it anyway."
paras.zh: “我们不在乎。无论如何我们都会建造它。”

paras.en: Pence says Dominion wants a human to remain the last decision maker for the drone, and is building that boundary into the decision-making of its AI models.
paras.zh: 彭斯表示，Dominion 希望人类仍然是无人机的最后决策者，并正在将这一界限纳入其人工智能模型的决策中。

paras.en: But they have yet to figure out what, specifically, all those safeguards would be, says Benoit Breault, senior vice-president for aerospace engineering at Dominion.
paras.zh: 但 Dominion 航空航天工程高级副总裁伯努瓦·布劳特 (Benoit Breault) 表示，他们尚未弄清楚所有这些保障措施具体是什么。

paras.en: Some boundaries are straightforward, Breault says — for example, any use of force will require human approval.
paras.zh: 布劳特说，有些界限很简单，例如，任何武力的使用都需要人类的批准。

paras.en: Benoit Breault, senior vice-president for aerospace engineering at Dominion, is working on safeguards to make sure a human is the last decision maker for the drone they want to build. (Nicolas Legault/CBC)
paras.zh: Dominion 航空航天工程高级副总裁伯努瓦·布劳特 (Benoit Breault) 正在研究保障措施，以确保人类是他们想要制造的无人机的最后决策者。 （尼古拉斯·莱戈/CBC）

paras.en: Other boundaries may seem less critical at first blush, but can become unexpectedly dangerous. For instance, if engineers want the drone to return home, can AI decide what route to take?
paras.zh: 其他界限乍一看似乎不那么重要，但可能会变得意想不到的危险。例如，如果工程师希望无人机返回家园，人工智能可以决定走哪条路线吗？

paras.en: "You don't want to return to base straight into dangerous environments or contested airspace," Breault said.
paras.zh: “你不想返回基地直接进入危险环境或有争议的空域，”布劳特说。

paras.en: He's also thinking about how to avoid overwhelming the pilot. Too much information from three or four drones could make it difficult for the pilot to maintain control of CCAs.
paras.zh: 他还在考虑如何避免让飞行员不知所措。来自三四架无人机的过多信息可能会使飞行员难以保持对 CCA 的控制。

paras.en: But right now, Breault acknowledges development of the human-machine interface is still "embryonic."
paras.zh: 但目前，布劳特承认人机界面的发展仍处于“萌芽阶段”。

paras.en: He says they're still trying to determine answers to important questions like, "How exactly are we going to provide information to the fighter jet pilots? How exactly are the decision recommendations going to be displayed."
paras.zh: 他说，他们仍在努力确定重要问题的答案，例如“我们将如何准确地向战斗机飞行员提供信息？将如何准确地显示决策建议。”

paras.en: These details are central to ethical concerns about autonomous weapons systems, says Craig Martin, a former Canadian navy officer and an expert in armed conflict laws who teaches at Washburn University in Topeka, Kan.
paras.zh: 加拿大前海军军官、武装冲突法专家、在堪萨斯州托皮卡市沃什伯恩大学任教的克雷格·马丁 (Craig Martin) 表示，这些细节对于自主武器系统的伦理问题至关重要。

paras.en: "This is the million dollar question," he said. "What is the extent and the nature of the human control that's being exercised over that weapon system?"
paras.zh: “这是一个价值百万美元的问题，”他说。 “人类对该武器系统的控制程度和性质是什么？”

paras.en: Martin is worried about automation bias — where humans put too much trust in the machine, especially if, for instance, they have just seconds to respond. Martin says AI systems can also fail if they're used in environments where they weren't trained. For instance, a system trained for use in Afghanistan could make mistakes if it's used in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 马丁担心自动化偏见——人类对机器过于信任，尤其是在他们只有几秒钟的时间做出反应的情况下。马丁表示，如果人工智能系统在未经训练的环境中使用，它们也可能会失败。例如，一个经过训练在阿富汗使用的系统如果在乌克兰使用可能会出错。

paras.en: Such errors, he says, "can actually compound in sort of exponential feedback loops that result in biases that can possibly lead to the killing of civilians."
paras.zh: 他说，此类错误“实际上可能会以指数反馈循环的方式复合，从而导致偏见，从而可能导致平民被杀。”

paras.en: This month, diplomats will meet in Geneva to see if countries want to enter into negotiations about rules governing the use of autonomous weapons. Craig Martin, a former Canadian navy officer and an expert in armed conflict laws, wants Canada to lead that conversation. (Andrew Lee/CBC)
paras.zh: 本月，外交官们将在日内瓦举行会议，看看各国是否愿意就自主武器的使用规则进行谈判。加拿大前海军军官、武装冲突法专家克雷格·马丁希望加拿大主导这场对话。 （安德鲁·李/CBC）

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres wants a legally binding treaty on autonomous weapons by the end of 2026.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯希望在 2026 年底前就自主武器达成具有法律约束力的条约。

paras.en: Guterres renewed that call in August, a month after a Russian drone, acting with no human operator, killed three civilians in Ukraine, the New York Times reported. The drone was reportedly a cheap, expendable weapon that picked its own target. It was in a different category from CCAs, but both that type of drone and CCAs are autonomous enough that they are able to make some of their own decisions.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，古特雷斯在八月再次发出这一呼吁，一个月前，一架俄罗斯无人机在无人操作的情况下在乌克兰杀死了三名平民。据报道，这架无人机是一种廉价的消耗性武器，可以自行选择目标。它与 CCA 属于不同的类别，但此类无人机和 CCA 都足够自主，能够做出一些自己的决定。

paras.en: Martin is calling for changes to international law that would ban fully autonomous weapons and restrict semi-autonomous weapons. This month, diplomats will meet in Geneva to see if countries want to enter into negotiations about rules governing the use of these weapons — and Martin wants Canada to lead that conversation.
paras.zh: 马丁呼吁修改国际法，禁止完全自主武器并限制半自主武器。本月，外交官们将在日内瓦举行会议，看看各国是否愿意就这些武器的使用规则进行谈判——马丁希望加拿大主导这场对话。

paras.en: Canada voted yes to a 2025 UN resolution calling on countries to lay the groundwork for possible negotiations on a treaty governing the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems.
paras.zh: 加拿大对 2025 年联合国决议投了赞成票，该决议呼吁各国为可能的关于管理致命自主武器系统使用的条约的谈判奠定基础。

paras.en: DND officials say Canada will continue to participate in international talks about these weapons. It's also ramping up defence spending, having committed to NATO's target of spending five per cent of GDP on defence by 2035.
paras.zh: DND 官员表示，加拿大将继续参与有关这些武器的国际谈判。它还增加了国防开支，承诺实现北约到2035年将GDP的5%用于国防的目标。

paras.en: Whether or not Canada buys in to autonomous weapons, Blondin, the former RCAF commander, says they're coming.
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家空军前指挥官布隆丁表示，无论加拿大是否购买自主武器，他们都会购买。

paras.en: "This is a discussion we need to have as a society."
paras.zh: “这是我们作为一个社会需要进行的讨论。”

articles.title: Shooting in Polish city of Krakow leaves 6 people dead and more than a dozen injured

paras.en: Shooting in Polish city of Krakow leaves 6 people dead and more than a dozen injured
paras.zh: 波兰克拉科夫市发生枪击事件，造成六人死亡、十几人受伤

paras.en: Shooting occurred in the Main Market Square, the municipal government said
paras.zh: 市政府称，主市场广场发生枪击事件

paras.en: Six people were killed and 15 wounded after a gunman opened fire on Saturday afternoon in a busy market square in Krakow, Poland, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周六下午，一名枪手在波兰克拉科夫一个繁忙的集市广场开枪，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。

paras.en: The gunman, a Polish citizen, aimed at random people as he drove into the Main Market Square, a major tourist destination in the centre of the city, Krakow police said. Police officers are among the wounded.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方称，枪手是一名波兰公民，他开车进入市中心的主要旅游目的地主市场广场时随机瞄准人群。伤者中有警察。

paras.en: The perpetrator was shot and wounded during a gunfight with officers a short distance away from the initial violence, police said. The death toll earlier stood at five, but the Malopolska regional government updated it to six in a post on social media platform X.
paras.zh: 警方称，肇事者在距离最初暴力事件不远的地方与警察发生枪战时被枪击受伤。早些时候的死亡人数为五人，但小波兰地区政府在社交媒体平台 X 上发布的帖子中将死亡人数更新为六人。

paras.en: Katarzyna Cisło, a spokesperson for the Krakow police, told TVN24 that the perpetrator was wearing military-style fatigues and used a military-type long gun in the attack. Police said they found many other weapons, as well as ammunition, in his car.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方发言人卡塔齐娜·西斯沃 (Katarzyna Cisło) 告诉 TVN24，行凶者在袭击中穿着军用型迷彩服，并使用军用型长枪。警方表示，他们在他的车里发现了许多其他武器和弹药。

paras.en: Cisło said the gunman acted alone and that the public is safe. Mass shootings are uncommon in Poland.
paras.zh: 西斯沃表示，枪手是单独行动，公众是安全的。大规模枪击事件在波兰并不常见。

paras.en: Emergency personnel speak to a person at the site of the shooting near Krakow's Main Market Square on Saturday. (Jakub Porzycki/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，急救人员在克拉科夫主集市广场附近的枪击现场与一名人员交谈。 （雅库布·波尔兹茨基/路透社）

paras.en: Images from the scene showed police officers and ambulances covering the area, and a Polish Medical Air Rescue helicopter also landed in the square.
paras.zh: 现场图像显示，警察和救护车覆盖了该地区，一架波兰医疗空中救援直升机也降落在广场上。

paras.en: A tram driver reported at about 3 p.m. local time that his vehicle was shot at by a man in a moving car while passing nearby the main square, the Krakow municipal transport company said. The window to the tram driver's cabin was shattered.
paras.zh: 下午3点左右，一名电车司机报告。克拉科夫市交通公司表示，当地时间当地时间，他的车辆在经过主广场附近时被一辆行驶中的汽车中的一名男子开枪射击。电车司机室的窗户被震碎。

paras.en: An estimated 15 million tourists visit Krakow annually, the majority passing through the Main Market Square.
paras.zh: 据估计，每年有 1500 万游客游览克拉科夫，其中大部分经过主集市广场。

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, in a post on X, said police are investigating the attack. And Polish President Karol Nawrocki said his thoughts were with the victims, the wounded and their families.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在 X 上发帖称，警方正在调查这起袭击事件。波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基表示，他与遇难者、伤者及其家人同在。

paras.en: A member of the Municipal Guard police force runs at the site of the shooting in Krakow on Saturday. (Jakub Porzycki/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，一名市卫队警察在克拉科夫枪击现场奔跑。 （雅库布·波尔兹茨基/路透社）

paras.en: Other details were not immediately available.
paras.zh: 其他细节尚未立即公布。

paras.en: "We are just learning details of the horrific mass shooting in Krakow, a savage and murderous attack that's shattered the peace of Poland," Tom Rose, the U.S. ambassador to Poland, wrote on X.
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯在 X 上写道：“我们刚刚了解到克拉科夫发生的可怕大规模枪击事件的细节，这是一场破坏了波兰和平的野蛮而凶残的袭击。”

paras.en: "America stands with Poland at this dark hour as Poland stands with her beloved citizens of Krakow."
paras.zh: “在这个黑暗的时刻，美国与波兰站在一起，就像波兰与她心爱的克拉科夫公民站在一起一样。”

paras.en: Krakow, the second-largest city in Poland, is about 250 kilometres from the capital, Warsaw.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫是波兰第二大城市，距首都华沙约250公里。

articles.title: After victory in the midterms, what next for US Democrats?

paras.en: A "blue wave" has rolled across the United States. Some are even calling it a "blue tsunami." The Democrats scored a decisive victory in the midterm elections on November 3, wresting the majority from President Donald Trump's Republicans in both the US House of Representatives and the Senate. They also won gubernatorial elections in former Republican strongholds such as Texas.
paras.zh: 一股“蓝色浪潮”席卷美国。有些人甚至称之为“蓝色海啸”。 11月3日，民主党在中期选举中取得决定性胜利，从特朗普领导的共和党手中夺取了美国众议院和参议院的多数席位。他们还赢得了德克萨斯州等前共和党据点的州长选举。

paras.en: Pictures from Tuesday evening show Democrat politicians and supporters across the country celebrating, hugging, even weeping with joy. However, as the White House reminded Americans in a post on X the day after the elections: "Trump is still your president."
paras.zh: 周二晚上的照片显示，全国各地的民主党政客和支持者庆祝、拥抱，甚至高兴地哭泣。然而，正如选举后第二天白宫在X上发帖提醒美国人的那样：“特朗普仍然是你们的总统。”

paras.en: Trump has the power to veto any proposed legislation Congress puts before him, and his veto can only be overruled by a two-thirds majority. Also, in the past he has, on occasion, simply ignored the Congress's decision.
paras.zh: 特朗普有权否决国会向他提出的任何拟议立法，并且他的否决只能以三分之二多数否决。此外，过去他有时干脆无视国会的决定。

paras.en: Patrick Malone, professor at the public administration and policy department at American University in Washington DC, told DW that a presidential veto is not necessarily the end of the matter — even though the Democrats don't have a two-thirds majority in either Congressional chamber.
paras.zh: 华盛顿特区美利坚大学公共管理和政策系教授帕特里克·马龙告诉德国之声，总统否决并不一定意味着事情的结束——尽管民主党在国会两院都没有获得三分之二多数。

paras.en: "There are Republicans, especially on the House side, who are not going to want to tie themselves that closely to Trump anymore," says Malone. "The Republicans that survived had a very strong message sent to them. It would be illogical and foolish for them to point to a neighboring district [that turned blue] and say, 'Well, that can't happen here.'"
paras.zh: 马龙说：“有些共和党人，特别是众议院方面的共和党人，不想再与特朗普如此紧密地联系在一起。” “幸存下来的共和党人向他们传达了一个非常强烈的信息。他们指着邻近的一个地区（变成蓝色）说，‘好吧，这不可能在这里发生’，这是不合逻辑和愚蠢的。”

paras.en: For that reason, Malone predicts that Republicans and Democrats may come together to overrule a Trump veto. "It could happen very easily."
paras.zh: 因此，马龙预测共和党和民主党可能会联合起来推翻特朗普的否决。 “这很容易发生。”

paras.en: A question at the front of many people's minds is: Might the Democrats make another attempt at impeachment? One possible basis for this would be that Trump started the war with Iran without congressional approval. The US Constitution says only Congress has the power to declare war. But as commander-in-chief, the president also has a degree of military authority. How far this extends without Congressional approval is legally disputed.
paras.zh: 许多人脑海中浮现的一个问题是：民主党是否会再次尝试弹劾？一个可能的依据是特朗普未经国会批准就发动了与伊朗的战争。美国宪法规定，只有国会才有权宣战。但作为总司令，总统也拥有一定程度的军事权力。在未经国会批准的情况下，这种情况能延伸到什么程度，在法律上存在争议。

paras.en: From January 2027, Democrats will have the simple majority required to bring charges against him in the House of Representatives. They will not, however, be able to muster the two-thirds majority in the Senate that would be needed for a conviction and Trump's removal from office. Some Democrats say it is nonetheless imperative that the impeachment process be initiated, as a way of keeping the president in check.
paras.zh: 从 2027 年 1 月起，民主党将获得在众议院对他提出指控所需的简单多数票。然而，他们将无法在参议院获得定罪和罢免特朗普所需的三分之二多数。一些民主党人表示，启动弹劾程序仍然势在必行，以此作为控制总统的一种方式。

paras.en: Others remain skeptical. "If we make Donald Trump the center of our focus, we will lose this moment in history," the Democratic senator Cory Booker said. "We need to deal with the American people's problems."
paras.zh: 其他人仍然持怀疑态度。民主党参议员科里·布克表示：“如果我们让唐纳德·特朗普成为我们关注的焦点，我们将失去历史上的这一时刻。” “我们需要解决美国人民的问题。”

paras.en: This does not mean that Democrats won't try to launch investigations into Trump, or into members of his family or government. Quite the reverse. Malone believes the Democrats in Congress take their control function very seriously and will definitely initiate investigations. These, he says, serve a purpose beyond the documented outcome: "Another thing about Congressional investigations: They have a much stronger impact on public opinion than on legislation. They catch people's attention."
paras.zh: 这并不意味着民主党不会尝试对特朗普或其家人或政府成员展开调查。恰恰相反。马龙相信国会中的民主党人非常重视他们的控制职能，肯定会发起调查。他说，这些的目的超出了记录在案的结果：“国会调查的另一件事是：它们对公众舆论的影响比对立法的影响要大得多。它们引起了人们的注意。”

paras.en: Will Hegseth be sacked as secretary of defense?
paras.zh: 赫格斯将被解除国防部长职务吗？

paras.en: While Trump will most likely get to keep his job, Pete Hegseth might be about to lose his. Observers assume the Democrats will demand a different secretary of defense. "There's a lot of speculation about what's going to happen to Pete Hegseth," says Brandon Conradis, a former DW journalist who is now an editor at Bloomberg Government in Washington DC. Whether Trump will actually fire Hegseth is a decision for the president. All the Democrats can do is exert political pressure.
paras.zh: 虽然特朗普很可能保住他的工作，但皮特·赫格斯可能即将失去他的工作。观察家认为民主党将要求更换国防部长。前德国之声记者、现任华盛顿特区彭博政府编辑的布兰登·康拉迪斯 (Brandon Conradis) 表示：“对于皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 的命运有很多猜测。”特朗普是否真的解雇赫格塞斯是总统的决定。民主党能做的就是施加政治压力。

paras.en: From January onward, the Democrats will have a majority in Congress, which is where decisions are made on how government funds are spent. Conradis says one possibility for the Democrats to get their way would be to link the financing of Trump's pet projects to specific conditions. "One thing Democrats might do is say, 'Look, if you want more funding for these conflicts, Pete Hegseth needs to go.'"
paras.zh: 从一月份开始，民主党将在国会占据多数席位，国会负责决定政府资金的使用方式。康拉迪斯表示，民主党如愿以偿的一种可能性是将特朗普喜欢的项目的融资与具体条件挂钩。 “民主党人可能会说，‘听着，如果你想为这些冲突提供更多资金，皮特·赫格斯需要下台。’”

paras.en: As secretary of defense, Hegseth is being held at least partially responsible for the US's relative lack of success in the war with Iran. This could also be a reason for Trump to fire him.
paras.zh: 作为国防部长，赫格塞斯对美国在与伊朗的战争中相对缺乏成功至少负有部分责任。这也可能是特朗普解雇他的一个原因。

paras.en: After their success in the midterms, the Democrats have been enjoying a brief moment of unity. But Malone says it won't last. "The Democratic Party was unified for maybe 24, 36 hours. Now they're not really going to unify for a bit."
paras.zh: 在中期选举中取得成功后，民主党享受了短暂的团结时刻。但马龙表示这种情况不会持续太久。 “民主党可能团结了 24、36 小时。现在他们不会真正团结了。”

paras.en: Unlike Germany, the US does not have governing coalitions at the federal level. There are, however, various political groupings within the Democratic Party itself. On the left wing of the political spectrum there are the progressive Democrats, including, among others, the prominent young representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. "[Progressives] have very aggressive policy ideas, whether it be environment or social programs," comments Malone.
paras.zh: 与德国不同，美国没有联邦层面的执政联盟。然而，民主党内部也存在各种政治派别。政治光谱的左翼是进步的民主党人，其中包括著名的年轻代表亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯。 “[进步派]拥有非常积极的政策理念，无论是环境还是社会计划，”马龙评论道。

paras.en: In the middle are the mainstream liberal Democrats, who see themselves as politically pragmatic and good at compromising. But there are also moderates. "This is an important group on the Democratic side," Malone says. "There were a lot of Democrats [in the midterms] who won elections in former red districts or really, really conservative blue districts. They won't be able to go back to their districts and say, 'Look, AOC wants this.'"
paras.zh: 中间是主流自由民主党，他们认为自己在政治上务实且善于妥协。但也有温和派。 “这是民主党方面的一个重要团体，”马龙说。 “（在中期选举中）有很多民主党人在前红区或非常非常保守的蓝区赢得了选举。他们将无法回到自己的选区并说，‘看，AOC 想要这个。’”

paras.en: It will be no easy task for Democrats in Congress to agree on one clear direction. But many believe that it's vital that they do. "They're going to have to figure out a positive governing agenda that they can all agree on," says Malone. Just opposing Trump won't be enough for the Democrats to sustain their current success, the pundit argues.
paras.zh: 对于国会中的民主党人来说，要就一个明确的方向达成一致绝非易事。但许多人认为这样做至关重要。马龙说：“他们必须找出一个他们都能同意的积极的治理议程。”这位专家认为，仅仅反对特朗普不足以让民主党维持目前的成功。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Son of Iran's shah receives 'Freedom Prize' in Frankfurt

paras.en: Iranian opposition leader Reza Pahlavi on Saturday received a "Freedom Prize" in Frankfurt in the central German state of Hesse.
paras.zh: 伊朗反对派领导人礼萨·巴列维周六在德国中部黑森州的法兰克福接受了“自由奖”。

paras.en: Some 18,000 people rallied to show support for Reza Pahlavi, according to a police statement.
paras.zh: 根据警方声明，约有 18,000 人集会表示对礼萨·巴列维的支持。

paras.en: The event was held at St Paul's Church. The building hosted the Germany's first-ever elected parliament in 1848-1849, known as the Frankfurt Assembly.
paras.zh: 该活动在圣保罗教堂举行。 1848 年至 1849 年间，德国历史上第一届民选议会在此召开，即法兰克福议会。

paras.en: Pahlavi is the son of the last shah of Iran, Mohammed Reza Pahlavi, an autocrat who fled into exile after being deposed in a 1979 revolution.
paras.zh: 巴列维是伊朗最后一位国王穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维的儿子，穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维是一位独裁者，在 1979 年的革命中被废黜后逃亡流亡。

paras.en: The 1979 revolution was followed by the transformation of Iran into an Islamic republic and the consolidation of power around the Shiite Muslim clergy.
paras.zh: 1979 年革命之后，伊朗转变为伊斯兰共和国，什叶派穆斯林神职人员的权力得到巩固。

paras.en: Pahlavi was handed the prize by the Friedrich Naumann Foundation, which is tied to the pro-business Free Democratic Party (FDP).
paras.zh: 巴列维的奖项由弗里德里希·瑙曼基金会颁发，该基金会与亲商业的自由民主党（FDP）有联系。

paras.en: What did Reza Pahlavi say about the prize?
paras.zh: 礼萨·巴列维对这个奖项有何评价？

paras.en: Pahlavi said that Iran "is a country not waiting to be taught democracy, this is a country being prevented from practicing it."
paras.zh: 巴列维说，伊朗“是一个不等待被教导民主的国家，这是一个被阻止实践民主的国家”。

paras.en: "A people ready to die for the right to vote is willing to exercise the right to vote," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“愿意为投票权而死的人民愿意行使投票权。”

paras.en: Rights groups say thousands were killed in a government crackdown on protests in January.
paras.zh: 人权组织称，政府在一月份镇压抗议活动时造成数千人死亡。

paras.en: "You could not have chosen a people who better understand the meaning of the word 'freedom,'" he said.
paras.zh: “你不可能选择一个更了解‘自由’这个词含义的人民，”他说。

paras.en: He also stressed that he was receiving the prize only as a "trustee" until a democratically-elected government comes to power in Iran.
paras.zh: 他还强调，在伊朗民选政府上台之前，他只是作为“受托人”获得该奖项。

paras.en: "I hold it only temporarily," he said. "One day I will place it in the hands of its rightful owners, not on foreign soil but in the capital, Tehran."
paras.zh: “我只是暂时持有它，”他说。 “有一天，我会将它交到其合法所有者手中，不是在外国土地上，而是在首都德黑兰。”

paras.en: The speech was accompanied by chants of "Long live the shah, long live Iran!" from the crowd.
paras.zh: 演讲中伴随着“国王万岁，伊朗万岁！”的口号。从人群中。

paras.en: Pahlavi has in the past offered to lead a transitional government in the event of a democratic transition in the West Asian country and has said he does not aim to use this proposed position to reinstate the Iranian monarchy under his father's dynasty, instead planning to leave the decision to a later referendum.
paras.zh: 巴列维过去曾提出在这个西亚国家进行民主过渡时领导一个过渡政府，并表示他无意利用这一提议的职位来恢复其父亲王朝统治下的伊朗君主制，而是计划将这一决定留待稍后的全民公决。

paras.en: Iranians criticize Freedom Prize for Pahlavi prince
paras.zh: 伊朗人批评巴列维王子获得自由奖

paras.en: While Pahlavi has emerged as a figurehead for factions within the anti-government protest movement, others have criticized him for his vocal support for Israel and have accused him of failing to distance himself from his father's autocratic rule.
paras.zh: 尽管巴列维已成为反政府抗议运动中各派系的傀儡，但其他人批评他公开支持以色列，并指责他未能与父亲的独裁统治保持距离。

paras.en: Around 200 prisoners held in Iran signed a letter protesting Pahlavi's receipt of the prize, Sahar Sanaie, spokeswoman for the Society for German-Iranians in Hesse, was cited by the AFP news agency as saying.
paras.zh: 法新社援引黑森州德伊朗人协会发言人萨哈尔·萨奈的话说，大约 200 名被关押在伊朗的囚犯签署了一封信，抗议巴列维获奖。

paras.en: The letter described him as the symbol of a "bygone dictatorship."
paras.zh: 这封信将他描述为“过去的独裁统治”的象征。

paras.en: The Frankfurt branches of the center-left Social Democrats (SPD) and the environmentalist Greens boycotted the event and said he could not be considered a legitimate representative of the Iranian people.
paras.zh: 中左翼社会民主党（SPD）法兰克福分部和环保主义者绿党抵制了这次活动，并表示他不能被视为伊朗人民的合法代表。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the socialist Left Party argued that the church could not by used as a venue for the event due to Frankfurt city statutes that prevent the use of places of worship for political gatherings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，社会主义左翼党辩称，由于法兰克福市法规禁止使用礼拜场所进行政治集会，因此该教堂不能用作该活动的场所。

articles.title: Journalism and AI: Who owns the news?

paras.en: Millions of people now use AI chatbots as a source of news to find quick answers to questions about current events.
paras.zh: 现在，数百万人使用人工智能聊天机器人作为新闻来源，以快速找到有关时事问题的答案。

paras.en: A 2026 survey by the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, which questioned more than 90,000 people worldwide, found that 10% use AI chatbots for news on a weekly basis, a figure that is significantly higher among younger audiences.
paras.zh: 路透社新闻研究所在 2026 年对全球 90,000 多人进行了一项调查，发现有 10% 的人每周使用人工智能聊天机器人来获取新闻，这一数字在年轻受众中明显更高。

paras.en: Explaining what is happening in the world, why it matters, and what it means has traditionally been the work of journalism. Media organizations send reporters into the field, commission investigations and conduct research, producing stories that help audiences understand global events. But as more people turn to AI tools for information, the relationship between those producing journalism and those distributing it is changing.
paras.zh: 解释世界上正在发生的事情、为什么它很重要以及它意味着什么，传统上是新闻业的工作。媒体组织派遣记者前往实地，委托调查和研究，制作故事以帮助受众了解全球事件。但随着越来越多的人转向人工智能工具获取信息，新闻制作者与新闻传播者之间的关系正在发生变化。

paras.en: "In the past, search engines like Google indexed our websites and directed users to their articles, generating traffic in return," Julia Becker, publisher of Funke Media Group, told a panel at the Global Media Forum (GMF) in Berlin. "But now that exchange has broken down."
paras.zh: “过去，像谷歌这样的搜索引擎会对我们的网站建立索引，并将用户引导至他们的文章，从而产生流量作为回报，”Funke Media Group 的出版商 Julia Becker 在柏林全球媒体论坛 (GMF) 的一个小组上表示。 “但现在这种交流已经破裂了。”

paras.en: "AI companies draw on our quality reporting to generate answers, yet the reporting itself often remains largely invisible by the end of this process," said DW Director General Barbara Massing in a keynote address at the forum.
paras.zh: 德国之声总干事芭芭拉·马辛 (Barbara Massing) 在论坛的主题演讲中表示：“人工智能公司利用我们的高质量报告来生成答案，但在这一过程结束时，报告本身通常在很大程度上仍然不可见。”

paras.en: Their remarks reflect a worry that is growing across the media industry. Publicly available news is copied and summarized by AI chatbots, while news organizations are becoming less and less able to rely on the money and visibility that used to come from distributing that work.
paras.zh: 他们的言论反映了整个媒体行业日益增长的担忧。公开的新闻由人工智能聊天机器人复制和总结，而新闻机构越来越不能依赖过去通过分发这些作品获得的金钱和知名度。

paras.en: There has been growing concern about how copyrighted material is collected, used, and reproduced by artificial intelligence, and whether the companies that build those systems should pay the people and organizations that created the material.
paras.zh: 人们越来越担心人工智能如何收集、使用和复制受版权保护的材料，以及构建这些系统的公司是否应该向创建这些材料的人员和组织付费。

paras.en: Media houses are now pressing "Big Tech" companies to ask permission before using their work and to pay for it.
paras.zh: 媒体公司现在正在敦促“大型科技”公司在使用其作品之前征求许可并付费。

paras.en: In October, German broadcasters ARD and RTL, along with the country's Federal Association of Digital Publishers and Newspaper Publishers (BDZV) and the Association of Private Media (VAUNET), called for stronger copyright protections for media companies.
paras.zh: 10 月，德国广播公司 ARD 和 RTL 以及德国联邦数字出版商和报纸出版商协会 (BDZV) 以及私人媒体协会 (VAUNET) 呼吁加强对媒体公司的版权保护。

paras.en: In the US, lawsuits are adding pressure. The New York Times has sued internet company Brave Softwar for allegedly using its content without permission and getting around its paywall.
paras.zh: 在美国，诉讼正在增加压力。 《纽约时报》起诉互联网公司 Brave Softwar，指控其未经许可使用其内容并绕过其付费墙。

paras.en: Meanwhile, legal institutions in the EU, including the European Court of Justice (ECJ) are examining whether AI-generated answers can themselves infringe copyright.
paras.zh: 与此同时，包括欧洲法院 (ECJ) 在内的欧盟法律机构正在审查人工智能生成的答案本身是否会侵犯版权。

paras.en: In February, a coalition of media organizations, including the Guardian, the BBC, and the Financial Times, called for rules that would give publishers more control over how AI systems copy and reproduce their content.
paras.zh: 今年二月，包括《卫报》、《BBC》和《金融时报》在内的媒体组织联盟呼吁制定规则，让出版商更好地控制人工智能系统如何复制和复制其内容。

paras.en: The problem goes beyond whether AI companies may use journalism. It also concerns how publishers and journalists can get paid when their work becomes part of the answers AI systems generate.
paras.zh: 问题不仅仅在于人工智能公司是否可以使用新闻业。它还涉及当出版商和记者的工作成为人工智能系统生成的答案的一部分时如何获得报酬。

paras.en: "AI systems shouldn't just use quality journalism. They should also pay for it," Massing said.
paras.zh: “人工智能系统不应该只使用高质量的新闻报道。他们还应该为此付费，”马辛说。

paras.en: How could AI companies pay for the content they use?
paras.zh: 人工智能公司如何为他们使用的内容付费？

paras.en: Professor Martin Senftleben, who directs the Institute for Information Law at the University of Amsterdam, separates two ways AI companies use journalistic material: Training their models and generating responses to individual user questions.
paras.zh: 阿姆斯特丹大学信息法研究所所长 Martin Senftleben 教授将人工智能公司使用新闻材料的方式分为两种：训练模型和生成对个人用户问题的回答。

paras.en: Payment for training is a more complicated legal question, he said. The more urgent issue is what happens when an AI system uses journalism to answer a question in real time.
paras.zh: 他说，培训费用是一个更复杂的法律问题。更紧迫的问题是，当人工智能系统使用新闻来实时回答问题时会发生什么。

paras.en: He argued that European copyright law may already offer a way to address part of the problem. Under existing EU law, publishers and journalists may be able to claim payment collectively, without waiting for a new legal framework.
paras.zh: 他认为欧洲版权法可能已经提供了解决部分问题的方法。根据现行欧盟法律，出版商和记者可以集体索要付款，而无需等待新的法律框架。

paras.en: "What are we waiting for? Germany is a large member state. This should be introduced in Germany," he told the forum.
paras.zh: “我们还在等什么？德国是一个大成员国。这应该在德国引入，”他在论坛上说。

paras.en: One option, Senftleben suggested, is a legally required payment system in which every AI response that draws on journalism triggers a payment. A collecting organization would gather the money and distribute it among publishers and journalists, in the same way that music royalties are collected and distributed.
paras.zh: Senftleben 建议，一种选择是建立一个法律要求的支付系统，在该系统中，每一个利用新闻的人工智能响应都会触发支付。收集组织将收集资金并将其分配给出版商和记者，就像收集和分配音乐版税一样。

paras.en: Once such a system exists, publishers and authors could use its rates as a starting point when negotiating individual licensing deals with AI companies.
paras.zh: 一旦这样的系统存在，出版商和作者就可以将其费率作为与人工智能公司谈判个人许可协议的起点。

paras.en: Existing deals and concerns about too much regulation
paras.zh: 现有交易和对监管过多的担忧

paras.en: Lutz Mache, senior manager of government affairs and public policy at Google, told the GMF panel that Google is willing to negotiate agreements with German media companies and to discuss new AI products with them.
paras.zh: 谷歌政府事务和公共政策高级经理卢茨·马什(Lutz Mache)向GMF小组表示，谷歌愿意与德国媒体公司谈判协议，并与他们讨论新的人工智能产品。

paras.en: Google has also started testing other ways to pay publishers for their contributions to AI-generated answers. Its "AI Contribution" pilot, which is being tested with selected publishers, aims to reward content that plays a significant role in answers produced by products such as Gemini and AI Overviews. But the program is still an early experiment, not a general payment system open to all publishers.
paras.zh: 谷歌还开始测试其他方式向出版商支付对人工智能生成答案的贡献。其“AI Contribution”试点项目正在与选定的出版商进行测试，旨在奖励在 Gemini 和 AI Overviews 等产品生成的答案中发挥重要作用的内容。但该计划仍处于早期实验阶段，并不是向所有出版商开放的通用支付系统。

paras.en: Microsoft, Anthropic, and OpenAI have recently said they support clearer, standardized signals that let website owners state whether their content may be used to train AI models.
paras.zh: 微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 最近表示，他们支持更清晰、标准化的信号，让网站所有者声明他们的内容是否可用于训练人工智能模型。

paras.en: However, not everyone thinks more regulation is the answer.
paras.zh: 然而，并非所有人都认为加强监管就是答案。

paras.en: Jörg Heidrich, a lawyer who specializes in technology law and serves as AI commissioner at the German media company Heise, warned against adding new rules without considering their effects on the wider tech sector.
paras.zh: Jörg Heidrich 是一位专门从事技术法的律师，担任德国媒体公司 Heise 的人工智能专员，他警告不要在不考虑新规则对更广泛的科技行业的影响的情况下添加新规则。

paras.en: Europe has already fallen behind in the global AI race, he argued. More regulation, he warned, could make it harder for European companies to compete with major providers based elsewhere.
paras.zh: 他认为，欧洲已经在全球人工智能竞赛中落后了。他警告说，更多的监管可能会让欧洲公司更难与其他地方的主要供应商竞争。

paras.en: Heidrich also pointed to smaller players, including startups, independent developers, and research institutions. They depend on access to data to build and train AI systems. He argued that the debate over copyright and payment risks overlooking these groups, and that new restrictions could hurt their work.
paras.zh: 海德里希还指出了规模较小的参与者，包括初创公司、独立开发商和研究机构。他们依赖于数据访问来构建和训练人工智能系统。他认为，关于版权和付款的争论有可能忽视这些群体，而新的限制可能会损害他们的工作。

articles.title: At least five people killed in shooting in Poland’s Krakow

paras.en: Five people have been killed and others wounded in a shooting near the main market square of Krakow in southern Poland.
paras.zh: 波兰南部克拉科夫主要集市广场附近发生枪击事件，造成五人死亡、多人受伤。

paras.en: At around 3pm (14:00GMT) on Saturday, a man who had driven onto the city’s Main Market Square “began firing at random people from his car”, police said on X.
paras.zh: 警方于 X 日称，周六下午 3 点左右（格林威治标准时间 14:00），一名男子驾车驶入该市的主要集市广场，“开始从车内随机向人群开枪”。

paras.en: “As a result of the incident, five people were killed and around a dozen others were wounded,” a police spokesman told the AFP news agency.
paras.zh: 警方发言人告诉法新社：“这起事件导致五人死亡，十几人受伤。”

paras.en: The gunman was shot by officers and detained, police said. He was transported to hospital after sustaining injuries.
paras.zh: 警方称，枪手被警察开枪射击并拘留。他受伤后被送往医院。

paras.en: Police officers were also among the wounded.
paras.zh: 受伤者中也有警察。

paras.en: “According to information from police officers, the man was wearing military-style attire,” a police spokesperson told reporters.
paras.zh: 警方发言人告诉记者：“根据警方提供的信息，该男子穿着军装。”

paras.en: “During the arrest, officers used their weapons, but the man returned fire; as a result, two police officers are among the injured,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“在逮捕过程中，警察使用了武器，但该男子还击了；结果，两名警察受伤。”

paras.en: A “tragic shooting” took place on Saturday, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said in a post on X.
