paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在 X 上发帖称，周六发生了“悲剧性枪击事件”。

paras.en: “I am being kept informed by the Minister of the Interior about the situation in Krakow,” he wrote, adding that “the police are investigating the background and all the circumstances of the attack”.
paras.zh: “内政部长不断向我通报克拉科夫的局势，”他写道，并补充说“警方正在调查袭击的背景和所有情况”。

paras.en: President Karol Nawrocki said his thoughts were with the victims, those affected, and their families.
paras.zh: 总统卡罗尔·纳罗基表示，他的心与受害者、受影响的人和他们的家人同在。

paras.en: Tom Rose, the US ambassador to Poland, wrote on X: “We are just learning details of the horrific mass shooting in Krakow, a savage and murderous attack that’s shattered the peace of Poland.”
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯在X上写道：“我们刚刚了解到克拉科夫发生的可怕大规模枪击事件的细节，这是一场破坏了波兰和平的野蛮而凶残的袭击。”

paras.en: He said “America stands with Poland at this dark hour” as Poland stands with the citizens of Krakow.
paras.zh: 他说，“在这个黑暗的时刻，美国与波兰站在一起”，就像波兰与克拉科夫公民站在一起一样。

paras.en: Krakow is the second-largest city in Poland and about 250 kilometres (155 miles) south of the capital, Warsaw.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫是波兰第二大城市，位于首都华沙以南约 250 公里（155 英里）处。

articles.title: Iran’s IRGC says building underground sites for weapons production, storage

paras.en: Iran is building underground military complexes able to sustain weapons production and storage even under heavy bombardment, according to the country’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC).
paras.zh: 据伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）称，伊朗正在建造地下军事设施，即使在猛烈轰炸下也能维持武器生产和储存。

paras.en: IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi made a series of announcements on Saturday about the military’s capabilities during a news conference in Tehran, Iranian media reported.
paras.zh: 据伊朗媒体报道，伊斯兰革命卫队发言人侯赛因·莫赫比周六在德黑兰举行的新闻发布会上宣布了一系列有关军队能力的公告。

paras.en: Among the achievements listed were an “underground missile city” set to be unveiled, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据半官方的塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，列出的成就之一是即将揭幕的“地下导弹城”。

paras.en: Mohebbi said the IRGC had rapidly transferred its missile and drone production lines from the surface to underground facilities. This allows Iran to continue producing missiles while its adversaries assumed its stockpiles were dwindling, he explained.
paras.zh: 莫赫比表示，伊斯兰革命卫队已迅速将其导弹和无人机生产线从地面转移到地下设施。他解释说，这使得伊朗能够继续生产导弹，而其对手则认为其库存正在减少。

paras.en: The spokesperson also outlined advances in stealth technology. He maintained that such improvements had allowed Iran’s missiles and drones to pierce air defence systems and accurately strike targets during previous rounds of fighting with the United States and Israel.
paras.zh: 这位发言人还概述了隐形技术的进步。他坚称，这些改进使得伊朗的导弹和无人机能够在前几轮与美国和以色列的战斗中突破防空系统并准确打击目标。

paras.en: “Today, every weapon used by the IRGC Aerospace Force is manufactured using homegrown knowledge and expertise. Moreover, our products are not even derived from reverse-engineering captured enemy war material,” Iran’s IRNA news agency quoted Mohebbi as saying.
paras.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队通讯社援引莫赫比的话说：“如今，伊斯兰革命卫队航空航天部队使用的每件武器都是利用本土知识和专业知识制造的。此外，我们的产品甚至不是来自对捕获的敌方战争材料进行逆向工程。”

paras.en: A recent report by US newspaper, The Wall Street Journal, shows that Iran caused billions of dollars in damage to US bases throughout the Middle East during previous rounds of fighting.
paras.zh: 美国《华尔街日报》近日报道称，伊朗在前几轮战斗中给美国在中东各地的基地造成了数十亿美元的损失。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a separate report by the Reuters news agency found that Iran had successfully targeted Gulf infrastructure on at least 135 occasions during the same period, causing billions of dollars in damage and lost revenues.
paras.zh: 与此同时，路透社的另一篇报道发现，伊朗在同一时期至少135次成功瞄准海湾基础设施，造成数十亿美元的损失和收入损失。

paras.en: Mohebbi also warned on Saturday that restrictions on the range of Iranian missiles had been lifted. The warning follows a statement from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, who said that there would be “no geographical limits” to Iran’s response if it were attacked again by the US and Israel.
paras.zh: 莫赫比周六还警告称，对伊朗导弹射程的限制已经取消。在此警告之前，最高领袖哈梅内伊发表声明称，如果伊朗再次受到美国和以色列的袭击，伊朗的反应将“不受地域限制”。

paras.en: The US-Israeli war on Iran was launched on February 28, prompting Tehran to close the Strait of Hormuz and triggering a global energy crisis. Mediation efforts have stepped up recently, as regional countries hope to bring the war to an end.
paras.zh: 2月28日美以对伊朗发动战争，促使德黑兰关闭霍尔木兹海峡，引发全球能源危机。近来，地区国家希望结束战争，斡旋努力不断加强。

paras.en: On Friday, President Donald Trump said the US military launched limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island, while also claiming Washington had made “a lot of progress” in talks with Iran.
paras.zh: 周五，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，美军对伊朗格什姆岛发动了有限的袭击，同时还声称华盛顿在与伊朗的谈判中取得了“很大进展”。

paras.en: Tehran has repeatedly warned that it will target Gulf energy infrastructure if the fighting resumes. Such attacks would likely push energy prices even higher.
paras.zh: 德黑兰多次警告称，如果战斗重新爆发，它将针对海湾能源基础设施。此类攻击可能会推高能源价格。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Washington has also imposed additional sanctions on Iran as it seeks to force Tehran to concede to its demands. The restrictions have further strained the country’s economy, forcing Iran to adopt new trade routes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，华盛顿还对伊朗实施了额外制裁，试图迫使德黑兰屈服于其要求。这些限制进一步加剧了该国经济的压力，迫使伊朗采用新的贸易路线。

paras.en: On Saturday, US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced it was establishing a new task force that will support ongoing US efforts to prevent Iran from using land routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials.
paras.zh: 周六，美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）宣布正在成立一个新的特别工作组，该工作组将支持美国正在进行的阻止伊朗利用陆路运输先进武器和其他材料的努力。

paras.en: The US has also imposed a naval blockade on Iran to prevent it from exporting oil.
paras.zh: 美国还对伊朗实施海上封锁，阻止其出口石油。

articles.title: Guatemalan lawmaker and three police officers killed in armed attack

paras.en: A Guatemalan lawmaker and three police officers have been killed in an armed attack, according to the country’s authorities.
paras.zh: 据危地马拉当局称，一名议员和三名警察在一次武装袭击中丧生。

paras.en: The attack on Friday targeted Congressman Julio Portillo, who was in the town of Rio Hondo, in the eastern Zacapa department, which is known for drug trafficking activity.
paras.zh: 周五的袭击针对的是国会议员胡利奥·波蒂略（Julio Portillo），他当时住在萨卡帕省东部的里奥翁多镇，该镇以贩毒活动而闻名。

paras.en: Portillo was initially taken to a hospital with serious injuries. His death was later confirmed by the National Unity of Hope party, or UNE, to which he belonged.
paras.zh: 波蒂略最初因重伤被送往医院。他所属的民族希望团结党（UNE）后来证实了他的死讯。

paras.en: “President Luis Contreras, members of the Board of Directors and lawmakers mourn the tragic passing of Congressman Julio Cesar Portillo Paz, representative of the Zacapa district,” Guatemala’s Congress posted late Friday on X.
paras.zh: 危地马拉国会周五晚间在 X 上发布消息称：“总统路易斯·孔特雷拉斯、董事会成员和立法者对萨卡帕区代表、众议员朱利奥·塞萨尔·波蒂略·帕斯的不幸去世表示哀悼。”

paras.en: President Bernardo Arevalo said the three National Civil Police officers killed in the attack had died in the line of duty and instructed security forces to cooperate with prosecutors investigating the killings.
paras.zh: 总统贝尔纳多·阿雷瓦洛表示，在袭击中丧生的三名国家民警在执行任务时身亡，并指示安全部队与调查杀戮事件的检察官合作。

paras.en: Authorities have not disclosed a motive for the attack or identified who was responsible.
paras.zh: 当局尚未透露袭击动机，也没有确定袭击者是谁。

paras.en: The Lorenzana family cartel, which has links to Mexico’s Sinaloa cartel, controls the drug trade in Zacapa.
paras.zh: 洛伦扎纳家族贩毒集团与墨西哥锡那罗亚贩毒集团有联系，控制着萨卡帕的毒品贸易。

paras.en: Portillo won his seat in 2023 for the opposition party Cabal, but has since switched to the National Unity of Hope party led by former First Lady Sandra Torres.
paras.zh: 波蒂略于 2023 年为反对党 Cabal 赢得席位，但此后转投前第一夫人桑德拉·托雷斯领导的民族希望团结党。

paras.en: She is expected to run for president in Guatemala’s elections next year.
paras.zh: 预计她将在明年的危地马拉选举中竞选总统。

paras.en: The killings come about three weeks after former anticorruption prosecutor Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa was shot dead in Guatemala City, a case that heightened concerns about organised crime’s influence and the possible return of politically motivated assassinations.
paras.zh: 此次杀戮发生在前反腐败检察官胡安·弗朗西斯科·索洛扎诺·福帕在危地马拉城被枪杀大约三周后，该案加剧了人们对有组织犯罪影响力以及出于政治动机的暗杀可能卷土重来的担忧。

paras.en: Authorities have not established a connection between the two attacks.
paras.zh: 当局尚未确定两次袭击之间的联系。

articles.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
paras.zh: 癌症手术后，教皇利奥开始拉丁美洲之行

paras.en: ROME — Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, the region's least Catholic and most secular country, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.
paras.zh: 罗马——教皇利奥十四世即将开始拉丁美洲三国之行，他将访问乌拉圭，该地区天主教程度最低、最世俗化的国家。三周前，他接受了肺癌手术，这让整个旅行受到了质疑。

paras.en: Leo is due to arrive in Montevideo after a 13-and-a-half hour flight from Rome. He has a packed three-day itinerary in Uruguay including a visit to a neighborhood plagued by gang violence, a Mass in Paysandú, some 375 kilometers (230 miles) from the capital, and another Mass in the city of Florida, about 100 kilometers (60 miles) away.
paras.zh: Leo 将从罗马搭乘 13 个半小时的航班抵达蒙得维的亚。他在乌拉圭的三天行程安排得很满，包括参观一个受帮派暴力困扰的社区，在距首都约 375 公里（230 英里）的派桑杜举行弥撒，并在距首都约 100 公里（60 英里）的佛罗里达市举行另一场弥撒。

paras.en: The Uruguay leg is the first stop on what will be the longest and farthest trip of his pontificate, all being undertaken as the 71-year-old pope continues his recovery. The trip will also bring him to neighboring Argentina and finally back home to Peru, where Leo served as a missionary priest and bishop for two decades.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭之行是他任期内最长、最远的旅行的第一站，所有这一切都是在这位71岁的教皇继续康复期间进行的。这次旅行还将带他前往邻国阿根廷，最后回到家乡秘鲁，利奥在那里担任传教牧师和主教二十年。

paras.en: "His stamina is fantastic. The way that he's singing is incredible. And you can only sing if your lungs are really strong," said Maria Montserrat Alvar, the Vatican's new communications chief. She noted that Leo has passed the 14-day convalescence period required by doctors after his Oct. 13 surgery and is eager to get on the road.
paras.zh: “他的耐力太棒了。他唱歌的方式令人难以置信。只有你的肺真的很强壮，你才能唱歌，”梵蒂冈新任通讯主任玛丽亚·蒙特塞拉特·阿尔瓦说。她指出，Leo 在 10 月 13 日接受手术后，已经过了医生要求的 14 天恢复期，渴望上路。

paras.en: "His doctors are very confident and he'll have plenty of medical care on board should something happen, but we don't see that in his prognosis or even in the way that he's acting," she said.
paras.zh: “他的医生非常有信心，如果发生什么事情，他将在船上得到充足的医疗护理，但我们在他的预后甚至他的行为方式中都看不到这一点，”她说。

paras.en: In Uruguay, which hasn't had a papal visit since 1988, Leo is expected to try to remind the 3.5 million people of their strong Catholic heritage stemming from the times of Spanish colonial rule. He is likely to propose the faith anew as an answer to today's challenges and problems.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭自 1988 年以来就没有接受过教皇的访问，预计利奥将试图提醒 350 万人民，他们源自西班牙殖民统治时代的深厚天主教传统。他可能会重新提出这一信仰，作为应对当今挑战和问题的答案。

paras.en: Upon arrival, Leo will meet with President Yamandú Orsi, leader of the center-left alliance that assumed power in Uruguay in March 2025, and then deliver his welcome address to government officials and diplomats. He finishes the long day with a vespers service at the city's cathedral.
paras.zh: 抵达后，利奥将与2025年3月在乌拉圭掌权的中左翼联盟领导人亚曼杜·奥尔西总统会面，然后向政府官员和外交官致欢迎辞。他在城市大教堂举行晚祷仪式，结束了漫长的一天。

paras.en: Leo will find in Uruguay a country unlike any other in Latin America, which is home to around 40% of the world's 1.4 billion Catholics. Uruguay is considered the most secular country in the region, where only a fraction of people who identify as Catholic actually go to Mass regularly.
paras.zh: Leo 会发现乌拉圭是一个与拉丁美洲任何其他国家都不同的国家，全世界 14 亿天主教徒中约 40% 都居住在乌拉圭。乌拉圭被认为是该地区最世俗的国家，只有一小部分自称为天主教徒的人实际上定期参加弥撒。

paras.en: Uruguay was the first country in the world to legalize marijuana for recreational use, the second country in Latin America to decriminalize abortion, and the third country in the Americas to legalize same-sex marriage.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭是世界上第一个将娱乐用大麻合法化的国家，是拉丁美洲第二个将堕胎合法化的国家，也是美洲第三个将同性婚姻合法化的国家。

paras.en: More recently, it became the first country in the region to approve assisted dying legislation over the strong opposition of the Catholic Church, evidence of Uruguay's entrenched, church-state separation that prohibits any mention of God in oaths of office.
paras.zh: 最近，乌拉圭不顾天主教会的强烈反对，成为该地区第一个批准安乐死立法的国家，这证明了乌拉圭根深蒂固的政教分离，禁止在就职宣誓中提及上帝。

paras.en: Leo is expected to recall the church's opposition to abortion and euthanasia as part of his broader argument about upholding human dignity in all phases of life.
paras.zh: 预计利奥将回顾教会对堕胎和安乐死的反对，作为他关于在生命各个阶段维护人类尊严的更广泛论点的一部分。

paras.en: Uruguayan church officials have marveled at the apparent enthusiasm the visit has provoked, with reports that tickets to Leo's prayer vigil at Montevideo's Centenario Stadium were snapped up after two days.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭教会官员对这次访问所引发的明显热情感到惊讶，有报道称，在蒙得维的亚森特纳里欧体育场举行的利奥祈祷守夜活动的门票两天后就被抢购一空。

paras.en: "It seems that the pope's presence is shifting something here and is gradually breaking down this veil that has always sought to obscure and diminish the presence of the Catholic tradition that lies at the country's foundation," said Guzmán Carriquiry, the Uruguayan former head of the Vatican's pontifical commission for Latin America.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭前梵蒂冈宗座拉丁美洲委员会主席古兹曼·卡里基里表示：“看来教皇的出现正在改变这里的某些东西，并逐渐打破这层面纱，这层面纱一直试图掩盖和削弱作为该国基础的天主教传统的存在。”

paras.en: "I believe this pope will stir up questions in the hearts of Uruguayans -- disturbing questions -- questions about meaning and, we hope, questions about faith," he said.
paras.zh: “我相信这位教皇将在乌拉圭人心中激起问题——令人不安的问题——关于意义的问题，我们希望，关于信仰的问题，”他说。

paras.en: Recalling the Catholic origins of independence
paras.zh: 回顾独立的天主教起源

paras.en: Carriquiry said he expects Leo will seek to revive the Catholic roots of Uruguay, especially when he travels to Florida on Sunday to mark an important Catholic feast day.
paras.zh: 卡里奎里表示，他预计利奥将寻求复兴乌拉圭的天主教根源，特别是当他周日前往佛罗里达州纪念重要的天主教节日时。

paras.en: The Nov. 8 feast commemorates the Virgin of the Thirty-three, a small wooden icon of the Virgin Mary that is intricately connected to Uruguay's independence movement. According to tradition, 33 independence patriots acquired the Guaraní statue and had it with them when independence was declared from the Brazilian empire in Florida on Aug. 25, 1825.
paras.zh: 11 月 8 日的盛宴是为了纪念三十三圣母，这是一个圣母玛利亚的小型木制圣像，与乌拉圭的独立运动有着千丝万缕的联系。根据传统，1825 年 8 月 25 日佛罗里达州宣布脱离巴西帝国独立时，33 名独立爱国者获得了瓜拉尼雕像并随身携带。

paras.en: "So the number 33 is an ecclesiastical symbol, a national symbol," said Carriquiry, who was also Uruguay's ambassador to the Holy See. "And so the pope will speak there about the Catholic tradition that lies at the origin of Uruguay—that stems from Uruguay and gave rise to Uruguay—in order to revive and renew the Catholic tradition in the hearts of Uruguayans."
paras.zh: “所以数字33是一个教会的象征，一个国家的象征，”同时担任乌拉圭驻罗马教廷大使的卡里奎里说。 “因此，教宗将在那里谈论乌拉圭起源的天主教传统——源于乌拉圭并产生乌拉圭——以便复兴和更新乌拉圭人心中的天主教传统。”

paras.en: Andrew Chesnut, chair of Catholic studies and an expert in the Latin American church at Virginia Commonwealth University, said he wasn't surprised that Leo's visit had generated enthusiasm and that he will be welcomed warmly.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚联邦大学天主教研究系主任、拉丁美洲教会专家安德鲁·切斯纳特表示，利奥的访问引起了人们的热情，他对此并不感到惊讶，而且他将受到热烈欢迎。

paras.en: "But that's not necessarily going to translate into folks in the pews," he said. "If the overarching goal is trying to revitalize Catholicism in the most Catholic region on Earth, Uruguay is kind of a lost cause, and it has been for decades."
paras.zh: “但这并不一定会影响坐在长椅上的人们，”他说。 “如果首要目标是在地球上天主教徒最多的地区复兴天主教，那么乌拉圭就注定是失败的，而且几十年来一直如此。”

articles.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
paras.zh: 法官叫停特朗普拱门的建设。并且，劳工部将发布就业报告

paras.en: Rising prices and stagnant wages fueled frustration during this week's midterm elections, prompting voters to express their discontent at the ballot box. Similarly, the stock market experienced a downturn yesterday. Concerns about a Democratic Congress regulating AI led to a more than 5% drop in the tech-heavy Nasdaq, wiping out more than $2 trillion in market value. This decline followed from Wednesday when shares rose as investors were relieved that the midterms had made Congress's fate clear. In contrast, there has been less volatility in the job market, and today the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report.
paras.zh: 物价上涨和工资停滞加剧了本周中期选举的挫败感，促使选民通过投票箱表达不满。同样，昨天股市也经历了低迷。对民主党国会监管人工智能的担忧导致以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌超过 5%，市值蒸发超过 2 万亿美元。周三股价上涨，中期选举已经让国会的命运变得清晰，这让投资者松了一口气。相比之下，就业市场的波动较小，今天劳工部将发布最新的就业报告。

paras.en: - 🎧 Today's jobs report is expected to show that employers added about 60,000 jobs last month, NPR's Scott Horsley tells Up First. While this isn't robust growth, it should keep the unemployment rate low. As long as the job market stays stable, the Federal Reserve can focus on fighting stubbornly high inflation, which likely drove the recent election outcomes.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Scott Horsley 告诉 Up First，今天的就业报告预计将显示雇主上个月增加了约 60,000 个就业岗位。虽然这不是强劲的增长，但它应该会保持低失业率。只要就业市场保持稳定，美联储就可以专注于对抗顽固的高通胀，这可能推动了最近的选举结果。

paras.en: A federal judge has temporarily blocked construction of President Trump's 250-foot arch in the capital. District Court Judge Tanya Chutkan issued an order just before midnight Friday, halting work for 14 days at the request of D.C. and Virginia governments. In her 33-page opinion, she scrutinized the administration's justifications for the arch, particularly its focus on national security and agreed that the local governments are likely to be harmed by its construction. The arch is planned for Memorial Circle, a traffic island on the bridge linking the Lincoln Memorial to Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官暂时阻止了特朗普总统在首都建造 250 英尺拱门的工程。应华盛顿特区和弗吉尼亚州政府的要求，地区法院法官 Tanya Chutkan 在周五午夜前发布命令，停工 14 天。在长达 33 页的意见中，她仔细审查了政府修建这座拱门的理由，特别是其对国家安全的关注，并同意地方政府可能会因拱门的建设而受到损害。该拱门计划用于纪念圈，这是连接林肯纪念堂和阿灵顿国家公墓的桥梁上的一个交通岛。

paras.en: - 🎧 The judges' decision followed a contentious meeting last night, during which the National Capital Planning Commission, filled with Trump allies, voted to approve the arch, NPR's Rachel Treisman says. The commission's approval came despite significant opposition to the arch from dozens and dozens of people. After nearly nine hours, the panel gave the go-ahead, which would have allowed excavation to begin. Several Democratic lawmakers are already talking about blocking the arch. Democrat Jared Huffman of California, likely to become head of the House Natural Resources Committee, warned commissioners at yesterday's meeting that anyone advancing projects not authorized by Congress risks legal repercussions.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的雷切尔·特雷斯曼 (Rachel Treisman) 表示，昨晚举行了一场有争议的会议，法官们做出了决定，会议期间，由特朗普盟友组成的国家首都规划委员会投票批准了这座拱门。尽管数十人强烈反对这座拱门，委员会还是批准了。近九个小时后，专家组批准了挖掘工作，开始了挖掘工作。一些民主党议员已经在讨论封锁拱门的问题。可能成为众议院自然资源委员会主席的加利福尼亚州民主党人贾里德·霍夫曼在昨天的会议上警告委员们，任何推进未经国会授权的项目的人都可能面临法律后果。

paras.en: School enrollment is set to plunge by another 2 million kids by 2030, and education experts say the crisis will be worsened by the deportation of immigrant families with school-age children. Even before the Trump administration's policy changes, public schools faced a significant decline due to shrinking family sizes. U.S. Census data show the number of children under 18 nationwide had fallen by about 2.1 million since 2010. The Trump administration's large-scale deportations began after public schools started facing a demographic crisis, with a Migration Policy Institute study indicating that 1.9 million people left the U.S. during Trump's second term. This situation marks the first time in nearly a century that birth rates and immigration levels are both low at the same time.
paras.zh: 到 2030 年，入学人数预计将再减少 200 万，教育专家表示，有学龄儿童的移民家庭被驱逐出境将使危机进一步恶化。甚至在特朗普政府改变政策之前，公立学校就因家庭规模缩小而面临大幅下降。美国人口普查数据显示，自 2010 年以来，全国 18 岁以下儿童数量减少了约 210 万。在公立学校开始面临人口危机后，特朗普政府开始大规模驱逐出境，移民政策研究所的一项研究表明，在特朗普第二任期内，有 190 万人离开美国。这种情况标志着近一个世纪以来首次出现出生率和移民水平同时较低的情况。

paras.en: Harmeet Dhillon has left her position as head of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division after 18 tumultuous months. During her time in the role, she transformed the unit, saw a significant loss of career staff and aggressively pursued Trump's agenda. She is the first senior official to depart since Democrats gained control of Congress in the midterms. Dhillon called the role "the honor of a lifetime."
paras.zh: 在经历了 18 个月的动荡之后，哈米特·迪伦 (Harmeet Dhillon) 辞去了司法部民权司司长的职务。在任职期间，她对部门进行了改造，看到职业员工大量流失，并积极推行特朗普的议程。她是自民主党在中期选举中控制国会以来第一位离职的高级官员。迪伦称这个角色是“一生的荣幸”。

paras.en: Healthy or Hype? is an NPR series helping readers and listeners sort truth from fiction when it comes to online health claims.
paras.zh: 健康还是炒作？是 NPR 的一个系列节目，帮助读者和听众在网上健康声明方面辨别真假。

paras.en: Many people are replacing their fluoride dental products with those containing hydroxyapatite. It is a mineral that boasts cavity protection, whitening and enamel strengthening — all without fluoride. While health experts widely agree that fluoride is beneficial to health, interest in fluoride-free alternatives is growing. A driving force behind the trend is Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. blaming water fluoridation for health issues like arthritis, bone fractures, bone cancer and neurodevelopmental disorders. Here's what dentists say about it.
paras.zh: 许多人正在用含有羟基磷灰石的产品取代含氟牙科产品。它是一种具有蛀牙保护、美白和强化牙釉质功效的矿物质，而且不含氟化物。虽然健康专家普遍认为氟化物有益于健康，但人们对无氟化物替代品的兴趣正在与日俱增。这一趋势背后的推动力是卫生部长小罗伯特·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)，他将关节炎、骨折、骨癌和神经发育障碍等健康问题归咎于水氟化。以下是牙医对此的评价。

paras.en: - 🪥 Fluoride has been extensively researched, especially in long-term studies, but early research on hydroxyapatite shows promising results.
paras.zh: - 🪥 氟化物已被广泛研究，特别是在长期研究中，但对羟基磷灰石的早期研究显示出有希望的结果。

paras.en: - 🪥 For patients considering both options, Bennett Amaechi, a professor of dentistry at the University of Texas at San Antonio, recommends using fluoride because there is more evidence supporting its effectiveness.
paras.zh: - 🪥 对于考虑这两种选择的患者，德克萨斯大学圣安东尼奥分校的牙科教授 Bennett Amaechi 建议使用氟化物，因为有更多证据支持其有效性。

paras.en: - 🪥 Amaechi was an author of a 2021 study in Scientific Reports that followed 177 children for a year and compared hydroxyapatite and fluoride toothpaste. The findings showed similar outcomes of tooth decay in both groups.
paras.zh: - 🪥 Amaechi 是《科学报告》2021 年一项研究的作者，该研究跟踪了 177 名儿童一年，并对羟基磷灰石和氟化物牙膏进行了比较。研究结果显示，两组的蛀牙结果相似。

paras.en: - 🪥 The American Dental Association told NPR that it acknowledges that more people are using hydroxyapatite products, which may aid in remineralization. However, they noted that research on its clinical effectiveness is still limited and unclear.
paras.zh: - 🪥 美国牙科协会告诉 NPR，它承认越来越多的人正在使用羟基磷灰石产品，这可能有助于再矿化。然而，他们指出，对其临床有效性的研究仍然有限且不清楚。

paras.en: - 🪥 The ADA recommends brushing teeth twice daily for two minutes with fluoride toothpaste, flossing every day and visiting a dentist regularly.
paras.zh: - 🪥 ADA 建议每天使用含氟牙膏刷牙两次，每次两分钟，每天使用牙线并定期看牙医。

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.zh: 🍿 电影：约翰·特托罗在《纽约唯一活着的扒手》中饰演哈利，一名熟练的扒手和妻子的看护人。当他从一个大学生那里偷了一个背包时，他的生活发生了巨大的变化，却发现他是一个犯罪头目的孙子。

paras.en: 🎮 Gaming: Nintendo's Ocarina of Time remake secures its legacy in gaming, but despite its high production values, NPR's James Perkins Mastromarino says it left him feeling oddly bereft.
paras.zh: 🎮 游戏：任天堂的《时之笛》重制版巩固了其在游戏领域的遗产，但尽管其制作价值很高，NPR 的詹姆斯·帕金斯·马斯特罗马里诺 (James Perkins Mastromarino) 表示，这让他感到奇怪的失落感。

paras.en: ❓ Quiz: The midterms are over, and while this week was politics-heavy, that's not all that happened. This quiz offers a great recap of the week's diverse events.
paras.zh: ❓ 测验：中期选举已经结束，虽然本周充满政治色彩，但这并不是发生的全部。该测验很好地回顾了本周发生的各种事件。

paras.zh: - 新的全球数据表明，只有一小部分儿童和青少年按照世界卫生组织的建议每天至少进行一小时的出汗运动。

articles.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
articles.author: Ava Berger

paras.en: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
paras.zh: 被驱逐的巴拉圭总统出现在检察官面前

paras.en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was impeached and placed under house arrest Friday after the collapse of a prominent U.S.-owned bank with ties to Paraguay's government. The fallout has left millions across the country without access to their money.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳周五因与巴拉圭政府有联系的一家著名美国银行倒闭而被弹劾并被软禁。其后果导致全国数百万人无法获得资金。

paras.en: Peña is one of Washington's closest allies in the region and was a shareholder in Ueno Bank, a digital lender that served about 3 million customers — more than half of the country's adult population.
paras.zh: 佩纳是华盛顿在该地区最亲密的盟友之一，也是上野银行的股东，该银行是一家数字贷款机构，为约 300 万客户（占该国成年人口的一半以上）提供服务。

paras.en: He was known as a pro-market leader focused on making it easier to do business in the country, but legislators said he jeopardized state assets and benefitted himself through his connection to the bank.
paras.zh: 他被认为是一位亲市场的领导人，致力于让在该国开展业务变得更加容易，但立法者表示，他危害了国有资产，并通过与银行的联系为自己谋取利益。

paras.en: Ueno Bank previously said more than a million people opened bank accounts for the first time using its services, which included generous cash back offers on groceries.
paras.zh: 上野银行此前表示，超过一百万人首次使用其服务开设了银行账户，其中包括对食品杂货的慷慨现金返还优惠。

paras.en: A trial has proceeded against Peña, and he appeared before prosecutors Saturday morning. The last president ousted from office was Fernando Lugo in 2012.
paras.zh: 对佩纳的审判已经开始，他于周六上午出庭受审。上一位被赶下台的总统是 2012 年的费尔南多·卢戈。

paras.en: Peña has denied any wrongdoing but on Thursday he announced his resignation. Lawmakers refused to accept that resignation, and instead moved forward with the country's impeachment process.
paras.zh: 佩纳否认有任何不当行为，但周四他宣布辞职。议员们拒绝接受这一辞职，而是继续推进该国的弹劾程序。

paras.en: At proceedings inside the country's Senate Friday, legislators unanimously found Peña guilty of malfeasance in office, according to the Senate's website.
paras.zh: 据参议院网站称，在周五参议院的审理中，立法者一致认定佩纳犯有职务渎职罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors then accused him of a breach of trust, among other charges, before placing him under house arrest.
paras.zh: 检察官随后指控他违反信任等罪名，然后将他软禁。

paras.en: "I want to apologize to the Paraguayan people if I have failed you," Peña said in a speech posted to social media.
paras.zh: 佩纳在社交媒体上发布的讲话中说：“如果我让你们失望了，我想向巴拉圭人民道歉。”

paras.en: Pedro Alliana, the country's vice president, was sworn in as president to serve out the rest of Peña's term until August 2028. In a speech on Friday, he announced he would take action to compensate people whose money was lost in the bank's collapse.
paras.zh: 该国副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳宣誓就任总统，任期至 2028 年 8 月。佩尼亚在周五的一次讲话中宣布，他将采取行动赔偿因银行倒闭而损失资金的人们。

paras.en: Paraguay's central bank said it seized control of Ueno Bank on Tuesday because its solvency ratio, an assessment of a company's long-term financial viability, no longer met legal standards.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭央行表示，周二接管了上野银行，因为其偿付能力充足率（对公司长期财务生存能力的评估）不再符合法律标准。

paras.en: Protests erupted across Asunción, the country's capital city, following the seizure.
paras.zh: 扣押事件发生后，该国首都亚松森爆发了抗议活动。

paras.en: NPR's John Otis and Catherine Osborn contributed reporting to this story.
paras.zh: NPR 的约翰·奥蒂斯和凯瑟琳·奥斯本对这个故事进行了报道。

paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers

paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card.富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。
