articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Big Ten coach who had an abysmal record in the SEC thinks his team would be ranked in the SEC

paras.en: Illinois head football coach Bret Bielema, who went 11-29 against the SEC during his five-year run at Arkansas, thinks his current program would be ranked ... If it were in the SEC.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊州橄榄球队主教练布雷特·比勒马 (Bret Bielema) 在阿肯色州的五年任期内以 11 胜 29 负的成绩击败了 SEC，他认为他目前的计划将会排名……如果是在 SEC 的话。

paras.en: Now, to be fair, Illinois is having a decent season. The Fighting Illini are coming off a 24-13 win over Nebraska Friday night, and sit at 6-3 as the regular season begins its final month. It's been a good year for Illinois up to this point. Credit where it's due, Bielema has the fellas playing well in 2026.
paras.zh: 现在，公平地说，伊利诺伊州正在经历一个不错的季节。周五晚上，战斗伊利尼队以 24-13 战胜内布拉斯加州，在常规赛最后一个月开始时以 6-3 的战绩坐稳。到目前为止，对于伊利诺伊州来说，这是美好的一年。值得赞扬的是，比勒马让这些家伙在 2026 年打得很好。

paras.en: For some reason, though, the SEC continues to be on the brains of every Big Ten coach in America right now. Earlier this week, Curt Cignetti took a shot at the conference after the initial CFP rankings was overloaded with SEC teams.
paras.zh: 但出于某种原因，美国证券交易委员会现在仍然是美国十大教练的脑海中。本周早些时候，在最初的 CFP 排名中 SEC 球队超载后，Curt Cignetti 在会议上进行了尝试。

paras.en: After last night's win, Bielema joined the chorus, saying his unranked Fighting Illini would be in the mix if they played in the SEC.
paras.zh: 昨晚获胜后，比勒马加入了合唱团，表示如果他们在 SEC 比赛，他的未排名战斗伊利尼队也会加入其中。

paras.en: "But to be in this job, where we’re at right now, 6-3, we beat another 5-3 team. If we were in the SEC, we’d probably be a top-15 team."
paras.zh: “但要做好这份工作，我们现在的战绩是 6-3，我们击败了另一支 5-3 的球队。如果我们在 SEC，我们可能会成为前 15 名的球队。”

paras.en: So, Bielema is correct in the fact that if Illinois was currently 6-3 and played an SEC conference schedule, it would be ranked. Not sure it would be a top-15 team, but certainly ranked. I guess it depends who the wins/losses came against.
paras.zh: 因此，Bielema 的说法是正确的，即如果伊利诺伊州目前战绩为 6 胜 3 负，并且按照 SEC 会议日程进行比赛，那么它就会排名。不确定这是否会进入前 15 名球队，但肯定排名。我想这取决于赢/输的对手是谁。

paras.en: But also, if Illinois played in the SEC ... I'm not sure the Fighting Illini would be a 6-3 team right now. Their current wins have come against:
paras.zh: 而且，如果伊利诺伊州参加 SEC 比赛……我不确定现在的伊利诺伊州战斗队会是一支 6 胜 3 负的球队。他们目前的胜利是针对：

paras.en: One ranked win probably doesn't cut it. Now, Illinois' three losses? Purdue, Duke, and Ohio State (42-19). It doesn't feel like an "SEC schedule," at least not this season. The wins aren't impressive, beyond beating an Oregon team that has no business being ranked with Dante Moore out.
paras.zh: 一场排名胜利可能并不能解决问题。现在，伊利诺伊州的三场失利？普渡大学、杜克大学和俄亥俄州立大学 (42-19)。这感觉不像是“SEC 赛程表”，至少本赛季不是。除了击败俄勒冈队之外，这些胜利并不令人印象深刻，而俄勒冈队在丹特·摩尔出局的情况下根本没有资格排名。

paras.en: As for Bielema's actual record in the conference he can't get off his brain ...
paras.zh: 至于比勒马在会议上的实际记录，他无法忘怀……

paras.en: He went 11-29 against the SEC over four years at Arkansas, including 0-8 in his first season. Not saying that was completely his fault because that roster certainly wasn't his, but the numbers are still the numbers.
paras.zh: 在阿肯色州效力的四年里，他在对阵 SEC 的比赛中取得了 11 胜 29 负的战绩，其中第一个赛季的战绩为 0 胜 8 负。并不是说这完全是他的错，因为名单肯定不是他的，但数字仍然是数字。

paras.en: And the numbers say Bret Bielema's current team would be nowhere close to 6-3 in the SEC right now.
paras.zh: 数据显示，Bret Bielema 目前的球队目前在 SEC 的战绩远未达到 6 胜 3 负。

paras.en: It's a down year for the Big Ten. Let's just be honest for a second.
paras.zh: 对于十大联盟来说，这是低迷的一年。让我们说实话。

paras.en: That conference has dominated this sport for a few years now, but it's just a down year. It happens. Ohio State lost its starting QB. Oregon did, too. Penn State stinks. Michigan stinks.
paras.zh: 该联盟多年来一直主导着这项运动，但这只是低迷的一年。它发生了。俄亥俄州立大学失去了首发四分卫。俄勒冈州也这么做了。宾夕法尼亚州立大学很臭。密歇根臭气熏天。

paras.en: Indiana is currently ranked fourth, but needed overtime to beat both Michigan AND Minnesota.
paras.zh: 印第安纳目前排名第四，但需要加时才能击败密歇根和明尼苏达。

paras.en: Everyone wants to complain about the committee showing "SEC bias" in the initial batch of rankings earlier this week. That's fine. That's fair.
paras.zh: 每个人都想抱怨委员会在本周早些时候的第一批排名中表现出“SEC 偏见”。没关系。这很公平。

articles.title: 7 Costco Thanksgiving food deals and steals that shoppers can't miss this holiday season

paras.en: With Thanksgiving already just weeks away, shoppers are starting to stock up on holiday staples.
paras.zh: 距离感恩节只有几周了，购物者开始储备节日必需品。

paras.en: From discounted baking supplies to easy appetizers and quick meals, Costco is offering a number of food finds for shoppers preparing for Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 从折扣烘焙用品到简单的开胃菜和快餐，Costco 为准备感恩节的购物者提供多种食品。

paras.en: New and seasonal products continue to spark excitement online, even without steep discounts, said Andrew Edelblum, Ph.D., an assistant professor of marketing at the University of Dayton in Ohio.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州代顿大学营销学助理教授安德鲁·埃德布卢姆博士表示，即使没有大幅折扣，新产品和季节性产品仍继续在网上引发人们的兴奋。

paras.en: "They don’t even necessarily need to have really phenomenal deals on their product to drum up excitement about whatever is new coming through the doors on a week-to-week basis," Edelblum told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 埃德布卢姆告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“他们甚至不一定需要在产品上进行真正惊人的交易，才能激发人们对每周推出的新产品的兴奋感。”

paras.en: The holiday-season buzz is especially visible around Costco's pumpkin pie, a Costco staple that Edelblum said benefits from the retailer's bulk purchasing and in-house bakery production.
paras.zh: 假期季节的热潮在 Costco 的南瓜派周围尤其明显，Edelblum 表示，Costco 的南瓜派是 Costco 的主食，受益于零售商的批量采购和内部烘焙生产。

paras.en: Here are seven Costco food deals and seasonal finds to check out, according to recent reports.
paras.zh: 根据最近的报道，这里有七种 Costco 食品优惠和季节性产品可供查看。

paras.en: Some of the reported discounts run until Nov. 15. Prices and overall availability can vary by location.
paras.zh: 部分报告折扣持续至 11 月 15 日。价格和整体供应情况可能因地点而异。

paras.en: Costco’s massive pumpkin pie measures 12 inches across and weighs nearly 4 pounds.
paras.zh: Costco 的巨型南瓜派宽 12 英寸，重近 4 磅。

paras.en: It typically costs $5.99 in stores and shoppers say it freezes well for later use, Fox News Digital previously reported.
paras.zh: 据福克斯新闻数字媒体此前报道，它在商店的售价通常为 5.99 美元，购物者表示它可以很好地冷冻以供以后使用。

paras.en: Costco is taking $15 off a two-pack of 8-ounce bottles of the baking staple, which is a favorite among professional bakers, making it a timely stock-up for the holidays.
paras.zh: Costco 现将两瓶装 8 盎司的烘焙主食降价 15 美元，这是专业面包师的最爱，使其成为节日时的及时储备。

paras.en: The deal is available online only, according to EatingWell.
paras.zh: 据 EatWell 称，该优惠仅在网上提供。

paras.en: The three-pack includes two Garlic & Fine Herbs cheeses and one Shallot & Chive cheese at $2.70 off.
paras.zh: 三件装包括两份大蒜和优质香草奶酪和一份青葱和香葱奶酪，优惠 2.70 美元。

paras.en: Serve it with crackers as an easy holiday appetizer, or mix it into mashed potatoes, Southern Living suggests.
paras.zh: 《南方生活》建议，将其与饼干一起作为简单的节日开胃菜，或将其混入土豆泥中。

paras.en: The 18-stack box is $3.30 off at Costco, according to Southern Living.
paras.zh: 据 Southern Living 报道，Costco 的 18 叠礼盒可享受 3.3 美元的折扣。

paras.en: The buttery crackers are an easy addition to a holiday snack spread and can also be crushed for casserole toppings or other comfort foods.
paras.zh: 黄油饼干很容易添加到节日小吃中，也可以压碎作为砂锅配料或其他舒适食品。

paras.en: Costco’s $10.99 pack features buttery croissant rolls filled with creamy Brie sauce and Emmental cheese.
paras.zh: Costco 的售价 10.99 美元的套装包含黄油羊角面包卷，里面充满了奶油布里酱和埃蒙塔尔奶酪。

paras.en: They heat in about eight minutes, making them a quick option for holiday appetizers, breakfast or snacks, Eat This, Not That reports.
paras.zh: 据《吃这个，不是那个》报道，它们在大约八分钟内加热，使其成为节日开胃菜、早餐或零食的快速选择。

paras.en: The six-pack of 32-ounce cartons is a handy pantry staple for soups, stews, casseroles and pasta bakes all winter long.
paras.zh: 六包 32 盎司纸盒装是方便的厨房主食，适合整个冬天的汤、炖菜、砂锅菜和面食烘焙。

paras.en: The reduced-sodium broth is also a healthier option that lets cooks better control the salt content of their recipes.
paras.zh: 低钠肉汤也是一种更健康的选择，可以让厨师更好地控制食谱中的盐含量。

paras.en: 7. Ling Ling Chicken & Vegetable Potstickers
paras.zh: 7. 玲玲鸡肉蔬菜锅贴

paras.en: A go-to quick dinner or weekend lunch, a bag of these potstickers is on sale for just under $10, and are ready in about 10 minutes.
paras.zh: 作为快餐或周末午餐的首选，一袋这些锅贴售价不到 10 美元，大约 10 分钟内即可准备好。

paras.en: They contain 12 grams of protein per serving, making for a convenient, high-protein option.
paras.zh: 每份含有 12 克蛋白质，是一种方便的高蛋白选择。

articles.title: Gunman opens fire from moving car in European tourist hotspot, leaving 6 dead and at least 12 wounded

paras.en: Małopolska Police confirmed a Polish gunman opened fire at a popular tourist destination in Kraków on Saturday, killing six people and wounding at least eleven more.
paras.zh: 小波兰警方证实，一名波兰枪手周六在克拉科夫的一个热门旅游目的地开枪，造成六人死亡，至少造成十一人受伤。

paras.en: Shooting from a moving vehicle, the gunman allegedly targeted people at random, injuring civilians as well as police during the attack on Kraków's bustling Main Square.
paras.zh: 据称，枪手在袭击克拉科夫繁华的主广场时，从行驶中的车辆上随机射击，造成平民和警察受伤。

paras.en: Video posted on social media showed people running while gunshots rang out.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的视频显示，枪声响起时，人们在奔跑。

paras.en: Police shot and wounded the suspect during a gunfight and the area is now secured, according to authorities.
paras.zh: 据当局称，警方在枪战中开枪打伤了嫌疑人，该地区现已安全。

paras.en: The suspect, who has only been identified by police as a "citizen of the Republic of Poland," was wearing military-style fatigues and used a military-style rifle to carry out the attack, Katarzyna Cisło, a spokesperson for the Kraków police, told Polish network TVN24.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方发言人卡塔齐娜·西斯沃 (Katarzyna Cisło) 告诉波兰电视台 TVN24，警方仅确认嫌疑人为“波兰共和国公民”，他身穿军装，使用军用步枪实施袭击。

paras.en: Authorities also found numerous other weapons and ammunition in the suspect's car, Cisło said.
paras.zh: 西斯沃说，当局还在嫌疑人的车里发现了许多其他武器和弹药。

paras.en: Małopolska Police released a statement Saturday afternoon denying reports that a police officer died and that another perpetrator is being sought.
paras.zh: 小波兰警方周六下午发表声明，否认有关一名警察死亡以及正在寻找另一名肇事者的报道。

paras.en: "The only known perpetrator of the incident is in police custody," officials said.
paras.zh: 官员们表示：“唯一已知的这起事件的肇事者已被警方拘留。”

paras.en: A public train driver reported around 3 p.m. local time that his vehicle had been shot by a man in a moving car, shattering his window.
paras.zh: 下午 3 点左右，一名公共火车司机报告称。当地时间，他的车被行驶中的一名男子开枪射击，车窗被震碎。

paras.en: Police vehicles, ambulances, and a Polish Medical Air Rescue helicopter surrounded the scene at Main Square, which is located in the country's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 警车、救护车和波兰医疗空中救援直升机包围了位于该国第二大城市主广场的现场。

paras.en: Polish Police said in a statement on X, "in connection with the tragic incident that occurred in Kraków, National Police Commander Inspector General Marek Boroń is heading to the scene."
paras.zh: 波兰警方在 X 日的一份声明中表示，“关于克拉科夫发生的悲惨事件，国家警察总督察长马雷克·博伦正在前往现场。”

paras.en: Polish leaders reacted to the scene in a series of public statements on social media.
paras.zh: 波兰领导人在社交媒体上发表了一系列公开声明，对这一场景做出了反应。

paras.en: "My deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of the victims of the tragic attack in Kraków. My highest praise for the heroic police officers who risked their lives. And a heartfelt appeal to politicians of all stripes: do not exploit this tragedy. We will establish all the circumstances of this crime," Prime Minister Donald Tusk wrote in a statement posted to X.
paras.zh: 总理唐纳德·图斯克在发给X的一份声明中写道：“我向克拉科夫悲惨袭击事件的受害者家属和亲人表示最深切的哀悼。我对冒着生命危险的英勇警察表示最崇高的敬意。并衷心呼吁各派政客：不要利用这一悲剧。我们将查明这一罪行的所有情况。”

paras.en: Tusk also assured the public that police are investigating the background and details of the attack.
paras.zh: 图斯克还向公众保证，警方正在调查袭击的背景和细节。

paras.en: Poland's president Karol Nawrocki also weighed in.
paras.zh: 波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基也发表了看法。

paras.en: "I am deeply concerned by reports of the tragic events in central Kraków. My thoughts are with the victims, those injured and their families. I remain in contact with the relevant services and expect a full explanation of the circumstances surrounding these tragic events," he wrote on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“我对克拉科夫市中心发生的悲惨事件的报道深感担忧。我的心与受害者、伤者及其家人同在。我与相关部门保持联系，并期待对这些悲惨事件的情况作出全面解释。”

paras.en: Nawrocki also revealed that the head of Poland's National Security Bureau is on his way to the city to investigate.
paras.zh: 诺罗基还透露，波兰国家安全局局长正在前往该市进行调查。

paras.en: The United States Ambassador to Poland, Tom Rose, shared sympathies in a post on X.
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯 (Tom Rose) 在 X 上发帖表达了同情。

paras.en: "We are just learning details of the horrific mass shooting in Kraków, a savage and murderous attack that’s shattered the peace of Poland," Rose wrote. "America stands with Poland at this dark hour as Poland stands with her beloved citizens of Kraków."
paras.zh: 罗斯写道：“我们刚刚了解克拉科夫发生的可怕大规模枪击事件的细节，这是一场野蛮而凶残的袭击，破坏了波兰的和平。” “在这个黑暗的时刻，美国与波兰站在一起，就像波兰与她心爱的克拉科夫公民站在一起一样。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the shooting as "shocking," in a statement on X, also extending condolences to the victims' loved ones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在 X 网站的一份声明中称此次枪击事件“令人震惊”，并向受害者的亲人表示哀悼。

paras.en: "There can be no justification for this attack, and we trust the perpetrator will face justice," Zelenskyy wrote. "We wish strength and a speedy recovery to the injured and to everyone affected by this tragedy. Ukraine stands in solidarity with Poland and the Polish people. People have the right to safety."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基写道：“这次袭击没有任何正当理由，我们相信肇事者将面临正义。” “我们祝愿受伤者和所有受这场悲剧影响的人得到力量并早日康复。乌克兰与波兰和波兰人民站在一起。人民有获得安全的权利。”

paras.en: Shootings are exceedingly rare in Poland, a country that ranks among the world's lowest in gun-related deaths at 0.2 to 0.4 deaths per 100,000 residents.
paras.zh: 波兰的枪击事件极为罕见，该国是世界上枪支相关死亡人数最低的国家之一，每 10 万居民中有 0.2 至 0.4 人死亡。

paras.en: This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个发展的故事。请回来查看更新。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: New Zealand faces weeks of uncertainty with election ‘too close to call’
articles.author: Eva Corlett in Auckland

paras.en: New Zealand could be facing a weeks-long wait to know the shape of its next government, after its nail-biting election failed to hand a decisive victory to either the incumbent rightwing coalition or opposition left bloc.
paras.zh: 在令人紧张的选举未能让现任右翼联盟或反对派左翼集团取得决定性胜利后，新西兰可能面临长达数周的等待，以了解下一届政府的组成。

paras.en: On preliminary results, the centre-right National party, led by the prime minister, Christopher Luxon, managed to secure enough seats to govern alongside its traditional coalition partners, the libertarian Act and populist New Zealand First parties.
paras.zh: 初步结果显示，总理克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)领导的中右翼国家党成功获得了足够的席位，与其传统的联盟伙伴、自由主义法案党和民粹主义的新西兰优先党一起执政。

paras.en: But with some seats won by very slim margins, and special votes yet to be counted, that success is precarious, resulting in an election too close to call until official results are released on 27 November.
paras.zh: 但由于一些席位以微弱优势赢得，而且特别选票尚未清点，这种成功是不稳定​​的，导致选举在 11 月 27 日正式结果公布之前难以预测。

paras.en: Special votes include overseas votes and ballots cast outside a voter’s electorate. In 2023, 600,000 such votes were made, 21% of the total. These votes tend to favour the left – in 2023, special votes resulted in Te Pāti Māori (the Māori party) and the Greens gaining three seats between them.
paras.zh: 特别投票包括海外投票和选民选区之外的投票。 2023年，进行了60万次此类投票，占总数的21%。这些选票往往有利于左翼——2023 年，特别投票结果是 Te Pāti Māori（毛利党）和绿党赢得了三个席位。

paras.en: With nearly 100% of the regular votes counted on Saturday night, National secured 42 seats, Act 13 and New Zealand First 12. The combined 67-seat majority is wafer thin, with the left bloc just three seats behind.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，近 100% 的常规选票已清点完毕，国家党获得了 42 个席位，第 13 号法案和新西兰优先党获得了 12 个席位。加起来，67 个席位的多数席位微乎其微，左翼集团仅落后 3 个席位。

paras.en: Speaking to a room full of the party faithful at Auckland’s Viaduct events centre just before midnight, Luxon said the results were “too close to call” and the special votes would need to be counted before negotiations could begin.
paras.zh: 午夜前，卢克森在奥克兰高架桥活动中心对一屋子的党内忠实人士发表讲话，他表示，结果“势均力敌”，在谈判开始之前需要清点特别选票。

paras.en: National was still the largest party in parliament, he said, and had “a pathway to forming the next government”. National pipped Labour by 0.02% in the party vote.
paras.zh: 他说，国家党仍然是议会中最大的政党，并且有“组建下一届政府的途径”。国家党在党内投票中领先工党 0.02%。

paras.en: Labour, led by Chris Hipkins, secured 35 seats, while its traditional coalition partners the Greens won 16 and Te Pāti Māori five. Even with the seven seats from the centrist newcomer party, Opportunity, the left bloc is three seats short of forming a government.
paras.zh: 克里斯·希普金斯 (Chris Hipkins) 领导的工党获得 35 个席位，而其传统联盟伙伴绿党 (Greens) 赢得 16 个席位，毛利党 (Te Pāti Māori) 赢得 5 个席位。即使中间派新人机遇党拥有七个席位，左翼集团距离组建政府还差三个席位。

paras.en: Before a rowdy crowd of supporters at the Cosmopolitan Club in Upper Hutt, north of Wellington, Hipkins joked that New Zealand had spoken but “it may take a bit longer to work out what they’ve said”.
paras.zh: 在惠灵顿北部上哈特的大都会俱乐部，在一群喧闹的支持者面前，希普金斯开玩笑说新西兰已经发声了，但“可能需要更长的时间才能弄清楚他们所说的内容”。

paras.en: “As things stand tonight, it is clear that we are not going to know the shape of our next government for a little while longer yet,” Hipkins said, promising that Labour would get “straight to work” should the final count land in its favour.
paras.zh: 希普金斯说：“从今晚的情况来看，很明显，我们在一段时间内不会知道下一届政府的形式。”他承诺，如果最终计票结果对工党有利，工党将“直接开始工作”。

paras.en: The collapse of the two major parties, amid a sluggish economy and stubbornly high inflation, is feeding record support for the smaller parties, including Act, New Zealand First and the Greens. It is also helped propel Opportunity into parliament for the first time.
paras.zh: 在经济低迷和通胀居高不下的背景下，两个主要政党的垮台，为包括行动党、新西兰优先党和绿党在内的较小政党提供了创纪录的支持率。它还帮助机遇号首次进入议会。

paras.en: Opinion polls in the lead-up to the election had Opportunity placed to become the kingmaker. At this stage, the right bloc does not need the party to govern, but if special votes change the landscape, its predicted role could come to fruition.
paras.zh: 选举前的民意调查显示，机遇号有望成为造王者。在现阶段，右翼集团不需要政党来执政，但如果特别投票改变格局，其预期的作用可能会实现。

paras.en: Currently at 5.9%, the centrist party has met the threshold needed to enter parliament, a historic first. Since New Zealand adopted the mixed-member proportional (MMP) electoral system in 1996, no new party has been able to meet that threshold – all the other minor parties have been born from MPs or groups splintering from larger parties.
paras.zh: 目前中间派的得票率为5.9%，已经达到了进入议会所需的门槛，这是历史性的首次。自1996年新西兰采用混合议员比例（MMP）选举制度以来，没有任何新政党能够达到这一门槛——所有其他小政党都是由国会议员或从大政党中分裂出来的团体诞生的。

paras.en: The party’s leader, Qiulae Wong, told her supporters in Auckland she was “stoked”.
paras.zh: 该党领袖 Qiulae Wong 告诉奥克兰的支持者，她感到“兴奋”。

paras.en: “It’s looking very promising for us,” she said. “Let’s just see how the rest of the votes fall.”
paras.zh: “这对我们来说看起来非常有希望，”她说。 “让我们看看其余的选票如何下降。”

paras.en: In New Zealand, voters cast two votes: one for an electorate MP and one for a party. The system is meant to produce a parliament that reflects each party’s share of the nationwide vote.
paras.zh: 在新西兰，选民投两票：一张投给选区议员，另一张投给政党。该制度旨在产生一个反映各党派在全国投票中所占份额的议会。

paras.en: However, if New Zealanders vote for more electorate MPs from a particular party than their party vote would entitle them to, they get to keep the extra MPs in what is called an overhang.
paras.zh: 然而，如果新西兰人投票选出的某个政党的议员人数多于其政党投票所赋予的议员人数，他们就可以将多余的议员保留在所谓的“悬而未决”的地方。

paras.en: National won more seats that its party support allows for, meaning it could gain an extra five seats to make up the balance.
paras.zh: 国家党赢得了其政党支持所允许的更多席位，这意味着它可以额外获得五个席位来弥补平衡。

paras.en: That will be good news for its path to power, but comes with some significant trade-offs for the party. Four of its most senior ministers, including Nicola Willis, Paul Goldsmith, Chris Bishop and Gerry Brownlee, will not return to parliament because they did not win a seat, or the party didn’t win enough votes to bring in list-only MPs.
paras.zh: 这对于该党的执政之路来说是个好消息，但也会带来一些重大的权衡。包括尼古拉·威利斯（Nicola Willis）、保罗·戈德史密斯（Paul Goldsmith）、克里斯·毕晓普（Chris Bishop）和格里·布朗利（Gerry Brownlee）在内的四位最高级部长将不会重返议会，因为他们没有赢得席位，或者该党没有赢得足够的选票来引入仅名单议员。

paras.en: On the other side of the house, Te Pāti Māori picked up five overhang seats.
paras.zh: 在房子的另一边，Te Pāti Māori 挑出了五个悬垂的座位。

paras.en: With all the extra seats, there could be 130 in the next parliament – a record under MMP – which means 65 seats are needed to form a coalition.
paras.zh: 加上所有额外席位，下一届议会可能有 130 个席位（这是 MMP 下的记录），这意味着需要 65 个席位才能组成联合政府。

paras.en: The country faces a two-week wait until special votes are announced, followed by the possibility of weeks of negotiations. Luxon said caretaker government conventions would apply in the meantime.
paras.zh: 该国需要等待两周才能宣布特别投票，随后可能进行数周的谈判。卢克森表示，看守政府会议将同时适用。

paras.en: “For now, I want to tell New Zealanders that well-established caretaker conventions apply … The daily business of government will continue.”
paras.zh: “现在，我想告诉新西兰人，完善的看守公约适用……政府的日常事务将继续进行。”

articles.title: Six dead after gunman opens fire ‘at random’ in Kraków market square
articles.author: Donna Ferguson

paras.en: Six people have been killed and 15 injured after a shooting in a market square in Kraków, Poland.
paras.zh: 波兰克拉科夫市集广场发生枪击事件，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。

paras.en: A man who had driven into the square at about 3pm began “firing at random people from his car”, according to a statement by local police on X.
paras.zh: 据当地警方在 X 上发布的一份声明称，下午 3 点左右，一名男子开车进入广场，开始“从车内随机向人群开枪”。

paras.en: The gunman was a Polish citizen who acted alone and was shot and wounded during a gunfight with police nearby, authorities said. He was dressed in “military-style” clothes and used a long military-type firearm, police said.
paras.zh: 当局称，枪手是一名波兰公民，他单独行动，在附近与警察的枪战中被枪杀。警方称，他穿着“军用”服装，使用长军用枪支。

paras.en: The injured included two police officers who were hurt - one of them seriously after being shot three times in the shootout with the alleged attacker. Those killed were four women and two men.
paras.zh: 伤者包括两名警察，其中一名警察在与袭击者的枪战中中弹三枪，伤势严重。遇难者包括四名女性和两名男性。

paras.en: The incident took place in the main market square, a popular tourist destination in Kraków, Poland’s second-largest city.
paras.zh: 这起事件发生在波兰第二大城市克拉科夫的热门旅游目的地主集市广场。

paras.en: A tram driver reported about 3pm that his vehicle was shot at from a man in a moving car while passing nearby the main square, the Krakow municipal transport company said. The window to the tram driver’s cabin was shattered.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市交通公司表示，下午 3 点左右，一名电车司机报告说，他的车辆在经过主广场附近时，被一辆行驶中的汽车中的一名男子枪击。电车司机室的窗户被震碎。

paras.en: The prime minister, Donald Tusk, confirmed the shooting after initial reports by local media, which cited police and the fire department.
paras.zh: 在当地媒体援引警方和消防部门的初步报道后，总理唐纳德·图斯克证实了这起枪击事件。

paras.en: “I am being kept informed by the minister of the interior about the situation in Kraków following the tragic shooting,” he wrote on X, adding that “the police are investigating the background and all the circumstances of the attack”.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“内政部长不断向我通报克拉科夫发生悲惨枪击事件后的情况”，并补充说“警方正在调查袭击的背景和所有情况”。

paras.en: Later in the evening, government spokesperson Adam Szlapka wrote on X: “Today’s event in Kraków has shaken all of Poland,” adding that “Prime minister Donald Tusk is on his way to Kraków”
paras.zh: 当晚晚些时候，政府发言人 Adam Szlapka 在 X 上写道：“今天在克拉科夫发生的事件震动了整个波兰”，并补充说“总理唐纳德·图斯克正在前往克拉科夫的路上”

paras.en: The justice minister, Waldemar Żurek, wrote on X that authorities would “ensure that the perpetrator of this crime is held fully accountable and severely punished”.
paras.zh: 司法部长瓦尔德马·祖雷克 (Waldemar Żurek) 在 X 上写道，当局将“确保追究这一罪行的肇事者的全部责任并受到严厉惩罚”。

paras.en: The Polish president, Karol Nawrocki, said he was “deeply concerned by reports of the tragic events” in Kraków, and that his thoughts are with victims, those injured and their families.
paras.zh: 波兰总统卡罗尔·纳乌罗基表示，他“对克拉科夫发生的悲惨事件的报道深表关切”，并表示他与受害者、伤者及其家人同在。

paras.en: An interior minister is heading to the scene, according to reports.
paras.zh: 据报道，一名内政部长正在前往现场。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Euronews reported that the number of legally owned firearms in Poland surpassed 1 million for the first time.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，欧洲新闻报道称，波兰合法拥有的枪支数量首次超过 100 万支。

paras.en: Poland issued a record 50,700 gun permits in 2025, and the number of active permits registered in 2025 was almost double the number registered in 2015, according to the police statistics cited in the report.
paras.zh: 报告中引用的警方统计数据显示，波兰在2025年发放了创纪录的50,700张持枪许可证，2025年登记的有效许可证数量几乎是2015年登记数量的两倍。

articles.title: Kraków shooting latest updates: six killed and more than a dozen injured, police say
articles.author: Nadeem Badshah (now) and Hamish Mackay (earlier)

paras.en: A man who gave his name as Konrad, and witnessed the shooting, told news website Interia: “I saw shots being fired from the driver’s side window, and smoke was coming out. I ran to the police station in the main market square; when I burst inside, it was full of people hiding on the floor.”
paras.zh: 一名自称康拉德（Konrad）的男子目睹了枪击事件，他告诉新闻网站Interia：“我看到从驾驶员侧的车窗里开枪，烟雾冒出。我跑到主要集市广场的警察局；当我冲进去时，里面挤满了躲在地板上的人。”

paras.en: The gunman fired shots from a passing car near Slawkowska Street in the main square, according to local reports.
paras.zh: 据当地报道，枪手在主广场 Slawkowska 街附近向一辆路过的汽车开枪。

paras.en: They were then shot by police officers and detained near the intersection of Dietla and Stradomska streets.
paras.zh: 随后，他们被警察开枪射杀，并在 Dietla 街和 Stradomska 街交叉口附近被拘留。

paras.en: News website Onet, citing police, said: “The man had no identification documents with him. The police were able to establish his identity through operational work.”
paras.zh: 新闻网站 Onet 援引警方的话称：“该男子没有携带身份证件。警方通过业务工作确定了他的身份。”

paras.en: Courtesy of my colleague Jakub Krupa. Małopolska region police told tvn24 the Krakow attacker, who is injured in hospital, wore “military style” clothing and used “military type firearms”. More weapons have been secured in his car.
paras.zh: 由我的同事雅库布·克鲁帕 (Jakub Krupa) 提供。小波兰地区警方告诉tvn24，克拉科夫袭击者在医院受伤，他穿着“军用风格”服装并使用“军用型枪支”。他的车里藏有更多武器。

paras.en: He added the incident has been contained with no other suspects.
paras.zh: 他补充说，事件已得到控制，没有其他嫌疑人。

paras.en: Police started to receive reports at around 3 p.m. (1400 GMT) that someone in a car had been shooting randomly people who entered the square, a police spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 警方于下午3点左右开始接到报案。 （格林尼治标准时间 1400）警方发言人表示，有人在车里随机射击进入广场的人。

paras.en: “According to information from police officers, the man was wearing military-style attire,” the spokesperson told reporters.
paras.zh: 发言人告诉记者：“根据警方提供的信息，该男子穿着军装。”

paras.en: “During the arrest, officers used their weapons, but the man returned fire; as a result, two police officers are among the injured.”
paras.zh: “在逮捕过程中，警察使用了武器，但该男子还击，导致两名警察受伤。”

articles.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC

paras.en: The prime minister has said rejoining the bloc's internal market was among options he could pursue as part of a reshaping of ties since the UK's exit from the EU nearly six years ago.
paras.zh: 首相表示，自近六年前英国退出欧盟以来，作为重塑关系的一部分，重新​​加入欧盟内部市场是他可以采取的选择之一。

paras.en: But Michel Barnier told the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg that EU members would insist on the UK readopting certain conditions, such as the free movement of people, to gain access.
paras.zh: 但米歇尔·巴尼耶 (Michel Barnier) 周日接受英国广播公司 (BBC) 采访时表示，欧盟成员国将坚持要求英国重新采取某些条件，例如人员自由流动，以获得准入。

paras.en: He said there was not a "single market Ã la carte" menu from which the UK could pick and choose what elements it wanted to adopt.
paras.zh: 他表示，没有一个“单一市场点菜”菜单可供英国选择其想要采用的元素。

paras.en: Barnier - who led the EU delegation during Brexit talks between 2016 and 2021, and had a three-month spell as French prime minister in 2024 - said the "door is open" within Europe to the UK rejoining as an EU member.
paras.zh: 巴尼耶曾在 2016 年至 2021 年英国脱欧谈判期间领导欧盟代表团，并于 2024 年担任法国总理三个月。他表示，欧洲内部英国重新加入欧盟的“大门是敞开的”。

paras.en: But he insisted that any move to rejoin the single market - which allows for goods to be freely traded without border controls - would require the UK to follow the same terms as other members.
paras.zh: 但他坚称，任何重新加入单一市场（允许货物在没有边境管制的情况下自由贸易）的举措都将要求英国遵循与其他成员国相同的条款。

paras.en: He added that this included compliance with regulations designed to promote the circulation of goods, services, capital and people, referred to collectively within EU institutions as the "four freedoms".
paras.zh: 他补充说，这包括遵守旨在促进商品、服务、资本和人员流通的法规，这些法规在欧盟机构内统称为“四大自由”。

paras.en: "There will be no possibility to have one freedom and not the other. The four freedoms are clearly the four conditions to be inside a single market."
paras.zh: “不可能只有一种自由而没有另一种自由。这四种自由显然是进入单一市场的四个条件。”

paras.en: Since becoming prime minister in July, Burnham has suggested he could commit Labour to pursuing a much closer future relationship with Europe, including asking to rejoin the organisation as a full member, though he has ruled out major changes before the next election.
paras.zh: 自七月份成为首相以来，伯纳姆一直表示他可以让工党致力于在未来与欧洲建立更密切的关系，包括要求以正式成员身份重新加入该组织，不过他排除了在下次选举前做出重大改变的可能性。

paras.en: His predecessors have struck a series of deals with the EU on different aspects of how the UK and EU interact post-Brexit.
paras.zh: 他的前任就英国脱欧后英国和欧盟如何互动的不同方面与欧盟达成了一系列协议。

paras.en: Both sides are hoping to use a meeting in Brussels in 10 days' time to unveil deals on food standards, youth visas and re-linking British industry to the EU's carbon trading regime.
paras.zh: 双方希望利用 10 天后在布鲁塞尔举行的会议，公布有关食品标准、青年签证以及将英国工业与欧盟碳交易制度重新联系起来的协议。

paras.en: Of the four freedoms, the free movement of people - which allows EU citizens to live and work elsewhere in the bloc without a visa - was a key issue during the 2016 Brexit referendum.
paras.zh: 在四项自由中，人员自由流动——允许欧盟公民无需签证即可在欧盟其他地方生活和工作——是 2016 年英国脱欧公投期间的一个关键问题。

paras.en: Burnham's immediate predecessor, Sir Keir Starmer, ruled out re-establishing it for the UK in Labour's 2024 election manifesto and any move to advocate it again would prove a key dividing line with the Conservatives and Reform UK at a future poll.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆的前任凯尔·斯塔默爵士排除了在工党 2024 年选举宣言中为英国重新建立这一制度的可能性，任何再次倡导这一制度的举措都将在未来的民意调查中成为与保守党和改革英国的关键分界线。

paras.en: Burnham recently said in an interview that he would not re-establish free movement of people without a referendum, prompting Downing Street to clarify that he was not advocating its return at this point.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆最近在接受采访时表示，如果没有全民公投，他不会重新建立人员自由流动，这促使唐宁街澄清，他目前并不主张回归自由流动。

paras.en: He has previously said he wanted to lay out "different options" for the relationship with Europe at the Brussels summit later this month, before trying to find a consensus with the British public on a new relationship.
paras.zh: 他此前曾表示，他希望在本月晚些时候的布鲁塞尔峰会上为与欧洲的关系提出“不同的选择”，然后试图与英国公众就新关系达成共识。

paras.en: Barnier also predicted that EU countries would reject reinstating the British financial rebate, first negotiated in 1985, that lowered UK contributions towards the EU's annual budget while it was a member.
paras.zh: 巴尼耶还预测，欧盟国家将拒绝恢复英国在 1985 年首次谈判的财政退税，该退税降低了英国在其作为欧盟成员国期间对欧盟年度预算的贡献。

paras.en: The UK's decision to leave the bloc had created "a new situation", he said, meaning a new rebate would be "off the table".
paras.zh: 他表示，英国脱欧的决定创造了“新的局面”，这意味着新的退税将“不可能”。

paras.en: Barnier also compared Reform leader Nigel Farage to French politician Marine Le Pen. He said: "We have our own Farage. It is Mrs Le Pen. The same populism, the same lies, the same false promises."
paras.zh: 巴尼耶还将改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇与法国政治家马琳·勒庞进行了比较。他说：“我们有自己的法拉奇。她就是勒庞夫人。同样的民粹主义，同样的谎言，同样的虚假承诺。”

paras.en: Asked by Kuenssberg to clarify what he was referring to with his accusation of lies, Barnier said "for instance, when Mr Farage and Mr Johnson promised the UK people to get back [Â£350] million per week, it was not true, it was not possible. It was a lie".
paras.zh: 当昆斯伯格要求澄清他对谎言的指控时，巴尼耶表示，“例如，当法拉奇先生和约翰逊先生向英国人民承诺每周收回[3.5亿英镑]时，这不是真的，这是不可能的。这是一个谎言”。

paras.en: The Vote Leave campaign, of which Boris Johnson became a key figure, has been criticised previously for the slogan on the side of their campaign bus that said Britain sent Â£350m a week to the EU, adding: "Let's fund our NHS instead".
paras.zh: 鲍里斯·约翰逊(Boris Johnson)成为脱欧公投运动的关键人物，该运动此前曾因其竞选巴士侧面的口号而受到批评，该口号称英国每周向欧盟提供3.5亿英镑，并补充道：“让我们资助我们的国民医疗服务体系(NHS)”。

paras.en: Johnson said in 2017 that "once we have settled our accounts, we will take back control of roughly Â£350m per week. It would be a fine thing as many of us have pointed out if a lot of that money went on the NHS".
paras.zh: 约翰逊在 2017 年表示，“一旦我们结清账目，我们将收回每周约 3.5 亿英镑的控制权。正如我们许多人所指出的，如果其中大量资金进入 NHS，那将是一件好事”。

paras.en: Critics have said that the Â£350m per week was an approximate sum which represents a "gross contribution" and did not take into account the UK's Â£75m-a-week rebate nor the EU's investments in the UK.
paras.zh: 批评人士表示，每周 3.5 亿英镑只是一个近似数字，代表“总贡献”，并未考虑英国每周 7500 万英镑的退税，也没有考虑欧盟在英国的投资。

paras.en: Johnson has since defended the claim, saying the Â£350m was based on the UK's gross contribution to the EU, and was in fact an underestimate as UK contributions were due to rise.
paras.zh: 约翰逊此后为这一说法进行了辩护，称3.5亿英镑是根据英国对欧盟的总贡献计算的，实际上是低估的，因为英国的贡献将会增加。

paras.en: âIn his memoirs published in 2024, Johnson said EU money spent in the UK was not "democratically controlled by the British people", and "even if the net figure was only Â£175m, that was still a hell of a lot of money".
paras.zh: 约翰逊在 2024 年出版的回忆录中表示，欧盟在英国花的钱并不是“由英国人民民主控制的”，“即使净值只有 1.75 亿英镑，那仍然是一大笔钱”。

paras.en: Farage, who led Leave UK and was not part of the Vote Leave campaign so not connected to the Â£350m claim, said: "It is the same old Barnier - arrogant, out of touch and a bully. He vindicates our decision to leave every time he opens his mouth."
paras.zh: 法拉奇是英国脱欧党的领导者，并未参与脱欧运动，因此与3.5亿英镑的索赔无关，他说：“这还是那个老巴尼耶——傲慢、脱离现实、恶霸。他每次开口都证明我们脱欧的决定是正确的。”

articles.title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election

paras.en: There was no clear winner following New Zealand's election on Saturday, as the leaders of its two major parties preparing for negotiations to form a coalition government.
paras.zh: 新西兰周六大选后没有明显的赢家，因为该国两个主要政党的领导人正准备进行谈判以组建联合政府。

paras.en: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's centre-right National Party won 42 seats but was 19 short of the simple majority needed to form a government, despite being the largest party, preliminary results show.
paras.zh: 初步结果显示，总理克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)领导的中右翼国家党赢得了42个席位，但尽管是最大政党，但距离组建政府所需的简单多数还差19个。

paras.en: Combined with their coalition partners ACT and New Zealand First, they would have a slim lead over the left-leaning bloc if a deal could be reached.
paras.zh: 加上他们的联盟伙伴行动党和新西兰优先党，如果能够达成协议，他们将以微弱优势领先于左倾集团。

paras.en: But opposition leader Chris Hipkins, whose Labour Party won 36 seats, showed no signs of conceding, saying the "shape of the next government" will remain uncertain "for a while".
paras.zh: 但工党赢得 36 个席位的反对党领袖克里斯·希普金斯 (Chris Hipkins) 没有表现出让步的迹象，他表示，“下一届政府的形式”将在“一段时间内”仍不确定。

paras.en: The tight result followed a campaign shaped by the cost of living and unemployment.
paras.zh: 在一场由生活成本和失业因素影响的竞选活动之后，结果出现了紧缩。

paras.en: Projections show the National Party on 42 seats and Labour on 36. The Greens are on 16, with ACT on 13, New Zealand First on 12, the Opportunity Party on 7 and Te PÄti MÄori, which represents MÄori interests, on 5.
paras.zh: 预测显示，国家党获得 42 个席位，工党获得 36 个席位。绿党获得 16 个席位，行动党获得 13 个席位，新西兰优先党获得 12 个席位，机会党获得 7 个席位，代表毛利利益的特帕蒂毛利党获得 5 个席位。

paras.en: The electoral commission was not due to announced the official result until 27 November.
paras.zh: 选举委员会要到 11 月 27 日才会宣布正式结果。

paras.en: Luxon congratulated Hipkins on a "very hard-fought race" before addressing party colleagues, saying "whatever the final count, we are incredibly proud of each and everyone for you".
paras.zh: 卢克森祝贺希普金斯参加了一场“非常艰苦的竞选”，然后向党内同事发表讲话，并表示“无论最终结果如何，我们都为你的每一个人感到无比自豪”。

paras.en: He said he would run a caretaker government until the final results were confirmed later in the month, adding: "With those final results there can then be meaningful negotiations."
paras.zh: 他表示，他将管理一个看守政府，直到本月晚些时候最终结果得到确认，并补充道：“有了这些最终结果，就可以进行有意义的谈判。”

paras.en: Elsewhere, Labour leader Kipkins said "the people have spoken", adding: "It may take a bit longer to work out what they've said."
paras.zh: 在其他地方，工党领袖基普金斯表示“人们已经发声了”，并补充道：“可能需要更长的时间才能弄清楚他们所说的内容。”

paras.en: Hipkins said the results made clear the "next parliament is going to require all of us to compromise, to work together and to find a common ground".
paras.zh: 希普金斯表示，结果清楚地表明“下一届议会将要求我们所有人妥协、共同努力并找到共同点”。

paras.en: More than 99% of votes have been counted in New Zealand, with National and Labour neck-and-neck in terms of vote share.
paras.zh: 新西兰99%以上的选票已经清点完毕，国家党和工党的得票率不相上下。

paras.en: But the preliminary results pointed to historically low support for the two major parties, with a combined vote share of around 60%.
paras.zh: 但初步结果显示，两大党的支持率处于历史低位，合计得票率约为 60%。

paras.en: They were followed by the Greens, ACT, New Zealand First, centrist party Opportunity and Te PÄti MÄori, which represents MÄori interests.
paras.zh: 紧随其后的是绿党、行动党、新西兰优先党、中间派机会党和代表毛利人利益的特帕蒂毛利党。

paras.en: The Opportunity Party crossed the 5% threshold to enter parliament for the first time, with leader Qiulae Wong saying would work with either side.
paras.zh: 机会党首次跨过 5% 的门槛进入议会，党魁 Qiulae Wong 表示将与任何一方合作。

paras.en: It has been described as this election's kingmaker as it remains open to working with either major bloc, but its leaders said they would negotiate first with the party that secures the most seats.
paras.zh: 它被描述为这次选举的王者制造者，因为它仍然愿意与任何一个主要集团合作，但其领导人表示，他们将首先与获得最多席位的政党进行谈判。

paras.en: Speaking at Opportunity's watch party, Wong told supporters: "We believe that we can change the way we do politics to focus on the future, on the next generation, and on finding common ground."
paras.zh: 在机遇号的观看聚会上，黄对支持者说：“我们相信我们可以改变我们从事政治的方式，以关注未来、下一代并寻找共同点。”

paras.en: Professor Andrew Geddis from the University of Otago, an expert in election law, said "the Opportunity Party as a wildcard player" could "determine which bloc of parties is able to govern".
paras.zh: 奥塔哥大学选举法专家安德鲁·格迪斯教授表示，“机会党作为通配符玩家”可以“决定哪个政党集团能够执政”。

paras.en: "It will come down to some very fine vote margins not just between the parties, but in individual electorates. We are going to have to wait for the special votes to be processed and counted over the next three weeks," he said.
paras.zh: “这不仅取决于政党之间的投票差距，还取决于个别选民的投票差距。我们将不得不等待特别选票在未来三周内得到处理和计票，”他说。

paras.en: Special votes are votes cast outside a voter's electorate, including overseas.
paras.zh: 特别投票是在选民选民之外（包括海外）进行的投票。

paras.en: The Greens â who have proposed forcing the country's two main supermarkets to divest stores to create publicly-owned shops â saw their vote rise by a couple of percentage points.
paras.zh: 绿党提议迫使该国两家主要超市剥离商店以创建公营商店，他们的支持率上升了几个百分点。

paras.en: Julian McCrann, head of polling at Roy Morgan, told BBC News the cost of living was the main issue for many New Zealanders
paras.zh: 罗伊摩根民意调查负责人朱利安·麦克莱恩 (Julian McCrann) 告诉 BBC 新闻，生活成本是许多新西兰人面临的主要问题

paras.en: "Three years ago, Luxon came in saying he'd be making New Zealanders' lives better and solving these economic issues, but he hasn't really delivered," he said.
paras.zh: “三年前，卢克森曾表示他将让新西兰人的生活变得更好并解决这些经济问题，但他并没有真正兑现承诺，”他说。

paras.en: More than half of the country no longer see New Zealand as a land of opportunity, according to an annual social cohesion survey. Record numbers of Kiwis have been leaving the country, with many going to Australia.
paras.zh: 根据年度社会凝聚力调查，超过一半的国家不再将新西兰视为充满机遇的土地。离开新西兰的新西兰人数量创历史新高，其中许多人前往澳大利亚。

paras.en: New Zealand's mixed-member proportional voting system means most governments are coalitions.
paras.zh: 新西兰的混合成员比例投票制度意味着大多数政府都是联合政府。

paras.en: Each voter makes two choices â for the representative of their constituency in parliament and a political party.
paras.zh: 每个选民都有两个选择——议会中选区的代表和政党。

articles.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data

paras.en: Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani says he has been targeted by "cyber-criminals" who published his personal data online because of his country's support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼表示，由于意大利支持乌克兰，他已成为“网络犯罪分子”的目标，这些犯罪分子在网上发布了他的个人数据。

paras.en: "For days now, cyber-criminals have been publishing my personal data on the dark web and seeking further information, effectively exposing me to new threats and intimidation," Tajani wrote on X.
paras.zh: 塔贾尼在 X 上写道：“几天来，网络犯罪分子一直在暗网上发布我的个人数据并寻求更多信息，这实际上使我面临新的威胁和恐吓。”

paras.en: He did not specify the nature of the threats, but said the hackers were also targeting his family.
paras.zh: 他没有具体说明威胁的性质，但表示黑客还针对他的家人。

paras.en: The dark web is a hidden part of the internet that is not indexed by common search engines and can only be accessed with specialist software.
paras.zh: 暗网是互联网的隐藏部分，常见搜索引擎无法索引，只能通过专业软件访问。

paras.en: "Our position on Ukraine is the political reason I have been targeted," Tajani said.
paras.zh: 塔贾尼说：“我们对乌克兰的立场是我成为攻击目标的政治原因。”

paras.en: "Defending the freedom of a sovereign state, taking a clear stand in support of a nation's democracy and independence, is dangerous in the eyes of these criminal entities."
paras.zh: “在这些犯罪实体眼中，捍卫主权国家的自由、明确支持国家的民主和独立是危险的。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni blamed the incident on pro-Russian hackers and offered Tajani her "full solidarity".
paras.zh: 总理乔治亚·梅洛尼将这一事件归咎于亲俄黑客，并向塔亚尼表示“全力声援”。

paras.en: "The sale of confidential information about institutional representatives is a cause of serious concern and must be tackled with the utmost determination," she said in a statement.
paras.zh: 她在一份声明中表示：“出售有关机构代表的机密信息令人严重关切，必须以最大的决心予以解决。”

paras.en: Moscow has not publicly responded to the allegations.
paras.zh: 莫斯科尚未公开回应这些指控。

paras.en: Meloni also expressed concern about "circulation of false images" which she said were shared by members of Italy's opposition. She did not give details about the content of the images.
paras.zh: 梅洛尼还对“虚假图像的传播”表示担忧，她说意大利反对派成员也分享了这些图像。她没有详细说明这些图像的内容。

paras.en: The Italian government has provided humanitarian and military support to Ukraine in its war against Russia.
paras.zh: 意大利政府向乌克兰对抗俄罗斯的战争提供了人道主义和军事支持。

paras.en: Tajani, who is also the deputy prime minister, said the government was taking the threats seriously.
paras.zh: 兼任副总理的塔贾尼表示，政府正在认真对待这些威胁。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators. Schwab emphasized that this expansion is about more than adding product categories. By leveraging its engineering expertise, OEM relationships and aftermarket partnerships, Niterra is building on its reputation to deliver solutions trusted by professional technicians and customers.

articles.title: OEC Launches Largest Parts Marketplace for U.S. Repair Shops
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: OEConnection LLC (OEC), a leading global technology provider for the automotive aftersales industry, has announced the launch of the first marketplace to bring all major part types together, giving U.S. repair shops one place to source OE, aftermarket and tires. PartsTech already connects shops to 240-plus aftermarket suppliers, 60-plus tire suppliers, and distributor-sponsored promotional programs. Now, through the integration of RepairLink, PartsTech adds nearly 9,000 OE dealers across all 50 states and OE-sponsored promotional programs from 14-plus OE brands. Every major part type is now available in a single search, an industry first at this scale. The result is a faster, simpler ordering process for shops, along with greater reach for the suppliers and dealers who serve them.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Until now, shops typically sourced parts across multiple disconnected channels, with OE and aftermarket parts available only on separate platforms. With OE now in PartsTech through the RepairLink integration, parts from the shop’s preferred dealers appear in the same search results as aftermarket parts and tires, so shops can compare options and place orders in one workflow.

Shops simply connect their RepairLink account to PartsTech, which automatically adds the shop’s preferred OE dealers, including dealer pricing, to their parts search. The upgraded PartsTech marketplace features both the newly added OE-sponsored promotional programs, from RepairLink, and the existing aftermarket distributor-sponsored promotional programs.
Manufacturer-sourced OE diagrams are also now available in PartsTech, helping shops confirm the right part before they order.

“For too long, mechanical shops have had to work through a fragmented, error-prone parts procurement process that slows repair order times and, ultimately, hurts shop performance,” said Greg Kirber, senior vice president of Mechanical eCommerce at OEC. “The PartsTech and RepairLink integration changes that. Shops can now find and order every part they need, whether it’s aftermarket, OE or tires, in a single search and cart. This is something shops have requested for a long time, and we’re excited to deliver it.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For dealers, the new marketplace puts their parts inventory in front of PartsTech’s network of 34,000-plus shops at the start of the ordering process, without changing how they manage orders. OE parts orders placed in PartsTech flow directly into the RepairLink Dealer Portal for review and approval. With sourcing consolidated in one platform, counter teams also handle fewer phone calls and manual lookups, freeing up time for sales and customer support.

“Shops want to spend less time sourcing parts and more time repairing vehicles and serving their customers,” said Greg Rivera, president at OEC. “Through the RepairLink integration, PartsTech now connects their preferred OE dealers with their aftermarket and tire suppliers, while providing both OE- and distributor-sponsored promotions, all in one place. That’s time and margin back in the shop’s hands, and that’s what keeps a repair business growing.”

The all-part-types marketplace is available now to all U.S. repair shops through PartsTech and RepairLink dealers. Shops can connect their RepairLink account to PartsTech for free, and dealers on RepairLink are connected automatically.
For more information, visit oeconnection.com.

articles.title: New Pro Spot Products Bring More Flexibility, Precision and Productivity to Collision Repair
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Pro Spot continues to expand its lineup of collision repair equipment with new technology designed to help body shops work more efficiently, improve repair quality and give technicians greater flexibility throughout the repair process. The latest additions include the PR-28U Ultrasonic Plastic Welder, PRO-101 Ion Hammer and PRO-99 Pro Pull + Cordless Dent Pullers, PLZ-1 Handheld Laser Welder and PSA-i5s Robotic Spot Welder. Each product addresses a different area of collision repair, bringing new capabilities to the shop while helping technicians handle repairs with greater control and consistency.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The new Ion Hammer (PRO-101) and Pro Pull + (PRO-99) cordless dent pullers give technicians the freedom to bring the tool directly to the repair, without being tethered to a power cord or stationary workstation. Whether working on a vehicle in the body shop or moving between repair areas, technicians can take the tool wherever it’s needed. Both systems deliver controlled pulling power designed to create a strong pull without burning through the backside of the panel.

The PR-28U Ultrasonic Plastic Welder adds another option for repairing modern vehicle plastics, including bumper covers, brackets, clips, sensor mounts and headlamp tabs. Using high-frequency vibrations to fuse compatible thermoplastics, it creates strong bonds without filler materials or preheating. OEMs are also able to use this technology for many of their thermoplastic subassemblies.

The PLZ-1 Handheld Laser Welder brings laser welding technology to the collision repair environment, offering a fast, easy-to-learn solution for welding steel, stainless steel and aluminum. Its low heat input helps minimize the heat-affected area, while optional pre-weld and post-weld cleaning capabilities help improve weld quality and finish.

For shops looking to take the next step with automation, the first-of-its-kind PSA-i5s Robotic Spot Welder combines Pro Spot’s resistance spot welding technology with collaborative robot automation. Features such as automatic weld adjustment, easy on-gun programming, repeatable weld positioning and welding data capture help shops improve consistency, traceability and production efficiency with what can be called the world’s smartest tool balancer.
Together, these products give collision repair facilities more ways to tackle today’s repair challenges while preparing for the demands of tomorrow’s vehicles.
For more information, visit prospot.com.

articles.title: MSO CEOs on the right people for the right jobs, and some industry misconceptions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: This year’s MSO Symposium brought together “the Four Aces” — the CEOs of Boyd Group, Caliber, Classic Collision, and Crash Champions —in Las Vegas on Monday, who ultimately landed on a simple conclusion: the collision repair industry depends on the right people fitting into the right roles.

When moderator Dan Risley asked what they’re hearing from investors and other stakeholders about the industry today, Boyd Group CEO Brian Kaner responded that the industry isn’t “recession-proof, but it is recession-resilient.”

“There are plenty of opportunities for us to continue to grow our businesses,” he said. “It all comes down to making sure you have the right people in the right roles with the right capabilities. And if you have that and you know how to keep score and you can win with the insurance carriers and you can take care of their customers and really be the extension of what they’re looking for, this is a great business to be in, and it’s something that we can continue to all thrive in.”

However, in response to a different question Risley posed about the “temperature” of each MSO’s team leaders, Crash Champions CEO Matt Ebert and Kaner agreed it’s a tense, stressful time for them, and made some important points about estimators.
Ebert said being an estimator, or as Crash Champions calls them, a service advisor, “has to be one of the most miserable spots.”

“You’ve got technicians bitching at you, you’ve got management or ownership bitching at you, you’ve got insurance companies bitching at you,” he said. “Everything you do gets criticized. Everything you do gets reviewed and sent back, and you have to do it again. I wouldn’t last a week. I would quit that job and tell you to shove it up your a**. If you want to know the temperature of our people, that is the truth.”

Ebert added that general managers also face pressure to keep customers, employees, and insurance companies happy while trying to make money and handle the safety, legal, and logistical pieces of their jobs.
Kaner said the industry has a “compelling opportunity” to invest in people.

“You’ve got to make investments in estimators,” he said. “We all make investments in technicians. I think one of the bigger gaps we have as an industry right now is in estimators. There’s not enough of them. There’s not enough of them that understand the metrics. There’s not enough of them that are salespeople that can go help actually go sell a consumer-paid job. …it’s a tense time and anytime when you’re in an environment where volume is tight, it just ups the pressure of the organization.”
Brad Anderson, who joined the collision repair industry in June to take over as CEO of Classic Collision, said he believes all jobs in the industry are hard.

“We put a lot on them, and I think all of us as an industry and ecosystem have to consider that it all crashes down to the people at the shop,” he said. “The small changes we make up here get really big when there’s 20 changes happening to the individual, whether it’s a tech, a GM, a service advisor, so we’ve got to simplify the work.”
During the discussion, Ebert also noted that 40-50% of MSO employees don’t touch a car, which he said “presents huge administrative opportunity,” another point he and Kaner agreed on.

“We have 15,000 people in our organization, and half of them are technicians and the other half are the people that are just trying to get the car to the back and do all the administrative things that they need to do to get it there,” Kaner said.
The conversation also touched on declining repairable claims volume, with Risley asking what’s missing from that narrative.

Caliber CEO David Simmons said the overall picture on repairable claims is probably a little more positive than the data that’s often quoted, “even though it is bad.” The primary misleading point, he said, is repairable claims data being viewed as representative of the market.

“If you allow yourself to be defined by repairable claims volumes, you have 30 years of history of insurance premium inflation in one year followed by claims frequency 12 to 18 months later,” he said. “And the pattern recognition in that 30-year data set would show that when you get into mid- to low-single-digit insurance premium inflation, which we’ve been in for several quarters now, you have a lag to low- to mid-single-digit claims frequency increase. There’s reasons for optimism that the old pattern holds, kind of offset by a structural shift with consumers because of the shock factor of insurance premium inflation.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: However, outside of insurance claims, one point remains: people are still getting their cars repaired, but they’re paying out of pocket, he said.

“We don’t track the juxtaposition of [the] increase in the dollar value of direct customer pay against the decrease in repairable claims and the dollar value of that,” Simmons said. “If you look at that, the total market has come down, but it’s a lot different dynamic. Now we’re built to service the insurance carrier, so it requires some adaptation to get at this customer pay. But if you want, we have to adapt, but if one’s willing to adapt, that market segment is there, and it’s growing, it’s growing robustly.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Simmons said he would love to see Mitchell and CCC “come together with a combined audited data set that is as close to accurate as possible on what’s really going on with claims, total losses, repairable claims, and segments of claims.”
Kaner said he thinks one thing people miss is that what’s happening in the industry isn’t all that different from what’s been happening.
“It’s like any ecosystem; something that happens can have a negative effect downstream, and this industry has the same thing,” he said.

In this case, “a very precipitous increase in premiums that then put consumers on heightened alert,” Kaner said, causing them to raise their deductibles, drop coverage, or not file a claim for fear of a large premium increase.

“But if you look at what’s happening in the environment, the underlying claims themselves, i.e., we call for a claims environment to be down 2%,” he said. “I think the claims environment driven by the ADAS systems, collision avoidance systems, is probably just that. What’s happened is the propensity to file a claim over that two-year period of time is really what’s driven much of the negative in the industry. And as that starts to work itself out of the system, you’re starting to see the claims environment come back again.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Kaner added that too much is ascribed to collision avoidance systems.

“We as an industry have to do a really good job of making sure people don’t hear things like, ‘Oh, well, front-end collisions are down 40%.’ Well, front-end collisions are down 40% in the cars that actually have that technology in them,” he said. “The reality is, for that technology to bleed through the system takes quite a while… Anything that happens new in a car takes 20 years to get all the way through the system.”
Risley also asked the group what the biggest threat to the collision repair industry is. Three out of the four responded, “ourselves.” Anderson’s take was technology.
