articles.title: Flexell Space Establishes French Subsidiary to Strengthen European Presence
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Paris-based FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS creates a local business hub in Europe
paras.zh: – 总部位于巴黎的 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS 在欧洲创建本地商业中心

paras.en: – New entity to support ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers, from technical reviews to supply planning
paras.zh: – 新实体支持与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论，从技术审查到供应计划

paras.en: Paris, France – Flexell Space, a space solar solution company, announced the establishment of its French entity, FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS, in Paris to strengthen support for ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎——太空太阳能解决方案公司 Flexell Space 宣布在巴黎成立其法国实体 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS，以加强对与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论的支持。

paras.en: The move comes as the company’s business discussions in Europe advance. Flexell Space is currently in talks with multiple European customers regarding collaboration agreements and volume supply of space solar cells and power solutions. Through its local presence, the company aims to accelerate customer communication and strengthen its ability to support business activities ranging from technical reviews to negotiations on supply terms.
paras.zh: 此举正值该公司在欧洲的业务讨论取得进展之际。 Flexell Space 目前正在与多个欧洲客户就合作协议以及太空太阳能电池和电力解决方案的批量供应进行谈判。通过其在当地的业务，该公司旨在加速客户沟通，并增强其支持从技术审查到供应条款谈判等业务活动的能力。

paras.en: - Advancing Contract and Production Discussions with European Customers
paras.zh: - 推进与欧洲客户的合同和生产讨论

paras.en: Space solar cells require close coordination on performance, dimensions, reliability, and delivery schedules, depending on each customer’s spacecraft design and operating environment. Beyond initial product introductions, discussions involve technical documentation reviews, sample evaluations, environmental test results, and design adjustments. Progressing toward volume supply also requires alignment on production schedules and quality management processes.
paras.zh: 太空太阳能电池需要在性能、尺寸、可靠性和交付时间表方面密切协调，具体取决于每个客户的航天器设计和操作环境。除了最初的产品介绍之外，讨论还涉及技术文档审查、样品评估、环境测试结果和设计调整。实现批量供应还需要调整生产计划和质量管理流程。

paras.en: Flexell Space said that as discussions with European customers move toward contracts and volume production, a local presence has become increasingly important for responding promptly to customer needs. The French entity will support these activities and serve as a link between European customers and the company’s R&D and manufacturing teams in Korea.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 表示，随着与欧洲客户的讨论转向合同和批量生产，本地业务对于迅速响应客户需求变得越来越重要。法国实体将支持这些活动，并充当欧洲客户与该公司在韩国的研发和制造团队之间的纽带。

paras.en: The company plans to deepen engagement with customers and partners across Europe, including France, Germany, Italy, and Lithuania. By gaining a closer understanding of each customer’s development schedule and technical requirements, it aims to facilitate timely decisions and follow-up actions throughout the collaboration process.
paras.zh: 该公司计划加深与欧洲各地客户和合作伙伴的接触，包括法国、德国、意大利和立陶宛。通过更深入地了解每个客户的开发进度和技术要求，旨在促进整个协作过程中的及时决策和后续行动。

paras.en: - Connecting Next-Generation Space Solar Technology with Production Readiness
paras.zh: - 将下一代太空太阳能技术与生产准备相结合

paras.en: Flexell Space develops next-generation tandem solar cells and related power solutions for space applications. Its tandem architecture combines solar cells with different characteristics to deliver the performance, low weight, and cost competitiveness required for space missions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 为太空应用开发下一代串联太阳能电池和相关电源解决方案。其串联架构结合了具有不同特性的太阳能电池，以提供太空任务所需的性能、低重量和成本竞争力。

paras.en: The company is expanding beyond solar cell development into modules and arrays tailored to customer missions and satellite platforms. Its preparations for commercialization and volume production address not only product performance, but also reliability in the space environment, manufacturing process repeatability, quality management, and supply stability.
paras.zh: 该公司正在将太阳能电池开发扩展到为客户任务和卫星平台量身定制的模块和阵列。其商业化和量产的准备工作不仅涉及产品性能，还涉及太空环境的可靠性、制造过程的可重复性、质量管理和供应稳定性。

paras.en: With the establishment of its French entity, Flexell Space plans to incorporate feedback from European technical discussions into product development and supply planning more quickly. It will strengthen coordination between its Korean R&D teams and European customers by communicating required specifications and evaluation criteria, while sharing development progress and validation results.
paras.zh: 随着法国实体的成立，Flexell Space 计划更快地将欧洲技术讨论的反馈纳入产品开发和供应规划中。它将通过沟通所需的规格和评估标准，同时共享开发进度和验证结果，加强韩国研发团队和欧洲客户之间的协调。

paras.en: The company will also continue discussions on supply scope, development schedules, production volumes, and delivery timelines to translate ongoing negotiations into concrete business outcomes.
paras.zh: 该公司还将继续讨论供应范围、开发计划、产量和交付时间表，将正在进行的谈判转化为具体的业务成果。

paras.en: - Building Long-Term Partnerships Across Europe
paras.zh: - 在欧洲建立长期合作伙伴关系

paras.en: Flexell Space plans to operate its French entity as a hub for developing long-term relationships with European customers. Alongside supporting existing customer projects, it will explore new product applications and joint development opportunities with local space companies and research institutions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 计划将其法国实体作为与欧洲客户发展长期关系的中心进行运营。除了支持现有客户项目外，还将探索新产品应用以及与当地航天公司和研究机构的联合开发机会。

paras.en: As satellite missions and platforms become more diverse, space power solutions increasingly require development and supply arrangements tailored to specific operating conditions. Flexell Space’s strategy is to maintain close contact with customers and connect their requirements with R&D and manufacturing preparations to expand its European business.
paras.zh: 随着卫星任务和平台变得更加多样化，空间电源解决方案越来越需要针对特定​​操作条件进行定制的开发和供应安排。 Flexell Space的战略是与客户保持密切联系，将他们的需求与研发和制造准备工作联系起来，以扩大其欧洲业务。

paras.en: “We are currently discussing contracts and volume supply with multiple European customers. As these discussions progress, being closer to our customers has become increasingly important in turning them into tangible results,” said Keo-san Lee, CFO of Flexell Space. “Our French entity will help accelerate technical discussions and business execution, while enabling us to respond more closely to our customers’ development and production schedules.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席财务官 Keo-san Lee 表示：“我们目前正在与多个欧洲客户讨论合同和批量供应。随着这些讨论的进展，为了将其转化为切实成果，与客户的距离变得越来越重要。” “我们的法国实体将有助于加快技术讨论和业务执行，同时使我们能够更密切地响应客户的开发和生产计划。”

paras.en: “In the space industry, technical capability must be accompanied by confidence in a supplier’s ability to deliver products reliably,” Lee added. “By connecting our R&D and manufacturing capabilities in Korea with local customer support in Europe, we aim to build stronger, longer-term partnerships.”
paras.zh: “在航天工业中，技术能力必须伴随着对供应商可靠交付产品能力的信心，”李补充道。 “通过将我们在韩国的研发和制造能力与欧洲当地客户支持联系起来，我们的目标是建立更强大、更长期的合作伙伴关系。”

articles.title: Craft Prospect kicks off PERSEUS project to advance optical communications for space
articles.author: Craft Prospect

paras.en: Craft Prospect is working with Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics (Fraunhofer CAP) and Vector Photonics on a new project exploring the potential of next-generation laser technology for high-performance optical communications in space.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 正在与弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心 (Fraunhofer CAP) 和 Vector Photonics 合作开展一个新项目，探索下一代激光技术在太空高性能光通信中的潜力。

paras.en: PERSEUS (PCSEL Environmental and Radiation Sensitivity: Evaluation for Use in Space) will investigate whether a promising new laser technology called Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers (PCSELs) is suitable for operation in space and can offer a differentiated capability for both space-to-space and space/ground networks.
paras.zh: PERSEUS（PCSEL环境和辐射敏感性：太空使用评估）将研究一种有前途的新型激光技术，称为光子晶体表面发射激光器（PCSEL）是否适合在太空中运行，并可以为空对空和空/地网络提供差异化​​的功能。

paras.en: The project will evaluate the technology under conditions relevant to space deployment, demonstrate its compatibility with representative spacecraft hardware, and identify the next engineering steps required to move towards a commercial solution.
paras.zh: 该项目将在与太空部署相关的条件下评估该技术，展示其与代表性航天器硬件的兼容性，并确定迈向商业解决方案所需的下一步工程步骤。

paras.en: The project is funded through the Advanced Connectivity Technologies (ACT) programme, delivered by Innovate UK and funded by the Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS). The ACT R&D Programme was announced by Minister Ian Murray during his speech at Connected Britain on 9 September 2026.
paras.zh: 该项目由先进连接技术 (ACT) 计划资助，该计划由创新英国组织实施，并由文化、媒体和体育部 (DCMS) 资助。 ACT 研发计划是由 Ian Murray 部长于 2026 年 9 月 9 日在 Connected Britain 上发表演讲时宣布的。

paras.en: Exploring a new approach to optical communications
paras.zh: 探索光通信新方法

paras.en: PCSEL technology offers the potential to address some of the limitations of existing optical and RF communications systems in space, supporting the move towards longer-range, higher-capacity, and more secure free-space optical links between ground stations, satellites, and potentially deeper-space assets.
paras.zh: PCSEL 技术有可能解决太空中现有光学和射频通信系统的一些局限性，支持地面站、卫星和潜在的深空资产之间建立更远距离、更高容量和更安全的自由空间光学链路。

paras.en: By bridging the gap between component and space system, PERSEUS will chart a course from disruptive technology to differentiated on-orbit capability for the fast-growing space market.
paras.zh: 通过弥合组件和太空系统之间的差距，PERSEUS 将为快速增长的太空市场制定从颠覆性技术到差异化在轨能力的路线。

paras.en: From device testing to spacecraft integration
paras.zh: 从设备测试到航天器集成

paras.en: The PERSEUS programme will subject PCSELs to a range of test campaigns expected of space qualified technologies, as well as carrying out long-range, high-bandwidth free-space demonstrations to showcase early performance.
paras.zh: PERSEUS 计划将使 PCSEL 接受一系列符合太空技术要求的测试活动，并进行远距离、高带宽自由空间演示，以展示早期性能。

paras.en: PCSEL devices will undergo characterisation and testing, including radiation, vibration, and thermal-vacuum campaigns, to better our understanding of how the technology fares in the launch and space environments.
paras.zh: PCSEL 设备将接受特性描述和测试，包括辐射、振动和热真空活动，以更好地了解该技术在发射和太空环境中的表现。

paras.en: Furthermore, the project will demonstrate early integration success with other flight-representative hardware for end-to-end data transmission, and develop mission concepts that harness the unique capabilities of PCSELs.
paras.zh: 此外，该项目还将展示与其他飞行代表硬件进行端到端数据传输的早期集成成功，并开发利用 PCSEL 独特功能的任务概念。

paras.en: The findings will feed into a future communications system design concept and help define the engineering roadmap required to progress PCSEL technology towards a differentiated space communications solution.
paras.zh: 研究结果将纳入未来的通信系统设计概念，并帮助定义将 PCSEL 技术发展为差异化空间通信解决方案所需的工程路线图。

paras.en: Bringing together photonics and space engineering expertise
paras.zh: 汇集光子学和空间工程专业知识

paras.en: At Craft Prospect, Head of Engineering Kevin Quillien is serving as Project Lead, supported by Chief Engineer Paul Yarr and Systems Engineers Lauryn Atkinson and Kairavi Pandit.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 的工程主管 Kevin Quillien 担任项目负责人，并得到总工程师 Paul Yarr 以及系统工程师 Lauryn Atkinson 和 Kairav Pandit 的支持。

paras.en: At Fraunhofer CAP, Dr Gerald Bonner is subcontract lead, while at Vector Photonics Dr Richard Taylor serves as subcontract lead and Dr Graham Goldberg as Project Manager.
paras.zh: 在 Fraunhofer CAP，Gerald Bonner 博士担任分包负责人，而在 Vector Photonics，Richard Taylor 博士担任分包负责人，Graham Goldberg 博士担任项目经理。

paras.en: The project also builds on Craft Prospect’s growing quantum-optical communications capability, including our work on OPS-SAT VOLT, where we are developing and testing space-to-ground free-space quantum and optical communications technologies as part of our wider mission to deliver Smart Secure Space.
paras.zh: 该项目还建立在 Craft Prospect 不断增长的量子光通信能力的基础上，包括我们在 OPS-SAT VOLT 上的工作，我们正在开发和测试空对地自由空间量子和光通信技术，作为我们提供智能安全空间的更广泛使命的一部分。

paras.en: Kevin Quillien, Project Lead and Head of Engineering Craft Prospect, said of the project:
paras.zh: 项目负责人兼 Engineering Craft Prospect 负责人 Kevin Quillien 谈到该项目时说道：

paras.en: ‘PERSEUS is an exciting opportunity to take a promising new photonics technology and understand the potential it has to offer the space industry.
paras.zh: “PERSEUS 是一个令人兴奋的机会，可以采用有前途的新型光子技术并了解它为航天工业带来的潜力。

paras.en: ‘By carrying out all the necessary early-stage work to test and characterise PCSELs for space, we will build a strong understanding of the potential that the technology offers in building the next generation of communication solutions. We’re looking forward to working with Fraunhofer CAP and Vector Photonics to explore where this roadmap will take us.’
paras.zh: “通过开展所有必要的早期工作来测试和表征太空 PCSEL，我们将深入了解该技术在构建下一代通信解决方案方面的潜力。我们期待与 Fraunhofer CAP 和 Vector Photonics 合作，探索该路线图将带我们走向何方。

paras.en: Craft Prospect is a Glasgow-based space engineering company advancing its vision of Smart Secure Space through onboard intelligence, quantum technologies, and satellite subsystem innovation. Learn more here.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 是一家总部位于格拉斯哥的空间工程公司，通过机载智能、量子技术和卫星子系统创新推进其智能安全空间的愿景。在这里了解更多。

paras.en: About Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics
paras.zh: 关于弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心

paras.en: Fraunhofer CAP is a not-for-profit research and technology organisation (RTO) offering industry a professional development capability in the fields of photonics, lasers and quantum technologies. Learn more about Fraunhofer CAP here.
paras.zh: Fraunhofer CAP 是一家非营利性研究和技术组织 (RTO)，为业界提供光子学、激光和量子技术领域的专业开发能力。点击此处了解有关弗劳恩霍夫 CAP 的更多信息。

articles.title: Ukrainian startup, GomSpace test satellite for future communications network
articles.author: Sandra Erwin

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Ukrainian defense technology company and a Danish satellite manufacturer have begun operating an experimental communications satellite in orbit.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——一家乌克兰国防技术公司和一家丹麦卫星制造商已经开始在轨道上运行一颗实验通信卫星。

paras.en: Ukrainian startup Himera and Denmark’s GomSpace said Oct. 27 that their Obria Nano satellite, launched Oct. 1 aboard the SpaceX Transporter-18 rideshare mission, is undergoing tests. The companies plan to design a constellation that would provide communications coverage across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰初创公司 Himera 和丹麦 GomSpace 于 10 月 27 日表示，他们的 Obria Nano 卫星于 10 月 1 日搭载 SpaceX Transporter-18 拼车任务发射，目前正在进行测试。两家公司计划设计一个星座，为整个乌克兰提供通信覆盖。

paras.en: The project is one of at least two European-backed initiatives aimed at giving Ukraine greater control over satellite communications, following disruptions this month to SpaceX’s Starlink and Starshield services that affected Ukrainian military operations.
paras.zh: 该项目是至少两项欧洲支持的举措之一，旨在让乌克兰更好地控制卫星通信，本月 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和 Starshield 服务中断，影响了乌克兰的军事行动。

paras.en: The announcement comes five days after Finnish satellite manufacturer Iceye and telecommunications equipment maker Nokia signed a letter of intent with Ukraine’s Defense Ministry to explore developing a sovereign broadband satellite communications network.
paras.zh: 五天前，芬兰卫星制造商 Iceye 和电信设备制造商诺基亚与乌克兰国防部签署了一份意向书，探讨开发主权宽带卫星通信网络。

paras.en: Ukraine has relied heavily on SpaceX’s satellite services for battlefield communications since Russia’s invasion in 2022. The services have become essential to military command networks, drone operations and communications in areas where terrestrial infrastructure has been destroyed or disrupted.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年俄罗斯入侵以来，乌克兰一直严重依赖 SpaceX 的卫星服务进行战场通信。这些服务对于地面基础设施遭到破坏或中断的地区的军事指挥网络、无人机操作和通信至关重要。

paras.en: But restrictions imposed in mid-October limited satellite connectivity, interfering with Ukrainian drone operations, including efforts to intercept Russian attack drones.
paras.zh: 但十月中旬实施的限制限制了卫星连接，干扰了乌克兰无人机的行动，包括拦截俄罗斯攻击无人机的努力。

paras.en: Ukraine said Oct. 24 that Starlink and Starshield services had returned to normal operating speeds. The disruptions prompted a dispute over responsibility, with SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk and U.S. officials offering conflicting explanations about who had authorized the limits.
paras.zh: 乌克兰10月24日表示，星链和星盾服务已恢复正常运行速度。这些干扰引发了责任纠纷，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和美国官员对于谁授权了这些限制给出了相互矛盾的解释。

paras.en: Himera and GomSpace said the Obria Nano project is intended to establish a communications system under Ukrainian control, with plans eventually to manufacture satellites and ground terminals domestically.
paras.zh: Himera 和 GomSpace 表示，Obria Nano 项目旨在建立乌克兰控制下的通信系统，并计划最终在国内制造卫星和地面终端。

paras.en: “For us, this project is about more than launching a satellite. It is an opportunity to lay the foundation for an independent communications network for Ukraine,” said Misha Rudominski, Himera’s co-founder and chief executive.
paras.zh: Himera 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Misha Rudominski 表示：“对我们来说，这个项目不仅仅是发射一颗卫星。这是一个为乌克兰独立通信网络奠定基础的机会。”

paras.en: “We are starting by testing technologies in orbit, while our long-term goal is to develop capabilities that will strengthen the country’s strategic security and reduce dependence on external communications providers,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们首先在轨道上测试技术，而我们的长期目标是发展加强国家战略安全并减少对外部通信提供商的依赖的能力。”

paras.en: Himera, founded in 2022, develops secure tactical radio systems for military forces, including equipment designed to operate in environments affected by electronic warfare.
paras.zh: Himera 成立于 2022 年，致力于为军队开发安全战术无线电系统，包括设计用于在受电子战影响的环境中运行的设备。

paras.en: GomSpace, headquartered in Aalborg, Denmark, manufactures small satellites, communications payloads and spacecraft subsystems.
paras.zh: GomSpace 总部位于丹麦奥尔堡，生产小型卫星、通信有效载荷和航天器子系统。

paras.en: The companies said Obria Nano is operating in orbit and undergoing testing that will inform the design of a constellation. They did not disclose the satellite’s specifications, communications capacity, project financing or the number of satellites envisioned for the network.
paras.zh: 两家公司表示，Obria Nano 正在轨道上运行并正在进行测试，这将为星座的设计提供信息。他们没有透露卫星的规格、通信能力、项目融资或网络中设想的卫星数量。

paras.en: Neither European initiative is expected to replace Starlink’s extensive global network. Smaller national constellations could provide dedicated communications for selected military operations while supplementing commercial services.
paras.zh: 预计这两项欧洲举措都不会取代星链广泛的全球网络。较小的国家星座可以为选定的军事行动提供专用通信，同时补充商业服务。

articles.title: Cyprus: Island of Snakes, Cats, and Ophiolites

paras.en: The island of Cyprus began to form some 90 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous, with molten rock pouring from the seafloor, solidifying, and building new oceanic crust. Over time, portions of this oceanic rock were wrenched upward by tectonic forces, eventually emerging as a rugged island made of ophiolite, a type of rock with a mottled green appearance said to look like the skin of a snake. Remnants of that ancient island are still visible in the dark rocks of the Troodos Mountains.
paras.zh: 塞浦路斯岛于约 9000 万年前的白垩纪晚期开始形成，熔岩从海底涌出，凝固并形成新的洋壳。随着时间的推移，这种海洋岩石的一部分被构造力向上扭动，最终形成一个由蛇绿岩构成的崎岖岛屿，蛇绿岩是一种具有斑驳绿色外观的岩石，据说看起来像蛇的皮肤。在特罗多斯山脉的黑色岩石中，仍然可以看到那个古老岛屿的遗迹。

paras.en: During the Miocene, considerably younger layers of chalk, limestone, marl, and other marine sedimentary rocks accumulated around the island, providing material that developed into a second, smaller island to the south during a later period of geologic uplift. Over time, sediment poured from rivers into the channel separating the two islands and combined with marine sediments to create deltas and eventually two land bridges, or tombolos. The joined landmass comprises the Akrotiri Peninsula, now the southernmost tip of Cyprus.
paras.zh: 在中新世期间，相当年轻的白垩层、石灰岩、泥灰岩和其他海洋沉积岩在岛屿周围堆积，为在后期地质隆起期间发展成为南部第二个较小岛屿提供了物质。随着时间的推移，沉积物从河流涌入分隔两个岛屿的河道，并与海洋沉积物结合形成三角洲，最终形成两座陆桥或连岛岛。连接的陆地包括阿克罗蒂里半岛，现在是塞浦路斯的最南端。

paras.en: The sandy edges of the peninsula were visible when Landsat 8 captured these images on October 10, 2026. Akrotiri Salt Lake, a coastal lagoon that was once an arm of the Mediterranean Sea, lies between the two tombolos. The more westerly feature, the Kouris River tombolo, formed first, developing about 50,000 years ago from river-deposited gravels and sands. The eastern tombolo extended southward from Cyprus, cutting off the Mediterranean Sea only within the past 2,000 years, according to geologists.
paras.zh: 当 Landsat 8 于 2026 年 10 月 10 日拍摄到这些图像时，半岛的沙质边缘清晰可见。阿克罗蒂里盐湖是一个沿海泻湖，曾经是地中海的一个海湾，位于两个连岛之间。更西边的库里斯河连岛岛 (Kouris River tombolo) 最先形成，约 5 万年前由河流沉积的砾石和沙子发育而成。据地质学家称，东部连岛群岛从塞浦路斯向南延伸，仅在过去 2000 年内切断了地中海。

paras.en: The lake's water levels now vary markedly with the seasons, typically filling in the late autumn and winter and drying out in the summer. The influx of winter water has historically attracted sizable overwintering flamingo populations, averaging about 4,000 birds. However, the wintering flamingo population has declined in recent years, plummeting to 30 birds in 2025, according to news reports. Flamingos have long flocked to the lake to feed on fairy shrimp, which are rich in colorful substances called carotenoids that give the birds their famously pink hue.
paras.zh: 现在，该湖的水位随季节变化明显，通常在秋末和冬季充水，在夏季干涸。历史上，冬季洪水的涌入吸引了大量的火烈鸟过冬，平均数量约为 4,000 只。然而，据新闻报道，越冬火烈鸟的数量近年来有所下降，到 2025 年将锐减至 30 只。长期以来，火烈鸟都成群结队地来到湖边以神仙虾为食，神仙虾富含一种叫做类胡萝卜素的彩色物质，使火烈鸟呈现出著名的粉红色调。

paras.en: Snakes are another of the island's more notorious animal inhabitants. In antiquity, Cyprus was known as Ophiousa, or "land of snakes," likely due to its robust population of blunt-nosed vipers. According to legend, the island's snake communities grew to be so problematic during a drought in the fourth century that the Roman Empress Helena, mother of Constantine the Great, called for shiploads of cats to be sent from Egypt to control the venomous reptiles.
paras.zh: 蛇是岛上另一种臭名昭著的动物居民。在古代，塞浦路斯被称为 Ophiousa，或“蛇之国”，可能是因为这里有大量的钝鼻毒蛇。据传说，四世纪的干旱期间，岛上的蛇群变得非常严重，以至于君士坦丁大帝的母亲罗马皇后海伦娜呼吁从埃及派遣一船的猫来控制这种有毒的爬行动物。

paras.en: The first feline imports were released in a particularly snake-infested area on the southeastern part of the Akrotiri Peninsula, an area that came to be known as Cape Gata (Cape Cat in Greek). The cape today is still home to the Holy Monastery of St. Nicholas of the Cats, a place where legend says that monks encouraged newly arrived Egyptian cats to hunt snakes. Today, Cyprus has as many cats as people, with more than one million of the feline predators stalking the island. The handful of nuns who now live in the monastery still care for hundreds of cats, according to the St. Nicholas Center.
paras.zh: 第一批进口猫科动物是在阿克罗蒂里半岛东南部一个蛇出没特别严重的地区放归的，这个地区后来被称为加塔角（希腊语中的猫角）。今天，海角仍然是圣尼古拉斯猫圣修道院的所在地，传说僧侣们在这里鼓励新来的埃及猫捕蛇。如今，塞浦路斯的猫科动物数量与人口数量一样多，岛上有超过一百万只猫科掠食者。据圣尼古拉斯中心称，现在住在修道院里的少数修女仍然照顾着数百只猫。

articles.title: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?

paras.en: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?
paras.zh: COP31 解释：今年的联合国气候峰会有什么利害关系？

paras.en: The world has more tools than ever to tackle climate change, yet millions remain unable to benefit from them. As clean energy technologies advance faster than ever, the challenge facing countries at COP31 is no longer just finding solutions – but making sure everyone can afford them.
paras.zh: 世界拥有比以往更多的工具来应对气候变化，但数百万人仍然无法从中受益。随着清洁能源技术的进步速度比以往任何时候都快，各国在 COP31 上面临的挑战不再只是寻找解决方案，而是确保每个人都能负担得起。

paras.en: Catastrophic floods, deadly heatwaves and prolonged droughts have been a hallmark of 2026, a year in which scientists confirmed that the world is on track to exceed the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C warming threshold.
paras.zh: 灾难性洪水、致命热浪和长期干旱是 2026 年的标志，科学家们证实这一年世界气温有望超过《巴黎协定》规定的 1.5°C 升温阈值。

paras.en: Against this backdrop, and with a powerful El Niño expected to intensify climate impacts further, representatives of more than 190 countries will gather in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9 to 20 November for COP31, the latest iteration of the keynote annual UN climate conference.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，强大的厄尔尼诺现象预计将进一步加剧气候影响，来自 190 多个国家的代表将于 11 月 9 日至 20 日齐聚土耳其安塔利亚，参加 COP31，这是联合国气候年度主题会议的最新一届。

paras.en: While fossil fuels remain the main driver of warming emissions, the technologies needed to move away from them are advancing at an extraordinary pace. Solar power, electric vehicles and battery storage are becoming increasingly accessible.
paras.zh: 虽然化石燃料仍然是温室气体排放的主要驱动因素，但摆脱化石燃料所需的技术正在以惊人的速度发展。太阳能、电动汽车和电池存储变得越来越容易获得。

paras.en: Yet many countries continue to struggle to benefit from them. Why?
paras.zh: 然而许多国家仍在努力从中受益。为什么？

paras.en: Ahead of the summit, UN News spoke with Selwin Hart, the UN Special Adviser on Climate Action and Just Transition, about what's at stake, what’s holding back progress and what another round of climate diplomacy can realistically achieve.
paras.zh: 峰会前，《联合国新闻》采访了联合国气候行动和公正转型特别顾问塞尔温·哈特，讨论了利害攸关的问题、阻碍进展的因素以及新一轮气候外交可以实际实现的目标。

paras.en: COP stands for Conference of the Parties, in this case, the countries that are parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). These annual gatherings allow governments to assess progress and negotiate how to tackle a challenge that no nation can solve alone.
paras.zh: COP 代表缔约方会议，在本例中是指《联合国气候变化框架公约》(UNFCCC) 的缔约方国家。这些年度聚会使各国政府能够评估进展情况并就如何应对任何国家都无法单独解决的挑战进行谈判。

paras.en: The talks produced the landmark Paris Agreement in 2015, when countries committed to keeping global warming well below 2°C and pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.
paras.zh: 会谈于 2015 年达成了具有里程碑意义的《巴黎协定》，各国承诺将全球变暖幅度控制在远低于 2°C 的范围内，并努力将其控制在比工业化前水平高 1.5°C 的范围内。

paras.en: COPs now extend well beyond government negotiations. Businesses, scientists, Indigenous Peoples, young people and civil society increasingly participate, reflecting the scale of the challenge.
paras.zh: 缔约方会议现在的范围远远超出了政府谈判的范围。企业、科学家、原住民、年轻人和民间社会越来越多地参与其中，反映出挑战的规模。

paras.en: “There’s now a clear recognition that addressing the climate crisis requires all hands on deck,” Mr. Hart explains.
paras.zh: “现在人们清楚地认识到，解决气候危机需要所有人齐心协力，”哈特先生解释道。

paras.en: A COP is often judged by the agreement reached at the end, sometimes after days of difficult discussions and last-minute compromises. But Mr. Hart argues that this tells only part of the story.
paras.zh: 缔约方会议通常根据最后达成的协议来评判，有时是经过数天的艰难讨论和最后一刻的妥协。但哈特先生认为这只是故事的一部分。

paras.en: He identifies three ways these conferences can make a difference:
paras.zh: 他指出了这些会议可以发挥作用的三种方式：

paras.en: - Negotiated agreements: Countries seek consensus on issues such as climate finance, emissions reductions and adaptation, though geopolitical divisions often make ambitious outcomes difficult.
paras.zh: - 谈判达成的协议：各国寻求在气候融资、减排和适应等问题上达成共识，尽管地缘政治分歧常常使雄心勃勃的成果变得困难。

paras.en: - The Action Agenda: Governments, development banks, businesses and civil society organizations work together on practical solutions, from expanding renewable energy and modernizing electricity networks to reducing methane emissions.
paras.zh: - 行动议程：各国政府、开发银行、企业和民间社会组织共同努力制定切实可行的解决方案，从扩大可再生能源和现代化电力网络到减少甲烷排放。

paras.en: - National commitments: Countries use COPs to announce actions at home, including new climate plans, commitments to move away from fossil fuels and contributions to climate funds.
paras.zh: - 国家承诺：各国利用缔约方大会宣布国内行动，包括新的气候计划、放弃化石燃料的承诺以及对气候基金的捐款。

paras.en: “There’s sometimes this expectation that COPs will always have this big grand deal that will solve the climate crisis. That’s not realistic,” Mr. Hart says.
paras.zh: “有时人们期望缔约方会议总会达成解决气候危机的重大协议。这是不现实的，”哈特先生说。

paras.en: There’s sometimes this expectation that COPs will always have this big grand deal that will solve the climate crisis. That’s not realistic
paras.zh: 有时人们期望缔约方会议总会达成解决气候危机的重大协议。这不现实

paras.en: This year, Türkiye will host and preside, while Australia is leading the negotiations, working closely with Pacific Island countries.
paras.zh: 今年，土耳其将主办并主持谈判，澳大利亚则牵头谈判，并与太平洋岛国密切合作。

paras.en: The summit places particular emphasis on implementation, with Türkiye promoting initiatives on clean energy, food security, resilient cities, greener industries, oceans and waste reduction.
paras.zh: 峰会特别强调落实，土耳其推动清洁能源、粮食安全、弹性城市、绿色工业、海洋和减少废物等方面的倡议。

paras.en: “I’m running a personal campaign to rename the Action Agenda, the Implementation Agenda,” says the top climate adviser, underscoring the need to move beyond promises and focus on practical solutions.
paras.zh: 这位最高气候顾问表示：“我正在开展一场个人运动，将行动议程重新命名为实施议程。”他强调，需要超越承诺，专注于实际解决方案。

paras.en: Behind the diplomatic language are decisions that could affect millions of lives. Several major issues remain unresolved:
paras.zh: 外交语言的背后是可能影响数百万人生命的决定。有几个主要问题仍未解决：

paras.en: - Climate finance: Developing countries want wealthier nations to fulfil their financial commitments under the Paris Agreement, while disagreements persist over funding responsibilities, access to finance and how global financial flows can be directed towards climate action.
paras.zh: - 气候融资：发展中国家希望富裕国家履行《巴黎协定》下的财政承诺，但在资金责任、融资渠道以及如何将全球资金流引导至气候行动方面仍存在分歧。

paras.en: - Just transition: Countries agreed last year to establish a mechanism to support the shift to cleaner economies – but still need to decide how it will work.
paras.zh: - 公正转型：各国去年同意建立一个机制来支持向清洁经济转型，但仍需要决定该机制如何运作。

paras.en: - Adaptation: Negotiators will continue to work on measuring progress while developing countries press for greater financial support.
paras.zh: - 适应：谈判代表将继续努力衡量进展情况，同时发展中国家要求提供更多财政支持。

paras.en: - Cutting emissions: Governments remain divided over how to strengthen emissions action and deliver on existing commitments.
paras.zh: - 减少排放：各国政府对于如何加强排放行动和兑现现有承诺仍存在分歧。

paras.en: COP31 will also launch the second global stocktake, the Paris Agreement’s formal process for assessing collective progress towards its long-term goals.
paras.zh: COP31 还将启动第二次全球盘点，这是《巴黎协定》评估其长期目标集体进展的正式程序。

paras.en: But, haven’t we already lost the fight against global warming?
paras.zh: 但是，我们不是已经输掉了对抗全球变暖的斗争吗？

paras.en: Scientists warn that the world is set to temporarily exceed the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C warming threshold, a situation known as overshoot. But how far temperatures rise, and for how long, still depends on the choices governments, businesses and societies make today.
paras.zh: 科学家警告说，世界将暂时超过《巴黎协定》规定的 1.5°C 升温阈值，这种情况被称为“超调”。但气温上升多少以及持续多长时间，仍然取决于政府、企业和社会今天做出的选择。

paras.en: “Overshoot is not surrender. Overshoot should really lead to a much greater degree of urgency,” Mr Hart says, calling for faster emissions cuts and greater investment in protecting vulnerable communities.
paras.zh: “超调并不是投降。超调确实应该导致更大程度的紧迫性，”哈特先生说，他呼吁加快减排速度并加大投资力度来保护脆弱社区。

paras.en: Despite the warning, he sees reasons for optimism.
paras.zh: 尽管有警告，他还是看到了乐观的理由。

paras.en: “The good news in this horrible situation of overshoot is that the world has never been better equipped to solve this challenge,” he says, pointing to the rapid expansion of electric vehicles, solar energy and battery storage.
paras.zh: “在这种可怕的超调情况下，好消息是，世界从未有过更好的装备来应对这一挑战，”他指出电动汽车、太阳能和电池存储的快速扩张。

paras.en: Just a decade ago, the clean energy transition looked very different. The technological frontier is expanding at a remarkable pace.
paras.zh: 就在十年前，清洁能源转型看起来非常不同。技术前沿正在以惊人的速度扩展。

paras.en: - Electric vehicles: Ten years ago, fewer than one in 100 new cars sold worldwide was electric. In 2025, it was one in four, and that share is expected to reach 28 per cent in 2026.
paras.zh: - 电动汽车：十年前，全球售出的新车中只有不到百分之一是电动汽车。 2025 年，这一比例将达到四分之一，预计 2026 年这一比例将达到 28%。

paras.en: - Solar power: The world added more than 600 gigawatts of solar power capacity in 2025, accounting for over three-quarters of new renewable power capacity.
paras.zh: - 太阳能：到2025年，全球新增太阳能发电容量将超过600吉瓦，占新增可再生能源发电容量的四分之三以上。

paras.en: - Battery storage: Global battery storage capacity is now 11 times higher than in 2021. In 2025 alone, the world added 108 GW – 40 per cent more than the previous year. These systems allow electricity generated by solar panels and wind turbines to be stored and used later
paras.zh: - 电池存储：全球电池存储容量目前比 2021 年高出 11 倍。仅 2025 年，全球就新增了 108 GW，比上一年增加了 40%。这些系统可以存储太阳能电池板和风力涡轮机产生的电力并供以后使用

paras.en: If the solutions exist, what’s holding us back?
paras.zh: 如果解决方案存在，是什么阻碍了我们？

paras.en: Clean energy investment has grown rapidly, but its benefits have been far from equally distributed.
paras.zh: 清洁能源投资增长迅速，但其效益分配却很不平衡。

paras.en: Emerging and developing economies outside China, home to nearly two-thirds of the world's population, received just 18 per cent of global clean energy investment in 2025.
paras.zh: 中国以外的新兴和发展中经济体拥有世界近三分之二的人口，但到 2025 年，它们仅获得全球清洁能源投资的 18%。

paras.en: Africa illustrates the challenge. Despite its enormous renewable energy potential, the continent attracts only a small share of global investment, while around 600 million people still lack access to electricity.
paras.zh: 非洲就说明了这一挑战。尽管可再生能源潜力巨大，但非洲大陆仅吸引了全球投资的一小部分，而约 6 亿人仍然无法用上电力。

paras.en: Mr. Hart says capital investment is one of the biggest obstacles. Financing renewable energy projects in developing countries can cost several times more than in wealthier nations, even when the technology is identical.
paras.zh: 哈特先生表示，资本投资是最大的障碍之一。即使技术相同，发展中国家可再生能源项目的融资成本也可能比富裕国家高出几倍。

paras.en: “So, our task now, in this second decade of the Paris Agreement, is to ensure that we remove the barriers to implementation, the barriers to faster action in these economies,” he explains.
paras.zh: “因此，在《巴黎协定》的第二个十年里，我们现在的任务是确保消除实施障碍，以及这些经济体更快采取行动的障碍，”他解释道。

paras.en: For countries already struggling with heavy debt burdens, the challenge is particularly difficult, leaving governments with limited resources to invest in healthcare, education and climate protection.
paras.zh: 对于已经在沉重债务负担中挣扎的国家来说，这一挑战尤其困难，导致政府投资于医疗保健、教育和气候保护的资源有限。

paras.en: “We need solutions on finance that will not increase debt,” Mr. Hart stresses.
paras.zh: “我们需要不会增加债务的金融解决方案，”哈特先生强调。

paras.en: COP31 will not solve the climate crisis in two weeks. But it could help remove some of the barriers standing between the solutions already available and the people who need them.
paras.zh: COP31不会在两周内解决气候危机。但它可以帮助消除现有解决方案与需要它们的人们之间的一些障碍。

paras.en: For millions living with the consequences of a warming planet, that is what will matter long after the summit ends.
paras.zh: 对于数以百万计生活在地球变暖后果中的人来说，这才是峰会结束后很长一段时间内最重要的事情。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force

paras.en: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：刚果民主共和国平民被杀，乌克兰人努力回返，古特雷斯呼吁武力“正常化”

paras.en: At least 30 civilians were killed overnight on Thursday in Beni Territory, North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local sources cited by the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
paras.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室 (OCHA) 援引当地消息人士称，刚果民主共和国北基伍省贝尼地区周四夜间至少有 30 名平民丧生。

paras.en: During the attack, attributed by local authorities to extremist rebel group the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) – according to news reports – homes were burnt and a health centre was destroyed, killing several patients.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，地方当局将这次袭击归咎于极端反叛组织民主同盟军 (ADF)，袭击期间房屋被烧毁，一个医疗中心被摧毁，导致数名患者死亡。

paras.en: The insecurity has also disrupted the Ebola response. People who had been in contact with Ebola patients reportedly fled an observation centre, and response teams were forced to suspend operations, making it harder to track infections and contain the outbreak.
paras.zh: 不安全局势也扰乱了埃博拉应对工作。据报道，与埃博拉患者接触过的人逃离了观察中心，反应小组被迫暂停行动，这使得追踪感染和控制疫情变得更加困难。

paras.en: Authorities have reported more than 10,700 confirmed cases and over 5,200 deaths.
paras.zh: 当局已报告确诊病例超过 10,700 例，死亡人数超过 5,200 人。

paras.en: The UN called on all parties to protect civilians, respect international humanitarian law and ensure safe, unhindered access for humanitarian and health workers, warning that continued violence is costing lives and undermining efforts to contain the outbreak.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁各方保护平民，尊重国际人道主义法，确保人道主义和卫生工作者安全、不受阻碍地进入，并警告说，持续的暴力正在造成生命损失，并破坏遏制疫情的努力。

paras.en: Asked about burial practices during the ongoing outbreak, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told reporters in New York they were being addressed through community outreach.
paras.zh: 当被问及疫情持续爆发期间的埋葬做法时，联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 在纽约告诉记者，这些问题正在通过社区外展得到解决。

paras.en: He noted that disinformation about the work of frontline health workers had led to attacks on staff.
paras.zh: 他指出，有关一线卫生工作者工作的虚假信息导致了对工作人员的袭击。

paras.en: He praised the courage of workers, “most of whom are Congolese”, who continue to battle the disease and save lives amid the fighting between armed groups which has roiled the region for decades.
paras.zh: 他赞扬了工人们的勇气，“其中大多数是刚果人”，他们在数十年来困扰该地区的武装团体之间的战斗中继续与疾病作斗争并拯救生命。

paras.en: Displaced Ukrainians return home but most do not say: IOM
paras.zh: 流离失所的乌克兰人返回家园，但大多数人没有说：国际移民组织

paras.en: Ukrainians displaced by the war continue to make frequent journeys back to their country without returning permanently, according to a new study published Friday.
paras.zh: 周五发表的一项新研究显示，因战争而流离失所的乌克兰人继续频繁返回自己的国家，但没有永久返回。

paras.en: Commissioned by the UN International Organization for Migration (IOM), the report found that nearly nine in 10 displaced Ukrainians crossing back from Poland planned to stay in their home country for no more than 30 days.
paras.zh: 受联合国国际移民组织 (IOM) 委托，这份报告发现，从波兰回国的流离失所的乌克兰人中，近十分之九计划在自己的祖国停留不超过 30 天。

paras.en: Respondents had spent almost three years abroad – on average – yet ties to home remain strong. More than three-quarters had crossed the border at least three times since being displaced.
paras.zh: 受访者平均在国外度过了近三年的时间，但与家乡的联系依然紧密。超过四分之三的人自流离失所以来至少跨越过边境三次。

paras.en: “For many Ukrainians, going home means seeing family, getting medical care or spending a few days in a place they have missed for years,” said Arthur Erken, IOM Regional Director for Europe and Central Asia.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织欧洲和中亚区域主任阿瑟·埃尔肯 (Arthur Erken) 表示：“对于许多乌克兰人来说，回家意味着见到家人、获得医疗护理或在他们多年来错过的地方度过几天。”

paras.en: But he added that “a visit is not the same as being able to stay. Many are still living between their home country and where they reside, making repeated journeys to hold on to the people and places that matter to them.”
paras.zh: 但他补充说，“访问并不等于能够留下来。许多人仍然生活在祖国和居住地之间，不断往返，以留住对他们重要的人和地方。”

paras.en: Most visits back to Ukraine were to reunite with family, with 85 per cent intending to return to their region of origin.
paras.zh: 大多数返回乌克兰的目的是与家人团聚，其中 85% 的人打算返回原籍地区。

paras.en: However, only eight per cent planned to remain in Ukraine for more than a month.
paras.zh: 然而，只有百分之八的人计划在乌克兰停留一个多月。

paras.en: Security concerns, damage to housing, limited income opportunities and healthcare needs, continue to hinder sustainable returns.
paras.zh: 安全问题、住房受损、收入机会有限和医疗保健需求继续阻碍可持续回报。

paras.en: Latest UN data indicates that about 5.9 million Ukrainians remain displaced abroad as refugees.
paras.zh: 联合国最新数据显示，仍有约 590 万乌克兰人在国外流离失所，成为难民。

paras.en: UN chief: Charter rules apply to all, with ‘no double standards’
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长：宪章规则适用于所有人，“不存在双重标准”

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned on Friday against the normalisation of force and the erosion of international law, in a speech at Spain’s University of Salamanca less than two months before his term ends.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯周五在西班牙萨拉曼卡大学发表讲话，警告不要武力正常化和国际法受到侵蚀，此时距离他的任期还有不到两个月。

paras.en: “The unlawful use of force is becoming normalised,” he said, after receiving an honorary doctorate. “Borders are being redrawn by force of arms. Too many States take an à la carte approach to international law.”
paras.zh: “非法使用武力正在变得常态化，”他在获得荣誉博士学位后说道。 “边界正在通过武力重新划定。太多国家对国际法采取点菜方式。”

paras.en: From Ukraine to Sudan, the Sahel and Gaza, civilians are the first to suffer, Mr. Guterres said, while “every crime that goes unpunished paves the way for the next.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯表示，从乌克兰到苏丹、萨赫勒地区和加沙地带，平民首当其冲，而“每一次未受惩罚的犯罪行为都为下一次犯罪铺平了道路”。

paras.en: “The Charter lays down the same rule for everyone,” he said. “No exceptions. No double standards.”
paras.zh: “宪章为每个人制定了同样的规则，”他说。 “没有例外。没有双重标准。”

paras.en: He invoked Francisco de Vitoria, the theologian who taught at Salamanca in the 16th century and is seen as a forerunner of international law. His legacy endures, the UN chief said: “Power must be subject to the law.”
paras.zh: 他援引了 16 世纪在萨拉曼卡任教的神学家弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚 (Francisco de Vitoria)，他被视为国际法的先驱。联合国秘书长表示，他的遗产永垂不朽：“权力必须服从法律。”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres called the lack of a permanent Security Council seat for Africa and for Latin America and the Caribbean “a historic injustice that we must rectify”. He also noted that military spending is breaking records while aid is plummeting.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生称非洲以及拉丁美洲和加勒比地区缺乏安理会常任理事国席位是“我们必须纠正的历史性不公正现象”。他还指出，军费开支正在打破记录，而援助却直线下降。

paras.en: “Terms of office come and go,” he said. “The struggle for peace, dignity and justice continues.”
paras.zh: “任期来来去去，”他说。 “争取和平、尊严和正义的斗争仍在继续。”

articles.title: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions

paras.en: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions
paras.zh: 阿富汗因广泛的权利限制而面临日益加深的人道主义危机

paras.en: Afghanistan stands at a “difficult crossroad” more than five years after the Taliban returned to power, a senior UN official said on Friday. Relative stability and security are being undercut by a fragile economy, sweeping curbs on rights and acute humanitarian need.
paras.zh: 联合国高级官员周五表示，塔利班重新掌权五年多后，阿富汗正处于“艰难的十字路口”。脆弱的经济、全面的权利限制和迫切的人道主义需求正在削弱相对的稳定和安全。

paras.en: Bruno Lemarquis is the Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General for Afghanistan. He is also the UN’s Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in the country.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·勒马奎斯是负责阿富汗问题的秘书长副特别代表。他还是联合国驻该国的驻地和人道主义协调员。

paras.en: Women and girls continue to suffer from “severe and sweeping” restrictions on their freedoms, being deprived of many spaces to learn, work and participate in public life, Mr. Lemarquis stressed.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯先生强调，妇女和女童的自由继续受到“严重和全面”的限制，被剥夺了许多学习、工作和参与公共生活的空间。

paras.en: In particular, the restriction of girls’ access to education represents “one of the world’s most sensitive…education challenges,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，特别是，对女孩接受教育的限制代表了“世界上最敏感的……教育挑战之一”。

paras.en: Since 2021, over 2.6 million girls have been denied secondary education, and female university enrollment currently stands at zero.
paras.zh: 自 2021 年以来，超过 260 万女童无法接受中等教育，目前女性大学入学率为零。

paras.en: But higher education overall is in crisis: due to the country’s economic frailty, some families are also holding back from sending their boys to school.
paras.zh: 但高等教育总体上正处于危机之中：由于国家经济脆弱，一些家庭也不愿送孩子上学。

paras.en: When asked by a journalist how the Taliban justify their restrictions on women and girls, Mr. Lemarquis said their explanations are a mix of religious extremism and deep historical practices of control and discrimination.
paras.zh: 当记者问塔利班如何证明其对妇女和女孩的限制合理时，勒马奎斯表示，他们的解释是宗教极端主义和根深蒂固的历史控制和歧视做法的结合。

paras.en: Since September 2025, Afghan women staffers have also been banned from entering United Nations premises across the country, and the ban has not been lifted.
paras.zh: 自2025年9月起，阿富汗女工作人员也被禁止进入全国各地的联合国房地，且禁令至今仍未解除。

paras.en: The “massive” return of 6.7 million nationals to Afghanistan since 2020 is also placing additional strain on its already stretched services.
paras.zh: 自 2020 年以来，670 万国民“大规模”返回阿富汗，也给其本已捉襟见肘的服务带来了额外的压力。

paras.en: Many were forcibly expelled from the neighbouring countries that were hosting them, with a large portion coming from Pakistan and Iran.
paras.zh: 许多人被强行驱逐出收容他们的邻国，其中很大一部分来自巴基斯坦和伊朗。

paras.en: Mr. Lemarquis said he had met many who had to return to Afghanistan despite never having lived there before. This included a 45-year-old father born abroad who had ended up back in his ancestral village along with his children.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯表示，他遇到了许多不得不返回阿富汗的人，尽管他们以前从未在那里生活过。其中包括一位出生在国外的 45 岁父亲，他最终和孩子们一起回到了自己祖籍的村庄。

paras.en: He stressed that these returnees need legal documentation, protection and “jobs, jobs, jobs.”
paras.zh: 他强调，这些返回者需要法律文件、保护和“工作、工作、工作”。

paras.en: For decades, Afghanistan was the world’s biggest source of illicit opium, but its cultivation dropped dramatically following a 2022 Taliban ban.
paras.zh: 几十年来，阿富汗一直是世界上最大的非法鸦片来源地，但在 2022 年塔利班颁布禁令后，其种植面积急剧下降。

paras.en: Yet Mr. Lemarquis cited a recent UN report which found opium poppy production increasing by 330 per cent during 2025, with farmers finding ways of hiding their production from the Taliban.
paras.zh: 然而，勒马奎斯先生引用了联合国最近的一份报告，该报告发现，2025 年罂粟产量增加了 330%，而农民则想方设法向塔利班隐瞒自己的产量。

paras.en: For eradication to be effective, he said, there needs to be viable alternatives to making a living.
paras.zh: 他说，为了有效地根除这一疾病，需要有可行的谋生替代方案。

paras.en: “We cannot survive. And we don’t want to die,” some farmers told him, talking about how little income they would make without opium cultivation.
paras.zh: “我们无法生存。而且我们不想死，”一些农民告诉他，如果不种植鸦片，他们的收入将是多么少。

paras.en: Humanitarian needs in Afghanistan are expected to rise starkly in 2027 due to a combination of shocks – the mass influx of returnees, regional instability and the stronger-than-ever El Nino weather pattern together seriously threaten food security and access to services.
paras.zh: 由于一系列冲击，阿富汗的人道主义需求预计将在 2027 年急剧上升——大量回返者涌入、地区不稳定以及比以往任何时候都严重的厄尔尼诺天气模式，共同严重威胁粮食安全和服务的获取。

paras.en: Yet at the same time, humanitarian funding is being cut year-on-year. In 2023, the humanitarian response reached $2 billion, in 2025 it halved to $1 billion, and so far in 2026 it has only amounted to $570 million, roughly a quarter of 2023 levels.
paras.zh: 但与此同时，人道主义资金却逐年削减。 2023年，人道主义应急资金达到20亿美元，2025年减半至10亿美元，而2026年迄今为止仅达到5.7亿美元，大约是2023年水平的四分之一。

paras.en: 40 per cent of primary healthcare facilities are expected to close between 2025 and 2026 – corresponding to 700 health posts out of 1,900 across the country.
paras.zh: 预计 40% 的初级医疗机构将在 2025 年至 2026 年间关闭——相当于全国 1,900 个卫生站中的 700 个。

paras.en: The consequences are “very, very, very significant,” Mr. Lemarquis stressed, urging the international community not to turn its back of Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 勒马奎斯强调，其后果“非常、非常、非常严重”，并敦促国际社会不要背弃阿富汗。

paras.en: “And there is a saying in Afghanistan that is ‘What is happening in Afghanistan is not staying in Afghanistan,’” he said.
paras.zh: “阿富汗有句俗话，‘阿富汗发生的事情不能留在阿富汗’，”他说。

paras.en: “The consequences could go beyond the Afghanistan border, potentially affecting regional security, regional stability and migration pathways.”
paras.zh: “其后果可能超出阿富汗边境，可能影响地区安全、地区稳定和移民通道。”

articles.title: WTA chair apologises to Pegula after 'diva' comment broadcast

paras.en: WTA chair apologises to Jessica Pegula after airing of 'diva' comment about Mirra Andreeva, confirms audio deactivated on practice courts at Indian Wells
paras.zh: WTA主席在发表有关米拉·安德烈娃的“天后”评论后向杰西卡·佩古拉道歉，并确认印第安维尔斯练习场的音频已关闭

paras.en: Jessica Pegula was heard saying Mirra Andreeva needed to be "humbled" during a practice session ahead of the WTA Finals in California; American hopes incident can help players to "keep pushing for more privacy"; watch tournament from Sunday, live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula) 表示，在加州 WTA 总决赛之前的练习中，米拉·安德烈娃 (Mirra Andreeva) 需要“谦虚”。美国希望事件能够帮助玩家“继续争取更多的隐私”；从周日开始观看天空体育直播的比赛

paras.en: Audio recording on practice courts will be deactivated at the WTA Finals after private comments made by Jessica Pegula about Mirra Andreeva were picked up, with the governing body's chair apologising to the American for the "regrettable" incident.
paras.zh: 在杰西卡·佩古拉（Jessica Pegula）对米拉·安德烈娃（Mirra Andreeva）的私人评论被采纳后，WTA年终总决赛练习场上的录音将被停用，管理机构主席就这一“令人遗憾”的事件向美国选手道歉。

paras.en: US player Pegula describing Russian teenager Andreeva as "a diva" while conversing with coach Mark Knowles during a practice session were heard on a YouTube livestream at Indian Wells, the venue for the WTA Tour season-ending event from November 8-15.
paras.zh: 在印第安维尔斯举行的 YouTube 直播中，美国选手佩古拉在练习赛中与教练马克·诺尔斯交谈时将俄罗斯少年安德烈耶娃描述为“天后”。印第安维尔斯是 11 月 8 日至 15 日举行的 WTA 巡回赛赛季末赛事的举办地。

paras.en: The WTA shouldered the blame for failing to properly inform players about active microphones, with chair Valerie Camillo saying there was "a lack of advanced notice and clear signage" as she confirmed audio will now be switched off for practice sessions.
paras.zh: WTA 承担了未能正确告知球员有关麦克风活动情况的责任，主席瓦莱丽·卡米洛 (Valerie Camillo) 表示，“缺乏提前通知和清晰的标志”，她确认现在将在练习赛中关闭音频。

paras.en: - Pundits' predictions for the WTA Finals at Indian Wells
paras.zh: - 专家对印第安维尔斯 WTA 决赛的预测

paras.en: - Download Sky Sports app for analysis, news and video
paras.zh: - 下载天空体育应用程序进行分析、新闻和视频

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播

paras.en: Camillo added: "I want to specifically apologise to Jessica Pegula and [coach] Mark Knowles. What happened was regrettable and unacceptable.
paras.zh: 卡米洛补充道：“我想特别向杰西卡·佩古拉和[教练]马克·诺尔斯道歉。发生的事情令人遗憾和不可接受。

paras.en: "Jess is one of the WTA's best advocates and biggest stars. She does not deserve this distraction.
paras.zh: “杰西是 WTA 最好的倡导者和最大牌的明星之一。她不应该受到这种干扰。

paras.en: "As a member organisation, one of the primary responsibilities of the WTA is to protect players whenever possible. The players deserve better and we will continue to work to raise the bar for the WTA."
paras.zh: “作为一个成员组织，WTA 的主要职责之一就是尽可能保护球员。球员应该得到更好的待遇，我们将继续努力提高 WTA 的标准。”

paras.en: Pegula: Let's keep pushing for more privacy
paras.zh: 佩古拉：让我们继续争取更多的隐私

paras.en: Pegula, who was also heard saying French Open champion Andreeva "needs to be humbled" and that her coach, former Wimbledon winner, Conchita Martinez, encouraged her player's behaviour, addressed the incident on ESPN on Friday.
paras.zh: 佩古拉周五在 ESPN 上谈到了这一事件，她还表示法网冠军安德烈耶娃“需要谦虚”，并且她的教练、前温布尔登冠军孔奇塔·马丁内斯鼓励她球员的行为。

paras.en: The world No 5 said: "Obviously I had no idea and was not informed that audio was being recorded. But it is what it is.
paras.zh: 世界第五说道：“显然我不知道，也没有被告知音频正在被录制。但事实就是如此。

paras.en: "I think it's something that we have fought a lot over the last couple years as there's a lot more surveillance, audio and, I guess, access to the players at tournaments than there has been in the past.
paras.zh: “我认为这是我们在过去几年里一直在努力解决的问题，因为与过去相比，现在有更多的监控、音频，而且我想，在比赛中接触球员的情况也更多了。

paras.en: "I know for broadcasting that it's great for fans, but I think we've seen a couple incidents now throughout the year, the last couple of years really, where it seems highly unnecessary.
paras.zh: “我知道对于广播来说这对粉丝来说很棒，但我认为我们一年中已经看到了几起事件，实际上是过去几年，这似乎非常没有必要。

paras.en: "I think [this will] definitely reignite the topic. Hopefully we can use this incident to keep pushing for more player privacy."
paras.zh: “我认为[这]肯定会重新引发这个话题。希望我们可以利用这一事件来继续推动更多的玩家隐私。”

paras.en: Two-time Grand Slam champion Coco Gauff - in Pegula's group at the WTA Finals, alongside Linda Noskova and world No 1 Elena Rybakina - called for more privacy in January after cameras caught her smashing her racket following defeat to Elina Svitolina at the Australian Open quarter-finals in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 两届大满贯冠军可可·高夫在 WTA 总决赛中与佩古拉同组，与琳达·诺斯科娃和世界排名第一的埃琳娜·雷巴基娜并列。一月份，在墨尔本举行的澳大利亚网球公开赛四分之一决赛中输给埃琳娜·斯维托丽娜后，摄像机拍到她摔碎球拍，她呼吁更多的隐私。

paras.en: Watch the WTA Finals live on Sky Sports from November 15-22, with world No 1 Elena Rybakina the defending champion. Stream tennis with no contract through NOW and on the Sky Sports App.
paras.zh: 11 月 15 日至 22 日，观看天空体育直播的 WTA 总决赛，世界排名第一的埃琳娜·瑞巴基娜 (Elena Rybakina) 是卫冕冠军。通过 NOW 和天空体育应用程序观看无合同的网球比赛。

articles.title: Castle Cove chases the repeat bid in the November Handicap

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Doncaster, Southwell and Uttoxeter
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：唐卡斯特、绍斯韦尔和尤托克西特

paras.en: In today’s feature, Castle Cove returns from a year off to make it back-to-back successes in an ultra-competitive edition of the November Handicap at Doncaster. We also have competitive action from Southwell and Uttoxeter, live on Sky Sports Racing from 11.55am
paras.zh: 在今天的专题中，Castle Cove 队在休整一年后回归，在唐卡斯特举行的 11 月盘口赛的竞争异常激烈的比赛中连续取得成功。我们还提供来自 Southwell 和 Uttoxeter 的竞技比赛，天空体育赛车从上午 11.55 开始直播

paras.en: We have a busy day’s racing on Saturday with action from Doncaster, Southwell and Uttoxeter, live on Sky Sports Racing...
paras.zh: 周六我们将进行忙碌的一天比赛，来自唐卡斯特、绍斯韦尔和尤托克西特的比赛将由天空体育赛车直播……

paras.en: 3.25 Doncaster - Last year's winner Castle Cove faces Nobody Knows
paras.zh: 3.25 唐卡斯特 - 去年的冠军 Castle Cove 面对无人知晓

paras.en: A typically competitive Virgin Bet November Handicap sees last year's winner Castle Cove and ante-post favourite Nobody Knows headline a field of 23.
paras.zh: 在典型的 Virgin Bet 11 月让分盘中，去年的冠军 Castle Cove 和赛前热门的无人知晓 (Nobody Knows) 占据了 23 个席位。

paras.en: William Haggas' Castle Cove has not been seen since landing this pot under Jason Hart last season and rates a fascinating runner under new pilot Cieren Fallon. Up eight pounds from last year's ready success, he must be considered if fit enough on this return.
paras.zh: 威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 的《城堡湾》(Castle Cove) 自从上赛季在杰森·哈特 (Jason Hart) 的带领下登陆以来就再也没有出现过，并在新飞行员西伦·法伦 (Cieren Fallon) 的带领下评价了一位迷人的跑步者。与去年的成功相比，他的体重增加了八磅，必须考虑他在这次回归中是否足够健康。

paras.en: Nobody Knows has been at the head of the betting for this contest since Monday and Richard Hughes has booked the services of Ryan Moore. The three-year-old caught the eye when staying on to finish fifth at York last month and is expected to step forward again over this extra yardage.
paras.zh: 自周一以来，“无人知晓”一直是这场比赛的投注领头羊，理查德·休斯已经预订了瑞安·摩尔的服务。这位三岁马上个月在约克站获得第五名时引起了人们的注意，预计他将在这一额外码数上再次前进。

paras.en: - King's former horse Point Of Law wins Melbourne Cup
paras.zh: - King 的前任马 Point Of Law 赢得墨尔本杯

paras.en: - Watch: Sovereignty is crowned King in the Breeders' Cup Classic
paras.zh: - 观看：Sovereignty 在育马者杯经典赛中加冕为王

paras.en: Stablemates Circus Of Rome and Duraji have each-way claims on the best of their form, while Alfred Wincham is another to note. He won by an eased down eight lengths at York on his last outing and must defy a 13-pound higher mark.
paras.zh: 罗马马戏团 (Circus Of Rome) 和杜拉吉 (Duraji) 的同伙都声称自己处于最佳状态，而阿尔弗雷德·温查姆 (Alfred Wincham) 也是值得注意的。上一场比赛中，他在约克以 8 杆的优势获胜，并且必须挑战 13 磅的更高分数。

paras.en: 2.10 Doncaster - Coul Angel and Montassib contest Listed cavalry charge
paras.zh: 2.10 唐卡斯特 - Coul Angel 和 Montassib 较量 列出骑兵冲锋

paras.en: Coul Angel and Montassib feature among a field of 21 sprinters for this Listed Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes.
paras.zh: Coul Angel 和 Montassib 是参加本次上市 Virgin Bet 每周六退款 Wentworth 锦标赛的 21 名短跑选手之一。

paras.en: Coul Angel arrives on a hat-trick having scored in handicap company at the Curragh and York the last twice. He is now five pounds higher as he heads into Listed company for the first time.
paras.zh: 库尔·安赫尔在过去两次在库拉和约克的比赛中上演帽子戏法。由于他是第一次进入上市公司，现在他的体重增加了五磅。

paras.en: Montassib has not been successful since winning the Haydock Sprint Cup in 2024 but has not been disgraced this season and was fifth in this race last year.
paras.zh: 蒙塔西布自2024年赢得海多克冲刺杯以来一直没有取得成功，但本赛季并没有丢脸，去年在这场比赛中获得了第五名。

paras.en: Others to note include Ed Walker pair Sunday Girl and Midnight Tango, while Irish-raider Unique Journey likes soft ground and has Ryan Moore in the saddle.
paras.zh: 其他值得注意的包括 Ed Walker 组合 Sunday Girl 和 Midnight Tango，而爱尔兰袭击者 Unique Journey 则喜欢松软的地面，并且有 Ryan Moore 坐镇。

paras.en: 2.45 Doncaster - I'm The One and Felicitas headline Gillies Fillies field
paras.zh: 2.45 唐卡斯特 - I'm The One 和 Felicitas 标题 Gillies Fillies field

paras.en: I'm The One and Felicitas headline a deep edition of this Listed Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes at 2.45pm.
paras.zh: I'm The One 和 Felicitas 于下午 2.45 推出深度版《列出的 Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes》。

paras.en: The Ed Walker-trained Felicitas scored on her first two starts before finishing runner-up in the Musidora at York. She has not been beaten far in hot races since and looks an obvious contender down in grade.
paras.zh: 埃德·沃克（Ed Walker）训练的费利西塔斯（Felicitas）在前两场比赛中均取得进球，随后在约克的穆西多拉（Musidora）比赛中获得亚军。从那以后，她在激烈的比赛中就没有被击败过，而且看起来成绩明显下降了。

paras.en: I'm The One, one-time Oaks favourite, returned from a break with a narrow second at Southwell and she will be expected to take a big step forward as she reverts to the turf under Sean Levey.
paras.zh: “I’m The One”曾是橡树队的最爱，她在绍斯韦尔 (Southwell) 比赛中以微弱的第二名从休息中归来，当她回到肖恩·利维 (Sean Levey) 的领导下时，预计她将向前迈出一大步。

paras.en: Revoir is worth a mention after her excellent second in Group Three company in Italy, while Ribbon Of Sea has first-time cheekpieces.
paras.zh: 值得一提的是，Revoir 在意大利第三组比赛中取得了出色的第二名，而 Ribbon Of Sea 则首次获得了面颊。

paras.en: 2.50am Flemington - Defiantly runs in Group Three Handicap. Dylan Browne McMonagle rides.
paras.zh: 2.50am 弗莱明顿 - 顽强地参加第三组让分赛。迪伦·布朗·麦克莫纳格尔骑行。

paras.en: 4.50am Flemington - Group One Champions Sprint where Tempted and Joliestar feature.
paras.zh: 4.50am 弗莱明顿 - 第一组冠军冲刺赛，由 Tempted 和 Joliestar 参加。

paras.en: 5.30am Flemington - Autumn Glow headlines Group One Champions Mile.
paras.zh: 上午 5.30 弗莱明顿 - Autumn Glow 成为第一组冠军英里赛的头条新闻。

paras.en: 6.10am Flemington - Group One Champions Stakes - Aeliana and Sir Delius clash. Cox Plate hero Cosmic Crusader also declared.

articles.title: U.S. Marine dies in Japan during training, military says
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: A U.S. Marine has died in Japan following a “training incident,” the military said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 军方周三在一份声明中表示，一名美国海军陆战队员在日本发生“训练事件”后死亡。

paras.en: The unnamed Marine was undertaking training at Camp Schwab in Okinawa, Japan’s southernmost prefecture, the statement said. The area is home to a large U.S. military presence and bases that serve as a regional hub in the Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 声明称，这名未透露姓名的海军陆战队员正在日本最南端冲绳县的施瓦布军营接受训练。该地区拥有大量美国军事存在和基地，是印度-太平洋地区的区域中心。

paras.en: The Marine, who was with the 3rd Marine Division, died Tuesday and will not be named until 24 hours after the individual’s family has been notified, the 3rd Marine Division said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 海军陆战队第三师周三在一份声明中表示，这名海军陆战队士兵于周二去世，在通知其家人 24 小时后，他的姓名才会被公布。

paras.en: “It is with heavy hearts that 3rd Marine Division announces the death of a Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, Japan, on Nov. 3, 2026,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“海军陆战队第三师怀着沉重的心情宣布一名海军陆战队员在 2026 年 11 月 3 日日本冲绳施瓦布军营发生训练事件后死亡。”

paras.en: “The circumstances surrounding the incident remain under investigation,” it added. “We express our deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of our Marine.”
paras.zh: “事件相关情况仍在调查中，”它补充道。 “我们向我们海军陆战队的家人和亲人表示最深切的哀悼。”

paras.en: Okinawa was under U.S. occupation following World War II until it was handed back to Japan in 1972. Today, the U.S. population on the island is nearly 80,000, with nearly 30,000 being active-duty troops from all four branches of the armed forces, though the Marines make up the bulk of the forces.
paras.zh: 冲绳岛在第二次世界大战后一直处于美国占领之下，直到 1972 年被交还给日本。如今，岛上的美国人口接近 80,000 人，其中近 30,000 人是来自武装部队所有四个军种的现役军人，不过海军陆战队占了部队的主体。

paras.en: Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio last month pledged to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a U.S. Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa. The case sparked widespread protests and led to a U.S. military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥上个月承诺与日本当局合作，调查一名美国海军陆战队员在冲绳谋杀一名妇女的指控。此案引发了广泛的抗议，并导致美国实行军事宵禁以及强制标准和纪律培训。

paras.en: Lt. Gen. Benjamin Watson, commander of the III Marine Expeditionary Force, said at the time that serving on the Japanese island “comes with responsibility.”
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队第三远征军司令本杰明·沃森中将当时表示，在日本岛上服役“伴随着责任”。

articles.title: Live: Rugby League World Cup semifinal weekend begins in Newcastle
articles.author: Michael Doyle

paras.en: Rugby League World Cup live: First semifinals from Newcastle — blog and scores
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟世界杯直播：纽卡斯尔首场半决赛 — 博客和比分

paras.en: A spot in the Rugby League World Cup final is on the line as the first semis in the men's and women's tournaments are held in Newcastle.
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛的席位岌岌可危，男子和女子锦标赛的首场半决赛将在纽卡斯尔举行。

paras.en: New Zealand has both men's and women's sides playing at Hunter Stadium today. The women's Kiwi Ferns meet Samoa, followed by the men's Kiwis facing a fierce Tongan outfit.
paras.zh: 新西兰男队和女队今天在亨特体育场进行比赛。女子新西兰蕨队迎战萨摩亚队，男子新西兰队迎战凶猛的汤加队。

paras.en: Follow the live blog below and tune in to our live radio coverage.
paras.zh: 请关注下面的实时博客并收听我们的现场广播报道。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: The rugby league world lost one of it's great people this week.
paras.zh: 本周，橄榄球联盟世界失去了一位伟大的人物。

paras.en: Paul Langmack, a man who won three premierships with Canterbury in the 1980s, and dedicated so much time in later years to running mental health programs, died this week aged 61.
paras.zh: 保罗·朗马克 (Paul Langmack) 于 20 世纪 80 年代随坎特伯雷三度夺得英超冠军，并在晚年投入了大量时间来开展心理健康项目，他于本周去世，享年 61 岁。

paras.en: Samoa had to make a change after in-form winger Freedom Crichton Ropati suffered an ankle injury last week against England. Anastasia Leatupue (19) comes on to the wing, while Fanua Rimoni starts at lock and Tavarna Papalii moves to the bench.
paras.zh: 萨摩亚队在上周对阵英格兰队的比赛中，状态正佳的边锋弗里德姆·克里顿·罗帕蒂脚踝受伤，萨摩亚队不得不做出改变。阿纳斯塔西娅·利图普（19 岁）出现在边路，法努阿·里莫尼首发，塔瓦尔纳·帕帕利坐上替补席。

paras.en: Despite the underdog status (and a win today would be MASSIVE), Fetu Samoa boasts plenty of talent who have played at the highest level.
paras.zh: 尽管处于劣势（今天的胜利将是巨大的），Fetu Samoa 拥有大量在最高水平比赛中表现出色的人才。

paras.en: Ivana Lolesio knows all about State of Origin with Queensland, Annetta Nuuausala has been in a Test arena for nearly a decade (starting with New Zealand), while players like Destiny Mino-Sinapati (Titans) and Mercedez Taulelei-Siala (Knights) were big reasons their clubs played NRLW finals this season.
paras.zh: Ivana Lolesio 对昆士兰州的起源了如指掌，Annetta Nuuausala 已经在测试赛场上待了近十年（从新西兰开始），而 Destiny Mino-Sinapati（泰坦队）和 Mercedez Taulelei-Siala（骑士队）等球员是他们的俱乐部本赛季打入 NRLW 决赛的重要原因。

paras.en: New Zealand are as advertised earlier in the week.
paras.zh: 新西兰正如本周早些时候所宣传的那样。

paras.en: This is a proper side filled with class, and likely the only nation that could realistically challenge the Jillaroos for this year's tite.
paras.zh: 这是一支充满阶级的球队，并且可能是唯一能够真正挑战吉拉鲁队今年冠军头衔的球队。

paras.en: Halfback Raecene McGregor is a terrific game-manager, while powerhouse centre Mele Hufanga is a good a ball runner as there is in footy.
paras.zh: 中卫雷塞内·麦格雷戈是一位出色的比赛经理，而强力中锋梅勒·胡方加则是一位出色的足球跑动者。

paras.en: Hooker Georgia Hale is a born leader who will organise the team from dummy-half.
paras.zh: 胡克·乔治亚·黑尔（Hooker Georgia Hale）是一位天生的领导者，他将从假半场开始组织球队。

paras.en: We have reached the semifinals, and today, one nation in the men's and women's tournaments will book their spot in next Sunday's final.
paras.zh: 我们已经进入半决赛，今天，男子和女子锦标赛中的一个国家将在下周日的决赛中获得席位。

paras.en: In the first women's semifinal, New Zealand faces Samoa, followed by a blockbuster men's semi — New Zealand vs Tonga.
paras.zh: 在第一场女子半决赛中，新西兰对阵萨摩亚，随后是一场轰动一时的男子半决赛——新西兰对阵汤加。

paras.en: Join us throughout the afternoon and evening as we bring you all of the action from Hunter Stadium in Newcastle.
paras.zh: 请在整个下午和晚上加入我们，我们将为您带来纽卡斯尔亨特体育场的所有赛事。

articles.title: Live: Counting begins in New Zealand election
articles.author: Will Jackson, Doug Dingwall, Nelli Saarinen, and Bang Xiao

paras.en: Live updates: New Zealand 2026 election reactions and results
paras.zh: 实时更新：新西兰 2026 年选举反应和结果

paras.en: A tight election result looms in New Zealand as polls show the leaders of both major parties — incumbent National Party leader Christopher Luxon and Labour's Chris Hipkins — may struggle to form a government alone.
paras.zh: 新西兰的选举结果迫在眉睫，因为民意调查显示两个主要政党的领导人——现任国家党领袖克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)和工党领袖克里斯·希普金斯(Chris Hipkins)——可能很难单独组建政府。

paras.en: Follow the latest updates on our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客上关注最新动态。

paras.en: Observing Kiwis voting today in Auckland was a rather surreal experience — at least for this Australian journalist.
paras.zh: 今天在奥克兰观察新西兰人投票是一次相当超现实的经历——至少对这位澳大利亚记者来说是这样。

paras.en: New Zealand does elections slightly differently from Australia. There are strict election "blackout" rules that restrict all forms of advertising, commentary and campaigning.
paras.zh: 新西兰的选举方式与澳大利亚略有不同。有严格的选举“封锁”规则，限制一切形式的广告、评论和竞选活动。

paras.en: The blackout even applies to reporting, with media banned from broadcasting anything that might influence voters.
paras.zh: 封锁甚至适用于报道，媒体被禁止广播任何可能影响选民的内容。

paras.en: So when you visit a voting booth on election day, it is a bit different to the (occasionally rowdy) festival of democracy you get in Australia.
paras.zh: 因此，当您在选举日参观投票站时，这与您在澳大利亚遇到的（偶尔吵闹的）民主节日有点不同。

paras.en: Nobody is badgering voters with how to vote cards, and there are no party banners, signs or corflutes.
paras.zh: 没有人纠缠选民如何投票卡，也没有政党横幅、标语或彩旗。

paras.en: At the voting place the ABC visited in Auckland's inner suburbs this morning, there was one very familiar thing on hand, however — a sausage sandwich.
paras.zh: 然而，在澳大利亚广播公司今天早上探访的奥克兰内城区的投票地点，手头有一个非常熟悉的东西——香肠三明治。

paras.en: Voting closed at 7pm New Zealand time (5pm AEDT) and vote counting has now begun.
paras.zh: 投票于新西兰时间晚上 7 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 5 点）结束，计票现已开始。

paras.en: The first results are expected to be entered before 7.30pm (NZ time).
paras.zh: 第一批结果预计将在晚上 7.30（新西兰时间）之前输入。

paras.en: You can access the results on the NZ Electoral Commission's results website: http://electionresults.govt.nz
paras.zh: 您可以在新西兰选举委员会的结果网站上查看结果：http://electionresults.govt.nz

paras.en: • results from 50 per cent of voting places by 10pm (NZ time)
paras.zh: • 晚上 10 点（新西兰时间）前公布 50% 投票点的结果

paras.en: • results from 95 per cent of voting places by 11.30pm (NZ time)
paras.zh: • 晚上 11 点 30 分（新西兰时间）公布 95% 投票点的结果

paras.en: However, the count on election night only provides the preliminary results.
paras.zh: 然而，选举之夜的计票结果仅提供了初步结果。

paras.en: We’ll talk a bit more about when the official result is due a bit later.
paras.zh: 我们稍后会详细讨论官方结果何时公布。

paras.en: Voting has closed in New Zealand's election and we will soon see results trickling in.
paras.zh: 新西兰大选投票已经结束，我们很快就会看到结果。

paras.en: In an election campaign overshadowed by cost of living pressures and an economy buffeted by international shocks, the National Party has been making its case to stay in government and Labour has tried to prise back votes it needs to regain office.
paras.zh: 在一场被生活成本压力和经济受到国际冲击打击的竞选活动中，国家党一直在提出留在政府的理由，而工党则试图夺回重新执政所需的选票。

paras.en: But experts say both parties ran negative campaigns.
paras.zh: 但专家表示，两党都开展了负面竞选活动。

paras.en: "I'm not sure anyone has much enjoyed it," Richard Shaw, a professor of politics at Massey University, told the ABC.
paras.zh: “我不确定是否有人很喜欢它，”梅西大学政治学教授理查德·肖告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: "The policy contest which marked the opening stanzas has largely fallen away into an acrimonious exchange between the left and the right about how to game the electoral system through strategic voting."
paras.zh: “以开场白为标志的政策竞赛在很大程度上已经沦为左翼和右翼之间关于如何通过战略投票来博弈选举制度的激烈交锋。”

paras.en: National and Labour focused on criticising not just their rival parties but also the people involved, with Labour trying to seize on the unpopularity of Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and National seeking to exploit similar sentiment about Labour's Chris Hipkins, said Tom Jamieson, a senior lecturer in political science at Victoria University of Wellington.
paras.zh: 惠灵顿维多利亚大学政治学高级讲师汤姆·贾米森(Tom Jamieson)表示，国家党和工党不仅重点批评对手政党，还批评相关人士，工党试图利用总理克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)不受欢迎的机会，而国家党则试图利用工党党魁克里斯·希普金斯(Chris Hipkins)的类似情绪。

paras.en: "For a party leading the incumbent government, National ran less on their record than you might have expected on their record and more about what their opponents were likely to do in power."
paras.zh: “对于领导现任政府的政党来说，国家党的竞选记录比你想象的要少，而更多的是他们的对手掌权后可能采取的行动。”

paras.en: On the other hand, smaller parties including New Zealand First, ACT, the Green Party, Te Pāti Māori and the Opportunity party focused their efforts on policy initiatives and their vision for the country, Dr Jamieson said.
paras.zh: 贾米森博士说，另一方面，包括新西兰优先党、首都领地党、绿党、毛利党和机会党在内的较小政党则将精力集中在政策举措和国家愿景上。

paras.en: "In an electorate with a plurality that has consistently indicated they are on the wrong track, it could be that these parties benefit from dissatisfaction with the direction of the government," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在一个拥有多数席位的选民中，他们一直表明自己走在错误的道路上，这些政党可能会因对政府方向的不满而受益。”

paras.en: Polls have indicated it could be a tight election.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，这可能是一场势均力敌的选举。

paras.en: Results released tonight will indicate the election outcome and are expected to arrive over several hours. The official count begins tomorrow, and the Electoral Commission is aiming to release the official results by November 27.
paras.zh: 今晚公布的结果将表明选举结果，预计将在几个小时内得出。正式计票将于明天开始，选举委员会计划在 11 月 27 日之前公布正式结果。

paras.en: Professor Shaw expected it would be a long three weeks and said special votes — which take longer to count — may be consequential.
paras.zh: 肖教授预计这将是漫长的三周，并表示特别投票（​​需要更长的时间来计票）可能会产生重要影响。

paras.en: "We may have a clear result tonight, but that seems unlikely," he said.
paras.zh: “今晚我们可能会得到明确的结果，但这似乎不太可能，”他说。

paras.en: That stands for "welcome" in Māori, so come join us as we begin our live coverage of the 2026 New Zealand election!
paras.zh: 这在毛利语中代表“欢迎”，所以请加入我们，开始对 2026 年新西兰大选进行现场报道！

paras.en: Voting has just closed at 7pm local time (5pm AEDT).
paras.zh: 投票于当地时间晚上 7 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 5 点）刚刚结束。

paras.en: We're expecting to see the first results coming in soon, but the official results are not anticipated until Friday, November 27.
paras.zh: 我们预计很快就会看到第一批结果，但官方结果预计要到 11 月 27 日星期五才会公布。

paras.en: The polls are showing both major parties may struggle to form a government alone, so it's not just Chris vs Chris (Luxon and Hipkins, leaders of the National and Labour parties).
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，两个主要政党可能很难单独组建政府，因此这不仅仅是克里斯与克里斯（国家党和工党领导人卢克森和希普金斯）之间的较量。

paras.en: The top minor parties may become the "kingmakers" with the power to decide who is next to govern Aotearoa (New Zealand).
paras.zh: 顶级小党可能会成为“拥王者”，有权决定谁是下一个执政新西兰的人。

paras.en: This election is expected to be tightly fought, so strap in as we bring you the latest from across the ditch.
paras.zh: 这次选举预计将是一场激烈的角逐，所以请系好安全带，我们将为您带来来自另一边的最新消息。

articles.title: Man, 75, dies in Goldfields mine incident
articles.author: Daniel Holmes

paras.en: A 75-year-old man has died following a workplace incident at a mine site in Western Australia's Goldfields.
paras.zh: 一名 75 岁的男子在西澳大利亚州金矿区的一个矿场发生工作场所事故后死亡。

paras.en: The incident happened at Regis Resources' Duketon South operation, about 130 kilometres north of Laverton and more than 700km from Perth.
paras.zh: 该事件发生在瑞吉斯资源公司的杜克顿南作业区，位于拉弗顿以北约 130 公里处，距离珀斯 700 多公里。

paras.en: Emergency services were called to the mining camp at Bandya about 12:30pm on Friday, November 6, where mine site medical staff provided first aid before they arrived.
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日星期五中午 12:30 左右，紧急服务人员接到通知前往班迪亚 (Bandya) 采矿营地，矿场医务人员在抵达前提供了急救。

paras.en: Regis Resources confirmed the man was a member of its contract team and was carrying out work at the Duketon South operation when the incident occurred.
paras.zh: Regis Resources 证实，该男子是其合同团队的成员，事件发生时正在杜克顿南工厂工作。

paras.en: Regis Resources says operations at Duketon have been stood down while investigations continue.
paras.zh: 瑞吉斯资源公司表示，杜克顿的业务已停止，调查仍在继续。

paras.en: WorkSafe is investigating the death, with investigators and inspectors making arrangements to attend the scene as soon as practicable.
paras.zh: 工作安全局正在调查这起死亡事件，调查人员和检查人员正在安排尽快前往现场。

paras.en: WA Police will also prepare a report for the Coroner.
paras.zh: 西澳警方还将为验尸官准备一份报告。

paras.en: WorkSafe Commissioner Sally North has extended her condolences to the man’s family, friends and colleagues.
paras.zh: 工作安全局局长萨莉·诺斯向该男子的家人、朋友和同事表示哀悼。

paras.en: Regis Resources says it is providing support to those affected by the incident, with employee assistance programs activated.
paras.zh: 瑞吉斯资源公司表示，它正在为受该事件影响的人提供支持，并启动了员工援助计划。

articles.title: U.S. sanctions Canadian money-exchange businesses allegedly connected to Iranian regime, Ryan Wedding
articles.author: Rhianna Schmunk

paras.en: U.S. sanctions Canadian money-exchange businesses allegedly connected to Iranian regime, Ryan Wedding
paras.zh: 美国制裁涉嫌与伊朗政权有关联的加拿大货币兑换企业瑞安婚礼

paras.en: Companies in Canada gave sanctioned Iranian entities 'financial lifeline,' treasury says
paras.zh: 财政部表示，加拿大公司为受制裁的伊朗实体提供了“财务生命线”

paras.en: The United States government has announced sanctions against several Canadian currency-exchange businesses accused of helping the Iranian regime and, in several cases, also helping the alleged head of a drug trafficking ring.
paras.zh: 美国政府已宣布对多家加拿大货币兑换企业实施制裁，这些企业被指控帮助伊朗政权，并在某些情况下还帮助涉嫌贩毒团伙的头目。

paras.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury on Friday said eight Canadian businesses had helped Iranian entities get around financial sanctions. It said some also helped launder proceeds of crime by changing Iranian rials and other currencies into digital assets, like crypto.
paras.zh: 美国财政部周五表示，八家加拿大企业已帮助伊朗实体规避金融制裁。报告称，一些人还通过将伊朗里亚尔和其他货币兑换成加密货币等数字资产来帮助洗钱犯罪所得。

paras.en: "Canada cannot be a safe haven for illicit financial facilitators that provide sanctions evasion services to the Iranian regime and its proxies," Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent wrote in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在一份声明中写道：“加拿大不能成为向伊朗政权及其代理人提供逃避制裁服务的非法金融服务商的避风港。”

paras.en: The sanctions effectively cut the Canadian firms off from the U.S. dollar-based financial system, blocking any assets the firms might have south of the border and banning any transactions with American people or entities.
paras.zh: 制裁有效地切断了加拿大公司与以美元为基础的金融体系的联系，封锁了这些公司在边境以南可能拥有的任何资产，并禁止与美国人民或实体进行任何交易。

paras.en: In its statement, the treasury said the crackdown is part of a wider effort to "sever the economic lifelines that sustain the Iranian regime" and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), which is listed as a terrorist organization in Canada.
paras.zh: 财政部在声明中表示，此次镇压是“切断维持伊朗政权的经济命脉”和伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）更广泛努力的一部分，该组织在加拿大被列为恐怖组织。

paras.en: The Treasury identified the sanctioned businesses in Ontario and British Columbia as the following:
paras.zh: 财政部确定安大略省和不列颠哥伦比亚省受制裁的企业如下：

paras.en: - Diverse Trade Inc., doing business as Million Exchange in Ontario.
paras.zh: - Diverse Trade Inc.，在安大略省以 Million Exchange 名义开展业务。

paras.en: - 1380079 BC Limited, doing business as Amin Exchange in B.C.
paras.zh: - 1380079 BC Limited，在 BC 省以 Amin Exchange 名义开展业务

paras.en: - Top PC Technician Inc., operating in Ontario.
paras.zh: - Top PC Technician Inc.，在安大略省运营。

paras.en: - NIA Nations Currency Ltd., based in B.C.
paras.zh: - NIA Nations Money Ltd.，总部位于不列颠哥伦比亚省

paras.en: - 2397639 Ontario Ltd., doing business as Farah Exchange.
paras.zh: - 2397639 Ontario Ltd.，以 Farah Exchange 名义开展业务。

paras.en: - B Galaxy Inc., doing business as Cryptoyal from the same Ontario location as CCC Inc.
paras.zh: - B Galaxy Inc.，以 Cryptoyal 名义开展业务，与 CCC Inc. 位于安大略省同一地点。

paras.en: The statement said the companies gave the Iranian regime "financial lifelines" by providing their services. In several cases, officials said the businesses have changed their names and addresses to avoid detection.
paras.zh: 声明称，这些公司通过提供服务为伊朗政权提供了“财务生命线”。官员们表示，在一些情况下，这些企业已经更改了名称和地址以避免被发现。

paras.en: In August, the Trump administration expanded secondary sanctions its government can impose on entities and countries maintaining business connections with Iran, raising the economic pressure on Tehran as the war neared its six-month mark.
paras.zh: 8月，特朗普政府扩大了政府可以对与伊朗保持业务联系的实体和国家实施的二级制裁，随着战争接近六个月，德黑兰面临的经济压力加大。

paras.en: "Our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone," Bessent said at the time.
paras.zh: 贝森特当时表示：“我们的目标是切断维持这个暴政政权的每一条经济命脉，直到德黑兰独立。”

paras.en: In addition, the statement said three of those businesses helped Ryan Wedding — the Olympian-turned-alleged-drug-kingpin — hide money by laundering bulk cash into digital assets. Ultimately, the treasury said companies sent millions of dollars worth of digital funds abroad before Wedding was arrested in January.
paras.zh: 此外，声明还称，其中三家企业帮助瑞安·威丁（Ryan Wedding）——这位奥运选手变身的毒枭——通过将大量现金洗钱成数字资产来藏匿资金。最终，财政部表示，在 Wedding 一月份被捕之前，公司已将价值数百万美元的数字资金转移到国外。

paras.en: CBC News has contacted Wedding's lawyer for comment.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系威丁的律师征求意见。

articles.title: Ousted Paraguayan president placed under house arrest

paras.en: Ousted Paraguayan president placed under house arrest
paras.zh: 被驱逐的巴拉圭总统被软禁

paras.en: Arrest ordered shortly after Senate removed him as president
paras.zh: 参议院罢免他总统职务后不久就下令逮捕

paras.en: Ousted Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed under house arrest Friday on suspicion of breach of trust and influence peddling, among other charges, shortly after the Senate removed him from office over the collapse of a government-linked bank that locked nearly half the country's six million people out of their savings.
paras.zh: 被驱逐的巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳周五因涉嫌违反信任和兜售影响力等罪名而被软禁，此前不久，参议院因一家与政府有联系的银行倒闭而将他免职，该银行导致该国近一半的六百万人无法存款。

paras.en: All 44 senators present voted to remove Peña for misconduct in office, making him the second Paraguayan president ousted by impeachment since the end of Gen. Alfredo Stroessner's 35-year dictatorship in 1989.
paras.zh: 出席会议的 44 名参议员全部投票罢免佩尼亚，因为佩尼亚在任期间行为不当，使他成为自 1989 年阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳将军 35 年独裁统治结束以来第二位因弹劾而被罢免的巴拉圭总统。

paras.en: As the verdict came down, ending what had been seen as one of South America's most stable presidencies, a roar rose from the crowds packed into the plaza outside Congress. Depositors, retirees and students in national soccer jerseys waved Paraguayan flags, sang and hugged, chanting "Dictatorship never again!"
paras.zh: 随着判决的落下，结束了被视为南美洲最稳定的总统任期之一，国会外广场上挤满了人群，爆发出一阵欢呼声。身着国家足球队球衣的储户、退休人员和学生挥舞着巴拉圭国旗、唱歌、拥抱，高呼“独裁政权永远不再出现！”

paras.en: Regulators had seized Ueno Bank just three days earlier, sending shock waves through the financial system and setting off the country's worst political crisis in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 三天前，监管机构查封了上野银行，给金融体系带来了冲击，并引发了该国十多年来最严重的政治危机。

paras.en: Peña was ordered to remain at one of his homes in Asunción until he appears before prosecutors Saturday morning on charges of breach of trust, influence peddling and using public office for personal gain, the most serious of which carry up to 10 years in prison. Lawmakers accuse him of using his political influence to steer hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds into Ueno while regulators overlooked risky insider lending.
paras.zh: 佩纳被勒令留在亚松森的一处家中，直到周六上午出庭受审，罪名是背信弃义、兜售影响力和利用公职谋取私利，最严重的罪名最高可判处 10 年监禁。立法者指责他利用自己的政治影响力将数亿美元的公共资金引导到上野，而监管机构却忽视了有风险的内部贷款。

paras.en: Police ringed the house Friday night as crowds gathered outside, waving flags and vowing to keep vigil until morning to make sure he didn't escape.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，警方包围了这所房子，人群聚集在外面，挥舞着旗帜，并发誓要一直守夜到早上，以确保他不会逃跑。

paras.en: Prosecutors also ordered the arrest of Carlos Carvallo, who ran the finance company that became Ueno until Peña named him central bank chief in 2023. It was not immediately clear whether Carvallo was in custody.
paras.zh: 检察官还下令逮捕卡洛斯·卡瓦洛（Carlos Carvallo），他经营着一家金融公司，后来成为上野（Ueno），直到佩纳于 2023 年任命他为央行行长。目前尚不清楚卡瓦洛是否已被拘留。

paras.en: Vice-President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president Friday to serve out the term, which ends in August 2028.
paras.zh: 副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳于周五宣誓就任总统，任期将于 2028 年 8 月结束。

paras.en: "The Paraguay we receive today has urgent needs," said Alliana, who also is under investigation in connection with the bank's collapse, inherits a government under pressure to return depositors' money and punish those responsible.
paras.zh: “我们今天收到的巴拉圭有紧急需求，”阿利亚纳说，他也因银行倒闭而接受调查，他继承的政府面临着归还储户资金并惩罚责任人的压力。

paras.en: People protest against the government and Ueno Bank in Asunción, Paraguay, on Wednesday. (Jorge Saenz/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周三，巴拉圭亚松森，人们抗议政府和上野银行。 （豪尔赫·萨恩斯/美联社）

paras.en: In a farewell message before the verdict, Peña said that he did not want his "presence to be a cause of greater division or instability."
paras.zh: 佩纳在判决前的告别辞中表示，他不希望自己的“存在成为更大分裂或不稳定的原因”。

paras.en: "I say goodbye with gratitude, without ignoring the anguish of those who are waiting for answers today," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“我满怀感激地告别，同时也没有忽视那些今天等待答案的人们的痛苦。”

paras.en: Public outrage has become more thunderous by the day. As senators deliberated Friday, protesters demanding their frozen savings back and accountability for Ueno's failure marched through downtown Asunción chanting, "Santi Peña to Tacumbú!" — a reference to the capital's main prison, where Ueno's founder and former CEO, Miguel Vázquez, is now being held.
paras.zh: 公众的愤怒日益强烈。当参议员们周五进行审议时，抗议者要求退回被冻结的储蓄，并为上野的失败承担责任，他们在亚松森市中心游行，高呼“桑蒂佩纳到塔库姆布！” ——指的是首都的主要监狱，上野的创始人兼前首席执行官米格尔·巴斯克斯 (Miguel Vázquez) 目前被关押在那里。
